fields.description_zh:
確認申報醫院之醫事機構代碼。
欄位位置：1–10
fields.description_en:
Confirm the healthcare facility code of the reporting hospital.
Field position: 1–10
fields.purpose_zh: 確認申報醫院。
fields.guide_zh: 各家醫院均有醫事機構代碼，依申報醫院之「健保申報代碼」填入。
fields.purpose_en: Confirms the reporting hospital.
fields.guide_en: Every hospital has a healthcare facility code; enter the reporting hospital's "NHI claim code".

fields.description_zh:
記錄個案於申報醫院之病歷號碼。
欄位位置：11–20
fields.description_en:
Record the medical record number of the case at the reporting hospital.
Field position: 11–20
fields.purpose_zh: 用來辨識個案及作為調閱病歷之依據；亦可作為辨識個案是否有多重原發腫瘤之依據。
fields.guide_zh:  記錄個案在申報醫院之病歷號碼。 若病歷號碼少於10碼，則直接填入病歷號碼，資料向左靠、後面留空白；若有英文字母請大寫。 若病歷號碼未知，則編碼為9999999999。
fields.purpose_en: Used to identify the case and as the basis for retrieving medical records; can also be used to identify whether the case has multiple primary tumors.
fields.guide_en: • Record the patient's medical record number at the reporting hospital. • If the medical record number has fewer than 10 characters, enter it directly, left-aligned with trailing blanks; use capital letters for any letters. • If the medical record number is unknown, code 9999999999.

fields.description_zh:
填寫個案的姓名。
欄位位置：21–30
fields.description_en:
Enter the name of the case.
Field position: 21–30
fields.purpose_zh: 用來辨識個案。
fields.guide_zh:  本欄位不可空白，若不知道個案的姓名，則編碼為不詳。 若電腦中無此字，請用「？」全形字體替代；字與字中間不可空白。
fields.purpose_en: Used to identify the case.
fields.guide_en: This field must not be blank; if the case's name is not known, code it as unknown. If the character is not available in the computer, substitute a full-width question mark; no spaces are allowed between characters.

fields.description_zh:
記錄個案的身分證統一編號。
欄位位置：31–40
fields.description_en:
Record the national ID number of the case.
Field position: 31–40
fields.purpose_zh: 用來辨識個案。
fields.guide_zh:  記錄個案的身分證統一編號。 身分證統一編號應確實詳填，並需與性別符合，身分證統一編號英文字母後第一位數字若為1則為男性，2則為女性。 身分證統一編號若不詳，應設法透過各種管道查證，如：詳閱病歷資料(住院許可證、手術同意書、護理紀錄單等)、醫院電腦系統、或直接向個案及相關人員查詢等。
fields.purpose_en: Used to identify the case.
fields.guide_en: Record the case's national identification number. The national identification number must be filled in accurately and must match the sex; if the first digit after the letter of the national identification number is 1, the case is male, and if 2, female. If the national identification number is unknown, try to verify it through various channels, such as carefully reading medical record data (admission permit, surgical consent form, nursing record sheets, etc.), the hospital computer system, or inquiring directly with the case and related persons.

fields.description_zh:
確認個案的性別。
欄位位置：41–41
fields.description_en:
Confirm the sex of the case.
Field position: 41–41
fields.purpose_zh: 可作為各癌症部位性別比例及預後之比較。個案若有多重原發，其病歷紀錄上的性別都應相同。
fields.guide_zh:  記錄病歷上個案的性別。 需注意個案性別應與其身分證統一編號性別碼相符合。 編碼4：變性人(transsexual)係指經手術方式改變原本之性別。
fields.purpose_en: Can be used to compare sex ratios and prognosis by cancer site. If a case has multiple primaries, the sex recorded in the medical record should be the same.
fields.guide_en: Record the case's sex as documented in the medical record. Note that the case's sex should match the sex code of the national identification number. Code 4: Transsexual refers to a person whose original sex was changed surgically.

fields.description_zh:
確認個案的出生日期。
欄位位置：42–49
fields.description_en:
Confirm the date of birth of the case.
Field position: 42–49
fields.purpose_zh: 有助於確認個案的身份；對於以個案世代研究(patient cohort)作為腫瘤分析也很有幫助。
fields.guide_zh:
 依病歷上所記載來記錄個案的出生日期。 若出生日期不詳者，應設法透過各種管道查證，或直接與個案或相關人員查詢。 民國年換算為西元年，年度為民國前者，以「1912」減民國前年度；民國後，以「1911」加民國年度。例如民前5年為西元1907年，民國5年則為西元1916年。年 月 日使用4位數字的西元年 01 1 月 01 9999 年不詳 02 2 月 02 03 3 月 03 … … … … 10 10 月 29 11 11 月 30 12 12 月 31 99 月不詳 99 日不詳範例：編碼：案例
19060630：個案出生日期為民國前 6年 6月30日。
19409999：個案在民國 89 年 6 月 15 日時是 60 歲，在病歷記錄中並無記載其出生日期。則記錄月份和日期未知(分別為 99, 99)，並推算其出生年份為民國 29年。
19279999：病歷上僅記載個案之出生年份是民國 16年。
fields.purpose_en: Helps confirm the case's identity; also useful for tumor analysis using a patient cohort.
fields.guide_en:
Record the case's date of birth as written in the medical record. If the date of birth is unknown, try to verify it through various channels, or inquire directly with the case or relevant persons. To convert an ROC year to a Western (AD) year: for years before the ROC era, subtract the number of years before the ROC from "1912"; for ROC years, add the ROC year to "1911". For example, 5 years before the ROC is AD 1907, and ROC year 5 is AD 1916. Year Month Day Use a 4-digit Western (AD) year 01 January 01 9999 Year unknown 02 February 02 03 March 03 ... ... ... ... 10 October 29 11 November 30 12 December 31 99 Month unknown 99 Day unknown Examples: Code: Case
19060630: The case's date of birth is June 30, 6 years before the ROC (1906).
19409999: The case was 60 years old on June 15, ROC year 89 (2000), and the medical record does not document the date of birth. Record month and day as unknown (99, 99 respectively), and estimate the year of birth as ROC year 29 (1940).
19279999: The medical record documents only that the case's year of birth was ROC year 16 (1927).

fields.description_zh:
記錄個案在診斷為癌症時之戶籍地代碼。
欄位位置：50–53
fields.description_en:
Record the registered household address code of the case at the time of cancer diagnosis.
Field position: 50–53
fields.purpose_zh: 為個案流行病學之地域資料，並可作為癌症群聚或環境因素研究分析。
fields.guide_zh:  記錄身分證上戶籍地址之鄉鎮市區代碼，依附錄A「戶籍地代碼表」填入。 病歷上若有二個(含)以上地址時，應予以詳細查明，勿任意填選。癌症確認
fields.purpose_en: Epidemiological geographic data on the case, which can be used for analysis of cancer clusters or environmental factors.
fields.guide_en: • Record the township/district code of the registered household address on the identity card, filled in according to Appendix A "Household registration code table".• If the medical record has two or more addresses, check carefully and do not choose arbitrarily.Cancer confirmation

fields.description_zh:
記錄個案診斷此癌症時之實足年齡。
欄位位置：54–56
fields.description_en:
Record the age in completed years of the case at diagnosis of this cancer.
Field position: 54–56
fields.purpose_zh: 有助於個案的確認，且對於統計分析癌症相關資料時，年齡常是一個重要的因素。
fields.guide_zh:  記錄個案診斷為此癌症時的實足年齡。 若個案有多個原發癌症，診斷年齡應該依不同原發而個別計算。 若個案於2010年1月1日(含)之後在子宮內即被診斷為癌症者(in utero diagnosis)，診斷年齡為000。
fields.purpose_en: Helps identify the case, and age is often an important factor in statistical analysis of cancer-related data.
fields.guide_en: Record the case's exact age in full years at the time of diagnosis of this cancer. If the case has multiple primary cancers, the age at diagnosis should be calculated separately for each primary. If a case was diagnosed with cancer in utero (in utero diagnosis) on or after January 1, 2010, the age at diagnosis is 000.

fields.description_zh:
指個案一生中所罹患惡性腫瘤的發生順序。
欄位位置：57–58
fields.description_en:
Indicates the order of occurrence of the malignant tumors the case has had over a lifetime.
Field position: 57–58
fields.purpose_zh: 可用來選擇單一原發腫瘤個案及進行特定的追蹤研究，並可分析發生多發腫瘤的因子。
fields.guide_zh:
 編碼01代表個案的第1個惡性腫瘤，而後續腫瘤的譯碼數字則依序類推。 如果同時診斷出2個或2個以上的惡性腫瘤或原位癌時，則預後最差的診斷給予最低順序的號碼。若其預後沒有差異性，則順序號碼的決定就沒有硬性規定。 若申報醫院在稍後得知有尚未登錄的腫瘤且會影響到腫瘤發生的順序，則應該要再重新編腫瘤發生順序號碼。範例：編碼：案例
01：個案以前並無癌症病史，在民國 92年6月13日診斷出有乳房原位癌。
02：個案在民國 92年6月13日診斷為乳癌，之後在民國 92年8月30日診斷為皮膚黑色素瘤之癌症發生順序號碼。
fields.purpose_en: Can be used to select single-primary-tumor cases for specific follow-up studies, and to analyze factors in the occurrence of multiple tumors.
fields.guide_en:
• Code 01 represents the 1st malignant tumor of the case, and the codes of subsequent tumors follow in order. • If 2 or more malignant tumors or carcinomas in situ are diagnosed at the same time, the diagnosis with the worst prognosis is given the lowest sequence number. If there is no difference in prognosis, there is no fixed rule for deciding the sequence numbers. • If the reporting hospital later learns of a tumor that has not yet been recorded and that affects the sequence of tumor occurrence, the tumor sequence numbers should be reassigned. Example: Code: Case
01: The patient had no previous cancer history and was diagnosed with breast carcinoma in situ on June 13, ROC year 92 (2003).
02: The patient was diagnosed with breast cancer on June 13, ROC year 92 (2003), and then diagnosed with skin melanoma on August 30, ROC year 92 (2003); this is the cancer occurrence sequence number.

fields.description_zh:
將個案進行分類。
欄位位置：59–59
fields.description_en:
Classify the case.
Field position: 59–59
fields.purpose_zh: 在做治療和存活分析時，本欄位將個案分為可分析和不可分析個案兩類。進而提供申報醫院進行研究個案之選擇。
fields.guide_zh:
 個案分類包括0、1、2、3、5、7、8、9共8類。可分析治療和存活的個案編碼為1-2；不可分析個案編碼為0，3-9。 癌症診療臨床情境可以非常錯綜複雜，癌症登記師在申報個案資料時，必須參考在規定申報期限內所有相關的病歷資料，以完成正確個案分類。 個案分類的編碼必須經由綜合判斷「2.3.1診斷狀態分類 」及「2.3.2治療狀態分類」兩個新欄位的編碼，方能正確的摘錄。 Class 1 及 Class 2 個案必須詳細申報所有項目(包含SSFs)。 Class 0 個案不需申報欄位序號#4.1~4.5.2及#7.1~7.6以”9”補滿；#8.1~8.10以”988”編碼。但個案拒絕治療或在治療前即死亡或病危出院，則「首次療程開始日期」欄位應摘錄拒絕治療、病危出院或死亡日期。 Class 3 個案不需申報欄位序號#3.1~4.5.2及#7.1~7.6以”9”補滿；#8.1~8.10以”988”編碼。 Class 3 個案如在該申報醫院被診斷復發，或接受癌症復發治療，應申報欄位序號#5.1~5.4各個項目，以利存活分析。 於申報醫院診斷並於申報醫院訂定首次療程為不予治療的個案，個案分類編碼是1，不可編碼為0。 雙碼分類為12、15、16、19的Class 0個案，必須是在申報期限內，確實未於申報醫院接受任何治療，方能以上述分類申報。 Class 0中雙碼分類為12的個案，申報醫院必須確認個案接受後續診療的醫院，方能以雙碼12申報此個案。 可分析個案Analytic case :雙碼11、13、14個案(class 1)及21、23、24個案(class 2)。 不可分析個案Non-analytic case: 雙碼10、12、15、16、19個案 (class 0) 及雙碼20、22、25、26、27、29、30、32、34、35、36、37、39個案 (class 3) 不需申報個案: 個案分類為編碼 7、8 者，不需申報。 於他院診斷，但為了其他疾病至申報醫院求診之個案，不需申報。 首次療程與後續治療定義請詳見總論說明。 根據「2.3.1診斷狀態分類 」及「2.3.2治療狀態分類」綜合判斷「2.3個案分類 」：範例：診斷：治療個案狀態：狀態分類：案例分類：分類編碼編碼：編碼
0：1 0 個案因暈眩、跌倒而到申報醫院，做腦部電腦斷層及核磁共振造影檢查，結果發現腦部的雙葉有多重性轉移情形，肺部電腦斷層發現右上肺葉有 4公分腫塊且縱膈腔及肺門處有淋巴結病變，診斷為肺癌併腦部轉移。個案因病情急速惡化，未能接受任何治療即死亡。
0：1 2 個案因暈眩、跌倒而到申報醫院，做腦部電腦斷層及核磁共振造影檢查，結果發現腦部的雙葉有多重性轉移情形，肺部電腦斷層發現右上肺葉有 4公分腫塊且縱膈腔及肺門處有淋巴結病變，診斷為肺癌併腦部轉移。個案自動出院，申報醫院僅獲知個案已自行前往 B 醫院，但申報醫院未能得知個案在 B 醫院的診療詳情。
0：1 5 個案因暈眩、跌倒而到申報醫院，做腦部電腦斷層及核磁共振造影檢查，結果發現腦部的雙葉有多重性轉移情形，肺部電腦斷層發現右上肺葉有 4公分腫塊且縱膈腔及肺門處有淋巴結病變，診斷為肺癌併腦部轉移。個案未接受進一步治療即出院，後續追蹤獲知個案服用中草藥治療肺癌。
0：1 5 個案因咳血痰而住院，到申報醫院檢查發現右上肺葉有腫塊，切片證實為腺癌，臨床期別第一期，主責醫師建議手術切除，個案起初拒絕手術而服用中草藥治療肺癌；個案於最初診斷日第三個月，惡化為臨床期別第三期時，才開始接受放射治療。
0：1 6 個案因陰道不正常出血至申報醫院檢查，經子宮內膜刮除(D & C)切片證實為子宮內膜癌，臨床期別第一期，主責醫師建議手術切除，但個案拒絕；於最初診斷日一年後，個案回診並重新評估臨床期別仍為第一期，且接受手術切除。
0：1 6 個案因咳血痰而住院，到申報醫院檢查發現右上肺葉有腫塊，切片證實為腺癌，臨床期別第一期，主責醫師建議手術切除，但個案未接受該治療；個案於最初診斷日第五個月，惡化為臨床期別第三期時，才開始接受放射治療。
0：1 6 個案因暈眩、跌倒而到申報醫院，做腦部電腦斷層及核磁共振造影檢查，結果發現腦部的雙葉有多重性轉移情形，肺部電腦斷層發現右上肺葉有 4公分腫塊且縱膈腔及肺門處有淋巴結病變，診斷為肺癌併腦部轉移。個案未接受進一步治療即出院，並拒絕追蹤。
0：1 9 個案因乳房腫塊，到申報醫院接受切片證實為原發性乳癌，但個案失聯且無法追蹤。診斷：治療個案狀態：狀態分類：案例分類：分類編碼編碼：編碼
1：1 1 個案因咳血痰而住院，到申報醫院檢查發現右上肺葉有腫塊，切片證實為腺癌，且在申報醫院接受手術及放射治療。
1：1 1 個案因咳血痰而住院，到申報醫院檢查發現右上肺葉有腫塊，切片證實為腺癌，臨床期別第一期，主責醫師建議手術切除，但因為充血性心衰竭治療，個案於最初診斷日第五個月後，才接受手術切除仍為臨床期別第一期的肺癌。
1：1 1 個案因咳血痰而住院，到申報醫院檢查發現右上肺葉有腫塊，切片證實為腺癌，臨床期別第一期，個案起初拒絕手術而服用中草藥治療肺癌；於最初診斷日第五個月後，重新評估臨床期別仍為第一期，並接受手術切除。
1：1 1 個案因咳血痰而住院，到申報醫院檢查發現右上肺葉有腫塊，切片證實為腺癌，臨床期別第一期，主責醫師建議手術切除，但個案猶豫不決；個案於最初診斷日第五個月後，重新評估臨床期別仍為第一期，並同意接受手術切除。
1：1 1 個案因咳血痰而住院，到申報醫院檢查發現右上肺葉有腫塊，切片證實為腺癌，臨床期別第一期，主責醫師建議手術切除，個案未接受；於最初診斷日六個月後，重新評估臨床期別仍為第一期，並進行放射治療。
1：1 1 個案因腹痛至申報醫院，腹部超音波發現個案脾臟腫大且抽血發現紅血球過高，再經由 JAK2 檢驗被醫師診斷為真性多紅血球症(Polycythemia vera，PV)；為使紅血球數降低個案在申報醫院接受放血治療(phlebotomy)，且因合併脾臟腫大接受口服化學治療。
1：1 1 個案因貧血而到申報醫院，經由抽血、骨髓切片檢查被醫師診斷為 Acute promyelocytic leukemia (APL)，在申報醫院先接受 Retinoid acid（ATRA）及類固醇藥物再進行化療治療。

fields.purpose_en: For treatment and survival analysis, this field classifies cases as analytic or non-analytic, thereby helping the reporting hospital select cases for research.
fields.guide_en:
• Case classes comprise 8 categories: 0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 8 and 9. Cases analyzable for treatment and survival are coded 1-2; non-analytic cases are coded 0 and 3-9. • Clinical scenarios in cancer care can be very complex. When reporting case data, the cancer registrar must consult all relevant medical records within the prescribed reporting period in order to assign the correct case class. • The case class code must be abstracted by jointly considering the codes of the two new fields "2.3.1 Diagnostic status class" and "2.3.2 Treatment status class". • Class 1 and Class 2 cases must have all items reported in detail (including SSFs). • For Class 0 cases, field serial numbers #4.1~4.5.2 and #7.1~7.6 need not be reported and are filled with "9"; #8.1~8.10 are coded "988". However, if the case refused treatment, or died or was discharged in critical condition before treatment, the "Date of first course of treatment start" field should record the date of refusal, critical discharge or death. • For Class 3 cases, field serial numbers #3.1~4.5.2 and #7.1~7.6 need not be reported and are filled with "9"; #8.1~8.10 are coded "988". • If a Class 3 case is diagnosed with recurrence at the reporting hospital, or receives treatment for cancer recurrence there, report each item of field serial numbers #5.1~5.4 to facilitate survival analysis. • A case diagnosed at the reporting hospital for which the reporting hospital determined that the first course of treatment is no treatment is coded case class 1 and must not be coded 0. • Class 0 cases with two-digit class 12, 15, 16 or 19 may be reported under these classes only if the case definitely received no treatment at the reporting hospital within the reporting period. • For a Class 0 case with two-digit class 12, the reporting hospital must confirm the hospital where the case received subsequent care before the case can be reported as two-digit 12. • Analytic cases: two-digit 11, 13, 14 (class 1) and 21, 23, 24 (class 2). • Non-analytic cases: two-digit 10, 12, 15, 16, 19 (class 0) and two-digit 20, 22, 25, 26, 27, 29, 30, 32, 34, 35, 36, 37, 39 (class 3). • Cases not required to be reported: cases with case class code 7 or 8 need not be reported. • Cases diagnosed at another facility who visit the reporting hospital for other diseases need not be reported. • For definitions of first course of treatment and subsequent treatment, see the general introduction. • Determine "2.3 Case class" by jointly considering "2.3.1 Diagnostic status class" and "2.3.2 Treatment status class". fields.purpose_zh: 與新增欄位2.3.1「診斷狀態分類」並用，以確保欄位 2.3「個案分類」的正確性。此欄位並協助記錄個案未於申報醫院接受首次療程的原因，以協助申報醫院改善管理個案流失；並提供此數據作為公衛行政資源調整的依據。
fields.guide_zh:
 如果病歷中沒有治療計畫、也沒有制定好的治療或處置指引可供參考，同時無法諮詢到主責醫師時，請參考以下原則：「首次療程必須起始於最初診斷日期的四個月之內」。 治療狀態分類編碼2(他院診療)、5(接受另類療法)、6 (拒絕治療)、9(失聯或首次療程不詳)的優先順序依次為2、5、6、9。 申報醫院若有委託他院執行部分放射治療，視為申報醫院接受部分首次療程，也於他院接受部分首次療程，編碼為113。 申報醫院若僅被委託執行部分放射治療，則視為申報醫院沒有執行首次療程，應編碼為322。 治療狀態分類編碼4為醫師決定不予以治療、再密切觀察(Watchful observation)、僅給予非腫瘤切除之緩和性手術、疼痛控制(pain control)、支持療法(supportive care)或轉介安寧照護。例如：若攝護腺癌個案僅接受TURP，後續醫生選擇積極監測(Active surveillance)或予以密切觀察(Watchful waiting)，「治療狀態分類」編碼為4，且「首次療程開始日期」應摘錄決定積極監測或密切觀察的日期。 若個案接受其他治療，其「治療狀態分類」欄位應編碼為1，下列處置為「治療狀態分類」欄位所定義之其他治療： UV therapy (ultraviolet) for skin cancer or cutaneous lymphoma. Trichloroacetic acid for anal intraepithelial neoplasia, grade III (AIN III) ONLY. Antibiotics/anti-microbials/anti-viral agents, such as anti-helicobacter pylori for gastric MALT lymphoma ONLY. Retinoid acid (ATRA) for acute promyelocytic leukemia (APL) ONLY. Anagrelide HCl for Essential thrombocythemia ONLY. Phlebotomy for polycythemia vera ONLY Blood-thinners and/or anti-clotting agents for essential thrombocythemia (9962/3) ONLY. 非肝癌個案接受TAE治療。注意: 其他治療若後續有新增處置，將以SEER 網站上之藥物查詢工具為依據:
http://seer.cancer.gov/tools/seerrx/。 檢索藥物時，若藥劑類別(category)顯示為 Other therapy 時，則視為其他治療。 藥劑類別若已清楚明示 (e.g. chemotherapy)，則將該藥物摘錄至適當治療欄位。 若無法在SEER*Rx 查詢到之藥物，請勿直接摘錄為其他治療，應先諮詢主責醫師。 根據 Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasm Coding Manual第24頁，"輸血"不視為癌症治療，而是症狀緩解，故「治療狀態分類」欄位應編碼為4。Do not collect blood transfusions (whole blood, platelets, etc.) as treatment. Blood transfusions are used widely to treat anemia and it is not possible to collect this procedure in a meaningful way. 「治療狀態分類」欄位編碼4與6之釐清： 若個案拒絕醫師或臨床指引建議之首次治療，但接受非腫瘤切除之緩和性手術、疼痛控制、支持療法、轉介安寧照護或其他治療者，其「治療狀態分類」欄位應編碼為4。 若個案拒絕醫師或臨床指引建議之首次治療，且未接受非腫瘤切除之緩和性手術、疼痛控制、支持療法、轉介安寧照護或其他治療者，其「治療狀態分類」欄位應編碼為6。 若個案僅接受其他治療，則「首次療程開始日期」應摘錄執行其他治療的日期。 治療狀態分類編碼5中所指的另類治療為本手冊未規範定義之各種療法，而且個案自行認定該療法對癌症有療效的治療。這些另類療法包括，但不僅限定於中草藥、氣功、生機療法及個案在未參與癌症診療認證合格的診所或醫療機構所接受被宣稱具有療效的免疫療法。 治療狀態分類編碼7(他院診療)必須伴隨診斷狀況分類碼為2或3。範例： 詳見2.3「個案分類」編碼案例
fields.purpose_en: Used together with the newly added field 2.3.1 "Diagnosis status category" to ensure the accuracy of field 2.3 "Case category". This field also helps record the reason the case did not receive the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital, to help the reporting hospital improve management of lost cases, and provides these data as a basis for adjusting public health administrative resources.
fields.guide_en:
If the medical record has no treatment plan and no established treatment or management guideline for reference, and the attending physician cannot be consulted, refer to the following principle: "The first course of treatment must begin within four months of the date of initial diagnosis." The order of priority for treatment status codes 2 (treated at another facility), 5 (received alternative therapy), 6 (refused treatment) and 9 (lost to follow-up or first course of treatment unknown) is 2, 5, 6, 9 in that order. If the reporting hospital commissioned another hospital to perform part of the radiation therapy, it is regarded as the reporting hospital having received part of the first course of treatment and also having received part of the first course of treatment at another hospital; code 113. If the reporting hospital was only commissioned to perform part of the radiation therapy, it is regarded as the reporting hospital not having performed the first course of treatment; code 322. Treatment status code 4 is for cases in which the physician decided not to treat and to continue watchful observation, gave only palliative surgery without tumor resection, pain control, supportive care, or referral to hospice care. For example: if a prostate cancer case received only TURP and the physician subsequently chose active surveillance or watchful waiting, the "Treatment status" is coded 4, and the "Date of first course of treatment start" should be abstracted as the date on which active surveillance or watchful waiting was decided. If the case received other treatment, its "Treatment status" field should be coded 1; the following procedures are the other treatments defined for the "Treatment status" field: UV therapy (ultraviolet) for skin cancer or cutaneous lymphoma. Trichloroacetic acid for anal intraepithelial neoplasia, grade III (AIN III) ONLY. Antibiotics/anti-microbials/anti-viral agents, such as anti-helicobacter pylori for gastric MALT lymphoma ONLY. Retinoid acid (ATRA) for acute promyelocytic leukemia (APL) ONLY. Anagrelide HCl for Essential thrombocythemia ONLY. Phlebotomy for polycythemia vera ONLY Blood-thinners and/or anti-clotting agents for essential thrombocythemia (9962/3) ONLY. TAE treatment in a case that is not liver cancer. Note: if additional procedures are added to other treatment later, the SEER drug lookup tool on the SEER website will be used as the basis:
http://seer.cancer.gov/tools/seerrx/. When looking up a drug, if the drug category shows Other therapy, it is regarded as other treatment. If the drug category is clearly stated (e.g. chemotherapy), abstract the drug in the appropriate treatment field. If a drug cannot be found in SEER*Rx, do not abstract it directly as other treatment; first consult the attending physician. According to page 24 of the Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasm Coding Manual, "blood transfusion" is not regarded as cancer treatment but as symptom relief, so the "Treatment status" field should be coded 4. Do not collect blood transfusions (whole blood, platelets, etc.) as treatment. Blood transfusions are used widely to treat anemia and it is not possible to collect this procedure in a meaningful way. Clarification of codes 4 and 6 of the "Treatment status" field: If the case refused the first treatment recommended by the physician or clinical guidelines but received palliative surgery without tumor resection, pain control, supportive care, referral to hospice care or other treatment, its "Treatment status" field should be coded 4. If the case refused the first treatment recommended by the physician or clinical guidelines and did not receive palliative surgery without tumor resection, pain control, supportive care, referral to hospice care or other treatment, its "Treatment status" field should be coded 6. If the case received only other treatment, the "Date of first course of treatment start" should be abstracted as the date on which the other treatment was performed. The alternative therapy referred to in treatment status code 5 means various therapies not defined or regulated in this manual and that the case themselves considers effective against cancer. These alternative therapies include, but are not limited to, Chinese herbal medicine, qigong, biological/organic therapy, and immunotherapy claimed to be effective that the case received at a clinic or medical institution not accredited for cancer care. Treatment status code 7 (treated at another facility) must be accompanied by a diagnostic status classification code of 2 or 3. Examples: See 2.3 "Case classification" Code: Case

fields.description_zh:
個案因此癌症至申報醫院門診或住院之最早日期。
欄位位置：62–69
fields.description_en:
Earliest date the case came to the reporting hospital as an outpatient or inpatient for this cancer.
Field position: 62–69
fields.purpose_zh: 可用來計算個案首次就診至進行癌症登記之時間間隔；也可用來計算首次就診至治療之時間差距，以作為監控癌症照護品質之用。
fields.guide_zh:
 記錄個案因此癌症至申報醫院門診或住院之最早日期。 本欄位可以是個案於門診作切片檢查、放射線檢查、實驗室檢查的日期。 若個案由屍體解剖時才診斷為癌症(個案分類為5)或僅由死亡證明書診斷為癌症(個案分類為8)，則以死亡日期作為首次就診日期。範例：編碼：案例
20040212：個案於民國 93年2月12日在申報醫院門診接受乳房攝影檢查結果懷疑是惡性，之後於民國 93年2月14 日作切除性切片檢查(excisional biopsy)或根除性手術。則乳房攝影的日期(民國 93年2月12日)即為個案之首次就診日期。
20030914：個案於民國 92年9月8日在私人診所中作切片檢查，其病理標本送至申報醫院判讀為惡性黑色素瘤。個案於民國 92年9月14 日在申報醫院進行廣泛性再切除手術。
20041207：個案因嚴重頭痛和失去方向感等症狀，於民國 93 年12月7日接受腦部磁振造影檢查懷疑是星狀細胞瘤，於民國 93年12月19 日接受手術切除全部的腫瘤。
20050999：住進申報醫院的確切日期不詳，只知道是民國94 年9月。
fields.purpose_en: Can be used to calculate the interval from the case's first visit to cancer registration; can also be used to calculate the interval from first visit to treatment, for monitoring the quality of cancer care.
fields.guide_en:
• Record the earliest date the patient came to the reporting hospital's outpatient clinic or was admitted for this cancer.• This field may be the date the patient had a biopsy, radiologic examination, or laboratory examination at the outpatient clinic.• If the patient was diagnosed with cancer only at autopsy (case class 5) or only from the death certificate (case class 8), use the date of death as the date of first visit. Examples: Code: Case
20040212: A patient had a mammogram at the reporting hospital's outpatient clinic on 12 February ROC year 93 (2004) with a result suspicious for malignancy, and underwent excisional biopsy or radical surgery on 14 February ROC year 93 (2004). The mammography date (12 February ROC year 93 (2004)) is the patient's date of first visit.
20030914: A patient had a biopsy at a private clinic on 8 September ROC year 92 (2003), and the pathology specimen was sent to the reporting hospital, where it was read as malignant melanoma. The patient underwent wide re-excision at the reporting hospital on 14 September ROC year 92 (2003).
20041207: A patient with symptoms such as severe headache and disorientation had a brain MRI on 7 December ROC year 93 (2004) suspicious for astrocytoma, and underwent surgical resection of the entire tumor on 19 December ROC year 93 (2004).
20050999: The exact date of admission to the reporting hospital is unknown; it is only known to be September ROC year 94 (2005).

fields.description_zh:
記錄此癌症最早被醫師診斷的日期。
欄位位置：70–77
fields.description_en:
Record the date this cancer was first diagnosed by a physician.
Field position: 70–77
fields.purpose_zh: 可計算癌症最初診斷日期至完成分期或開始治療的時間間隔。
fields.guide_zh:
 最初診斷日期可以是臨床或病理上診斷為癌症的開始日期。亦即「個案在申報醫院或外院被醫師診斷為癌症(或疑似癌症)的第一天」。需注意本欄位日期一定小於或等於「最後聯絡或死亡日期」。 若細胞學檢查(cytology)報告中使用含糊不清的詞彙，例如”suspicious for malignancy”只有在切片檢查為陽性或醫師有臨床判斷並支持此細胞學檢查時，才可編碼為最初診斷日期。 若僅是異常腫瘤指標不可視為癌症確診方式，需採用臨床判斷、病理或細胞學檢查確認陽性的日期，才可作為最初診斷日期，不可回推至該腫瘤指標採檢日為最初診斷日期。例如︰個案PSA值升高，但理學檢查為陰性。醫生建議個案接受攝護腺細針切片( fine needle biopsy)，病理報告結果為adenocarcinoma；則最初診斷日期應為切片日期(不可將PSA報告日或是採檢日作為最初診斷日期)。例如︰個案PSA值升高，但理學檢查為陰性。醫生於病歷上描述懷疑病人有攝護腺癌並建議個案接受攝護腺細針切片，切片結果為陽性，證實醫生的懷疑；則最初診斷日期應摘錄醫生描述懷疑為攝護腺癌的日期。注意︰僅有異常腫瘤指標不可視為癌症最初診斷日期。 若特定癌別之影像報告和數據系統(Imaging Reporting and Data System, RADS)分類結果符合下列可申報條件，且後續經顯微鏡證實為癌症或醫師有臨床判斷並支持此檢查報告時，該影像檢查日期可視為最初診斷日期。RADS可申報分類有： 肝癌LI-RADS 分類4、5 攝護腺癌 PI-RADS 分類4、5 乳癌BI-RADS 分類4、4A、4B、4C、5 肺癌Lung-RADS 分類4A、4B、4X例如：個案接受乳房篩檢，其乳房攝影結果BI-RADS分類為4C。後續至醫院接受切片，證實為乳房原位癌，則個案最初診斷日期應摘錄BI-RADS影像檢查日期。 個案經診斷為白血病或其他血液腫瘤疾患(排除淋巴癌)者： 疑似癌症的日期不可摘錄為最初診斷日期。注意：白血病個案若周邊血液(peripheral blood) blast≧20%，雖然醫師於病歷描述為rule out leukemia，仍可視為確診。(此適用於2023診斷年之前個案) 僅單次全血球計數(CBC)或白血球計數(WBC)報告確診，或多份報告但醫師明示依據某份報告診斷為癌症，則以該次採檢日為最初診斷日期。 有多次不足以確診之全血球計數或白血球計數報告時，醫師亦未明示依據某份報告診斷為癌症，則採用醫師診斷為癌症的日期作為最初診斷日期。 若全血球計數或白血球計數報告不足以確診為癌症，且醫師亦未確診癌症，經骨髓或其他切片檢查結果確診為癌症時，則以病理採檢日期為最初診斷日期。 若病理或細胞學報告均無法判斷為癌症時，以醫師診斷為癌症的日期為最初診斷日期。 個案在確定診斷之前就已接受首次療程，若無最初診斷日期，則可以治療開始的日期作為最初診斷日期。 有關作為癌症診斷的用語，可參考第一部份的「含糊不清詞彙」表列的內容。 個案分類為5者，其最初診斷日期即為死亡日期。 若個案於2010年1月1日(含)之後在子宮內即被診斷為癌症者(in utero diagnosis)，其最初診斷日期請填正確診斷或接受治療的日期；若是2010年以前之個案，則最初診斷日期請填出生日期。 若個案曾在外院診斷為癌症而日期不詳者，儘可能推算至月份；月份不詳者，請依下列原則編碼： 年度、季節可推算，但月份無法推算：年度依推算編碼；月份依季節編碼，春季為0499、夏季為0799、秋季為1099、冬季為1299(年尾)或0199(年初)。若診斷月份無法推算，則編碼為9999。 若院外最初診斷日期年、月、日皆不詳，則不須申報。範例：編碼：案例
20050312：民國 94年3月12日的乳房攝影檢查顯示，個案右邊乳房的外上四分之一處有癌症(compatible with carcinoma)。民國94 年 3月20日個案接受乳房切除性切片檢查確診為浸潤性管道癌(infiltrating ductal carcinoma)。
20030512：醫師記載個案在民國 92年 5月12日體檢時發現攝護腺有結節且懷疑是癌症。民國 92年6月15日做攝護腺超音波導引的細針切片檢查(ultrasound guided needle biopsy)，結果確診為腺癌(adenocarcinoma)。
20040199：個案於民國 93年1月因子宮內膜異位(endometriosis)而接受經腹部全子宮切除術(total abdominal hysterectomy)。於民國94 年11月因腹痛、腹脹而住院，經腹腔鏡行網膜切片檢查(laparoscopy with omental biopsy)結果顯示為轉移性囊狀腺癌(metastatic cystadenocarcinoma)。病理醫師重新調閱民國 93年子宮切除的標本，確認在左側卵巢有囊狀腺癌。
20059999：若最初診斷的確切日期不詳，則記錄其約略的日期，例如只知道是民國 94年。
20110904：個案於民國 100年9月1 日進行CBC/WBC檢查，醫師於 9月3日依據細胞學報告結果下診斷為 R/O 白血病。民國100年 9月4日再經骨髓切片之histology 結果確診為AML。
20110903：個案於民國 100年9月1 日進行CBC/WBC檢查且 blasts=18%，醫師未下診斷為癌症或疑似癌症，民國 100年9月3日再經骨髓切片之histology結果確診為 AML。
20110902：個案於民國 100年9月1 日進行CBC/WBC檢查，結果有疑異，民國 100年9月 2日再經抽血進行免疫表現分型檢查，醫師於民國100年9月5 日依據免疫表現分型報告判斷為 AML with t(8;21)(q22;q22)。
20110901：個案於民國 100年9月1 日進行CBC/WBC檢查，結果有疑異，醫師將9月1日的血液樣本，於 9月 2日申請對該異常檢體進行免疫表現分型檢查，醫師於民國100年9月5日依據免疫表現分型報告判斷為 AML with t(8;21)(q22;q22)。
20110904：個案於民國 100年9月1 日進行CBC/WBC檢查，醫師於 9月3日依據細胞學報告結果下診斷為 R/O 白血病。民國100年 9月4日開始化學治療。
fields.purpose_en: Allows calculation of the time interval from the initial cancer diagnosis date to completion of staging or start of treatment.
fields.guide_en:
• The date of initial diagnosis may be the date on which the cancer was clinically or pathologically diagnosed; that is, "the first day on which the patient was diagnosed with cancer (or suspected cancer) by a physician at the reporting hospital or another facility". Note that the date in this field must be earlier than or equal to the "Date of last contact or death". • If a cytology report uses vague terms, such as "suspicious for malignancy", it may be coded as the date of initial diagnosis only if the biopsy is positive or the physician has made a clinical judgment supporting the cytology result. • An abnormal tumor marker alone cannot be regarded as a means of confirming cancer; the date of positive clinical judgment, pathology or cytology must be used as the date of initial diagnosis, and it must not be traced back to the tumor marker sampling date. For example: a patient has an elevated PSA but a negative physical examination. The physician recommends a fine needle biopsy of the prostate, and the pathology report shows adenocarcinoma; the date of initial diagnosis should then be the biopsy date (the PSA report date or sampling date must not be used as the date of initial diagnosis). For example: a patient has an elevated PSA but a negative physical examination. The physician writes in the medical record that prostate cancer is suspected and recommends a fine needle biopsy of the prostate; the biopsy is positive, confirming the physician's suspicion; the date of initial diagnosis should then be the date on which the physician described the suspicion of prostate cancer. Note: an abnormal tumor marker alone cannot be regarded as the date of initial diagnosis of cancer. • If the Imaging Reporting and Data System (RADS) category result for a specific cancer meets the following reportable conditions, and the cancer is subsequently confirmed microscopically or the physician has made a clinical judgment supporting the imaging report, the date of that imaging examination may be regarded as the date of initial diagnosis. Reportable RADS categories are: • LI-RADS categories 4 and 5 for liver cancer • PI-RADS categories 4 and 5 for prostate cancer • BI-RADS categories 4, 4A, 4B, 4C and 5 for breast cancer • Lung-RADS categories 4A, 4B and 4X for lung cancer. For example: a patient underwent breast screening, and the mammography result was BI-RADS category 4C. A subsequent biopsy at a hospital confirmed breast carcinoma in situ; the patient's date of initial diagnosis should then be abstracted as the date of the BI-RADS imaging examination. • For patients diagnosed with leukemia or other hematologic neoplastic disease (excluding lymphoma): • The date of suspected cancer must not be abstracted as the date of initial diagnosis. Note: for a leukemia patient whose peripheral blood (peripheral blood) blasts are ≧20%, even if the physician describes it in the medical record as rule out leukemia, it may still be regarded as confirmed. (This applies to cases diagnosed before 2023.) • If a single complete blood count (CBC) or white blood cell count (WBC) report confirms the diagnosis, or there are multiple reports but the physician explicitly states which report the cancer diagnosis was based on, the sampling date of that report is the date of initial diagnosis. • If there are multiple CBC or WBC reports that are insufficient to confirm the diagnosis and the physician has not explicitly stated which report the cancer diagnosis was based on, the date on which the physician diagnosed cancer is used as the date of initial diagnosis. • If the CBC or WBC reports are insufficient to confirm cancer and the physician has not diagnosed cancer, and cancer is confirmed by bone marrow or other biopsy results, the pathology sampling date is the date of initial diagnosis. • If neither pathology nor cytology reports can establish cancer, the date on which the physician diagnosed cancer is the date of initial diagnosis. • If the patient had already received the first course of treatment before the definitive diagnosis and there is no date of initial diagnosis, the date treatment began may be used as the date of initial diagnosis. • For terms used in diagnosing cancer, refer to the "vague terms" table in Part 1. • For a patient classified as 5, the date of initial diagnosis is the date of death. • If a patient was diagnosed with cancer in utero (in utero diagnosis) on or after January 1, 2010, enter the date of the correct diagnosis or of receiving treatment as the date of initial diagnosis; for cases before 2010, enter the date of birth. • If a patient was diagnosed with cancer at another facility and the date is unknown, estimate it to the month as far as possible; if the month is unknown, code according to the following principles: • If the year and season can be estimated but the month cannot: code the year as estimated; code the month according to the season: spring is 0499, summer is 0799, autumn is 1099, winter is 1299 (end of year) or 0199 (beginning of year). If the month of diagnosis cannot be estimated, code 9999. • If the year, month and day of the initial diagnosis at another facility are all unknown, no report is needed. Examples: Code: Case
20050312: A mammogram on March 12, ROC 94 (2005) showed cancer (compatible with carcinoma) in the upper outer quadrant of the patient's right breast. On March 20, ROC 94 (2005), the patient underwent excisional breast biopsy, which confirmed infiltrating ductal carcinoma.
20030512: The physician recorded that on May 12, ROC 92 (2003), a nodule was found in the patient's prostate during physical examination and cancer was suspected. On June 15, ROC 92 (2003), an ultrasound-guided needle biopsy of the prostate was done, and the result confirmed adenocarcinoma.
20040199: In January ROC 93 (2004), the patient underwent total abdominal hysterectomy for endometriosis. In November ROC 94 (2005), the patient was hospitalized for abdominal pain and distension, and laparoscopy with omental biopsy showed metastatic cystadenocarcinoma. The pathologist re-examined the hysterectomy specimen from ROC 93 (2004) and confirmed cystadenocarcinoma in the left ovary.
20059999: If the exact date of initial diagnosis is unknown, record the approximate date, for example when only the year ROC 94 (2005) is known.
20110904: On September 1, ROC 100 (2011), the patient had a CBC/WBC test; on September 3, the physician diagnosed R/O leukemia based on the cytology report. On September 4, ROC 100 (2011), histology of a bone marrow biopsy confirmed AML.
20110903: On September 1, ROC 100 (2011), the patient had a CBC/WBC test with blasts=18%; the physician did not diagnose cancer or suspected cancer. On September 3, ROC 100 (2011), histology of a bone marrow biopsy confirmed AML.
20110902: On September 1, ROC 100 (2011), the patient had a CBC/WBC test with a doubtful result; on September 2, ROC 100 (2011), blood was drawn again for immunophenotyping, and on September 5, ROC 100 (2011), the physician determined AML with t(8;21)(q22;q22) based on the immunophenotyping report.
20110901: On September 1, ROC 100 (2011), the patient had a CBC/WBC test with a doubtful result; the physician requested immunophenotyping of the abnormal specimen (the September 1 blood sample) on September 2, and on September 5, ROC 100 (2011), the physician determined AML with t(8;21)(q22;q22) based on the immunophenotyping report.
20110904: On September 1, ROC 100 (2011), the patient had a CBC/WBC test; on September 3, the physician diagnosed R/O leukemia based on the cytology report. Chemotherapy was started on September 4, ROC 100 (2011).

fields.description_zh:
確認癌症原發部位。
欄位位置：78–81
fields.description_en:
Confirm the primary site of the cancer.
Field position: 78–81
fields.purpose_zh: 原發部位是分期及決定治療方針之依據；同時也影響其預後及病程。
fields.guide_zh:
 依ICD-O-3腫瘤部位碼(topography code)進行原發部位編碼。 若病歷紀錄並無原發部位之相關資訊，可詢問主責醫師以確認其原發部位或最確切之部位碼。 原發部位碼可於ICD-O-3的腫瘤部位章節查詢，共有二種查詢方式：以編碼順序編排(ICD-O-3，第43頁)及依英文字母順序索引(ICD-O-3,第105頁)之章節。 腫瘤部位碼是以大寫字母C開頭，之後加上3個數字碼(不記錄小數點)，編碼範圍為C000-C809(”C”為大寫)，不含小數點，第4位盡量查明詳填，實在無法辨識才能填9。 有關實質(solid tumors)癌症之編碼規則，遵循ICD-O-3第20-40頁及SEER「Solid Tumor coding rules」。 非多重原發個案，若單一解剖部位同時包括侵襲性及原位性病灶於不同細部位，則「原發部位」應以侵襲性部份來編碼。 惡性肉瘤（Sarcoma）個案若原發部位不明時，原發部位應編碼C499，而非C809。 當單一腫瘤橫跨兩個或兩個以上的細部位(subsite)時，且確切起源亦不清楚，則第4碼應為8。 若同一個器官有多顆腫瘤且位於不同細部位時，則第4碼應為9。 對於血液惡性腫瘤及淋巴癌(Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Cancer【M9590-9993】)是否為單一或多重原發，請依下列原則編碼： 2010年1月1日(含)以後新診斷個案：應遵循SEER「Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasm Coding Manual」最新公告版本與The Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasms Database (Hematopoietic DB) 之規則編碼。範例：編碼：案例
C108：口咽部(oropharynx)有overlapping 的病灶。例如當有一個大腫瘤，侵犯範圍包括lateral wall of oropharynx (C10.2)和posterior wall of oropharynx(C10.3)，並且其確切起源不清楚時，第 4 碼應為8。
C678：膀胱(bladder)有重疊的病灶。例如當有一個大腫瘤，侵犯範圍包括 dome (C67.1)和lateral wall (C67.2)，並且其確切起源不清楚時，第 4碼應為 8。
C679：Bladder, NOS。當有多顆腫瘤起源自 Bladder trigone (C67.0)和lateral wall (C67.2)時，第4碼應為9。
C189：Colon, NOS。當患有家族性息肉症(Familial polyposis)的個案，從橫結腸(C18.4)到降結腸(C18.6)皆發生有侵襲癌和原位癌時，應記錄為一個原發癌症，部位為 colon, NOS (C18.9)。詳細解說請參考第一部份多重原發之章節。
C16_：當淋巴癌位於胃(extranodal lymphoma)時，則以胃的細部位逕行編碼。
fields.purpose_en: The primary site is the basis for staging and deciding treatment policy; it also affects prognosis and disease course.
fields.guide_en:
Code the primary site according to the ICD-O-3 topography code. If the medical record has no information on the primary site, the attending physician may be asked to confirm the primary site or the most definitive site code. The primary site code can be looked up in the topography section of ICD-O-3, in two ways: the numerical listing (ICD-O-3, page 43) and the alphabetical index (ICD-O-3, page 105). The topography code begins with the capital letter C followed by 3 digits (the decimal point is not recorded); the coding range is C000-C809 ("C" in capital letter), without decimal point; determine and fill in the 4th digit as far as possible, and only use 9 if it truly cannot be identified. For the coding rules of solid tumors, follow ICD-O-3 pages 20-40 and the SEER "Solid Tumor coding rules". For a case that is not multiple primaries, if a single anatomic site contains both invasive and in situ lesions in different subsites, the "primary site" should be coded according to the invasive part. For a sarcoma case with unknown primary site, the primary site should be coded C499, not C809. When a single tumor spans two or more subsites and its exact origin is also unclear, the 4th digit should be 8. If the same organ has multiple tumors located in different subsites, the 4th digit should be 9. For whether hematopoietic and lymphoid cancers (Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Cancer [M9590-9993]) are single or multiple primaries, code according to the following principles: For cases newly diagnosed on or after January 1, 2010: follow the latest published version of the SEER "Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasm Coding Manual" and the rules of The Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasms Database (Hematopoietic DB). Examples: Code: Case
C108: Overlapping lesion of the oropharynx. For example, when there is one large tumor whose extent includes the lateral wall of oropharynx (C10.2) and the posterior wall of oropharynx (C10.3), and its exact origin is unclear, the 4th digit should be 8.
C678: Overlapping lesion of the bladder. For example, when there is one large tumor whose extent includes the dome (C67.1) and the lateral wall (C67.2), and its exact origin is unclear, the 4th digit should be 8.
C679: Bladder, NOS. When there are multiple tumors originating from the Bladder trigone (C67.0) and the lateral wall (C67.2), the 4th digit should be 9.
C189: Colon, NOS. For a case with familial polyposis who has invasive carcinoma and carcinoma in situ from the transverse colon (C18.4) to the descending colon (C18.6), record it as one primary cancer with site colon, NOS (C18.9). For detailed explanation, see the chapter on multiple primaries in Part 1.
C16_: When lymphoma is located in the stomach (extranodal lymphoma), code directly with the subsite of the stomach.

fields.description_zh:
確認癌症起源於成對器官或身體的某一側。本欄位只適用於原發腫瘤部位。
欄位位置：82–82
fields.description_en:
Confirm whether the cancer originated in a paired organ or one side of the body. This field applies only to the primary tumor site.
Field position: 82–82
fields.purpose_zh: 側性可提供分期及癌病侵犯程度的資訊，並可確定原發侵犯的數目。
fields.guide_zh:
 原發部位不明(C80.9)與非成對器官，其側性編碼為0；成對器官之編碼可以為1-5及9 (參看 若側位不詳，但是腫瘤是侷限於成對器官的某一側，編碼為3。 若確認原發側位別時，勿將對側轉移部位登錄為雙側侵犯。注意：若肺癌個案腫瘤雙側侵犯時，且無法確認原發側位別，則編碼為4。 原發部位為以下部位且為身體中線的腫瘤，編碼為5。 C700,C710-C714,C722-C725,C443,C444,C445。 若腫瘤非原發於以上部位時，則不可編碼為5。 非成對器官同時發現雙側侵犯時，則編碼為0。 非表列成對器官，若病歷記錄有描述側性則須登錄。範例：編碼：案例
0：甲狀腺癌個案病歷記載左右兩側侵犯。
3：病理報告記載個案有一個 2公分 carcinoma位於腎臟 upper pole處，其側位別編碼為3(因為只知道位置是在某ㄧ個腎，但是不知是左腎或右腎)。
9：個案診斷為肺癌，診斷依據為 sputum cytology，病歷上無其他任何與側位別相關資訊可提供。
5：個案肚臍正上方有一黑色素瘤，因皮膚為成對器官而腫瘤位於正中線腫瘤，故編碼為5。
1：右側口腔黏膜癌。
1：病歷記載為右側甲狀腺癌。
4：個案診斷為肺癌，影像報告顯示雙側腫瘤侵犯，醫師未明示或無法確認原發部位側性。
2：個案診斷為肺癌，影像報告顯示雙側腫瘤侵犯，醫師紀載原發部位為左側上葉(LUL)。
fields.purpose_en: Laterality provides information on stage and extent of disease and can determine the number of primary involvements.
fields.guide_en:
• For an unknown primary site (C80.9) and non-paired organs, the laterality is coded 0; for paired organs, the code may be 1-5 and 9 (see • If the laterality is unknown but the tumor is confined to one side of a paired organ, code 3. • If the side of the primary is confirmed, do not register metastasis to the contralateral side as bilateral involvement. Note: if a lung cancer patient has bilateral tumor involvement and the side of the primary cannot be confirmed, code 4. • For tumors whose primary site is one of the following sites and which lie on the midline of the body, code 5. • C700, C710-C714, C722-C725, C443, C444, C445. • If the tumor did not arise in the above sites, it must not be coded 5. • If bilateral involvement is found in a non-paired organ, code 0. • For paired organs not listed, laterality must be registered if the medical record describes it. Examples: Code: Case
0: A thyroid cancer patient whose medical record states involvement of both the left and right sides.
3: The pathology report states that the patient has a 2 cm carcinoma at the upper pole of a kidney; laterality is coded 3 (because it is known only to be in one kidney, but not whether the left or right kidney).
9: The patient was diagnosed with lung cancer based on sputum cytology, and the medical record has no other information on laterality.
5: The patient has a melanoma directly above the umbilicus; because the skin is a paired organ and the tumor is on the midline, code 5.
1: Cancer of the right oral mucosa.
1: The medical record states right thyroid cancer.
4: The patient was diagnosed with lung cancer, imaging reports show bilateral tumor involvement, and the physician did not state or could not confirm the laterality of the primary site.
2: The patient was diagnosed with lung cancer, imaging reports show bilateral tumor involvement, and the physician recorded the primary site as the left upper lobe (LUL).

fields.description_zh:
原發腫瘤細胞於顯微鏡下之結構。
欄位位置：83–86
fields.description_en:
Microscopic structure of the primary tumor cells.
Field position: 83–86
fields.purpose_zh: 作為分期及決定治療方針之根據；同時也影響其預後及病程。
fields.guide_zh:
 依ICD-O-3第69-104頁Numeric Lists/Morphology，以及第105-218頁中Alphabetic Index的部分來進行histology編碼。同時請遵循ICD-O-3第20-40頁之編碼規則予以編碼。 ICD-O-3之組織病理碼(M-code)第一個字母為M，之後接著四個數字，本欄位編碼只需數字部份，勿將M字填入。 對所有可申報之實質腫瘤(solid tumors)於登錄其histology之決定時，請採用SEER「Solid Tumor coding rules」中之編碼原則。這些規則乃適用於2018年1月1日(含)以後新診斷為癌症個案，2017年12月31日(含)以前新診斷之癌症個案請勿採用此規則。 若有病理報告時，須檢閱所有的病理報告。 血液惡性疾病個案之組織病理碼(M-code)依血液疾病編碼表登錄。 實質癌症(solid tumors)，依病理報告最終診斷(final pathologic diagnosis)記載之組織型態(histology)逕行編碼。附註︰若病理報告依 CAP採條列式描述可採用，亦可參考病理報告中的評論(comment)的描述。例外： 若病理報告最終診斷為「未明示(Not Otherwise Specified, NOS)」，如carcinoma, NOS、melanoma, NOS、lymphoma, NOS、或malignant tumor, NOS，則須參考病理報告中的顯微鏡觀察或評論(comment)的描述，以確認更明確的編碼，例如：adenocarcinoma、amelanotic melanoma或 spindle cell sarcoma 等。 cancer, NOS (8000)和carcinoma, NOS (8010)二者不可互換(參考ICD-O-3，第27頁)。若醫師僅描述個案患有carcinoma，則以未明示癌編碼之(8010)。 對於血液惡性腫瘤及淋巴癌(Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Cancer【M9590-9993】)是否為單一或多重原發，請依下列原則編碼： 2010年1月1日(含)以後新診斷個案：應遵循SEER「Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasm Coding Manual」最新公告版本與The Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasms Database (Hematopoietic DB) 之規則編碼。 若病理標本取自轉移部位，因為原發部位與其轉移部位基本上是具有相同之histology，因此以轉移部位之histology逕行編碼，而性態碼則編碼為3。範例：編碼：標示 案例
8140：Adenocarcinoma 病理報告主診斷為 prostate: carcinoma, NOS (8010)，其顯微鏡微觀(mircoscopic)敘述為 adenocarcinoma，則應編碼為 8140。
9680：Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma 病歷最後診斷是 lymphoma，但有任何紀錄 Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma的診斷時，應編碼為9680。
fields.purpose_en: Serves as the basis for staging and deciding treatment policy; also affects prognosis and disease course.
fields.guide_en:
• Code histology according to the Numeric Lists/Morphology on pages 69-104 of ICD-O-3 and the Alphabetic Index on pages 105-218. Also follow the coding rules on pages 20-40 of ICD-O-3. • The histopathology code (M-code) of ICD-O-3 begins with the letter M followed by four digits; this field requires only the numeric part, do not enter the letter M. • When determining the histology of all reportable solid tumors, use the coding principles in the SEER “Solid Tumor coding rules”. These rules apply to cases newly diagnosed with cancer on or after January 1, 2018; do not apply these rules to cases newly diagnosed on or before December 31, 2017. • When pathology reports are available, all pathology reports must be reviewed. • The histopathology code (M-code) of hematologic malignancy cases is recorded according to the hematologic disease code table. • For solid tumors, code directly according to the histology stated in the final pathologic diagnosis (final pathologic diagnosis) of the pathology report. Note: if the pathology report uses the CAP itemized format, it may be used, and the description in the comment (comment) of the pathology report may also be consulted. Exception: if the final diagnosis of the pathology report is “Not Otherwise Specified (NOS)”, such as carcinoma, NOS, melanoma, NOS, lymphoma, NOS, or malignant tumor, NOS, refer to the microscopic description or comment (comment) in the pathology report to confirm a more specific code, for example adenocarcinoma, amelanotic melanoma or spindle cell sarcoma. • Cancer, NOS (8000) and carcinoma, NOS (8010) are not interchangeable (see ICD-O-3, page 27). If the physician describes the case only as having carcinoma, code it as carcinoma, NOS (8010). • Whether hematopoietic and lymphoid cancer (Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Cancer [M9590-9993]) is a single or multiple primary should be coded according to the following principles: • For cases newly diagnosed on or after January 1, 2010: follow the latest published version of the SEER “Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasm Coding Manual” and the rules of The Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasms Database (Hematopoietic DB). • If the pathology specimen is taken from a metastatic site, because the primary site and its metastatic site basically have the same histology, code directly with the histology of the metastatic site, and code the behavior code as 3. Example: Code: Label Case
8140: Adenocarcinoma. The main diagnosis of the pathology report is prostate: carcinoma, NOS (8010), and its microscopic description is adenocarcinoma; it should be coded 8140.
9680: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma. The final diagnosis in the medical record is lymphoma, but if any record has a diagnosis of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, it should be coded 9680.

fields.description_zh:
記錄病理診斷中的性態碼。M-code中的第 5 碼即為性態碼。
欄位位置：87–87
fields.description_en:
Record the behavior code in the pathological diagnosis. The 5th digit of the M-code is the behavior code.
Field position: 87–87
fields.purpose_zh: 病理醫師常使用benign(0)、borderline(1)、in situ(2)、malignant, primary site(3)、malignant, metastatic site(6)、或 malignant, uncertain whether primary or metastatic site(9)來描述腫瘤的性態。其中性態碼為 2、3、6或9(若為 6或 9者，須申報原發部位，且性態碼改為 3)的個案必須申報至癌症登記中心。
fields.guide_zh:
 若原發腫瘤有惡性侵犯(malignant invasion)部份，即使其侵犯程度或範圍非常有限(如：微侵犯microinvasion)，其性態碼一律編碼為3。 若病理標本取自轉移部位，因為原發部位與其轉移部位基本上是具有相同之histology，因此以轉移部位之組織類型逕行編碼，而性態碼則編碼為3。 Stage 0 的癌症一般性態碼為2，除了Paget’s disease(8540/3) of nipple/areola(C50.0)，以及侷限於lamina propria 的結直腸癌。注意：Paget’s disease僅發生於乳頭、乳暈(C50.0)且乳房其他部位未發現任何腫瘤時，若病理報告明示Paget’s disease 為in stiu時，可編碼為8540/2。 原位癌個案非復發或疾病惡化情況下，發現有淋巴或遠端轉移，則性態碼編碼為3。例如：結腸切片病理報告診斷為tubulovillous adenoma with microfocal carcinoma in situ，後續接受 colectomy 未發現殘餘腫瘤，該手術同時執行 core liver biopsy 發現有adenocarcinoma，病歷記載肝臟腫瘤是結腸癌轉移，性態碼應從 2改為3。範例：編碼：案例
3：Intraductal carcinoma (8500/2) with focal areas of invasion.
1：Atypical meningioma (9539/1) invading bone of skull (the meninges, which line the skull, are capable of invading into the bone without being malignant; do not code as malignant unless it is specifically mentioned)
fields.purpose_en: Pathologists often describe tumor behavior using benign (0), borderline (1), in situ (2), malignant, primary site (3), malignant, metastatic site (6), or malignant, uncertain whether primary or metastatic site (9). Cases with behavior code 2, 3, 6 or 9 (for 6 or 9, the primary site must be reported and the behavior code changed to 3) must be reported to the cancer registry center.
fields.guide_en:
If the primary tumor has a malignant invasion component, even if the extent or range of invasion is very limited (e.g. microinvasion), the behavior code is always coded 3. If the pathological specimen was taken from a metastatic site, because the primary site and its metastatic site basically have the same histology, code directly the histologic type of the metastatic site, and code the behavior code 3. Stage 0 cancers generally have behavior code 2, except Paget's disease (8540/3) of nipple/areola (C50.0), and colorectal cancer confined to the lamina propria. Note: when Paget's disease occurs only in the nipple and areola (C50.0) with no tumor found in other parts of the breast, if the pathology report states that the Paget's disease is in stiu, it may be coded 8540/2. If a carcinoma in situ case is found to have lymphatic or distant metastasis without recurrence or disease progression, code the behavior code 3. For example: the colon biopsy pathology report diagnosed tubulovillous adenoma with microfocal carcinoma in situ; the case subsequently underwent colectomy with no residual tumor found, and a core liver biopsy performed at the same operation found adenocarcinoma; the medical record states that the liver tumor is a metastasis of colon cancer; the behavior code should be changed from 2 to 3. fields.description_en:

fields.purpose_zh: 與個案的預後有關。分級/分化可用以評估癌症嚴重程度；分級/分化及細胞型態對於許多癌症而言是重要的預後因子。分級/分化對於某些癌症更是判定期別的依據之一。
fields.guide_zh:
 請依據AJCC 第八版所建議的各癌別特殊分級/分化、一般分級/分化、字辭學摘錄；請參照手冊總論及附錄 D。 本欄位僅收錄實質腫瘤於首次治療前的分級/分化。 進行診斷性FNA、biopsy、needle core biopsy 等組織病理學檢查並有描述分級/分化者，應記錄於臨床分級/分化。 臨床分級/分化請優先摘錄切片(biopsy、needle core biopsy)的病理報告；若未執行切片，則可參考細胞學報告。若有執行切片，但切片之病理報告無描述時，即使同時有細胞學檢查而且細胞學檢查報告有明示分級/分化，仍不採用細胞學檢查之資訊，分級/分化應編碼為 9。 中樞神經系統之惡性腫瘤應收錄WHO之分級/分化，請參照附錄 D。 實質腫瘤(solid tumor)之臨床分級/分化請依下列優先順序編碼︰ 各癌症部位特殊分級分化系統(site-special grade system)；請參考附錄 D。 一般分級分化(generic grade)；請參考附錄 D。 字辭學(terminology)；請參考總論。 分級/分化程度只能依原發部位經顯微鏡證實(病理學或細胞學)之報告結果編碼，勿採用轉移部位或復發的分級/分化程度，即使是轉移部位或復發的組織型態本身就含有分級/分化之意仍不採用。 原發部位已侵犯至鄰近器官，由鄰近器官取得病理組織，應視為原發腫瘤故可依據該病理報告描述之分級/分化結果逕行編碼。 若原發部位不明，應編碼為 9 (分級/分化程度不詳)。 若病灶同時包括 in situ和invasive時，應依其 invasive部分的分級/分化程度編碼；但若其invasive部分之分級/分化程度不明，則編碼為 9。 通常原位癌腫瘤是沒有分級的。若腫瘤是原位癌病灶(in situ lesions)之腫瘤組織有描述其分級/分化程度，則依據原位癌的分級/分化程度來進行編碼。 若有超過一份以上的病理報告，且各報告之最終診斷的分級/分化不盡相同，則請依以下規則作為編碼之優先順序： 優先編碼 AJCC 第八版所建議之分級/分化(specific grading systems)，編碼為 1-5。 若無AJCC 第八版所建議之分級/分化(specific grading systems)，則以一般分級/分化(generic grade)之最高碼為主，編碼為 A-D、L、H。 若癌症部位不適用於 AJCC 第八版，則請參考附錄 D，分級/分化以最高碼為主。 若病理報告中主診斷(final diagnosis)未記載分化程度，則參考其顯微描述(Microscopic description)、補充說明(addendum)或評論(comment)的內容予以編碼。 若無病理組織報告，其分級/分化程度可參考磁振造影術(MRI)或正子造影術(PET)等報告上之描述進行編碼。 血液腫瘤(M-code 9590-9993)之分級/分化，自 2018診斷年起一律編碼為 8(不適用)；僅Lymphoma Ocular Adnexa (C44.1, C69.0, C69.5, C69.6)且組織型態為 follicular lymphoma (M-code 9690/3, 9691/3, 9695/3, 9698/3)，需編碼分級/分化，請參考 Grade 19及 AJCC 第八版第71章。 對於high grade dysplasia (severe dysplasia)個案，請勿編碼其分級程度，應編碼為X。 卵巢borderline tumor (Low malignant potential)合併microinvasive carcinoma 或/與intraepithelial carcinoma，應編碼為X。 闌尾(Appendix)組織型態為 Low grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasm (LAMN)或 High grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasm (HAMN)，應分別編碼為 L或H。 編碼9 (不詳)： 分化/分級不明或病歷未記載。 首次治療前未有臨床分級/分化。 術後才診斷為癌症。 當病歷中只有一個分級/分化，且無法區分是臨床或是病理時，應編碼於臨床分級/分化中，病理分級/分化應編碼9 (不詳)。範例：編碼：案例
1：Buccal mucosa cancer 個案接受切片檢查，病理切片報告描述為：squamous cell carcinoma, well differentiated，後續接受 wide excision，病理報告描述為squamous cell carcinoma in situ。因切片檢查為診斷性處置，不可視為切除性手術。
3：食道癌個案，其病理切片報告為：squamous cell carcinoma, poorly differentiated，經手術治療切除腫瘤，其手術病理報告為：squamous cell carcinoma, well differentiated。
9：乳癌個案手術前病理切片報告未描述分級/分化，CSRT 治療後切除腫瘤，病理報告描述分級/分化為Grade 2。
9：個案病理切片報告為 Sclerosing liposarcoma （M-code：8851/3），未描述分級/分化。
9：Skin cancer 個案接受 excision biopsy 後，病理報告描述為 squamous cell carcinoma, well differentiated。此excision biopsy 應視為治療性手術，原發部位手術方式也應編碼為27。
3：個案MRI報告描述corpus striatum tumor 且診斷為Anaplastic oligodendroglioma。病歷記錄未描述 WHO grade，參考附錄D中的Grade 20 並對應table.1 為WHO Grade III，則可編碼為 3。編碼：案例
9：個 案 病 理 切 片報 告為 C4-5 ， biopsy of intramedullary tumor ， 組 織 型態 為Ependymoma,with Molecular Testing RELA fusion-positive，病理報告未描述 WHO grade。參考附錄 D 中的 Grade 20 並對應 table.1 仍無法判定 WHO Grade，則應編碼為9。
2：個案MRI報告描述 Diffuse astrocytoma，low grade。參考附錄 D中的Grade 20 並對應table.1為 WHO Grade II，則可編碼為 2。
L：個案Brain MRI報告描述Glioma，low grade。參考附錄 D中的Grade 20，編碼為 L。
9：肺癌個案同時接受RUL, fine-needle aspiration及CT-guide biopsy。Fine-needle aspiration病理報告描述 Poorly differentiated carcinoma；而 CT-guide biopsy 病理報告結果為Adenocarcinoma，未描述分級/分化，不應摘錄細胞學檢查之分級/分化。
H：個案由影像診斷為 Renal pelvis cancer ，並接受 ureteroscope biopsy，切片病理報告為Papillary urothelial carcinoma, high grade；之後執行nephroureterectomy，手術後的病理報告描述為 no residual tumor，臨床及病理分級/分化皆編碼為 H。
fields.purpose_en: Related to the case's prognosis. Grade/differentiation can be used to assess cancer severity; grade/differentiation and cell type are important prognostic factors for many cancers. For some cancers, grade/differentiation is also one of the bases for determining stage.
fields.guide_en:
• Abstract the site-specific grade/differentiation, generic grade/differentiation, and terminology recommended by the AJCC 8th edition for each cancer type; refer to the General Introduction and Appendix D of the manual.• This field records only the grade/differentiation of solid tumors before the first course of treatment.• If a diagnostic histopathologic examination such as FNA, biopsy or needle core biopsy was performed and describes grade/differentiation, record it as the clinical grade/differentiation.• For the clinical grade/differentiation, abstract the pathology report of the biopsy (biopsy, needle core biopsy) first; if no biopsy was performed, the cytology report may be consulted. If a biopsy was performed but its pathology report has no description, do not use the cytology information even if a cytology examination was done at the same time and its report explicitly states the grade/differentiation; code the grade/differentiation as 9.• For malignant tumors of the central nervous system, abstract the WHO grade/differentiation; see Appendix D.• Code the clinical grade/differentiation of solid tumors in the following order of priority:• Site-specific grade system for each cancer site; see Appendix D.• Generic grade; see Appendix D.• Terminology; see the General Introduction.• Grade/differentiation may be coded only from microscopically confirmed (pathology or cytology) reports of the primary site. Do not use the grade/differentiation of a metastatic or recurrent site, even if the histology of the metastasis or recurrence itself implies a grade/differentiation.• If the primary site has invaded an adjacent organ and pathologic tissue is obtained from the adjacent organ, it should be regarded as the primary tumor, so the grade/differentiation described in that pathology report may be coded directly.• If the primary site is unknown, code 9 (grade/differentiation unknown).• If the lesion includes both in situ and invasive components, code the grade/differentiation of the invasive component; if the grade/differentiation of the invasive component is unknown, code 9.• In situ carcinomas are usually not graded. If the tumor tissue of an in situ lesion has a described grade/differentiation, code according to the grade/differentiation of the in situ carcinoma.• If there is more than one pathology report and the grades/differentiation in their final diagnoses differ, use the following order of priority for coding:• Code first the grade/differentiation recommended by the AJCC 8th edition (specific grading systems), coded 1-5.• If the AJCC 8th edition does not recommend a grade/differentiation (specific grading systems), use mainly the highest code of the generic grade, coded A-D, L, H.• If the cancer site is not covered by the AJCC 8th edition, refer to Appendix D and use mainly the highest grade/differentiation code.• If the final diagnosis of the pathology report does not state the degree of differentiation, refer to the microscopic description, addendum or comment for coding.• If there is no histopathology report, the grade/differentiation may be coded from descriptions in reports such as magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) or positron emission tomography (PET).• For hematologic neoplasms (M-code 9590-9993), grade/differentiation is always coded 8 (not applicable) from diagnosis year 2018; only for Lymphoma Ocular Adnexa (C44.1, C69.0, C69.5, C69.6) with follicular lymphoma histology (M-code 9690/3, 9691/3, 9695/3, 9698/3) must grade/differentiation be coded; see Grade 19 and Chapter 71 of the AJCC 8th edition.• For high grade dysplasia (severe dysplasia), do not code a grade; code X.• For ovarian borderline tumor (low malignant potential) with microinvasive carcinoma and/or intraepithelial carcinoma, code X.• For appendix histology of low grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasm (LAMN) or high grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasm (HAMN), code L or H, respectively.• Code 9 (unknown):• Differentiation/grade unknown or not documented in the medical record.• No clinical grade/differentiation before the first course of treatment.• Cancer diagnosed only after surgery.• When the medical record contains only one grade/differentiation and it cannot be distinguished as clinical or pathologic, code it in the clinical grade/differentiation and code the pathologic grade/differentiation as 9 (unknown).Examples: Code: Case
1: A patient with buccal mucosa cancer underwent biopsy, and the biopsy pathology report reads squamous cell carcinoma, well differentiated; the patient subsequently underwent wide excision, and the pathology report reads squamous cell carcinoma in situ. Because a biopsy is a diagnostic procedure, it must not be regarded as a resection.
3: A patient with esophageal cancer; the biopsy pathology report reads squamous cell carcinoma, poorly differentiated; the tumor was resected surgically, and the surgical pathology report reads squamous cell carcinoma, well differentiated.
9: A patient with breast cancer; the pre-operative biopsy pathology report does not describe grade/differentiation; the tumor was resected after CSRT, and the pathology report describes the grade/differentiation as Grade 2.
9: The patient's biopsy pathology report reads Sclerosing liposarcoma (M-code: 8851/3), with no grade/differentiation described.
9: A patient with skin cancer underwent excision biopsy, and the pathology report reads squamous cell carcinoma, well differentiated. This excision biopsy should be regarded as therapeutic surgery, and the primary site surgical procedure should also be coded 27.
3: The patient's MRI report describes a corpus striatum tumor, diagnosed as Anaplastic oligodendroglioma. The medical record does not describe the WHO grade; referring to Grade 20 in Appendix D and matching it to Table 1 gives WHO Grade III, so code 3. Code: Case
9: The patient's biopsy pathology report reads C4-5, biopsy of intramedullary tumor, histology Ependymoma, with Molecular Testing RELA fusion-positive; the pathology report does not describe the WHO grade. After referring to Grade 20 in Appendix D and matching it to Table 1, the WHO Grade still cannot be determined, so code 9.
2: The patient's MRI report describes Diffuse astrocytoma, low grade. Referring to Grade 20 in Appendix D and matching it to Table 1 gives WHO Grade II, so code 2.
L: The patient's brain MRI report describes Glioma, low grade. Referring to Grade 20 in Appendix D, code L.
9: A patient with lung cancer underwent both RUL fine-needle aspiration and CT-guided biopsy. The fine-needle aspiration pathology report describes Poorly differentiated carcinoma, while the CT-guided biopsy pathology report shows Adenocarcinoma with no grade/differentiation described; the grade/differentiation of the cytology examination should not be abstracted.
H: A patient was diagnosed on imaging with renal pelvis cancer and underwent ureteroscope biopsy; the biopsy pathology report reads Papillary urothelial carcinoma, high grade; nephroureterectomy was performed afterwards, and the post-operative pathology report describes no residual tumor; both the clinical and pathologic grade/differentiation are coded H.

1：Buccal mucosa cancer 個案接受切片檢查，病理切片報告描述為：squamous cell carcinoma, well differentiated，後續接受 wide excision，病理報告描述為squamous cell carcinoma in situ。病理分級/分化請摘錄侵襲癌之分級/分化。
9：Mouth floor cancer 個案接受切片檢查，病理切片報告描述為其病理切片報告為：squamous cell carcinoma, well differentiated，先接受 CCRT 再接受wide excision 及Selective Neck Dissection (SND)，原發部位病理報告描述為 no residual tumor。
3：乳癌個案先接受 excision biopsy 病理報告描述BR score為7，但是surgical margin can’t assessment，後續接受SM 病理報告診斷為focal residure tumor，BR score 9。
A：Forearm skin cancer 個案接受 wide excision 後，病理報告描述為 squamous cell carcinoma, well differentiated。
H：個案由影像診斷為 Renal pelvis cancer ，並接受 ureteroscope biopsy，切片病理報告為Papillary urothelial carcinoma, high grade；之後執行nephroureterectomy，手術後的病理報告描述為 no residual tumor，臨床及病理分級/分化皆編碼為 H。
fields.purpose_en: Related to the case's prognosis. Grade/differentiation can be used to assess cancer severity; grade/differentiation and cell type are important prognostic factors for many cancers. For some cancers, grade/differentiation is also one of the bases for determining pathological stage.
fields.guide_en:
Abstract according to the cancer-site-specific grade/differentiation, generic grade/differentiation and terminology recommended in the AJCC 8th edition; see the general chapter of the manual and Appendix D. This field only records the grade/differentiation of solid tumors after surgery of the primary site (procedure codes 20-90). For malignant tumors of the central nervous system, record the WHO grade/differentiation; see Appendix D. The pathological grade/differentiation of solid tumors is coded in the following order of priority: Site-specific grade system; see Appendix D. Generic grade; see Appendix D. Terminology; see the general chapter. Grade/differentiation may only be coded from microscopically confirmed (pathology or cytology) reports of the primary site; do not use the grade/differentiation of a metastatic site or recurrence, even if the histology of the metastasis or recurrence itself implies a grade/differentiation. If an excisional biopsy of the primary site was performed and the subsequent tumor resection showed no residual tumor, the pathological grade/differentiation may be taken from the description in the excisional biopsy. If the primary site is unknown, code 9 (grade/differentiation unknown). If the case received neo-adjuvant treatment before surgery, abstract the pathological grade of the tumor tissue after surgery. If the lesion contains both in situ and invasive components, code the grade/differentiation of the invasive component; if the grade/differentiation of the invasive component is unknown, code 9. Note: in a few cases the biopsy pathology report described invasive carcinoma with a grade/differentiation, the case then underwent surgery of the primary site, and the postoperative pathology report described only carcinoma in situ; in this situation, abstract the grade/differentiation of the invasive carcinoma. Carcinoma in situ tumors are usually not graded. If the tumor tissue of an in situ lesion has a described grade/differentiation, that grade/differentiation of the lesion may be used for coding. If there is more than one pathology report and the grade/differentiation in their final diagnoses differs, apply the following order of priority for coding: First code the grade/differentiation recommended by AJCC 8th edition (specific grading systems), coded 1-5. For Grade 04, 06, 07, 08, 09, 13, 16, 19 and 22 in Appendix D, the result of the pathology report of the largest tumor volume of the surgically resected primary site takes precedence. If AJCC 8th edition has no recommended grade/differentiation, use the highest code of the generic grade/differentiation (generic grade), coded A-D, L, H. If the cancer site is not covered by AJCC 8th edition, refer to Appendix D and use the highest code for grade/differentiation. If the main diagnosis (final diagnosis) in the pathology report does not record the differentiation, refer to the microscopic description, addendum or comment for coding. For hematologic neoplasms (M-code 9590-9993), the grade/differentiation is always coded 8 (not applicable) from 2018; only Lymphoma Ocular Adnexa (C44.1, C69.0, C69.5, C69.6) with follicular lymphoma histology (M-code 9690/3, 9691/3, 9695/3, 9698/3) requires grade/differentiation coding; see Grade 19 and Chapter 71 of AJCC 8th edition. For cases of high grade dysplasia (severe dysplasia), do not code a grade; code X. For ovarian borderline tumor (Low malignant potential) with microinvasive carcinoma and/or intraepithelial carcinoma, code X. For appendix with histology Low grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasm (LAMN) or High grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasm (HAMN), code L or H respectively. Code 9 (unknown): grade/differentiation unknown or not recorded in the medical record. The primary site did not receive surgery. The case received neoadjuvant therapy before surgery and the postoperative pathology report described no residual tumor. When the medical record contains only one grade/differentiation and it cannot be distinguished whether it is clinical or pathological, code it under clinical grade/differentiation and code the pathological grade/differentiation 9 (unknown). Examples: Code: Case
1: An esophageal cancer case; the biopsy pathology report was: squamous cell carcinoma, poorly differentiated; the tumor was surgically resected, and the surgical pathology report was: squamous cell carcinoma, well differentiated.
2: A breast cancer case; the biopsy pathology report before surgery did not describe a grade/differentiation; the tumor was resected after CSRT treatment, BR score 7 points.
X: Ovary, right, oophorectomy: mucinous borderline tumor with intraepithelial carcinoma. (M-code: 8472/2)
X: Ovary, right, oophorectomy : borderline seromucinous tumor with intraepithelial carcinoma and focal microinvasive carcinoma. (M-code: 8474/3)
X: Ovary, right, oophorectomy : atypical proliferative serous borderline tumor with microinvasive carcinoma. (M-code: 8442/3)
9: The pathology report of the case was corpus striatum tumor, craniotomy with removal of tumor—Anaplastic oligoastroglioma. The medical record did not describe the WHO grade; referring to Grade 20 in Appendix D and its table.1, the WHO grade still cannot be determined.
9: The pathology report of the case was C4-5, intramedullary tumor, removal of tumor --- Ependymoma, with Molecular Testing RELA fusion-positive; the pathology report did not describe the WHO grade. Referring to Grade 20 in Appendix D and its table.1, the WHO Grade still cannot be determined, so code 9. Code: Case
3: The pathology report of the case was Spinal nerve, intradural tumor, removal of spinal tumor— Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor. The medical record only described Histology grade (According to French Federation of Cancer Centers Sarcoma Group [FNCLCC]): Grade 3, and did not describe the WHO Grade.
1: A cheek skin cancer case underwent excision biopsy, and the pathology report described squamous cell carcinoma, well differentiated. This excision biopsy should be regarded as therapeutic surgery, and the surgical procedure of the primary site should also be coded 27.
3: In a cervical cancer case, the operative record described direct tumor invasion into the bladder, and radical hysterectomy and partial cystectomy were performed. One pathology report described Uterus and bilateral adnexa, radical hysterectomy --Squamous cell carcinoma of cervix, moderate differentiated; at the same time, another pathology report described Partial cystectomy--Squamous cell carcinoma , poorly differentiated, directed invasion from cervix.
1: A buccal mucosa cancer case underwent biopsy; the biopsy pathology report described: squamous cell carcinoma, well differentiated; the case then underwent wide excision, and the pathology report described squamous cell carcinoma in situ. For the pathological grade/differentiation, abstract the grade/differentiation of the invasive carcinoma.
9: A mouth floor cancer case underwent biopsy; the biopsy pathology report described: squamous cell carcinoma, well differentiated; the case first received CCRT and then wide excision and Selective Neck Dissection (SND); the pathology report of the primary site described no residual tumor.
3: A breast cancer case first underwent excision biopsy, and the pathology report described a BR score of 7 but the surgical margin could not be assessed; the case then underwent SM, and the pathology report diagnosed focal residure tumor, BR score 9.
A: A forearm skin cancer case underwent wide excision, and the pathology report described squamous cell carcinoma, well differentiated.
H: The case was diagnosed by imaging as Renal pelvis cancer and underwent ureteroscope biopsy; the biopsy pathology report was Papillary urothelial carcinoma, high grade; nephroureterectomy was then performed, and the postoperative pathology report described no residual tumor; both the clinical and pathological grade/differentiation are coded H.

fields.description_zh:
記錄個案於申報醫院或外院之最精確的診斷依據。
欄位位置：90–90
fields.description_en:
Record the most definitive basis of diagnosis of the case at the reporting hospital or another hospital.
Field position: 90–90
fields.purpose_zh: 作為統計癌症經顯微鏡檢確認之比例。完整的癌症發生率統計應包括臨床及病理確診的個案。
fields.guide_zh: 實質腫瘤(solid tumor)編碼指引(所有腫瘤，組織型態為 M9590-9993除外)： 請依序從最精確的histologic confirmation (編碼1)到最不精確的unknown (編碼9)。編碼1是癌症最精確的確診方法，只要個案有接受編碼1的方式，則不管個案是否有接受其他形式的檢查，一律編碼為1。 個案於病程中任何時間只要有接受了更精確的癌症確診方式，則修改為數字較小的編碼。 以下之顯微鏡檢診斷依據，應編碼為1： Biopsy、frozen section、surgery、autopsy或D&C等組織標本。 骨髓標本(aspiration or biopsy)。 以下之顯微鏡檢診斷依據，應編碼為2： 細胞學檢查，可包括sputum smears、bronchial brushings、bronchial washings、prostatic secretions、breast secretions、gastric fluid、spinal fluid、peritoneal fluid、pleural fluid、urinary sediment、cervical smears、vaginal smears。例如：因子宮頸抹片檢查結果偽陽性機率偏高，因此所有子宮頸癌個案「首次顯微鏡檢證實日期」皆以最早的 Histology 採檢日期為主；若只有 Pap smear 檢查結果為 CIN3或以上，而 Histology結果呈陰性，則不需申報，除非臨床醫師仍診斷為子宮頸癌時，則以其 Pap smear來編碼，「癌症確診方式」編碼為2。 濃縮之spinal、pleural、或peritoneal fluid的石蠟塊(Paraffin block)標本。 當醫師臨床診斷為癌症時，如當時是依據某些特定癌症臨床診斷用之實驗室檢查/腫瘤標記之臨床確診時，可編碼為5。例如：攝護腺癌個案的檢查結果只有 PSA值升高，而臨床醫師亦依據此 PSA值而診斷為癌症。例外：肝癌的 alpha-fetoprotein不可視為癌症確診方式。 手術探查之外科醫師手術報告，或經由colonoscopy、mediastinoscopy、或 peritoneoscopy等內視鏡檢查，同時未做組織檢體檢查者，編碼為6。淋巴癌、血癌、其他血液腫瘤疾患編碼指引 (組織型態為 M9590-9993) 淋巴癌、血癌、其他血液腫瘤疾患之確診方式編碼並無優先順序。多數明確的組織型態多由免疫表現分型(immunophenotyping)及/或基因(genetic)檢測診斷。「The Hematopoietic Database(DB)」提供腫瘤型態更明確的診斷資訊。 以下之顯微鏡檢診斷依據，應編碼為1： Biopsy、frozen section、surgery、autopsy或bone marrow(aspiration or biopsy)等組織標本。 僅適用於leukemia：經hematologic findings確診者，包括周邊血液抹片(peripheral blood smears)、全血球計數(CBC)及白血球計數(WBC)；若僅是利用骨髓或血液執行免疫表現分型(immunophenotyping)及/或基因(genetic)檢測診斷，編碼不應為1。 以下之顯微鏡檢診斷依據，應編碼為2： 細胞學檢查，可包括spinal fluid、peritoneal fluid、pleural fluid、urinary sediment、cervical smears、vaginal smears及濃縮之spinal、pleural、或peritoneal fluid的石蠟塊(Paraffin block)標本。這些方法極少用於診斷血液腫瘤或淋巴腫瘤。 當組織學診斷為癌症時，且免疫表現分型(immunophenotyping)及/或基因(genetic)檢測診斷亦為陽性，編碼為3。 當醫師臨床診斷為癌症時，是依據某些特定癌症臨床診斷用之實驗室檢查/腫瘤標記(包含免疫表現分型(immunophenotyping)同時/或基因(genetic)檢測)，但無組織學確診時，編碼為5。例如：Multiple myeloma 或Waldenstrom macroglobulinemia 之不正常電泳高峰(electrophoretic spike)。 若經由外科醫師手術探查之手術報告、或經由內視鏡檢查報告或屍體直接查看診斷為癌症，未做組織或細胞學檢查者，編碼為6。 當醫師僅以臨床診斷為癌症，無法編碼6或7時，則編碼為8。許多淋巴癌、血癌、其他血液腫瘤疾患，醫師的臨床診斷基於檢查檢驗報告與個案的臨床表現，以排除診斷的方式來確立診斷。
fields.purpose_en: Used to calculate the proportion of cancers confirmed by microscopic examination. Complete cancer incidence statistics should include clinically and pathologically confirmed cases.
fields.guide_en: Coding guide for solid tumors (all tumors except histologies M9590-9993): Select in order from the most precise histologic confirmation (code 1) to the least precise unknown (code 9). Code 1 is the most precise method of confirming cancer; whenever the case underwent a method coded 1, code 1 regardless of whether other forms of examination were done. If at any time during the course of disease the case underwent a more precise method of confirming cancer, change to the code with the smaller number. The following microscopic diagnostic bases should be coded 1: Tissue specimens from biopsy, frozen section, surgery, autopsy or D&C. Bone marrow specimens (aspiration or biopsy). The following microscopic diagnostic bases should be coded 2: Cytology, which may include sputum smears, bronchial brushings, bronchial washings, prostatic secretions, breast secretions, gastric fluid, spinal fluid, peritoneal fluid, pleural fluid, urinary sediment, cervical smears, vaginal smears. For example: because the false positive rate of cervical smear results is relatively high, for all cervical cancer cases the "Date of first microscopic confirmation" is based on the earliest histology sampling date; if only the Pap smear result is CIN3 or above while the histology result is negative, no report is needed, unless the clinician still diagnosed cervical cancer, in which case code from the Pap smear and code "Method of cancer confirmation" 2. Paraffin block specimens of concentrated spinal, pleural or peritoneal fluid. When the physician made a clinical diagnosis of cancer, if the clinical diagnosis was based on certain laboratory tests/tumor markers specifically used for the clinical diagnosis of cancer, code 5. For example: the only finding in a prostate cancer case is an elevated PSA, and the clinician diagnosed cancer based on this PSA value. Exception: alpha-fetoprotein in liver cancer must not be regarded as a method of confirming cancer. Code 6 for the surgeon's operative report of surgical exploration, or endoscopic examination such as colonoscopy, mediastinoscopy or peritoneoscopy, with no tissue specimen examination done at the same time. Coding guide for lymphoma, leukemia and other hematologic neoplasms (histologies M9590-9993): There is no order of priority in coding the method of confirmation for lymphoma, leukemia and other hematologic neoplasms. Most definitive histologies are diagnosed by immunophenotyping and/or genetic testing. "The Hematopoietic Database (DB)" provides more definitive diagnostic information on tumor types. The following microscopic diagnostic bases should be coded 1: Tissue specimens from biopsy, frozen section, surgery, autopsy or bone marrow (aspiration or biopsy). Applies to leukemia only: confirmed by hematologic findings, including peripheral blood smears, complete blood count (CBC) and white blood cell count (WBC); if the diagnosis was made only by immunophenotyping and/or genetic testing on bone marrow or blood, the code should not be 1. The following microscopic diagnostic bases should be coded 2: Cytology, which may include spinal fluid, peritoneal fluid, pleural fluid, urinary sediment, cervical smears, vaginal smears, and paraffin block specimens of concentrated spinal, pleural or peritoneal fluid. These methods are rarely used to diagnose hematologic or lymphoid neoplasms. When the histological diagnosis is cancer and the immunophenotyping and/or genetic testing is also positive, code 3. When the physician made a clinical diagnosis of cancer based on certain laboratory tests/tumor markers specifically used for the clinical diagnosis of cancer (including immunophenotyping and/or genetic testing) but without histological confirmation, code 5. For example: an abnormal electrophoretic spike in multiple myeloma or Waldenstrom macroglobulinemia. If cancer was diagnosed from the surgeon's operative report of surgical exploration, from an endoscopy report, or by direct visual inspection at autopsy, with no tissue or cytology examination, code 6. When the physician made only a clinical diagnosis of cancer and neither 6 nor 7 can be coded, code 8. For many lymphomas, leukemias and other hematologic neoplasms, the physician's clinical diagnosis is based on examination and laboratory reports and the case's clinical presentation, established by exclusion.

fields.name_zh: 首次顯微鏡檢證實日期
fields.description_zh:
記錄個案此癌症最早顯微鏡檢證實的日期。
欄位位置：91–98
fields.description_en:
Record the date this cancer was first confirmed by microscopic examination.
Field position: 91–98
fields.purpose_zh: 瞭解最初診斷日期與首次顯微鏡檢證實日期之不同，亦可計算至完成分期或開始治療的時間間隔。
fields.guide_zh:
 記錄採取標本的日期，而非病理報告完成日期。 「首次顯微鏡檢證實日期」以最早確定診斷日期為主，而病理組織型態則以較詳細之病理報告為主。 若細胞學檢查(cytology)報告中使用含糊不清的詞彙，例如”suspicious for malignancy”，不可編碼為首次顯微鏡檢證實日期。 「首次顯微鏡檢證實日期」以病理上的診斷為依據，包括Histology及Cytology。若個案Histology及Cytology採檢的日期不同，則以最早採檢的日期為主。例外 1：因子宮頸抹片檢查結果偽陽性機率偏高，因此所有子宮頸癌個案「首次顯微鏡檢證實日期」皆以最早的 Histology採檢日期為主；若只有 Pap smear檢查結果為 CIN3或以上，而 Histology結果呈陰性，則不需申報。例外 2：白血病或其他血液腫瘤疾患(排除淋巴癌)個案，全血球計數(CBC)或白血球計數(WBC)報告異常，醫師使用含糊不清字彙診斷癌症，則該採檢日不得為首次顯微鏡檢證實日期。 個案經診斷為白血病或其他血液腫瘤疾患(排除淋巴癌)者，若有下列任一情況時，以最早採檢日期為首次顯微鏡檢證實日期： 單次全血球計數(CBC)或白血球計數(WBC)報告異常。 多份全血球計數(CBC)或白血球計數(WBC)報告異常，且醫師確定診斷時明示採用某份異常報告；若醫師未明示採用某份異常報告，則以癌症確診後最近一份異常報告為主。 白血病個案若周邊血液(peripheral blood) blast≧20%，雖然醫師於病歷描述為rule out leukemia，仍可以視為確診。(此適用於2023診斷年之前個案) 經骨髓或其他組織切片檢查證實。注意1：執行CBC 或WBC 檢查結果須為異常，才可視為組織病理確診。注意2：CBC 或 WBC異常判定標準，請諮詢醫師或參考院內共識；若未能諮詢到醫師，則視報告結果無異常，癌登人員不需自行判斷。 許多淋巴癌、血癌、其他血液腫瘤疾患，醫師的臨床診斷依據檢查檢驗報告與個案的臨床表徵，且以排除其他癌症的方式來確立診斷，故「首次顯微鏡檢證實日期」應編碼為00000000。 「首次顯微鏡檢證實日期」盡量將年月日填寫完整，若無法填寫完整，請盡量推算至月份。範例：編碼：案例
