fields.purpose_en: Understand the difference between the initial diagnosis date and the date first confirmed by microscopic examination; can also be used to calculate the time interval to completion of staging or start of treatment.
fields.guide_en:
Record the date the specimen was collected, not the date the pathology report was completed. The "Date of first microscopic confirmation" is based on the earliest date of definite diagnosis, whereas the pathologic histology is based on the more detailed pathology report. If a cytology report uses vague terms, such as "suspicious for malignancy", it must not be coded as the date of first microscopic confirmation. The "Date of first microscopic confirmation" is based on the pathologic diagnosis, including histology and cytology. If the histology and cytology collection dates differ for the case, the earliest collection date is used. Exception 1: because the false-positive rate of Pap smear is relatively high, for all cervical cancer cases the "Date of first microscopic confirmation" is based on the earliest histology collection date; if only the Pap smear result is CIN3 or above and the histology is negative, no report is required. Exception 2: for a case of leukemia or another hematologic neoplasm (excluding lymphoma) with abnormal complete blood count (CBC) or white blood cell count (WBC) reports where the physician diagnoses cancer using vague terms, that collection date must not be the date of first microscopic confirmation. For a case diagnosed with leukemia or another hematologic neoplasm (excluding lymphoma), if any of the following applies, the earliest collection date is the date of first microscopic confirmation: a single abnormal complete blood count (CBC) or white blood cell count (WBC) report; multiple abnormal CBC or WBC reports where the physician explicitly states which abnormal report was used when confirming the diagnosis; if the physician did not state which abnormal report was used, the abnormal report closest to the cancer confirmation is used; for a leukemia case with peripheral blood blast ≧20%, even if the physician described it in the medical record as rule out leukemia, it may still be regarded as confirmed (this applies to cases diagnosed before 2023); confirmation by bone marrow or other tissue biopsy. Note 1: the CBC or WBC result must be abnormal for it to be regarded as histopathologic confirmation. Note 2: for the criteria for abnormal CBC or WBC, consult a physician or refer to the hospital's consensus; if no physician can be consulted, regard the report as normal; the cancer registrar need not judge on his/her own. For many lymphomas, leukemias and other hematologic neoplasms, the physician's clinical diagnosis is based on examination and laboratory reports and the case's clinical manifestations, and the diagnosis is established by excluding other cancers, so the "Date of first microscopic confirmation" should be coded 00000000. Fill in the year, month and day of the "Date of first microscopic confirmation" completely whenever possible; if it cannot be completed, estimate to the month as far as possible. Examples: Code: Case

fields.purpose_zh: 腫瘤大小是重要的癌症預後因子，也是判定 AJCC 期別的依據。一般編碼指引： 記錄報告中的腫瘤最大直徑，請依下列順序記錄其腫瘤大小：i. 若個案於手術前未接受輔助治療(neoadjuvant therapy)，且可取得病理報告記錄的腫瘤大小，應以病理報告(CAP protocol或pathology report checklist)描述的腫瘤大小來編碼。如果僅有text report，則腫瘤大小按照此順序摘錄：final diagnosis→ microscopic → gross examination。例如：肺癌病理報告為 2.1 cm × 3.2 cm × 1.4 cm，應編碼為 032 (32 mm)。例如：胸部X 光顯示3.5公分腫塊；手術取得病理報告記載此腫塊為惡性腫瘤，測量大小為 2.8公分，應編碼為 028 (28 mm)。ii. 若個案手術前(neoadjuvant)接受全身治療(化療、荷爾蒙治療、免疫療法)或放射治療，則編碼採用所有治療前最大的腫瘤大小。例如：個案口咽部位有一 2.2公分腫塊，經 fine needle aspiration 證實為 squamous cell carcinoma。個案先接受化學治療(neoadjuvant chemotherapy)後再手術，全切除手術腫瘤病理報告記載之大小為 2.8公分，應編碼為 022 (22 mm)。iii. 當個案病理報告或手術紀錄等無更詳盡之腫瘤大小資訊可提供時，可採用影像學檢查的腫瘤大小來編碼，最後才選擇理學檢查(physical exam)的大小編碼。注意：各項報告紀錄的腫瘤大小有差異。若個案有多項影像學檢查報告且分別描述不同腫瘤大小，無論以何種影像技術，應以最大的腫瘤大小來編碼。iv. 若上述i、ii、iii情況皆不適用，則腫瘤大小取診斷後4個月內無惡化情況下的最大徑。 採用腫瘤直徑的大小，而不是腫瘤的深度或厚度。 當腫瘤大小描述非實際數值時，請依下列方式摘錄：i. 若腫瘤大小描述為小於 x mm 或 x cm，則減少1mm摘錄。例如：腫瘤大小描述為 < 2 mm，編碼為001；< 1 cm，編碼為009 ; < 2 cm，編碼為019；< 3 cm，編碼為029；< 4 cm，編碼為039；< 5 cm，編碼為049。若描述為 < 1mm，則編碼為001，勿編碼為000。ii. 若腫瘤大小描述為大於 x mm 或 x cm，則增加1mm摘錄。例如：腫瘤大小描述為 > 10 mm 或 > 1 cm，編碼為011 ; > 2 cm，編碼為021；> 3 cm，編碼為031；> 4 cm，編碼為041；> 5 cm，編碼為051。若描述為大於989 mm (98.9 cm)，則編碼為989。iii. 若腫瘤大小描述為一個區間，應以最大值摘錄。例如：腫瘤大小描述為8-10 mm或是8 to 10 mm，編碼為010。例如：腫瘤大小描述為2-4 cm或是2 to 4 cm，編碼為040。 若腫瘤大小以亳米(mm)來描述且有小數點時，可使用四捨五入法。即當腫瘤大於1 mm時，0.1-0.4 mm捨去，0.5-0.9 mm進位(採四捨五入至亳米)。若腫瘤小於或等於1 mm、最大直徑介於0.1到0.9 mm，編碼為001 (此時勿採捨去法編碼為000)。例外：僅適用於乳癌，依據AJCC第八版第48章之乳癌規則，當腫瘤大小為>1.0 mm和≤2.4mm之間，應編碼為002。例如：描述乳癌腫瘤大小為6.5 mm，編碼為007。描述乳癌腫瘤大小為1.3 mm，編碼為002。描述Focus of cancer大小為0.5 mm，編碼為001。描述Focus of cancer大小為1.4 mm，編碼為001。描述直腸腫瘤大小為2.5 cm，編碼為025。 記錄原發腫瘤的大小，不可採用瘜肉(polyps)、潰瘍(ulcer)、囊腫(cysts)或轉移部位的大小來編碼。但對於描述為cystic mass的腫瘤，若是只有標示mass的大小，則以整個mass的大小來編碼，因為此囊腫本來就是腫瘤的一部份。例如：描述Polyp為15 mm，cancer in polyp的大小為2.3 mm，編碼為002。 記錄invasive部份的腫瘤大小。i. 若腫瘤同時含有in situ及invasive兩個部份，且已經個別測量大小，即使invasive的部分比較小，仍應以invasive的大小來編碼。例如：病理報告描述腺癌腫塊為3.7 cm混合有侵襲性及原位癌，其中1.4 cm為侵襲性，記錄腫瘤大小為014 (14 mm)。例如：病理報告描述乳房腫塊為2 x 1.5公分的intraductal carcinoma及1公分的infiltrating ductal carcinoma，應以侵襲性部分的1公分編碼為010 (10 mm)。ii. 若沒有記錄侵襲癌的腫瘤大小，則應參考手術紀錄、病理報告、影像學報告或是臨床檢查中所描述之整個腫瘤的大小編碼。例如：乳房腫瘤描述為infiltrating duct carcinoma with extensive in situ，整個腫瘤大小為2.3公分，則編碼為023 (23 mm)。例如：病理報告描述乳房腫瘤為Duct carcinoma in situ measuring 1.9 cm with an area of invasive ductal carcinoma，則編碼為019 (19 mm)。 記錄腫瘤之最大直徑，無論是取自切片檢查或原發腫瘤完全切除之標本。例如：肺癌個案於肺臟右上葉有個 1公分結節、右中葉有個 1.3公分結節。其腫瘤大小應以最大的結節 1.3公分，編碼為 013 (13 mm)。例如：腫瘤描述為 2.4 x 5.1 x 1.8 cm 的大小，應編碼為 051 (51mm).例如：肛門腫瘤從近端到遠端的大小為 2.5公分、環周長(circumference)為3.5公分，應摘錄腫瘤大小為 035 (35 mm)。環周長測量是此個案的最大測量值，病理學家通常將肛門和直腸像管子一樣切開，並將其展平成平面後測量周長。 腫瘤單純只有in situ，則直接以描述的大小來編碼。 腫瘤為Multifocal/multicentric，腫瘤為多灶性或有多個腫瘤起源於一個部位，其中若有侵襲癌部分，則摘錄侵襲癌中最大徑腫瘤大小；若僅為原位癌，取最大的腫瘤尺寸進行編碼。 顯微鏡檢下有殘餘腫瘤或手術邊緣陽性並不影響整體腫瘤大小，故可直接以其腫瘤大小逕行編碼。 若原發部位已執行過excisional biopsy之後再進行腫瘤切除，而殘餘腫瘤大於excisional biopsy時，則以殘餘腫瘤大小來編碼。 未記錄臨床腫瘤大小但接受incisional needle biopsy者，若個案作進一步切除手術時並無發現殘餘腫瘤，可採用incisional needle biopsy之腫瘤大小逕行編碼；或少見的個案其incisional needle biopsy的腫瘤大於切除手術的腫瘤大小，可採用incisional needle biopsy之腫瘤大小逕行編碼。 腫瘤大小依照T分期。若病歷記錄T分期項目及精確的腫瘤大小，則採用精確大小編碼。若醫師僅於醫療紀錄描述T分期項目，且T分期項目是依照腫瘤大小決定，則採用合適的編碼。 腫瘤大小編碼為000，適用於：i. 沒有發現原發部位的腫瘤或腫塊，但已有轉移癌。ii. 使用AJCC第6章Cervical Lymph Nodes and Unknown Primary of Head and Neck者(T0)。 僅由顯微鏡觀察見到微小病灶(microscopic focus)且未記載腫瘤大小，則編碼為990。(肉眼觀察下未發現腫瘤而僅於顯微鏡檢才辨識出腫瘤存在)。注意：「microscopic focus、microfocus 及 microinvasion」之意與「macroscopic focal or focus」不同，後者指於肉眼下可看得見之非常小的腫瘤。若僅於顯微鏡檢才辨識出腫瘤，應編碼為 990。若報告同時描述 microscopic focus 及明確腫瘤大小時，則編碼明確腫瘤大小。例如：子宮頸錐狀切除(conization)顯示為 severe dysplasia with focal areas of microinvasion，編碼為990 (顯微鏡觀察為微小病灶且無記載其大小)。例如：個案病理報告描述標本為 2 x 3 cm，其中於顯微鏡觀察下發現有 a focus of infiltrating carcinoma，編碼為 990 (顯微鏡觀察為微小病灶且無記載其大小)。例如：卵巢檢體病理報告 macroscopic (gross)描述為：extensive cystic disease with focal areas of tumor seeding，則不管其「focal」應編碼為 999 (不詳)。(因未註明腫瘤大小)例如：乳癌個案病理報告於顯微鏡觀察下發現有 multicentric microscopic foci，最大為0.5 mm，應編碼001。 當下列部位之腫瘤侵犯情形以下列字彙敘述時，應編碼為998；即使病歷上有描述腫瘤大小，仍應編碼998，不摘錄明確腫瘤大小：家族性/多發性息肉症 (Familial/multiple polyposis) : Colon (C18.0, C18.2-C18.9) Rectosigmoid and rectum (C19.9, C20.9) 當下列部位之腫瘤侵犯情形有描述腫瘤大小，則可摘錄腫瘤大小，若無描述大小，僅以下列字彙敘述時，應編碼998：侵犯整圈 (Circumferential) : Esophagus (C15.0-C15.5, C15.8-C15.9)瀰漫性(diffuse)；廣泛擴散(widespread)；侵犯3/4或更多；皮革胃(linitis plastica) : Stomach and Esophagus GE Junction (C16.0-C16.6, C16.8-C16.9)瀰漫性(diffuse)、侵犯整個肺臟或NOS : Lung and main stem bronchus (C34.0-C34.3, C34.8-C34.9)瀰漫性(diffuse) : Breast (C50.0-C50.6, C50.8-C50.9) High grade dysplasia (severe dysplasia) 個案之腫瘤大小請參考病理報告，勿採用影像學報告；若病理報告無描述腫瘤大小，應編碼為998。 腫瘤大小不詳或病歷未記載，則腫瘤大小編碼為999。 不適用腫瘤大小。下列組織類型或腫瘤部位之腫瘤大小不適用(not applicable)登錄於本欄位，應編碼為999：i. 以下部位之腫瘤大小應編碼為999： 原發部位為 C420, C421, C423-C424, C770-C779 或 C809 Hematopoietic, Reticuloendothelial, and Myeloproliferative neoplasms:組織型態範圍為9590-9993。排除Spleen (C422), Lymphoma Ocular Adnexa, Primary Cutaneous Lymphomas, Mycosis Fungoides and lymphomas that are collected in the Brain, CNS Other and Intracranial Gland。 Kaposi Sarcoma Lymphoma Lymphoma-CLL/SLL Melanoma Choroid and Ciliary Body Melanoma Iris Plasma Cell Disorders Plasma Cell Myeloma ii. 勿試圖將腫瘤碎片進行拼湊成一整個腫瘤大小，因為難以還原腫瘤原有的大小(可能不是位在同一個位置；或可能僅僅代表著一個大腫瘤很小的一部份)，此時應編碼為999；但若病理醫師有記載腫瘤聚集重建起來的大小，則可直接將此大小編碼。iii. 若僅測量鈣化(calcifications)或是細微鈣化點(a cluster of microcalcifications)的大小時，則不可將此視為腫瘤大小，若無測量腫塊(mass)或是腫瘤(tumor)的大小，則應編碼為999。iv. 前導性治療後接受手術，則不可摘錄手術後的病理報告所描述的腫瘤大小，應參考治療前所描述的臨床資訊，若治療前沒有描述腫瘤大小，則編碼為999。
fields.guide_zh:
範例：編碼：案例
000：頸部淋巴結執行 excision biopsy，病理報告診斷為squamous cell carcinoma，同時EBER 反應為陽性，但於頭頸部影像檢查及各處執行切片皆未發現有腫瘤，臨床醫師診斷原發部位為 nasopharyngeal carcinoma。
001：攝護腺癌之 TURP 呈現惡性病灶 0.6 mm(四捨五入為 1mm)。
008：甲狀腺切除的檢體病理報告為 8亳米的carcinoma。

013：肺癌個案於肺臟右上葉有個 1 公分結節、右中葉有個 1.3公分結節。其腫瘤大小應以最大的結節 13 mm 編碼。
022：個案口咽部位有一 2.2公分腫塊，經 fine needle aspiration 證實為squamous cell carcinoma。個案先接受化學治療(neoadjuvant chemotherapy)後再手術，全切除手術腫瘤病理報告記載之大小為 0.8公分。
023：乳癌病理報告為 infiltrating ductal carcinoma with extensive in situ component；整個腫瘤大小為 2.3公分。
025：乳癌Mammogram 呈現2.5 cm(2.5 cm = 25 millimeters)的惡性腫瘤。
028：胸部X光顯示 3.5公分腫塊；手術取的病理報告記載此腫塊為惡性腫瘤，測量大小為2.8 公分。
040：胸部電腦斷層顯示：右上肺葉有 4公分腫塊(4 cm = 40 mm)。
044：病理報告描述腫瘤大小為 3x 4.4 x 2.5 cm，應以腫瘤最大直徑 44 mm 編碼。
990：病理報告描述標本為 2 x 3 cm，其中於顯微鏡觀察下發現有 a focus of infiltrating carcinoma。
990：子宮頸錐狀切除(conization)顯示為 severe dysplasia with focal areas of microinvasion，應編碼為990(顯微鏡觀察為微小病灶且無記載其大小)。
990：肺葉切除之病理報告描述 multiple microscopic foci(顯微鏡觀察為多個微小病灶且無記載其大小)。
fields.purpose_en: Tumor size is an important prognostic factor for cancer and is also the basis for determining AJCC stage. General coding guidelines: • Record the maximum tumor diameter in the report, in the following order: i. If the case did not receive neoadjuvant therapy (neoadjuvant therapy) before surgery and a tumor size recorded in a pathology report is available, code the tumor size described in the pathology report (CAP protocol or pathology report checklist). If only a text report is available, abstract the tumor size in this order: final diagnosis → microscopic → gross examination. Example: a lung cancer pathology report states 2.1 cm × 3.2 cm × 1.4 cm; code as 032 (32 mm). Example: chest X-ray shows a 3.5 cm mass; the surgical pathology report states the mass is a malignant tumor measuring 2.8 cm; code as 028 (28 mm). ii. If the case received systemic therapy (chemotherapy, hormone therapy, immunotherapy) or radiotherapy before surgery (neoadjuvant), code the largest tumor size before all treatment. Example: the case has a 2.2 cm mass in the oropharynx confirmed by fine needle aspiration as squamous cell carcinoma. The case received neoadjuvant chemotherapy (neoadjuvant chemotherapy) before surgery, and the tumor size in the pathology report of the total resection is 2.8 cm; code as 022 (22 mm). iii. When the pathology report or operative record of the case provides no more detailed tumor size information, the tumor size from imaging may be used for coding, and finally the size from physical examination (physical exam). Note: tumor sizes recorded in various reports may differ. If the case has multiple imaging reports describing different tumor sizes, code the largest tumor size regardless of the imaging technique. iv. If none of i, ii and iii above apply, use the largest diameter within 4 months after diagnosis without progression. • Use the tumor diameter, not the depth or thickness of the tumor. • When the tumor size is described as a non-actual value, abstract as follows: i. If the tumor size is described as less than x mm or x cm, subtract 1 mm. Example: tumor size described as < 2 mm, code 001; < 1 cm, code 009 ; < 2 cm, code 019; < 3 cm, code 029; < 4 cm, code 039; < 5 cm, code 049. If described as < 1mm, code 001, do not code 000. ii. If the tumor size is described as greater than x mm or x cm, add 1 mm. Example: tumor size described as > 10 mm or > 1 cm, code 011 ; > 2 cm, code 021; > 3 cm, code 031; > 4 cm, code 041; > 5 cm, code 051. If described as greater than 989 mm (98.9 cm), code 989. iii. If the tumor size is described as a range, abstract the maximum value. Example: tumor size described as 8-10 mm or 8 to 10 mm, code 010. Example: tumor size described as 2-4 cm or 2 to 4 cm, code 040. • If the tumor size is described in millimeters (mm) with decimals, rounding may be used. That is, when the tumor is larger than 1 mm, 0.1-0.4 mm is rounded down and 0.5-0.9 mm is rounded up (rounded to the nearest mm). If the tumor is less than or equal to 1 mm, with a maximum diameter between 0.1 and 0.9 mm, code 001 (do not round down to 000 in this case). Exception: applies to breast cancer only; according to the AJCC 8th edition chapter 48 breast cancer rule, when the tumor size is >1.0 mm and ≤2.4 mm, code 002. Example: breast cancer tumor size described as 6.5 mm, code 007. Breast cancer tumor size described as 1.3 mm, code 002. Size of Focus of cancer described as 0.5 mm, code 001. Size of Focus of cancer described as 1.4 mm, code 001. Rectal tumor size described as 2.5 cm, code 025. • Record the size of the primary tumor; do not use the size of polyps (polyps), ulcers (ulcer), cysts (cysts) or metastatic sites for coding. However, for a tumor described as a cystic mass, if only the size of the mass is given, code the size of the whole mass, because the cyst is part of the tumor. Example: Polyp is 15 mm and the cancer in polyp is 2.3 mm, code 002. • Record the size of the invasive part of the tumor. i. If the tumor contains both in situ and invasive parts and each has been measured separately, code the invasive size even if the invasive part is smaller. Example: the pathology report describes a 3.7 cm adenocarcinoma mass mixed with invasive and in situ carcinoma, of which 1.4 cm is invasive; record tumor size as 014 (14 mm). Example: the pathology report describes a breast mass with 2 x 1.5 cm intraductal carcinoma and 1 cm infiltrating ductal carcinoma; code the 1 cm invasive part as 010 (10 mm). ii. If the size of the invasive carcinoma is not recorded, code the size of the whole tumor described in the operative record, pathology report, imaging report or clinical examination. Example: a breast tumor described as infiltrating duct carcinoma with extensive in situ, with a whole tumor size of 2.3 cm; code 023 (23 mm). Example: the pathology report describes a breast tumor as Duct carcinoma in situ measuring 1.9 cm with an area of invasive ductal carcinoma; code 019 (19 mm). • Record the maximum diameter of the tumor, whether taken from a biopsy or from a completely resected primary tumor specimen. Example: a lung cancer case has a 1 cm nodule in the right upper lobe and a 1.3 cm nodule in the right middle lobe. Its tumor size should be coded using the largest nodule, 1.3 cm, as 013 (13 mm). Example: a tumor described as 2.4 x 5.1 x 1.8 cm should be coded as 051 (51mm). Example: an anal tumor measures 2.5 cm from proximal to distal and the circumference (circumference) is 3.5 cm; the tumor size should be abstracted as 035 (35 mm). The circumference measurement is the largest measurement for this case; pathologists usually cut the anus and rectum open like a tube and flatten them into a plane before measuring the circumference. • If the tumor is in situ only, code the size as described. • If the tumor is multifocal/multicentric, that is, multifocal or with multiple tumors arising from one site, then if there is an invasive carcinoma component, abstract the largest-diameter tumor size within the invasive carcinoma; if there is only carcinoma in situ, code the largest tumor dimension. • Residual tumor under microscopy or positive surgical margins does not affect the overall tumor size, so code the tumor size directly. • If an excisional biopsy was performed at the primary site before tumor resection and the residual tumor is larger than the excisional biopsy, code the size of the residual tumor. • If the clinical tumor size is not recorded but the case underwent incisional needle biopsy (incisional needle biopsy), and no residual tumor was found at further resection, the tumor size from the incisional needle biopsy may be coded directly; or, in rare cases where the tumor in the incisional needle biopsy is larger than the tumor at resection, the tumor size from the incisional needle biopsy may be coded directly. • Tumor size according to T category. If the medical record documents the T category item and the exact tumor size, code the exact size. If the physician only describes the T category item in the medical record and the T category is determined by tumor size, use the appropriate code. • Tumor size code 000 applies to: i. No tumor or mass found at the primary site, but metastatic cancer is present. ii. Use of AJCC chapter 6 Cervical Lymph Nodes and Unknown Primary of Head and Neck (T0). • If only a microscopic focus (microscopic focus) is seen under the microscope and no tumor size is recorded, code 990. (No tumor seen on gross examination, and the tumor was identified only on microscopic examination.) Note: the meaning of 'microscopic focus, microfocus and microinvasion' differs from that of 'macroscopic focal or focus', the latter referring to a very small tumor visible to the naked eye. If the tumor was identified only on microscopic examination, code 990. If the report describes both a microscopic focus and a definite tumor size, code the definite tumor size. Example: cervical conization shows severe dysplasia with focal areas of microinvasion; code 990 (microscopic focus with no size recorded). Example: the pathology report of the case describes the specimen as 2 x 3 cm, in which a focus of infiltrating carcinoma was found under the microscope; code 990 (microscopic focus with no size recorded). Example: the ovarian specimen pathology report macroscopic (gross) description is: extensive cystic disease with focal areas of tumor seeding; regardless of 'focal', code 999 (unknown). (Because no tumor size is stated.) Example: the pathology report of a breast cancer case found multicentric microscopic foci under the microscope, the largest being 0.5 mm; code 001. • When tumor invasion at the following sites is described with the following terms, code 998; even if the medical record describes a tumor size, code 998 and do not abstract a specific tumor size: Familial/multiple polyposis (Familial/multiple polyposis) : • Colon (C18.0, C18.2-C18.9) • Rectosigmoid and rectum (C19.9, C20.9) • When tumor invasion at the following sites has a described tumor size, the size may be abstracted; if no size is described and only the following terms are used, code 998: Circumferential involvement (Circumferential) : • Esophagus (C15.0-C15.5, C15.8-C15.9) Diffuse (diffuse); widespread (widespread); involving 3/4 or more; linitis plastica (linitis plastica) : • Stomach and Esophagus GE Junction (C16.0-C16.6, C16.8-C16.9) Diffuse (diffuse), involving the entire lung, or NOS : • Lung and main stem bronchus (C34.0-C34.3, C34.8-C34.9) Diffuse (diffuse) : • Breast (C50.0-C50.6, C50.8-C50.9) • For cases of High grade dysplasia (severe dysplasia), refer to the pathology report for tumor size and do not use imaging reports; if the pathology report does not describe tumor size, code 998. • If the tumor size is unknown or not recorded in the medical record, code 999. • Tumor size not applicable. For the following histologic types or tumor sites, tumor size is not applicable (not applicable) to this field and should be coded 999: i. Tumor size for the following sites should be coded 999: • Primary site is C420, C421, C423-C424, C770-C779 or C809 • Hematopoietic, Reticuloendothelial, and Myeloproliferative neoplasms: histology range 9590-9993. Excluding Spleen (C422), Lymphoma Ocular Adnexa, Primary Cutaneous Lymphomas, Mycosis Fungoides and lymphomas that are collected in the Brain, CNS Other and Intracranial Gland. • Kaposi Sarcoma • Lymphoma • Lymphoma-CLL/SLL • Melanoma Choroid and Ciliary Body • Melanoma Iris • Plasma Cell Disorders • Plasma Cell Myeloma ii. Do not try to piece together tumor fragments into a whole tumor size, because it is difficult to restore the original tumor size (the fragments may not be from the same location, or may represent only a tiny part of a large tumor); code 999 in this case; but if the pathologist has recorded a reconstructed size of the aggregated tumor fragments, that size may be coded directly. iii. If only the size of calcifications (calcifications) or a cluster of microcalcifications (a cluster of microcalcifications) is measured, it must not be regarded as the tumor size; if no mass (mass) or tumor (tumor) size is measured, code 999. iv. If surgery is performed after neoadjuvant therapy, do not abstract the tumor size described in the post-surgical pathology report; refer to the clinical information described before treatment, and if no tumor size was described before treatment, code 999.
fields.guide_en:
Example: Code: Case
000: Excision biopsy of a neck lymph node; the pathology report diagnosed squamous cell carcinoma and EBER was positive, but head and neck imaging and biopsies at various sites found no tumor, and the clinician diagnosed the primary site as nasopharyngeal carcinoma.
001: TURP for prostate cancer showed a malignant focus of 0.6 mm (rounded to 1mm).
008: The pathology report of a thyroidectomy specimen showed carcinoma of 8 mm.
010: The pathology report described a breast mass as 2 x 1.5 cm of intraductal carcinoma and 1 cm of infiltrating ductal carcinoma; code directly with the invasive 10 mm.
013: A lung cancer patient had a 1 cm nodule in the right upper lobe and a 1.3 cm nodule in the right middle lobe. The tumor size should be coded as the largest nodule, 13 mm.
022: The patient had a 2.2 cm mass in the oropharynx, confirmed as squamous cell carcinoma by fine needle aspiration. The patient first received chemotherapy (neoadjuvant chemotherapy) and then surgery; the tumor size recorded in the pathology report of the complete resection was 0.8 cm.
023: The breast cancer pathology report was infiltrating ductal carcinoma with extensive in situ component; the whole tumor size was 2.3 cm.
025: A breast cancer mammogram showed a malignant tumor of 2.5 cm (2.5 cm = 25 millimeters).
028: A chest X-ray showed a 3.5 cm mass; the pathology report of the surgical specimen recorded the mass as a malignant tumor measuring 2.8 cm.
040: Chest CT showed a 4 cm mass in the right upper lobe (4 cm = 40 mm).
044: The pathology report described the tumor size as 3x 4.4 x 2.5 cm; code the maximum tumor diameter, 44 mm.
990: The pathology report described the specimen as 2 x 3 cm, in which a focus of infiltrating carcinoma was found under the microscope.
990: Cervical conization showed severe dysplasia with focal areas of microinvasion; it should be coded 990 (microscopic focus with no size recorded).
990: The pathology report of a lobectomy described multiple microscopic foci (multiple microscopic foci with no size recorded).

fields.description_zh:
記錄病歷中原發部位病理報告記載神經侵襲的情形。

fields.description_en:
Record whether perineural invasion is documented in the primary site pathology report in the medical record.
Field position: 102–102
fields.purpose_zh: 做為預後評估。腫瘤是否有神經侵襲，為臨床治療上的重要因素之一。
fields.guide_zh:
 根據原發部位病理報告摘錄是否有神經侵襲。若無病理報告，則可以參考病歷記錄中有關病理資訊之描述。 可參考申報醫院與外院資料，優先摘錄神經侵襲之陽性資訊，若無外院資料則摘錄申報醫院資料。 病情惡化後所執行的病理報告則不採用。 病理報告若描述為無殘餘腫瘤(no residual tumor)時，應視為無神經侵襲。 任一原發部位病理報告記載有神經侵襲，編碼為1。 未接受前導性治療的個案，若有多份原發部位病理報告，且報告內容描述涵蓋有不確定、未侵襲或不詳等記錄時，應以未侵襲的記錄為優先，編碼為0。 所有原發部位病理報告皆未描述神經侵襲情形，編碼為7。 因病理樣本無法評估或判斷而未能描述神經侵襲侵犯情形，編碼為7。 個案為High grade dysplasia (severe dysplasia)或原位癌，編碼為8(不適用)。 原發部位未執行病理組織檢查或僅執行細胞學檢查、原發部位不詳(C80.9)、淋巴瘤、白血病、Plasma Cell Myeloma、GIST和NETs之個案與中樞神經系統之惡性腫瘤，應編碼為8 (不適用)。 若個案接受前導性治療，登錄原則如下： 前導性治療執行前後任一原發部位病理報告記錄有神經侵襲，應編碼為1。 若治療前後的病理報告皆描述未有神經侵襲時，應編碼為0。 若治療前的病理報告描述為不確定是否有侵犯與未侵犯兩種記錄時，治療後有病理報告描述為未侵犯或無任何資訊請編碼7；治療後若無病理報告且無任何資訊編碼9。 若治療前無任何資訊，治療後病理報告描述未侵犯或無資訊編碼9。範例：編碼：案例
0：結腸癌個案切片病理報告並未描述神經侵襲狀態，接受手術治療，術後病理報告描述沒有神經侵襲。
0：口腔癌個案切片病理報告描述神經侵襲狀態為 NA，後續接受手術治療，術後病理報告描述沒有神經侵襲。
7：卵巢癌個案經影像確診後，接受手術治療，術後病理報告未描述神經侵襲狀態。
8：卵巢癌個案經影像確診後，病人拒絕切片檢查，後續未再回診。
fields.purpose_en: Used for prognosis assessment. Whether the tumor has perineural invasion is one of the important factors in clinical treatment.
fields.guide_en:
Abstract whether there is perineural invasion from the primary site pathology report. If there is no pathology report, the description of pathology information in the medical record may be consulted. Data from the reporting hospital and other facilities may be consulted; abstract positive information on perineural invasion first; if there are no data from another facility, abstract the reporting hospital data. Pathology reports performed after disease progression are not used. If the pathology report describes no residual tumor, it should be regarded as no perineural invasion. If any primary site pathology report records perineural invasion, code 1. For a case that did not receive neoadjuvant therapy, if there are multiple primary site pathology reports and the contents include records of uncertain, no invasion, or unknown, give priority to the record of no invasion and code 0. If no primary site pathology report describes perineural invasion, code 7. If perineural invasion could not be described because the pathology specimen could not be assessed or judged, code 7. If the case has High grade dysplasia (severe dysplasia) or carcinoma in situ, code 8 (not applicable). For cases with no pathological tissue examination of the primary site or only cytology, unknown primary site (C80.9), lymphoma, leukemia, Plasma Cell Myeloma, GIST and NETs, and malignant tumors of the central nervous system, code 8 (not applicable). If the case received neoadjuvant therapy, the recording principles are as follows: If any primary site pathology report before or after neoadjuvant therapy records perineural invasion, code 1. If the pathology reports before and after treatment both describe no perineural invasion, code 0. If the pathology report before treatment describes both uncertain invasion and no invasion records, and the report after treatment describes no invasion or has no information, code 7; if there is no pathology report after treatment and no information at all, code 9. If there is no information before treatment, and the pathology report after treatment describes no invasion or has no information, code 9. Examples: Code: Case
0: A colon cancer case; the biopsy pathology report did not describe perineural invasion status, the case received surgical treatment, and the post-operative pathology report described no perineural invasion.
0: An oral cancer case; the biopsy pathology report described perineural invasion status as NA, the case then received surgical treatment, and the post-operative pathology report described no perineural invasion.
7: An ovarian cancer case was confirmed by imaging and then received surgical treatment; the post-operative pathology report did not describe perineural invasion status.
8: An ovarian cancer case was confirmed by imaging; the patient refused biopsy and did not return afterwards.

fields.purpose_zh: 做為治療評估。腫瘤是否有淋巴管或血管侵犯，為臨床治療上的重要因素之一。
fields.guide_zh:
 根據原發部位病理報告摘錄是否有淋巴管或血管侵犯。若無病理報告，則可以參考病歷記錄中有關病理資訊之描述。 可參考申報醫院與外院資料，優先摘錄淋巴管或血管侵犯之陽性資訊，若無外院資料則摘錄申報醫院資料。 病情惡化後所執行的病理報告則不採用。 病理報告若描述為無殘餘腫瘤(no residual tumor)時，應視為無淋巴管或血管侵犯。 與Lymph-vascular invasion(LVI)的同義字詞包括：Angiolymphatic invasion、Blood vessel invasion、Lymph-vascular emboli、Lymphatic invasion、Lymphvascular invasion、Vascular invasion。 任一原發部位病理報告有描述淋巴管或血管有侵犯，編碼為1。 未接受前導性治療的個案，若有多份原發部位病理報告，且報告內容描述涵蓋有不確定、未侵襲或不詳等記錄時，應以未侵襲的記錄為優先，編碼為0。 所有原發部位病理報告皆未描述淋巴管或血管侵犯情形，編碼為7。 因病理樣本無法評估或判斷而未能描述淋巴管或血管侵犯情形，編碼為7。 個案為High grade dysplasia (severe dysplasia)或原位癌，編碼為8(不適用)。 原發部位未執行病理檢查或僅細胞學檢查、原發部位不詳(C80.9)、淋巴瘤、白血病、Plasma Cell Myeloma、GIST 和NETs 之個案與中樞神經系統之惡性腫瘤，應編碼為 8 (不適用)。 若個案接受前導性治療，登錄原則如下： 前導性治療執行前後任一原發部位病理報告記錄有淋巴管或血管有侵犯，應編碼為1。 若治療前後的病理報告皆描述淋巴管或血管未侵犯時，應編碼為0。 若治療前的病理報告描述為不確定是否有侵犯與未侵犯兩種記錄時，治療後有病理報告描述為未侵犯或無任何資訊請編碼7；治療後若無病理報告且無任何資訊編碼9。 若治療前無任何資訊，治療後病理報告描述未侵犯或無資訊編碼 9。範例：編碼：案例
0：結腸癌個案切片病理報告並未描述淋巴管或血管侵犯狀態，接受手術治療，術後病理報告描述沒有淋巴或血管侵犯。
0：口腔癌個案切片病理報告描述淋巴管或血管狀態為 NA，後續接受手術治療，術後病理報告描述沒有淋巴或血管侵犯。
7：卵巢癌個案經影像確診後，接受手術治療，術後病理報告未描述淋巴管或血管侵犯狀態。
8：卵巢癌個案經影像確診後，病人拒絕切片檢查，後續未再回診。
fields.purpose_en: Used for treatment evaluation. Whether the tumor has lymphovascular invasion is one of the important factors in clinical treatment.
fields.guide_en:
Abstract whether there is lymphatic or vascular invasion from the primary site pathology report. If there is no pathology report, the description of pathology information in the medical record may be consulted. Data from the reporting hospital and other facilities may be consulted; abstract positive information on lymphatic or vascular invasion first; if there are no data from another facility, abstract the reporting hospital data. Pathology reports performed after disease progression are not used. If the pathology report describes no residual tumor, it should be regarded as no lymphatic or vascular invasion. Synonyms of Lymph-vascular invasion (LVI) include: Angiolymphatic invasion, Blood vessel invasion, Lymph-vascular emboli, Lymphatic invasion, Lymphvascular invasion, Vascular invasion. If any primary site pathology report describes lymphatic or vascular invasion, code 1. For a case that did not receive neoadjuvant therapy, if there are multiple primary site pathology reports and the contents include records of uncertain, no invasion, or unknown, give priority to the record of no invasion and code 0. If no primary site pathology report describes lymphatic or vascular invasion, code 7. If lymphatic or vascular invasion could not be described because the pathology specimen could not be assessed or judged, code 7. If the case has High grade dysplasia (severe dysplasia) or carcinoma in situ, code 8 (not applicable). For cases with no pathological examination of the primary site or only cytology, unknown primary site (C80.9), lymphoma, leukemia, Plasma Cell Myeloma, GIST and NETs, and malignant tumors of the central nervous system, code 8 (not applicable). If the case received neoadjuvant therapy, the recording principles are as follows: If any primary site pathology report before or after neoadjuvant therapy records lymphatic or vascular invasion, code 1. If the pathology reports before and after treatment both describe no lymphatic or vascular invasion, code 0. If the pathology report before treatment describes both uncertain invasion and no invasion records, and the report after treatment describes no invasion or has no information, code 7; if there is no pathology report after treatment and no information at all, code 9. If there is no information before treatment, and the pathology report after treatment describes no invasion or has no information, code 9. Examples: Code: Case
0: A colon cancer case; the biopsy pathology report did not describe lymphatic or vascular invasion status, the case received surgical treatment, and the post-operative pathology report described no lymphatic or vascular invasion.
0: An oral cancer case; the biopsy pathology report described lymphatic or vascular status as NA, the case then received surgical treatment, and the post-operative pathology report described no lymphatic or vascular invasion.
7: An ovarian cancer case was confirmed by imaging and then received surgical treatment; the post-operative pathology report did not describe lymphatic or vascular invasion status.
8: An ovarian cancer case was confirmed by imaging; the patient refused biopsy and did not return afterwards.

fields.guide_zh:  本欄位僅適用於區域淋巴結，不含遠端淋巴結。 於首次療程中，不論摘除前是否接受治療，均以病理報告記載為準。 不確定是否檢查或移除淋巴結，編碼99。 編碼00，情況包括： 僅有臨床評估。 淋巴結未經病理檢驗。 進行淋巴結引流區之摘除(dissection)，但病理檢查未檢驗出淋巴組織。例如： 乳癌個案接受腋下淋巴結摘除，病理報告描述為軟組織轉移，且組織標本未檢測出淋巴結，則編碼為 00。 若區域淋巴結檢查數目編碼00，則區域淋巴結侵犯數目應編碼98。 記錄所有首次療程中，所有經病理檢驗之區域淋巴結總數，說明如下： 應累計診斷處置(aspiration、core biopsy)及手術切除(dissection)所摘除的區域淋巴結數目。注意：區域淋巴結檢查數目之累計，需視採樣是否來自於同一淋巴結群(lymph node chain)；若屬於同一淋巴結群，則區域淋巴結檢查數目應以手術切除顆數為主。 若同一淋巴結群，有進行診斷處置(aspiration、core biopsy)與手術切除(dissection)時，摘除的區域淋巴結顆數不可加總。例如： 肺癌個案透過 mediastinoscopy 從hilar lymph node 以core biopsy 採樣(呈陽性)，再進行右上葉肺切除手術，dissection 11 顆淋巴結，其中 hilar(3 顆)及mediastinal nodes(2 顆)均為陽性。正確編碼為：區域淋巴結檢查數目 11；區域淋巴結侵犯數目 05 (同一chain 之core biopsy 不予加總)。 若不同淋巴結群，有進行診斷處置(aspiration、core biopsy)與手術切除(dissection)時，摘除的區域淋巴結顆數可加總。例如： 乳癌個案從 supraclavicular node以 core biopsy 採樣呈(1顆)陽性，並從 axillary進行 dissection 取出8顆淋巴結，3顆為陽性。正確編碼為：區域淋巴結檢查數目 09；區域淋巴結侵犯數目 04 (supraclavicular node與 axillary node雖為不同的 chain，但兩者均屬區域淋巴結，應進行加總) 。 不確定診斷處置採樣取自何處之淋巴結，則應假設與手術摘除之淋巴結為相同淋巴結群，因此摘除顆數不可加總。例如： 個案在他院進行 core biopsy，且resection 時採檢 7/14 陽性淋巴結，「區域淋巴結檢查數目」應編碼為 14，「區域淋巴結侵犯數目」應編碼為 07。 顆數描述不一致時，採用的優先順序依次為：final diagnosis, CAP protocol, microscopic, gross。 僅以aspiration或core biopsy採樣，編碼95。 以sampling (包括excisional biopsy, berry picking, sentinel lymph node procedure等)方式採樣，若有記載顆數則按顆數編碼，若顆數不詳則編碼96。 以dissection (包括lymphadenectomy, radical node dissection, lymph node stripping, selective dissection)摘除大部分或所有同一chain(s)的淋巴結，顆數不詳，編碼97。 若同時以sampling及dissection方式處理，顆數不詳，編碼97。 淋巴結移除方式及顆數不詳，編碼98。 以下之原發部位和組織類型碼，應編碼為99： Placenta (C58.9) Brain and Cerebral Meninges (C70.0-C70.9, C71.0-C71.9) Other Parts of Central Nervous System (C72.0-C72.5,C72.8-C72.9, C75.1-C75.3) Hematopoietic, Reticuloendothelial, Immunoproliferative and Myeloproliferative Neoplasms，範圍如下：i. Primary sites: C420-C421, C423-C424 (all histologies) ii. Histologies：M-9727, 9732, 9741-9742, 9762-9809, 9832, 9840-9931, 9945-9946, 9950-9968, and 9975-9993 (all sites) Lymphomas：M-9590-9726, 9728-9729, 9731, 9734-9740, 9749, 9751, 9755-9760, 9811-9819, 9823, 9826, 9827, 9837 and 9971 & all sites)排除：C44.0-C44.9, C51.0-C51.2, C51.8-C51.9, C60.0-C60.2, C60.8-C60.9, C63.2 & 9597, 9680, 9700-9701, 9708-9709, 9712, 9718-9719, 9725-9726 Other and Ill-Defined Primary Sites (C760-C768, C809 & all histologies) Kaposi sarcoma (9140/3)
fields.purpose_en: This field can be used as a measure of pathology report quality, extent of surgery, and treatment quality.
fields.guide_en: • This field applies only to regional lymph nodes, not distant lymph nodes.• In the first course of treatment, regardless of whether treatment was given before removal, rely on what is recorded in the pathology report.• If it is uncertain whether lymph nodes were examined or removed, code 99.• Code 00 in the following situations:• Clinical evaluation only.• Lymph nodes were not examined pathologically.• A lymph node drainage area was dissected, but no lymphoid tissue was found on pathologic examination. For example: A patient with breast cancer underwent axillary lymph node dissection, the pathology report describes metastasis in soft tissue, and no lymph nodes were identified in the tissue specimen; code 00.• If regional lymph nodes examined is coded 00, regional lymph nodes positive should be coded 98.• Record the total number of regional lymph nodes examined pathologically during the entire first course of treatment, as explained below:• Accumulate the number of regional lymph nodes removed by diagnostic procedures (aspiration, core biopsy) and surgical resection (dissection). Note: whether the numbers of regional lymph nodes examined are accumulated depends on whether the samples come from the same lymph node chain; if they come from the same chain, the number of regional lymph nodes examined should be based mainly on the number of nodes surgically resected.• If, in the same lymph node chain, a diagnostic procedure (aspiration, core biopsy) and a surgical resection (dissection) were both performed, the numbers of regional lymph nodes removed must not be added together. For example: A patient with lung cancer had a positive core biopsy of a hilar lymph node by mediastinoscopy, then underwent right upper lobectomy with dissection of 11 lymph nodes, of which hilar (3 nodes) and mediastinal nodes (2 nodes) were all positive. The correct coding is: regional lymph nodes examined 11; regional lymph nodes positive 05 (the core biopsy of the same chain is not added).• If, in different lymph node chains, a diagnostic procedure (aspiration, core biopsy) and a surgical resection (dissection) were both performed, the numbers of regional lymph nodes removed may be added together. For example: A patient with breast cancer had a positive core biopsy (1 node) of a supraclavicular node, and dissection of the axilla removed 8 lymph nodes, 3 of which were positive. The correct coding is: regional lymph nodes examined 09; regional lymph nodes positive 04 (although the supraclavicular node and the axillary node are in different chains, both are regional lymph nodes and should be added together).• If it is uncertain from where the diagnostic sampling was taken, assume it is the same lymph node chain as the surgically removed nodes, so the numbers removed must not be added together. For example: A patient had a core biopsy at another facility, and at resection 7/14 lymph nodes sampled were positive; "regional lymph nodes examined" should be coded 14 and "regional lymph nodes positive" should be coded 07.• When the descriptions of the number of nodes are inconsistent, use the following order of priority: final diagnosis, CAP protocol, microscopic, gross.• If sampled only by aspiration or core biopsy, code 95.• If sampled by sampling (including excisional biopsy, berry picking, sentinel lymph node procedure, etc.), code the number if it is documented; if the number is unknown, code 96.• If most or all nodes of the same chain(s) were removed by dissection (including lymphadenectomy, radical node dissection, lymph node stripping, selective dissection) and the number is unknown, code 97.• If both sampling and dissection were performed and the number is unknown, code 97.• If the method of lymph node removal and the number are unknown, code 98.• The following primary site and histology codes should be coded 99:• Placenta (C58.9)• Brain and Cerebral Meninges (C70.0-C70.9, C71.0-C71.9)• Other Parts of Central Nervous System (C72.0-C72.5,C72.8-C72.9, C75.1-C75.3)• Hematopoietic, Reticuloendothelial, Immunoproliferative and Myeloproliferative Neoplasms, in the following ranges: i. Primary sites: C420-C421, C423-C424 (all histologies) ii. Histologies: M-9727, 9732, 9741-9742, 9762-9809, 9832, 9840-9931, 9945-9946, 9950-9968, and 9975-9993 (all sites)• Lymphomas: M-9590-9726, 9728-9729, 9731, 9734-9740, 9749, 9751, 9755-9760, 9811-9819, 9823, 9826, 9827, 9837 and 9971 & all sites) Exclude: C44.0-C44.9, C51.0-C51.2, C51.8-C51.9, C60.0-C60.2, C60.8-C60.9, C63.2 & 9597, 9680, 9700-9701, 9708-9709, 9712, 9718-9719, 9725-9726• Other and Ill-Defined Primary Sites (C760-C768, C809 & all histologies)• Kaposi sarcoma (9140/3)

fields.purpose_en: This field can be used as a measure of pathology report quality, extent of surgery, and treatment quality.
fields.guide_en: This field applies only to regional lymph nodes, not distant lymph nodes. Whether or not treatment was given before the lymph nodes were removed, the pathology report is the basis. Carcinoma in situ cases rarely have lymph node involvement; code 00 or 98. If lymph node metastasis does occur, reconfirm with the pathologist or decide at a team conference. Record the total number of regional lymph nodes found pathologically positive across the whole first course of treatment, as explained below: Accumulate the number of positive regional lymph nodes removed by diagnostic procedures (aspiration, core biopsy) and by surgical resection (dissection). Note: whether the number of involved regional lymph nodes is accumulated depends on whether the samples came from the same lymph node chain; if they belong to the same chain, the number of involved regional lymph nodes should be based on the number of positive nodes from surgical resection. If, in the same lymph node chain, a diagnostic sampling (positive) and a surgical removal (positive) were both done, the numbers of positive regional lymph nodes removed must not be added together. For example: A lung cancer case had a core biopsy (positive) of a hilar lymph node via mediastinoscopy, then underwent right upper lobectomy with dissection of 11 lymph nodes, of which hilar (3 nodes) and mediastinal nodes (2 nodes) were all positive. The correct coding is: regional lymph nodes examined 11; regional lymph nodes positive 05 (the core biopsy of the same chain is not added). For example: an aspiration found a positive lymph node, and a subsequent dissection of the same region showed 1 positive node out of 6. The correct coding: regional lymph nodes examined 06; regional lymph nodes positive 01. If, in different lymph node chains, a diagnostic sampling (positive) and a surgical removal (positive) were both done, the numbers of positive regional lymph nodes removed can be added together. For example: A breast cancer case had a core biopsy of a supraclavicular node that was positive (1 node), and a dissection of the axillary nodes removed 8 nodes, 3 of which were positive. The correct coding is: regional lymph nodes examined 09; regional lymph nodes positive 04 (although the supraclavicular node and axillary node are different chains, both are regional lymph nodes and should be added together). If it is uncertain from where the diagnostic sampling was taken, assume it is the same lymph node chain as the surgically removed nodes, so the numbers of positive nodes must not be added together. For example: A case had a core biopsy at another facility, and at resection 7/14 lymph nodes were positive; "Regional lymph nodes examined" should be coded 14 and "Regional lymph nodes positive" should be coded 07. When the node counts are described inconsistently, the order of priority is: final diagnosis, CAP protocol, microscopic, gross. If sampled by aspiration or core biopsy, code 95. If aspiration was positive but no surgical resection was performed, code 95. For example: An esophageal cancer case had an enlarged mid-esophageal node on CT scan that was positive on aspiration, and the case then received only radiotherapy. Code 95 for regional lymph nodes positive, and 95 for the number examined. If aspiration was positive but the nodes sampled at surgery were negative, code 95. For example: A lung cancer case had an aspiration of a suspicious hilar mass showing metastatic squamous carcinoma in lymph node tissue. The case then received preoperative radiotherapy, and a lobectomy showed 6 hilar lymph nodes negative. Code 95 for regional lymph nodes positive; the number examined depends on the number of nodes surgically removed. All reports of positive sampled lymph nodes should be taken into account; if the total number of positive nodes is unknown, code 97. For example: A pyriform sinus cancer case had 1 neck lymph node found positive by FNA. The case first received neoadjuvant chemotherapy, then resection of the primary site and radical neck dissection, removing 10 lymph nodes, of which many were positive and the rest showed "chemotherapy effect". Code 97 for regional lymph nodes positive, and code 10 for lymph nodes examined. Code 98 in the following situations: Clinical evaluation only. No lymph nodes were removed or examined. A lymph node drainage area dissection was performed but pathological examination found no lymphoid tissue. For example: A breast cancer case underwent axillary lymph node dissection, and the pathology report described soft tissue metastasis with no lymph nodes found in the specimen; code 98. When this field is coded 98, "Regional lymph nodes examined" should be coded 00. Except for cutaneous melanoma and cutaneous Merkel cell carcinoma, for all primary sites, when determining the number of positive lymph nodes, count only "micrometastases" or larger (greater than 0.2mm); do not count nodes containing only "isolated tumor cells (ITCs)". If the pathology report only describes the lymph node as positive without mentioning the size of the metastasis, assume the metastasis is greater than 0.2mm and include it in the count. For cutaneous melanoma and cutaneous Merkel cell carcinoma, lymph nodes with "isolated tumor cells (ITCs)" are included in the count of positive lymph nodes. The following primary sites and histology codes should be coded 99: Placenta (C58.9) Brain and Cerebral Meninges (C70.0-C70.9, C71.0-C71.9) Other Parts of Central Nervous System (C72.0-C72.5,C72.8-C72.9, C75.1-C75.3) Hematopoietic, Reticuloendothelial, Immunoproliferative and Myeloproliferative Neoplasms, in the following range: i. Primary sites: C420-C421, C423-C424 (all histologies) ii. Histologies: M-9727, 9732, 9741-9742, 9762-9809, 9832, 9840-9931, 9945-9946, 9950-9968, and 9975-9993 (all sites) Lymphomas: M-9590-9726, 9728-9729, 9731, 9734-9740, 9749, 9751, 9755-9760, 9811-9819, 9823, 9826, 9827, 9837 and 9971 & all sites) Excluding: C44.0-C44.9, C51.0-C51.2, C51.8-C51.9, C60.0-C60.2, C60.8-C60.9, C63.2 & 9597, 9680, 9700-9701, 9708-9709, 9712, 9718-9719, 9725-9726 Other and Ill-Defined Primary Sites (C760-C768, C809 & all histologies) Kaposi sarcoma (9140/3) Cancer stage at initial diagnosis

 記錄在申報醫院或外院進行「診斷性及分期性手術處置」的日期。 登錄臨床醫師確認癌症後所進行「診斷性及分期性手術處置」之最早日期。 若手術處置在個案癌症確診後進行，即使該手術處置之檢查結果為陰性，仍應在「診斷性及分期性手術處置日期」欄位中進行編碼。但若該術處置在個案癌症確診之前進行，該手術處置之檢查結果須為陽性，方可在「診斷性及分期性手術處置日期」欄位中進行編碼。範例：編碼：案例
20070603：個案民國 96年6月1日經電腦斷層檢查確診為肺癌，於 96年6月3日接受支氣管鏡併右上肺葉切片檢查結果為陰性，96年6月 10日再接受電腦斷層掃描指引右上肺葉切片檢查結果為肺腺癌。
20070703：個案96年 7月1日經電腦斷層檢查確診為肺癌，於 96年7月3日接受電腦斷層掃描指引右上肺葉切片檢查結果為陰性，96年7 月10日再接受電腦斷層掃描指引肝腫瘤切片檢查結果為肺腺癌肝臟轉移。
00000000：個案於96 年2月1日子宮頸抹片檢查結果為 CIN2，於 96年2月 3日接受子宮頸切片檢查結果為陰性，96 年2月10日再接受子宮頸錐狀切片檢查結果為CIS，且手術邊緣無腫瘤細胞殘留(視為手術治療)。
20070406：個案於96 年4月1日經腹部電腦斷層檢查疑似大腸癌併肝臟轉移，於 96 年4月6日接受肝臟超音波指引肝臟切片檢查結果為陰性，96年4月10日再接受大腸鏡檢查併腫瘤切片檢查結果為大腸癌。
fields.purpose_en: Records surgical procedure resources used for non-treatment purposes.
fields.guide_en:
• Record the date on which the “Diagnostic and staging surgical procedure” was performed, at the reporting hospital or another facility. • Record the earliest date of the “Diagnostic and staging surgical procedure” performed after the clinician confirmed the cancer. • If the procedure was performed after the cancer was confirmed, it should still be coded in the “Date of diagnostic and staging surgical procedure” field even if its result was negative. However, if the procedure was performed before the cancer was confirmed, its result must be positive for it to be coded in the “Date of diagnostic and staging surgical procedure” field. Example: Code: Case
20070603: On June 1, ROC year 96 (2007), the patient was diagnosed with lung cancer by CT; on June 3, ROC year 96, bronchoscopy with right upper lobe biopsy was negative; on June 10, ROC year 96, a CT-guided right upper lobe biopsy showed lung adenocarcinoma.
20070703: On July 1, ROC year 96 (2007), the patient was diagnosed with lung cancer by CT; on July 3, ROC year 96, a CT-guided right upper lobe biopsy was negative; on July 10, ROC year 96, a CT-guided liver tumor biopsy showed lung adenocarcinoma with liver metastasis.
00000000: On February 1, ROC year 96 (2007), the patient's Pap smear showed CIN2; on February 3, ROC year 96, a cervical biopsy was negative; on February 10, ROC year 96, a cervical cone biopsy showed CIS with no tumor cells remaining at the surgical margin (regarded as surgical treatment).
20070406: On April 1, ROC year 96 (2007), an abdominal CT suggested colon cancer with liver metastasis; on April 6, ROC year 96, a liver ultrasound-guided liver biopsy was negative; on April 10, ROC year 96, colonoscopy with tumor biopsy showed colon cancer.

fields.description_en:
Record the surgical procedure performed at another hospital for diagnosis or staging.
Field position: 116–117
fields.purpose_zh: 記錄在外院非治療目的所用之手術處置資源。
fields.guide_zh:
 此欄位不包含區域淋巴結的手術處置。 記錄在外院為診斷或分期目的而執行的手術處置。若該手術處置在個案癌症確診後進行，即使該手術處置之檢查結果為陰性，仍應在「診斷性及分期性手術處置日期」欄位中進行編碼。但若該手術處置在個案癌症確診之前進行，該手術處置之檢查結果須為陽性，方可在「診斷性及分期性手術處置日期」欄位中進行編碼。 若個案手術中接受腫瘤冰凍切片確診後，無針對該冰凍切片部位進行腫瘤切除，則可在「診斷性及分期性手術處置」進行編碼；但若後續針對該冰凍切片部位進行腫瘤切除，則不可編碼於「診斷性及分期性手術處置」欄位中。 若子宮體癌個案接受分期性手術(staging surgery)，醫師切除無病灶(如lesion, mass, tumor burden, tumor cakes)之其他部位組織時，應視為診斷或分期而執行的手術處置，需納入本欄位編碼。例如1︰子宮體癌(C54-C55)個案經原發切片證實為endometriod adenocarcinoma，接受分期性手術(staging surgery)執行腹膜切除(Omentectomy)，於手術記錄未描述腹膜有病灶(如lesion, mass, tumor burden, tumor cakes)，且腹膜病理報告無癌細胞侵犯，該腹膜切除(Omentectomy)目的為確認分期(for staging)應登錄於「診斷性及分期性手術處置」，編碼為10(原發部位及轉移部位皆執行切開性切片檢查)。例如2：子宮體癌(C54-C55)個案經原發切片證實為endometriod adenocarcinoma，接受分期性手術(staging surgery)執行腹膜切除(Omentectomy)，於手術記錄描述腹膜有沾黏(adhesion)，腹膜病理報告無癌細胞侵犯，該腹膜切除(Omentectomy)目的為確認分期(for staging)應登錄於「診斷性及分期性手術處置」，編碼為10(原發部位及轉移部位皆執行切開性切片檢查)。例如3︰子宮體癌(C54-C55)個案經原發切片證實為endometriod adenocarcinoma，接受分期性手術(staging surgery)時，於手術記錄未描述原發腫瘤外之其他組織或器官有病灶(如lesion, mass, tumor burden, tumor cakes)，但病理報告證實有癌細胞侵犯，執行原發腫瘤外之其他組織或器官切除，如腹膜切除(Omentectomy)，應登錄於「其他部位手術方式」。 若因疾病惡化或懷疑有新的轉移所執行之診斷性手術，不可編碼於此欄位。 原發部位及轉移部位皆執行切開性切片檢查(incisional biopsy)，則編碼為10，若二者處置方式不同時，忽略其執行方式。 若執行切片檢查時，確認該切片部位為原發腫瘤直接侵犯(direct invasion)，則該切片部位視為對原發腫瘤進行切片。 若執行切片檢查時，無法確認該切片部位是否為原發腫瘤直接侵犯(direct invasion)，或已確認切片部位與原發腫瘤為不連續的腫瘤，則該切片部位應視為對原發腫瘤以外的部位進行切片檢查。 結內淋巴癌個案，有多顆淋巴結侵犯時，僅針對其中ㄧ顆淋巴結切片(biopsied)或切除(removed)作為診斷或分期依據，則「外院診斷性及分期性手術處置」編碼為02，此狀況於『外院原發部位手術方式』，編碼為00。 若結內淋巴癌個案僅單顆淋巴結侵犯，且該顆淋巴結接受切除，則「外院診斷性及分期性手術處置」編碼為00；應登錄於「外院原發部位手術方式」，編碼為25。 若僅執行診斷性區域性淋巴結的組織抽吸(aspirate)、診斷性切片(incisional/excisional biopsy，core biopsy)手術處置本欄位需編碼為00。 刷拭(brushings)、沖洗(washings)、細胞抽吸(cell aspiration)、血液學檢查(周邊血液抹片檢查)等細胞學檢查呈陽性，需記錄在「癌症確診方式」欄位。上述細胞學檢查並非手術處置，因此勿編碼於「外院診斷性及分期性手術處置」欄位。 在進行切除性切片(excisional biopsies)檢查時，如手術邊緣在肉眼觀察下已切除乾淨，無論顯微鏡下是否仍有殘存癌細胞，則此手術不應該在本欄位中編碼，應該在「原發部位手術方式」進行編碼。(註：incision和excision不同：incision為切入之意，指將腫瘤切入並取部分檢體化驗以確定診斷；而excision為切除之意，指將腫瘤全部切除，其手術邊緣和腫瘤之間切除乾淨。)範例：編碼：案例
00：肺癌個案，經由電腦斷層檢查確診後死亡。並未接受任何診斷或分期性的外科處置。
00：懷疑罹患肺癌而進行痰液細胞學檢查，確定有肺癌細胞。此細胞學檢查不屬於手術處置。
00：個案於2月1 日子宮頸抹片檢查結果為 CIN2，於2月3 日接受子宮頸切片檢查結果為陰性，2 月10日再接受子宮頸錐狀切片檢查結果為 CIS，且手術邊緣無腫瘤細胞殘留。
00：乳癌個案手術前未接受任何切片檢查，於 6月1日先做冰凍切片結果為惡性，所以繼續接受partial mastectomy 手術。編碼：案例
00：個案因下背疼痛，接受 laminectomy，病理組織證實為轉移性癌症。
01：疑似大腸有廣泛性擴散的個案，進行肝轉移組織之細針切片檢查，肉眼下切片處仍有殘存癌細胞。
01：個案因下背疼痛，接受腰椎骨切片及 vertebroplasty，病理組織證實為轉移性癌症。
01：個案經子宮頸切片病理報告結果為 clear cell adenocarcinoma，主責醫師診斷為原發性卵巢癌，後續接受卵巢及全子宮切除手術治療。
01：個案影像學檢查為 LUL lung cancer with separate tumors in LLL lung and metastasis in the right lungs, T4N0M1a。僅接受RUL lung mass CT-guided biopsy，病理確診為adenocarcinoma。
02：個案經乳房攝影檢查於左側乳房上內方(upper inner quadrant, UIQ)及下內方(lower inner quadrant, LIQ)，發現各有 1顆腫瘤。2顆腫瘤均進行切片確診為 infiltrating ductal carcinoma。
02：個案影像學檢查為 LUL lung cancer with separate tumors in LLL lung and metastasis in the right lungs, T4N0M1a。僅接受LLL lung mass CT-guided biopsy，病理確診為adenocarcinoma。
02：進行大腸鏡檢查時，在原發性直腸腫塊進行切片檢查，肉眼下切片處仍有殘存癌細胞。
02：個案6月1日經電腦斷層檢查確診為肺癌，於 6月3日接受支氣管鏡併右上肺葉切片檢查結果為陰性，6月10日再接受電腦斷層掃描指引右上肺葉切片檢查結果為肺腺癌。
02：個案經由大腸鏡併切片證實為大腸癌個案，預行手術治療，但於 exploratory procedure時發現已 peritoneum seeding，因已無法執行根除性手術故未切除原發部位僅將傷口縫合。
02：個案6月1日經骨盆腔斷層檢查發現一顆巨大腫塊，疑似子宮頸癌直接侵犯(direct invasion)膀胱，於 6月3日接受並子宮頸切片及膀胱鏡檢查及膀胱切片確診為子宮頸癌侵犯膀胱。
02：個案經胃鏡檢查執行胃切片時發現原發來自鄰近大腸，且最後證實為大腸癌直接侵犯(direct invasion)胃，但未針對大腸癌作進一步切片檢查。
02：下咽癌個案同時接受喉頭切片與食道癌切片證實為晚期下咽癌侵犯至食道。
03：剖腹探查手術時，發現胃部有病灶，並懷疑後腹膜淋巴結有轉移現象，但未做任何的切片檢查或是治療。
04：剖腹探查手術時，發現罹患胰臟癌，並侵犯到周圍組織和動脈。手術中未進行治療，僅進行繞道手術以減輕個案的症狀。
07：肺癌第3期個案，在住院前已經完成診斷和分期。但不知進行何種術式。
09：個案最近才被診斷出來有轉移性黑色素瘤死於急診室中，並不清楚是否有進行診斷性或分期性手術處置。
10：個案7月1日經電腦斷層檢查確診為肺癌，於 7月3日接受電腦斷層掃描指引右上肺葉切片檢查結果為陰性，7月 10 日再接受電腦斷層掃描指引肝腫瘤切片檢查結果為肺腺癌肝臟轉移。編碼：案例
10：個案於4月1 日經腹部電腦斷層檢查疑似大腸癌併肝臟轉移，於 4月6日接受肝臟超音波指引肝臟切片檢查結果為陽性，4月10日再接受大腸鏡檢查併腫瘤切片檢查結果為大腸癌。
10：個案經由大腸鏡併切片證實為大腸癌，欲行手術治療，但經exploratory procedure時發現已peritoneum seeding，故醫師僅針對 peritoneum 執行biopsy 並無切除原發部位。
10：大腸癌個案經內視鏡原發切片診斷為 adenocarcinoma，接受 Partial colectomy，術中針對肝腫瘤進行冰凍切片(未切除肝腫瘤)。不論病理有無癌細胞轉移，均視為遠端部位執行診斷性處置。
11：原發性大腸癌個案，進行剖腹探查，僅在懷疑肝臟轉移的病灶處作切片檢查。
14：個案罹患瀰漫性胃癌，進行食道和胃的繞道手術(esophagogastrostomy)，同時在原發部位進行切片檢查。
fields.purpose_en: Records surgical procedure resources used for non-treatment purposes at another hospital.
fields.guide_en:
This field does not include surgical procedures on regional lymph nodes. Record surgical procedures performed at another facility for diagnostic or staging purposes. If the procedure was performed after the cancer was confirmed, code it in the "Date of diagnostic and staging surgical procedure" field even if its findings were negative. If the procedure was performed before the cancer was confirmed, its findings must be positive for it to be coded in the "Date of diagnostic and staging surgical procedure" field. If a tumor was confirmed by intraoperative frozen section and no tumor resection was then performed at the frozen-section site, it may be coded in "Diagnostic and staging surgical procedure"; if the tumor at the frozen-section site was subsequently resected, it must not be coded in the "Diagnostic and staging surgical procedure" field. If a corpus uteri cancer case undergoes staging surgery and the physician removes tissue from other sites without disease (such as lesion, mass, tumor burden, tumor cakes), this should be regarded as a surgical procedure performed for diagnosis or staging and be coded in this field. Example 1: A corpus uteri cancer (C54-C55) case with endometrioid adenocarcinoma confirmed by primary-site biopsy undergoes staging surgery with omentectomy; the operative record does not describe disease in the omentum (such as lesion, mass, tumor burden, tumor cakes) and the omentum pathology report shows no cancer cell invasion; the omentectomy was for staging and should be recorded in "Diagnostic and staging surgical procedure" with code 10 (incisional biopsy of both the primary site and a metastatic site). Example 2: A corpus uteri cancer (C54-C55) case with endometrioid adenocarcinoma confirmed by primary-site biopsy undergoes staging surgery with omentectomy; the operative record describes adhesions of the omentum and the omentum pathology report shows no cancer cell invasion; the omentectomy was for staging and should be recorded in "Diagnostic and staging surgical procedure" with code 10 (incisional biopsy of both the primary site and a metastatic site). Example 3: A corpus uteri cancer (C54-C55) case with endometrioid adenocarcinoma confirmed by primary-site biopsy undergoes staging surgery; the operative record does not describe disease (such as lesion, mass, tumor burden, tumor cakes) in tissues or organs other than the primary tumor, but the pathology report confirms cancer cell invasion, and tissues or organs other than the primary tumor are resected, such as omentectomy; this should be recorded in "Surgical procedure of other sites". A diagnostic surgical procedure performed because of disease progression or suspected new metastasis must not be coded in this field. If incisional biopsy is performed on both the primary site and a metastatic site, code 10; if the two procedures differ, ignore the method used. If at biopsy the biopsied site is confirmed to be direct invasion by the primary tumor, the biopsied site is regarded as a biopsy of the primary tumor. If at biopsy it cannot be confirmed whether the biopsied site is direct invasion by the primary tumor, or the biopsied site is confirmed to be a tumor discontinuous from the primary tumor, the biopsied site should be regarded as a biopsy of a site other than the primary tumor. For a nodal lymphoma case with multiple involved lymph nodes in which only one lymph node is biopsied or removed as the basis for diagnosis or staging, code "Diagnostic and staging surgical procedure at another facility" as 02, and code "Primary site surgical procedure at another facility" as 00 in this situation. If a nodal lymphoma case has only a single involved lymph node and that node is removed, code "Diagnostic and staging surgical procedure at another facility" as 00 and record "Primary site surgical procedure at another facility" as 25. If only tissue aspiration or diagnostic biopsy (incisional/excisional biopsy, core biopsy) of regional lymph nodes was performed for diagnosis, code this field as 00. Positive cytology such as brushings, washings, cell aspiration and hematologic tests (peripheral blood smear) should be recorded in the "Method of cancer confirmation" field. The above cytologic examinations are not surgical procedures, so do not code them in the "Diagnostic and staging surgical procedure at another facility" field. In excisional biopsy, if the surgical margin appears clear to the naked eye, then regardless of whether residual cancer cells remain under the microscope, the procedure should not be coded in this field but in "Primary site surgical procedure". (Note: incision and excision differ: incision means cutting into the tumor and taking a partial specimen for examination to establish the diagnosis, whereas excision means removing the whole tumor with the surgical margin cleanly cut away from the tumor.) Examples: Code: Case
00: A lung cancer case confirmed by CT died. No diagnostic or staging surgical procedure was performed.
00: Lung cancer was suspected and sputum cytology confirmed lung cancer cells. This cytologic examination is not a surgical procedure.
00: On Feb 1 the case's Pap smear showed CIN2; on Feb 3 cervical biopsy was negative; on Feb 10 cervical conization showed CIS, with no residual tumor cells at the surgical margin.
00: A breast cancer case had no biopsy before surgery; on Jun 1 frozen section was malignant, so the case went on to partial mastectomy. Code: Case
00: A case with low back pain underwent laminectomy, and the pathology confirmed metastatic cancer.
01: A case with suspected widespread colon cancer underwent fine-needle biopsy of liver metastasis tissue, with residual cancer cells still visible to the naked eye at the biopsy site.
01: A case with low back pain underwent lumbar vertebral biopsy and vertebroplasty, and the pathology confirmed metastatic cancer.
01: A case's cervical biopsy pathology report showed clear cell adenocarcinoma, the attending physician diagnosed primary ovarian cancer, and the case then underwent ovarian and total hysterectomy.
01: Imaging showed LUL lung cancer with separate tumors in LLL lung and metastasis in the right lungs, T4N0M1a. Only a CT-guided biopsy of an RUL lung mass was done, and pathology confirmed adenocarcinoma.
02: Mammography of the case showed one tumor each in the upper inner quadrant (UIQ) and the lower inner quadrant (LIQ) of the left breast. Both tumors were biopsied and confirmed as infiltrating ductal carcinoma.
02: Imaging showed LUL lung cancer with separate tumors in LLL lung and metastasis in the right lungs, T4N0M1a. Only a CT-guided biopsy of an LLL lung mass was done, and pathology confirmed adenocarcinoma.
02: During colonoscopy, a biopsy was taken of a primary rectal mass, with residual cancer cells still visible to the naked eye at the biopsy site.
02: On Jun 1 the case was confirmed to have lung cancer by CT; on Jun 3 bronchoscopy with right upper lobe biopsy was negative; on Jun 10 CT-guided right upper lobe biopsy showed lung adenocarcinoma.
02: A case with colorectal cancer confirmed by colonoscopy with biopsy was scheduled for surgery, but at exploratory procedure peritoneal seeding was found; because curative surgery could no longer be performed, the primary site was not resected and the wound was simply closed.
02: On Jun 1 pelvic CT showed a large mass suspected to be cervical cancer with direct invasion of the bladder; on Jun 3 the case underwent cervical biopsy, cystoscopy and bladder biopsy, which confirmed cervical cancer invading the bladder.
02: During gastroscopy with gastric biopsy it was found that the tumor originated from the adjacent colon, and it was finally confirmed to be colon cancer with direct invasion of the stomach, but no further biopsy of the colon cancer was performed.
02: A hypopharyngeal cancer case underwent laryngeal biopsy and esophageal biopsy at the same time, confirming advanced hypopharyngeal cancer invading the esophagus.
03: At exploratory laparotomy a lesion was found in the stomach and metastasis to retroperitoneal lymph nodes was suspected, but no biopsy or treatment was performed.
04: At exploratory laparotomy pancreatic cancer was found, invading surrounding tissues and arteries. No treatment was given during surgery; only a bypass operation was performed to relieve the case's symptoms.
07: A stage 3 lung cancer case had diagnosis and staging completed before admission, but the surgical procedure performed is unknown.
09: A case recently diagnosed with metastatic melanoma died in the emergency room, and it is unclear whether a diagnostic or staging surgical procedure was performed.
10: On Jul 1 the case was confirmed to have lung cancer by CT; on Jul 3 CT-guided right upper lobe biopsy was negative; on Jul 10 CT-guided liver tumor biopsy showed lung adenocarcinoma with liver metastasis. Code: Case

fields.description_en:
Record the surgical procedure performed at the reporting hospital for diagnosis or staging. Rationale: record the surgical procedure resources used at the reporting hospital for non-therapeutic purposes.
Field position: 118–119
fields.guide_zh:  此欄位不包含區域淋巴結的手術處置。 記錄在申報醫院為診斷或分期目的而執行的手術處置。若該手術處置在個案癌症確診後進行，即使該手術處置之檢查結果為陰性，仍應在「診斷性及分期性手術處置日期」欄位中進行編碼。但若該手術處置在個案癌症確診之前進行，該手術處置之檢查結果須為陽性，方可在「診斷性及分期性手術處置日期」欄位中進行編碼。 若個案手術中接受腫瘤冰凍切片確診後，無針對該冰凍切片進行腫瘤切除，則可在「診斷性及分期性手術處置」進行編碼；但若後續針對該冰凍切片部位進行腫瘤切除，則不可編碼於「診斷性及分期性手術處置」欄位中。 若子宮體癌個案接受分期性手術(staging surgery)，醫師切除無病灶(如lesion, mass, tumor burden, tumor cakes)之其他部位組織時，應視為診斷或分期而執行的手術處置，需納入本欄位編碼。例如1︰子宮體癌(C54-C55)個案經原發切片證實為endometriod adenocarcinoma，接受分期性手術(staging surgery)執行腹膜切除(Omentectomy)，於手術記錄未描述腹膜有病灶(如lesion, mass, tumor burden, tumor cakes)，且腹膜病理報告無癌細胞侵犯，該腹膜切除(Omentectomy)目的為確認分期(for staging)應登錄於「診斷性及分期性手術處置」，編碼為10(原發部位及轉移部位皆執行切開性切片檢查)。例如2：子宮體癌(C54-C55)個案經原發切片證實為endometriod adenocarcinoma，接受分期性手術(staging surgery)執行腹膜切除(Omentectomy)，於手術記錄描述腹膜有沾黏(adhesion)，腹膜病理報告無癌細胞侵犯，該腹膜切除(Omentectomy)目的為確認分期(for staging)應登錄於「診斷性及分期性手術處置」，編碼為10(原發部位及轉移部位皆執行切開性切片檢查)。例如3︰子宮體癌(C54-C55)個案經原發切片證實為endometriod adenocarcinoma，接受分期性手術(staging surgery)時，於手術記錄未描述原發腫瘤外之其他組織或器官有病灶(如lesion, mass, tumor burden, tumor cakes)，但病理報告證實有癌細胞侵犯，執行原發腫瘤外之其他組織或器官切除，如腹膜切除(Omentectomy)，應登錄於「其他部位手術方式」。 若因疾病惡化或懷疑有新的轉移所執行之診斷性手術，不可編碼於此欄位。 原發部位及轉移部位皆執行切開性切片檢查(incisional biopsy)，則編碼為10，若二者處置方式不同時，忽略其執行方式。 若執行切片檢查時，確認該切片部位為原發腫瘤直接侵犯(direct invasion)，則該切片部位視為對原發腫瘤進行切片。 若執行切片檢查時，無法確認該切片部位是否為原發腫瘤直接侵犯(direct invasion)，或已確認切片部位與原發腫瘤為不連續的腫瘤，則該切片部位應視為對原發腫瘤以外的部位進行切片檢查。 結內淋巴癌個案，有多顆淋巴結侵犯時，僅針對其中ㄧ顆淋巴結切片(biopsied)或切除(removed)作為診斷或分期依據，則「申報醫院診斷性及分期性手術處置」編碼為02；此狀況於「申報醫院原發部位手術方式」欄位，編碼為00。 若結內淋巴癌個案僅單顆淋巴結侵犯，且該顆淋巴結接受切除，則「申報醫院診斷性及分期性手術處置」編碼為00；應登錄於「申報醫院原發部位手術方式」欄位，編碼為25。 若僅執行診斷性區域性淋巴結的組織抽吸(aspirate)、診斷性切片(incisional/excisional biopsy，core biopsy)手術處置本欄位需編碼為00。 刷拭(brushings)、沖洗(washings)、細胞抽吸(cell aspiration)、血液學檢查(周邊血液抹片檢查)等細胞學檢查呈陽性，需記錄在「癌症確診方式」欄位。上述細胞學檢查並非手術處置，因此勿編碼於「申報醫院診斷性及分期性手術處置」欄位。 在進行切除性切片(excisional biopsies)檢查時，如手術邊緣在肉眼觀察下已切除乾淨，無論顯微鏡下是否仍有殘存癌細胞，則此手術不應該在本欄位中編碼，應該在「原發部位手術方式」進行編碼。(註：incision和excision不同：incision為切入之意，指將腫瘤切入並取部分檢體化驗以確定診斷；而excision為切除之意，指將腫瘤全部切除，其手術邊緣和腫瘤之間切除乾淨。) 接受緩和性外科手術勿在本欄位進行編碼，應在「申報醫院緩和照護」欄位編碼。
fields.guide_en: • This field does not include surgical procedures on regional lymph nodes. • Record surgical procedures performed at the reporting hospital for diagnostic or staging purposes. If the procedure was performed after the cancer was confirmed, it should still be coded in the “Date of diagnostic and staging surgical procedure” field even if its result was negative. However, if the procedure was performed before the cancer was confirmed, its result must be positive for it to be coded in the “Date of diagnostic and staging surgical procedure” field. • If a tumor frozen section taken during surgery confirms the diagnosis and that frozen section is not followed by tumor resection, it may be coded in “Diagnostic and staging surgical procedure”; but if the tumor at the frozen-section site is subsequently resected, it must not be coded in the “Diagnostic and staging surgical procedure” field. • If a patient with corpus uteri cancer undergoes staging surgery and the physician removes tissue from other sites without lesions (such as lesion, mass, tumor burden, tumor cakes), this should be regarded as a surgical procedure performed for diagnosis or staging and must be coded in this field. Example 1: A patient with corpus uteri cancer (C54-C55), with primary-site biopsy confirming endometrioid adenocarcinoma, undergoes staging surgery with omentectomy; the operative record does not describe lesions of the omentum (such as lesion, mass, tumor burden, tumor cakes) and the omentum pathology report shows no cancer cell invasion; the purpose of the omentectomy is to confirm staging (for staging), so it should be recorded under “Diagnostic and staging surgical procedure” with code 10 (incisional biopsy performed at both the primary site and a metastatic site). Example 2: A patient with corpus uteri cancer (C54-C55), with primary-site biopsy confirming endometrioid adenocarcinoma, undergoes staging surgery with omentectomy; the operative record describes adhesions of the omentum and the omentum pathology report shows no cancer cell invasion; the purpose of the omentectomy is to confirm staging (for staging), so it should be recorded under “Diagnostic and staging surgical procedure” with code 10 (incisional biopsy performed at both the primary site and a metastatic site). Example 3: A patient with corpus uteri cancer (C54-C55), with primary-site biopsy confirming endometrioid adenocarcinoma, undergoes staging surgery; the operative record does not describe lesions (such as lesion, mass, tumor burden, tumor cakes) in other tissues or organs outside the primary tumor, but the pathology report confirms cancer cell invasion, and tissues or organs other than the primary tumor, such as the omentum (omentectomy), are removed; this should be recorded under “Surgical procedure of other sites”. • A diagnostic procedure performed because of disease progression or suspected new metastasis must not be coded in this field. • If incisional biopsy is performed at both the primary site and a metastatic site, code 10; if the two procedures differ in method, ignore the method used. • If, when a biopsy is performed, the biopsied site is confirmed to be direct invasion by the primary tumor, the biopsied site is regarded as a biopsy of the primary tumor. • If, when a biopsy is performed, it cannot be confirmed whether the biopsied site is direct invasion by the primary tumor, or the biopsied site is confirmed to be a tumor discontinuous from the primary tumor, the biopsied site should be regarded as a biopsy of a site other than the primary tumor. • For a case with nodal lymphoma in which multiple lymph nodes are involved and only one lymph node is biopsied or removed as the basis for diagnosis or staging, the “Diagnostic and staging surgical procedure at the reporting hospital” is coded 02; in this situation the “Surgical procedure of the primary site at the reporting hospital” field is coded 00. • If a case with nodal lymphoma has only a single lymph node involved and that lymph node is removed, the “Diagnostic and staging surgical procedure at the reporting hospital” is coded 00; it should be recorded in the “Surgical procedure of the primary site at the reporting hospital” field with code 25. • If only diagnostic tissue aspiration of regional lymph nodes or a diagnostic biopsy (incisional/excisional biopsy, core biopsy) is performed, this field should be coded 00. • Positive cytologic examinations such as brushings, washings, cell aspiration and hematologic examination (peripheral blood smear) should be recorded in the “Method of cancer confirmation” field. The above cytologic examinations are not surgical procedures, so they must not be coded in the “Diagnostic and staging surgical procedure at the reporting hospital” field. • When excisional biopsy is performed, if the surgical margin is grossly clear, then regardless of whether cancer cells remain under the microscope, this procedure should not be coded in this field and should be coded in “Surgical procedure of the primary site”. (Note: incision and excision differ: incision means cutting into the tumor and taking part of the specimen for testing to confirm the diagnosis; excision means removing the whole tumor with clear margins between the surgical margin and the tumor.) • Palliative surgery should not be coded in this field; it should be coded in the “Palliative care at the reporting hospital” field.

fields.purpose_zh: 作為TNM 分期依據資料，該分期系統可用以評估癌症治療及控制的趨勢。醫師則用以進行預後的推估、治療的規劃、新療法的評估、結果的分析、追蹤的策劃和早期偵測結果的評定。
fields.guide_zh:  腫瘤分期判斷以臨床主責醫師為主，其次為其他科別的醫師，若醫師皆未描述時，則癌症登記人員請依病歷所提供的資訊自行判斷。 若醫師與癌症登記人員所判斷的結果有出入時，需藉由討論來達成共識。 對肺癌而言，occult carcinoma是以TX來編碼。(註：所謂的occult carcinoma是指進行痰液細胞學檢查時，有發現癌細胞，但在其他檢查卻沒有發現有明顯的腫瘤。) 編碼8888僅適用於AJCC schema未定義的T-code/M-code。若臨床期別組合使用Lugano Classification、International Staging System (ISS)，則編碼8888。 詳細的編碼規則，2003年1月1日至2009年12月31日之間診斷為癌症之個案，請參考AJCC第六版癌症分期手冊(cancer staging manual)；2010年1月1日至2017年12月31日之間診斷為癌症之個案則請參考AJCC第七版癌症分期手冊(cancer staging manual)。2018年1月1日以後診斷為癌症之個案則請參考AJCC第八版癌症分期手冊(cancer staging manual)。
fields.purpose_en: Data used as the basis for TNM staging. This staging system can be used to evaluate trends in cancer treatment and control. Physicians use it to estimate prognosis, plan treatment, evaluate new therapies, analyze results, plan follow-up, and assess early detection results.
fields.guide_en: Tumor stage is determined primarily by the attending clinical physician, then by physicians of other departments; if no physician described it, the cancer registrar should judge it from the information in the medical record. If the results judged by the physician and by the cancer registrar differ, consensus must be reached through discussion. For lung cancer, occult carcinoma is coded TX. (Note: occult carcinoma means that cancer cells were found on sputum cytology but no obvious tumor was found on other examinations.) Code 8888 applies only to T-codes/M-codes not defined in the AJCC schema. If the clinical stage group uses the Lugano Classification or International Staging System (ISS), code 8888. For detailed coding rules, for cases diagnosed with cancer from January 1, 2003 to December 31, 2009, refer to the AJCC 6th edition cancer staging manual; for cases diagnosed with cancer from January 1, 2010 to December 31, 2017, refer to the AJCC 7th edition cancer staging manual; for cases diagnosed with cancer from January 1, 2018 onward, refer to the AJCC 8th edition cancer staging manual.

If the clinical stage judged by the physician and by the cancer registrar differ, consensus must be reached through discussion. Convert all Roman numerals to Arabic numerals and use capital letters only. For detailed coding rules, for cases diagnosed with cancer from January 1, 2003 to December 31, 2009, refer to the AJCC 6th edition cancer staging manual; for cases diagnosed with cancer from January 1, 2010 to December 31, 2017, refer to the AJCC 7th edition cancer staging manual; for cases diagnosed with cancer from January 1, 2018 onward, refer to the AJCC 8th edition cancer staging manual. From January 1, 2010, the stage of the Ann Arbor Staging System and International Staging System (ISS) must be abstracted in the clinical stage group, and the clinical TNM should be coded T8888N888M888. From January 1, 2018, for the Lugano Classification Modification of the Ann Arbor Staging System, this stage must be abstracted in the clinical stage group, and the clinical TNM should be coded T8888N888M888. From January 1, 2018, the stage of the Rai System must be abstracted in the clinical stage group, and the clinical TNM should be coded T8888N888M888.

fields.guide_zh:  腫瘤分期判斷以病理醫師為主，其次為其他科別的醫師，若醫師皆未描述，則癌症登記人員請依病歷所提供的資訊自行判斷。 若醫師與癌症登記人員所判斷的臨床分期有出入時，需藉由討論來達成共識。 若「病理M」記錄為B，且「臨床M」記錄為0、1、1A、1B或1C時，則pT、pN和cM的組合可用來代表病理期別組合。 AJCC第八版的病理分期若需要分級/分化作為判定，但無病理的分級/分化時，則可藉由臨床評估階段之分級/分化作為病理期別的判斷依據。 若個案手術前有接受全身性治療/放射治療，病理期別仍可評估，且「病理分期的字根/字首」欄位應編碼為4。 詳細的編碼規則，2003年1月1日至2009年12月31日之間診斷為癌症之個案，請參考AJCC第六版癌症分期手冊(cancer staging manual)；2010年1月1日至2017年12月31日之間診斷為癌症之個案則請參考AJCC第七版癌症分期手冊(cancer staging manual)。2018年1月1日以後診斷為癌症之個案則請參考AJCC第八版癌症分期手冊(cancer staging manual)。

fields.guide_en: • Tumor staging is determined mainly by the pathologist, then by physicians of other specialties; if no physician has described it, cancer registrars should determine it themselves from the information provided in the medical record.• If the clinical stage determined by the physician and the cancer registrar differs, reach consensus by discussion.• If "Pathologic M" is recorded as B and "Clinical M" is recorded as 0, 1, 1A, 1B or 1C, the combination of pT, pN and cM may be used to represent the pathologic stage group.• If the AJCC 8th edition pathologic stage requires grade/differentiation for determination but there is no pathologic grade/differentiation, the grade/differentiation from the clinical evaluation phase may be used as the basis for determining the pathologic stage group.• If the patient received systemic therapy/radiotherapy before surgery, the pathologic stage can still be assessed, and the "Pathologic stage prefix/suffix" field should be coded 4.• For detailed coding rules, for cases diagnosed with cancer between 1 January 2003 and 31 December 2009, refer to the AJCC 6th edition Cancer Staging Manual; for cases diagnosed between 1 January 2010 and 31 December 2017, refer to the AJCC 7th edition Cancer Staging Manual; for cases diagnosed on or after 1 January 2018, refer to the AJCC 8th edition Cancer Staging Manual.

fields.purpose_zh: AJCC 分期及T、N、M 組成之編碼及規則會隨時間演進而改變，以利個案分析之用。
fields.guide_zh:
 本欄位左起第1-2碼摘錄AJCC癌症分期手冊版本，第3-5碼摘錄第八版各章節。 2003年1月1日至2009年12月31日之間診斷為癌症之個案，以AJCC第六版作為分期依據。 2010年1月1日至2017年12月31日之間診斷為癌症之個案，以AJCC第七版作為分期依據。 2018年1月1日起新診斷為癌症之個案，需收錄 AJCC 第八版之各章節作為分期依據。 2021年1月1日起新診斷為子宮頸癌之個案，以 AJCC 第九版 (Cervix Uteri Version
9)作為分期依據。 2023年1月1日起新診斷為闌尾癌、肛門癌、腦與脊髓癌之個案，以 AJCC 第九版作為分期依據。 2024年1月1日起新診斷為外陰癌、神經內分泌腫瘤(闌尾、結直腸、十二指腸與法特壺腹、空腸與迴腸、胰臟、胃等部位)之個案，以AJCC 第九版作為分期依據。 分期版本為第一版至第七版無需收錄該版本的各章節，故章節應編碼為 888。 若分期採用第八版，但章節不詳，應編碼為 08999。 若分期採用第九版，則編碼為 V9，並借用第八版章節編碼。 例如1：子宮頸癌個案採用第九版分期，而第八版章節為 52章，則編碼為V9052。 例如2：闌尾癌個案採用第九版分期，而第八版章節為 19章，則編碼為V9019。 為利爾後各醫院癌症期別資料的分析與應用，除個案不適用AJCC分期外，申報長表癌症應依新版AJCC分期規則填寫臨床期別；若個案接受手術治療，皆應申報AJCC病理分期；俾利後續資料能與國際比較。
fields.purpose_en: The codes and rules composing the AJCC stage and T, N, M change over time to facilitate case analysis.
fields.guide_en:
In this field, digits 1-2 from the left abstract the version of the AJCC cancer staging manual, and digits 3-5 abstract the chapter of the 8th edition. For cases diagnosed with cancer from January 1, 2003 to December 31, 2009, AJCC 6th edition is the staging basis. For cases diagnosed with cancer from January 1, 2010 to December 31, 2017, AJCC 7th edition is the staging basis. For cases newly diagnosed with cancer from January 1, 2018, the chapters of AJCC 8th edition must be recorded as the staging basis. For cases newly diagnosed with cervical cancer from January 1, 2021, AJCC 9th edition (Cervix Uteri Version
9) is the staging basis. For cases newly diagnosed with appendiceal cancer, anal cancer, and brain and spinal cord cancer from January 1, 2023, AJCC 9th edition is the staging basis. For cases newly diagnosed with vulvar cancer and neuroendocrine tumors (of the appendix, colorectum, duodenum and ampulla of Vater, jejunum and ileum, pancreas, stomach and other sites) from January 1, 2024, AJCC 9th edition is the staging basis. When the staging version is the 1st to 7th edition, the chapters of that version need not be recorded, so the chapter should be coded 888. If staging uses the 8th edition but the chapter is unknown, code 08999. If staging uses the 9th edition, code V9 and borrow the 8th edition chapter code. Example 1: a cervical cancer case staged with the 9th edition, whose 8th edition chapter is Chapter 52, is coded V9052. Example 2: an appendiceal cancer case staged with the 9th edition, whose 8th edition chapter is Chapter 19, is coded V9019. To facilitate subsequent analysis and use of cancer stage data across hospitals, except for cases to which AJCC staging does not apply, the long-form cancer report should fill in the clinical stage according to the new AJCC staging rules; if the case received surgical treatment, the AJCC pathological stage should always be reported, so that the data can later be compared internationally.

fields.purpose_zh: 對癌症進行分期，有利於治療計畫、預後評估及存活分析。
fields.guide_zh: 填寫AJCC 分期以外之癌症分期系統，適用範圍如下： 編碼01 FIGO為婦癌分期系統。 編碼02 MAC為結直腸癌分期系統。 編碼06 Barcelona Clinic Liver Cancer Staging System (BCLC)為肝癌分期系統。 編碼07 Small Cell Lung Cancer Classification為肺小細胞癌分期系統。 編碼09 Durie-Salmon Staging System (DSS)為多發性骨髓瘤(multiple myeloma)分期系統。 編碼11 DRE (Digital rectal examination) Clinical T category為攝護腺癌分期系統。 編碼12 Breast Cancer AJCC Prognostic Stage為乳癌預後分期系統。 編碼13 Binet Staging System為CLL(chronic lymphocytic leukemia)白血病分期系統。 編碼20 Toronto Paediatric Cancer Stage為兒童癌症分期系統。 編碼21 Modified Chang’s Staging System為小兒中樞神經生殖細胞瘤分期系統。 編碼22 Children's Oncology Group (COG)為小兒顱外及生殖腺外生殖細胞瘤分期系統。
fields.purpose_en: Cancer staging, which helps treatment planning, prognosis assessment and survival analysis.
fields.guide_en: Enter a cancer staging system other than AJCC. The scope of application is as follows: Code 01 FIGO is the staging system for gynecologic cancers. Code 02 MAC is the staging system for colorectal cancer. Code 06 Barcelona Clinic Liver Cancer Staging System (BCLC) is the staging system for liver cancer. Code 07 Small Cell Lung Cancer Classification is the staging system for small cell lung cancer. Code 09 Durie-Salmon Staging System (DSS) is the staging system for multiple myeloma. Code 11 DRE (Digital rectal examination) Clinical T category is the staging system for prostate cancer. Code 12 Breast Cancer AJCC Prognostic Stage is the prognostic staging system for breast cancer. Code 13 Binet Staging System is the staging system for CLL (chronic lymphocytic leukemia). Code 20 Toronto Paediatric Cancer Stage is the staging system for childhood cancers. Code 21 Modified Chang's Staging System is the staging system for pediatric central nervous system germ cell tumors. Code 22 Children's Oncology Group (COG) is the staging system for pediatric extracranial and extragonadal germ cell tumors.
