5: A patient with cervical cancer received 4500 cGy of 15 MV external beam radiotherapy to the pelvis, followed by 2 Fletcher intracavitary treatments.
1: A patient with parotid cancer received daily radiotherapy, of which 60% was 15 MV photon beam therapy and 40% was 16 MV electron beam therapy.
4: A patient with head and neck cancer was referred from another facility to the reporting hospital for a boost of high-dose-rate brachytherapy; detailed treatment records from the other facility are lacking.
1: A patient with breast cancer received 6 MV x-ray radiotherapy to the breast and the ipsilateral supraclavicular fossa.
8: A patient with thyroid cancer received iodine-131 radioisotope therapy.
3: A patient with non-small cell lung cancer with superior vena cava syndrome and a single brain metastasis received external beam radiotherapy to the primary tumor, mediastinum and whole brain, with a radiosurgery boost to the brain metastasis.
4: A patient with T1N0M0 prostate cancer received only low-dose-rate brachytherapy to the prostate.
17: A patient with lung cancer received photon radiotherapy from 2015/10/27 to 2015/12/24: 3D Conformal RT to the primary site and regional lymph nodes, 2000 cGy/10 fractions, with a RapidArc with IG boost to the primary tumor, 1000 cGy/5 fractions; in addition, from 2015/11/19 to 2015/12/17 the patient received proton therapy to the primary site and regional lymph nodes using a 2-Ports Ridge Filter, 4000 cGy/20 fractions.

Proton beam: T+N (whole pelvis and para-aortic lymphatic regions), 45 CGE/25 fx by particle passive scattering. Photon beam: T+N (boost the lower pelvis), 540 cGy/ 3 fx by rapid arc + IG. Brachytherapy: Intra-vagina, HDR, 200cGy x 3fx. Radiotherapy modality is coded 21 (1: photon therapy + 4: brachytherapy + 16: proton therapy).

fields.description_zh:
記錄在申報醫院的首次療程中，進行放射治療的開始日期。
欄位位置：206–213
fields.description_en:
Record the start date of radiation therapy in the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital.
Field position: 206–213
fields.purpose_zh: 在併用多重治療模式中，病理期別是很多癌症的重要預後因素，也是決定後續輔助治療與否的依據，因此記錄個別治療方式之時間順序及實際間隔，是非常重要的；手術前的放射治療可能會改變期別，並影響其應用於分析評估之使用方式。
fields.guide_zh:
 申報醫院若有委託他院執行部分放射治療，應視為申報醫院首次療程的一部份，須整併他院放射治療資料完整申報。 如果是多重放射治療模式(例如子宮頸癌的合併體外放射治療及體內近距放療)，「放射治療開始日期」必須記載的是整個多重放射治療模式的開始日期。 如果放射治療是個案首次療程中唯一的療法，則「放射治療開始日期」必須與「首次療程日期」吻合。 治療日期通常是記錄在放射治療摘要。範例：編碼：案例
20031215：個案於民國 92年12月15 日接受體外放射治療。
20031012：惡性腦瘤個案於民國 92年 10月12日接受加馬刀立體型放射手術。
20031012：非小細胞肺癌個案因腦轉移於 2003/10/12 做立體定位加馬刀放射手術，隨後於2003/12/15 至2003/12/30 接受12次總劑量30Gy 的全腦放射治療。
20031121：非小細胞肺癌個案於 2003/11/21 至 2003/12/10 接受 12 次總劑量 30Gy 的全腦放射治療，再於 2003/12/12 對腦轉移做立體定位加馬刀放射手術。
20060401：個案罹患巨大(bulky)之2B 期子宮頸鱗狀細胞癌，於 2006/04/01 至2006/05/11接受28次總劑量50.4Gy的全骨盆2D Box放射治療，並於總劑量達到39.6Gy時停止中央區照射(with central block after 39.6Gy)。接著再於Point A 處給予6 次各 500cGy 之銥-192(Ir-192)的空腔內高劑量率近距放射治療(2006/06/01及 2006/06/02 給予 500cGy x3，再於 2006/06/15 及 2006/06/16 給予 500cGy x3)。同時於體外放射治療期間給予兩個療程的 Cisplatin 100mg 之化學藥物治療。
20060401：個案罹患巨大之 2B 期子宮頸鱗狀細胞癌，於 2006/04/01 至 2006/04/30 先接受總劑量 39.6Gy 的全骨盆 2D Box 放射治療；接著再於 Point A 給予 6 次各500cGy 銥-192 的腔內高劑量率近距放射治療(2006/05/05 及 2006/05/07 給予500cGy x3，再於2006/05/19及2006/05/20給予500cGy x3)；最後於2006/06/01至 2006/06/08 再接受另外 6 次總劑量達 10.8Gy 的子宮旁結締組織(parametrial)之放射治療。體外放射治療期間並同時給予兩個療程的 Cisplatin 100mg 藥物治療。
fields.purpose_en: In combined multimodality treatment, pathological stage is an important prognostic factor for many cancers and is the basis for deciding whether to give subsequent adjuvant treatment, so it is very important to record the time sequence and actual intervals of the individual treatment modalities; preoperative radiation therapy may change the stage and affect how it is used in analysis and evaluation.
fields.guide_en:
• If the reporting hospital has commissioned another facility to deliver part of the radiotherapy, it should be regarded as part of the reporting hospital's first course of treatment, and the radiotherapy data from the other facility must be consolidated and reported in full. • If there are multiple radiotherapy modalities (for example, combined external beam radiotherapy and internal brachytherapy for cervical cancer), the "Date radiotherapy started" must record the start date of the entire multi-modality radiotherapy. • If radiotherapy is the only therapy in the patient's first course of treatment, the "Date radiotherapy started" must coincide with the "Date of first course of treatment". • The treatment date is usually recorded in the radiotherapy summary. Examples: Code: Case
20031215: The patient received external beam radiotherapy on December 15, ROC 92 (2003).
20031012: A patient with a malignant brain tumor received gamma knife stereotactic radiosurgery on October 12, ROC 92 (2003).
20031012: A patient with non-small cell lung cancer had stereotactic gamma knife radiosurgery for brain metastasis on 2003/10/12, followed by whole-brain radiotherapy, 12 fractions to a total dose of 30Gy, from 2003/12/15 to 2003/12/30.
20031121: A patient with non-small cell lung cancer received whole-brain radiotherapy, 12 fractions to a total dose of 30Gy, from 2003/11/21 to 2003/12/10, and then stereotactic gamma knife radiosurgery for brain metastasis on 2003/12/12.
20060401: The patient has bulky stage 2B squamous cell carcinoma of the cervix and received, from 2006/04/01 to 2006/05/11, whole-pelvis 2D Box radiotherapy, 28 fractions to a total dose of 50.4Gy, with central block after 39.6Gy. This was followed by intracavitary high-dose-rate iridium-192 (Ir-192) brachytherapy to Point A, 6 fractions of 500cGy each (500cGy x3 on 2006/06/01 and 2006/06/02, and 500cGy x3 on 2006/06/15 and 2006/06/16). Two courses of Cisplatin 100mg chemotherapy were given during the external beam radiotherapy.
20060401: The patient has bulky stage 2B squamous cell carcinoma of the cervix and first received whole-pelvis 2D Box radiotherapy to a total dose of 39.6Gy from 2006/04/01 to 2006/04/30; then intracavitary high-dose-rate iridium-192 brachytherapy to Point A, 6 fractions of 500cGy each (500cGy x3 on 2006/05/05 and 2006/05/07, and 500cGy x3 on 2006/05/19 and 2006/05/20); and finally another 6 fractions of parametrial (parametrial) radiotherapy to a total dose of 10.8Gy from 2006/06/01 to 2006/06/08. Two courses of Cisplatin 100mg were given concurrently during the external beam radiotherapy.

fields.description_zh:
記錄在申報醫院的首次療程中，進行放射治療的結束日期。
欄位位置：214–221
fields.description_en:
Record the end date of radiation therapy in the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital.
Field position: 214–221
fields.purpose_zh: 整個放射治療療程的長短是腫瘤控制及併發症的重要因素。此資訊可作為放療之品質指標，及應用於藉以維持不中斷持續放療的輔助療法之成效評估。
fields.guide_zh:
 申報醫院若有委託他院執行部分放射治療，應視為申報醫院首次療程的一部份，須整併他院放射治療資料完整申報。 如果是多重放射治療模式(例如子宮頸癌的合併體外放射治療及體內近距放療)，「放射治療結束日期」必須記載的是整個多重放射治療模式的結束日期。 治療結束日期通常是記錄在放射治療摘要。範例：編碼：案例
20050104：個案於2004/12/15 至2005/01/04 接受區域放射治療。
20060404：腦腫瘤個案在 2006/04/04 接受立體定位加馬刀放射手術。編碼：案例

20031212：非小細胞肺癌個案於 2003/11/21 至2003/12/10 接受 12次總劑量30Gy的全腦放射治療，接著再於 2003/12/12 對腦轉移做立體定位加馬刀放射手術。
20060616：個案罹患巨大之 2B 期子宮頸鱗狀細胞癌，於 2006/04/01 至 2006/05/11 接受 28次總劑量 50.4Gy的全骨盆2D Box 放射治療，並於總劑量達 39.6Gy 時停止中央區照射(with central block after 39.6Gy)。接著再於 Point A 給予6次各500cGy的腔內高劑量率銥-192 近距放射治療(2006/06/01 及 2006/06/02 給予 500cGy x3，再於 2006/06/15 及 2006/06/16 給予 500cGy x3)。同時於體外放射治療期間給予兩個療程的 Cisplatin 100mg 化學治療。
20060608：個案罹患巨大之 2B 期子宮頸鱗狀細胞癌，一開始於 2006/04/01 至2006/04/30 接受總劑量達 39.6Gy 的全骨盆 2D Box 放射治療。接著再給予 Point A 6 次各500cGy 的腔內高劑量率銥-192 近距放射治療(2006/05/05 及 2006/05/07 給予500cGy x3，再於 2006/05/19及 2006/05/20 給予500cGy x3)。最後再於2006/06/01至2006/06/08 接受額外6次總劑量達 10.8Gy的子宮旁放射治療。體外放射治療期間並同時給予兩個療程的 Cisplatin 100mg 化學治療。
fields.purpose_en: The length of the entire radiation therapy course is an important factor for tumor control and complications. This information can serve as a quality indicator for radiation therapy and be used to evaluate the effectiveness of adjunctive therapy given to maintain uninterrupted continuous radiation therapy.
fields.guide_en:
• If the reporting hospital has commissioned another facility to deliver part of the radiotherapy, it should be regarded as part of the reporting hospital's first course of treatment, and the radiotherapy data from the other facility must be consolidated and reported in full. • If there are multiple radiotherapy modalities (for example, combined external beam radiotherapy and internal brachytherapy for cervical cancer), the "Date radiotherapy ended" must record the end date of the entire multi-modality radiotherapy. • The treatment end date is usually recorded in the radiotherapy summary. This was followed by intracavitary high-dose-rate iridium-192 brachytherapy to Point A, 6 fractions of 500cGy each (500cGy x3 on 2006/06/01 and 2006/06/02, and 500cGy x3 on 2006/06/15 and 2006/06/16). Two courses of Cisplatin 100mg chemotherapy were given during the external beam radiotherapy.

This was followed by intracavitary high-dose-rate iridium-192 brachytherapy to Point A, 6 fractions of 500cGy each (500cGy x3 on 2006/05/05 and 2006/05/07, and 500cGy x3 on 2006/05/19 and 2006/05/20). Finally, another 6 fractions of parametrial radiotherapy to a total dose of 10.8Gy were given from 2006/06/01 to 2006/06/08. fields.description_zh:
記錄在任何醫療機構的首次療程中，針對治療區域，放射治療及手術的時間順序關係。
欄位位置：222–223
fields.description_en:
Record the sequence of radiation therapy and surgery for the treated region in the first course of treatment at any healthcare institution.
Field position: 222–223
fields.purpose_zh: 放射治療及手術的時間順序關係可能無法由相關日期直接計算得知。此項目提供更詳實的時間順序關係。
fields.guide_zh:
 本欄位僅比較原發部位(T)及區域淋巴結(N)之放射治療與手術順序，遠端部位(M)屬於不同治療範圍不列入比較。 本欄位手術定義範圍：(1) 原發部位手術編碼為20-90之處置，(2)區域淋巴結手術範圍編碼為3-7之處置。例外：攝護腺癌手術編碼為21-23、25時，不需比較治療順序。 首次療程無放射治療，不論是否有接受手術，皆編碼為0。 如果首次療程有放射治療而無手術，應編碼為-8(未手術)。 血液腫瘤疾病及遠端轉移個案，應編碼為-7。例外：結外淋巴癌(Extranodal lymphoma)仍需比較治療順序。 首次療程有手術也有放射治療但治療範圍不同，應編碼為-7。例如：原發部位手術合併預防性腦部轉移放射治療。 接受遠端部位預防性放射治療個案：(1)未合併原發部位或區域淋巴結手術應編碼-8，(2)有合併原發部位或區域淋巴結手術應編碼-7。例如：甲狀腺癌接受碘-131治療，因原發部位、區域淋巴結、遠端部位皆會受到放射治療，則視為遠端部位有做預防性照射，應編碼為-7。 TACE歸類為區域化學治療且非手術，勿將此治療納入放射治療及手術治療時間順序的考量。 其他治療不需列入放射治療及手術治療之順序比較。編碼1、2、4是可合併相加來代表所有可能的放射治療及手術治療之順序關係。例如：一個極罕見的個案接受手術前、手術中及手術後放射治療，其編碼為7(=1+2+4)。範例：編碼：案例-8：3B 子宮頸癌個案於子宮頸圓錐狀切片(cone biopsy)後，再進行空腔內近距放射治療。-8：胃部淋巴癌個案因年邁僅接受胃局部放射治療。-8：個案因為有其他醫療狀況而未接受手術，只接受緩和性放射治療來舒緩疼痛。-8：侷限期(Limited stage)小細胞肺癌個案接受腦部預防性放射治療，無接受手術治療。-7：侷限期(Limited stage)小細胞肺癌個案接受腦部預防性放射治療，並接受肺葉切除。編碼：案例-7：大腸癌個案合併肝轉移，接受肝葉切除後再進行化學治療。-6：個案於 2011/03/01 接受區域淋巴結手術，2011/03/05 原發部位接受放射治療，2011/03/07 接受原發部位手術。

fields.purpose_en: The time sequence of radiation therapy and surgery may not be directly calculable from the related dates. This item provides a more detailed time sequence.
fields.guide_en:
• This field compares only the sequence of radiotherapy and surgery for the primary site (T) and regional lymph nodes (N); distant sites (M) belong to a different treatment scope and are not included in the comparison. • Definition of surgery in this field: (1) primary site surgery with codes 20-90, (2) regional lymph node surgery with codes 3-7. Exception: when prostate cancer surgery is coded 21-23 or 25, the treatment sequence need not be compared. • If there was no radiotherapy in the first course of treatment, code 0, whether or not surgery was performed. • If there was radiotherapy but no surgery in the first course of treatment, code -8 (no surgery). • For hematologic neoplastic disease and cases with distant metastasis, code -7. Exception: for extranodal lymphoma (Extranodal lymphoma), the treatment sequence still needs to be compared. • If the first course of treatment included both surgery and radiotherapy but with different treatment volumes, code -7. For example: primary site surgery combined with prophylactic cranial irradiation. • For a patient who received prophylactic radiotherapy to a distant site: (1) without primary site or regional lymph node surgery, code -8; (2) with primary site or regional lymph node surgery, code -7. For example: thyroid cancer treated with iodine-131; because the primary site, regional lymph nodes and distant sites all receive radiation, it is regarded as prophylactic irradiation of distant sites, and should be coded -7. • TACE is classified as regional chemotherapy and not surgery; do not include this treatment in the consideration of the timing sequence of radiotherapy and surgery. • Other treatments need not be included in the comparison of the sequence of radiotherapy and surgery. Codes 1, 2 and 4 can be added together to represent all possible sequence relationships between radiotherapy and surgery. For example: in an extremely rare case receiving preoperative, intraoperative and postoperative radiotherapy, the code is 7 (=1+2+4). Examples: Code: Case -8: A stage 3B cervical cancer patient received intracavitary brachytherapy after cone biopsy. -8: A patient with gastric lymphoma, being elderly, received only local gastric radiotherapy. -8: A patient who did not undergo surgery because of other medical conditions received only palliative radiotherapy to relieve pain. -8: A patient with limited stage (Limited stage) small cell lung cancer received prophylactic cranial irradiation and no surgery. -7: A patient with limited stage (Limited stage) small cell lung cancer received prophylactic cranial irradiation and underwent lobectomy. fields.description_zh:
記錄在任何醫療機構的首次療程中，針對原發部位的手術或放射治療，與全身性治療的時間順序關係。
欄位位置：224–225
fields.description_en:
Record the sequence of primary site surgery or radiation therapy relative to systemic therapy in the first course of treatment at any healthcare institution.
Field position: 224–225
fields.purpose_zh: 區域治療與全身性治療的時間順序關係可能無法由相關日期直接計算得知。此項目提供經判斷後更直接正確的時間順序關係。
fields.guide_zh:
 本欄位僅比較全身性藥物治療與區域治療的時間順序；若個案同時接受全身性、局部性藥物治療及區域治療，應優先摘錄全身性藥物治療與區域治療的順序。 藥物治療分為全身性及局部性藥物治療，定義如下： 全身性藥物治療：包括全身性化學藥物治療、荷爾蒙/類固醇治療、免疫治療及標靶治療等藥物治療。 局部性藥物：包括動脈栓塞化學治療(TACE)、intraperitoneal、intrapleural、intrathecal、intravesical、intraocular、 intratumoral。注意：骨髓/幹細胞或內分泌治療不屬於藥物治療，不應列入比較順序。 區域治療定義為首次療程中的手術治療及放射線治療；手術定義範圍為原發部位手術編碼為20-90之處置。例外：攝護腺癌手術編碼為21-23、25時，不需比較治療順序。 若個案有兩次以上原發部位手術，則以原發部位最確切手術為主。 若首次療程有全身性藥物治療而無區域治療，應編碼為-8(不論是否有局部性藥物治療)。 若首次療程僅有局部性藥物治療而未使用全身性藥物治療，應編碼為-7(不論是否有區域治療)。 如果首次療程無藥物治療，不論是否有接受區域治療，皆編碼為0。 血液腫瘤疾病及遠端轉移個案，應編碼為-1。例外：結外淋巴癌(Extranodal lymphoma)仍需比較治療順序。 編碼2主要應用於同步全身性藥物放射治療(Concurrent systemic and radiation therapy，CSRT)。但也可以用於手術旁全身性藥物治療(perioperative chemotherapy)。注意：同步全身性藥物放射治療(CSRT)的定義為個案同時接受放射治療與全身性藥物治療；若接受放射治療前後14天內有給予全身性藥物治療，可視為有接受CSRT。但放射治療結束後一個月仍持續接受全身性藥物治療，應視為輔助治療。 編碼1、2、4是可合併相加來代表所有可能的區域治療與全身性藥物治療之順序關係。例如：一個極罕見之個案接受放射治療前、放射治療中及放射治療後全身性治療，其編碼為7，相當於 1(導引療法)+ 2(同步療法)+ 4 (輔助療法)。注意：乳癌個案若於手術前接受荷爾蒙治療，但主責醫師未明示為Neoadjuvant hormone therapy，應詢問主責醫師是否視為Neoadjuvant hormone therapy。 其他治療不需列入區域治療與全身性治療之順序比較。 雙盲試驗治療需列入區域治療與全身性治療之順序比較。範例：編碼：案例及原因

fields.purpose_en: The time sequence of regional therapy and systemic therapy may not be directly calculable from the related dates. This item provides a more direct and accurate time sequence after judgment.
fields.guide_en:
This field only compares the time sequence of systemic drug therapy and regional treatment; if a case received systemic therapy, local drug therapy and regional treatment, the sequence of systemic drug therapy and regional treatment should be abstracted first. Drug therapy is divided into systemic and local drug therapy, defined as follows: Systemic drug therapy: includes systemic chemotherapy, hormone/steroid therapy, immunotherapy, targeted therapy and other drug therapy. Local drug therapy: includes transarterial chemoembolization (TACE), intraperitoneal, intrapleural, intrathecal, intravesical, intraocular, and intratumoral therapy. Note: bone marrow/stem cell or endocrine therapy is not drug therapy and should not be included in the sequence comparison. Regional treatment is defined as surgery and radiation therapy in the first course of treatment; surgery is defined as primary site surgery with procedure codes 20-90. Exception: for prostate cancer with surgery codes 21-23, 25, the treatment sequence need not be compared. If the case had two or more primary site surgeries, use the most definitive primary site surgery. If the first course of treatment includes systemic drug therapy but no regional treatment, code -8 (regardless of whether local drug therapy was given). If the first course of treatment includes only local drug therapy and no systemic drug therapy, code -7 (regardless of whether regional treatment was given). If the first course of treatment includes no drug therapy, code 0 regardless of whether regional treatment was received. For hematologic malignancies and cases with distant metastasis, code -1. Exception: for extranodal lymphoma, the treatment sequence must still be compared. Code 2 is mainly applied to concurrent systemic and radiation therapy (CSRT), but may also be used for perioperative chemotherapy. Note: concurrent systemic and radiation therapy (CSRT) is defined as the case receiving radiation therapy and systemic drug therapy at the same time; if systemic drug therapy was given within 14 days before or after radiation therapy, it can be regarded as CSRT. However, if systemic drug therapy continues for one month after radiation therapy ends, it should be regarded as adjuvant therapy. Codes 1, 2 and 4 can be added together to represent all possible sequence relationships between regional treatment and systemic drug therapy. For example: a very rare case received systemic therapy before, during and after radiation therapy, coded 7, equivalent to 1 (neoadjuvant therapy) + 2 (concurrent therapy) + 4 (adjuvant therapy). Note: if a breast cancer case received hormone therapy before surgery but the attending physician did not explicitly state it as Neoadjuvant hormone therapy, ask the attending physician whether it is regarded as Neoadjuvant hormone therapy. Other treatment need not be included in the sequence comparison of regional treatment and systemic therapy. Double-blind trial treatment must be included in the sequence comparison of regional treatment and systemic therapy. Examples: Code: Cases and reasons

fields.description_en:
Record the status of radiation therapy delivery in the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital.
Field position: 226–227
fields.purpose_zh: 有助於了解建議之治療模式未被採用的理由及確認治療的執行度。
fields.guide_zh:
 申報醫院若有委託他院執行部分放射治療，應視為申報醫院首次療程的一部份，須整併他院放射治療資料完整申報。 若「放射治療臨床標靶體積摘要」的編碼是00，則根據病歷摘錄沒有放射治療的原因。 若有主責醫師提供個案多種治療模式(multiple modalities)的選擇，而個案未採用建議中含放射治療選項的治療模式，而選擇建議中的其他治療方式，應編碼為01。 個案或其家屬拒絕治療，應編碼為07。 編碼為08的個案，應持續追蹤以確定更適當之編碼。 若有多種治療建議，但不清楚個案的選擇，應編碼為99。範例：編碼：案例
01：第1期攝護腺癌個案，治療計畫可為手術或近距放射治療，個案選擇手術治療。
fields.purpose_en: Helps understand the reasons the recommended treatment modality was not adopted and confirm treatment compliance.
fields.guide_en:
• If the reporting hospital has commissioned another facility to deliver part of the radiotherapy, it should be regarded as part of the reporting hospital's first course of treatment, and the radiotherapy data from the other facility must be consolidated and reported in full. • If the code of the "Radiotherapy clinical target volume summary" is 00, abstract the reason for no radiotherapy from the medical record. • If the attending physician offered the patient multiple treatment modalities (multiple modalities) and the patient did not adopt the recommended modality that includes radiotherapy but chose another recommended treatment, code 01. • If the patient or family refused treatment, code 07. • For patients coded 08, continue follow-up to determine a more appropriate code. • If there were multiple treatment recommendations but the patient's choice is unclear, code 99. Examples: Code: Case
01: A patient with stage 1 prostate cancer; the treatment plan could be surgery or brachytherapy, and the patient chose surgery.

fields.purpose_zh: 本項目的資料有助於分析治療技術與 治療效果的關係。
fields.guide_zh:
 申報醫院若有委託他院執行部分放射治療，應視為申報醫院首次療程的一部份，須整併他院放射治療資料完整申報。 體外放射治療技術通常是記錄在放射治療摘要。 一個體外放射治療療程可以是在單一階段完成，也可能需要數個階段才能完成。單一階段體外放射治療的典型病例是症狀緩解的放射治療，30Gy分成12次完成；頭頸癌的放射治療往往需要分成兩個階段：首先第一階段照射對於含可辨識腫瘤及其附近可能有顯微性侵犯區域的大範圍給予25次共50Gy的照射，然後第二階段針對可辨識腫瘤10次共20Gy的照射。 每個階段的放射治療技術應先分別編碼，然後加總得到最後的整個療程的編碼。如果同一治療技術在多個階段被使用，只需記載一次而不可重複累進計算至整個療程的編碼。 如果放射治療摘要只記載電腦斷層模擬定位(CT Simulation)而未記載三維順形放射療法或強度調控放射療法，只可以編碼為1(二維或簡單電腦斷層定位)。 斷層放射療法是一種特殊的強度調控放射療法，因此用特別獨立代碼8來登錄；不要重複使用代碼4於斷層放射療法。 如果在個別階段使用到以下幾個編碼：1(二維或簡單電腦斷層定位)；2(三維順形放射療法)；4(強度調控放射療法)；8(斷層放射療法)。每個治療只登錄最高的編碼，再將各階段的最高碼相加成為整個療程的最後加總編碼，如果各階段的放射治療有重複，在加總時只能使用一次。 影像導引放射治療(編碼32)及呼吸監控技術(編碼64)只有在放射治療摘要有特別記載時，才可加以登錄。而且此二者不太可能在二維放射時使用，因此綜合編碼如果是33、65及97，應重複稽核其正確性。 若治療儀器描述為SBRT(Stereotatic Body Radiotherapy)或SABR(Stereotatic Ablative Body Radiotherapy)，且治療技術使用諾力刀(Norvalis)、強度調控放射治療(IMRT)、體積弧形放射治療(Rapid Arc® )或粒子(質子或碳離子)時，依據治療次數(Fraction /Session)及劑量區分放射手術或體外放射治療：治療次數≦6且劑量≧800 cGy/次視為放射手術；治療次數>6次或劑量＜800 cGy/次，則登錄為體外放射線治療。 如果諾力刀(Novalis)被當成先進體外放射治療技術使用，而不是用於放射手術，應視為IMRT登錄於本項目。 如果放射治療摘要記載該療程有使用數種放射技術，但未能明確地顯示出所使用的各種放射技術在時程上之相互順序關係，癌症登記師可以逕行加總編碼。 質子治療需區分使用技術；若個案僅接受質子治療，請根據使用技術之不同來編碼1、2或4。 若放射治療包含三種治療方式：(1)光子治療、(2)質子或碳離子治療與(3)放射手術或近接放射治療時，其中放射手術或近接放射治療的資訊，應摘錄於4.2.3「其他放射治療」相關欄位中；而光子治療及質子或碳離子治療這兩種治療方式，則摘錄於4.2.2.1「體外放射治療技術」相關欄位中。當光子和質子或碳離子摘錄於「體外放射治療技術」時，僅需摘錄光子照射技術，依1、2、4、8、32、64加總編碼，再加上編碼16。 首次療程若有使用到多重放射治療儀器，請參考 4.2.1.2「放射治療儀器」的臨床情境組合表格，摘錄相關放射治療數據至適當欄位。範例：編碼：案例及原因
1：對乳癌個案使用簡單電腦斷層定位，其乳房和同側鎖骨上窩接受 6MV x-rays 放射治療。
0：甲狀腺癌個案接受碘-131同位素治療。
1：非小細胞肺癌個案合併上腔靜脈症候群及單一腦轉移，其原發腫瘤、縱隔膜和全腦接受緩和性的二維體外放射治療，腦轉移並追加放射手術。
0：T1N0M0 攝護腺癌個案只接受過攝護腺低劑量率近距放射治療。
35：乳癌個案使用 3D-CRT + IGRT 5000cGy 再以2D electron beam appositional boost to tumor bed (surgical scar) to 6200 cGy。編碼：案例及原因
36：Gleason’s score 為 5+5 之攝護腺癌個案，期別為 T2N0M0，接受 45 次總劑量 81Gy的強度調控放射療法(IMRT)。為能精確定位標靶，每日執行該項放射治療的同時併用影像導引放射療法(IGRT)。
6：T2N2M0 鼻咽癌個案先接受 20 次三維順形放射治療至總劑量達 40Gy 後， 接續再以35次強度調控放射療法(IMRT)追加總劑量達 70Gy。
4：T2N2M0鼻咽癌個案的顯著腫瘤體積(GTV)接受35次總劑量70Gy的強度調控放射療法(IMRT)，並用同步照野內加強法(simultaneous in-field boost)對緊臨的臨床標靶體積追加35 次總劑量63Gy的治療。
1：IIB 子宮頸癌個案接受全骨盆 2D box 放射治療後，再對原發腫瘤進行高劑量率空腔內追加治療。
66：無法手術的 cT1N0M0 非小細胞肺癌個案，其顯著腫瘤體積接受 35 次總劑量 70Gy的呼吸調控三維順形放射療法。
4：鼻咽癌個案一開始其原發腫瘤及上頸區域接受強度調控放射療法(IMRT)，下頸區域接受 3D 前側照野，放射治療次數達 20 次，總劑量為 50Gy；之後再對顯著腫瘤體積給予 10 次總劑量 20Gy 的強度調控放射療法。對於前項第一階段混合技術中強度調控放射療法和 3D 的編碼分別為 4 和 2，以最高編碼 4 為該階段編碼；第二階段的強度調控放射療法的編碼為 4。由於不同階段相同的編碼只能計算一次，故整個療程的合併編碼為 4。
42：肺癌個案於 2015/10/27 至2015/12/24 執行光子放射治療；於原發部位及區域淋巴結使用3D Conformal RT 治療2000cGy/10 次，並以RapidArc with IG 追加治療原發腫瘤1000cGy/5 次；另於 2015/11/19 至2015/12/17 再接受質子治療，於原發部位及區域淋巴結使用 2-Ports Ridge Filter治療4000 cGy/20 次。
1：肺癌個案於 2016/4/8 至 2016/4/22 執行質子治療(Proton radiotherapy)，於原發部位及區域淋巴結使用 Wobbling uniform scanning technique 治療5500 cGy/10 次。
56：Endometrioid carcinoma, pT1bN0(i+)，術後接受放射治療：EBRT totally 5040 cGy/28 fx. Proton beam: T+N (whole pelvis and para-aortic lymphatic regions), 45 CGE/25 fx by particle passive scattering. Photon beam: T+N (boost the lower pelvis), 540 cGy/ 3 fx by rapid arc + IG. Brachytherapy: Intra-vagina, HDR, 200cGy x 3fx.體外放射治療技術編碼為 56 (8 Rapid Arc +16 Mixed photon and proton + 32 IGRT)。
fields.purpose_en: The data in this item help analyze the relationship between treatment technique and treatment effect.
fields.guide_en:
• If the reporting hospital commissions another facility to perform part of the radiotherapy, it should be regarded as part of the reporting hospital's first course of treatment, and the radiotherapy data of the other facility must be integrated and reported completely. • External beam radiotherapy technique is usually recorded in the radiotherapy summary. • A course of external beam radiotherapy may be completed in a single phase or may require several phases. A typical single-phase case is palliative radiotherapy, 30 Gy in 12 fractions; radiotherapy for head and neck cancer often needs two phases: in the first phase a large volume containing the identifiable tumor and nearby areas of possible microscopic invasion receives 50 Gy in 25 fractions, and then in the second phase the identifiable tumor receives 20 Gy in 10 fractions. • The radiotherapy technique of each phase should first be coded separately, and then summed to obtain the code for the whole course. If the same technique is used in several phases, record it only once and do not accumulate it repeatedly into the code for the whole course. • If the radiotherapy summary records only CT simulation (CT Simulation) and does not record three-dimensional conformal radiotherapy or intensity-modulated radiotherapy, it can only be coded 1 (2D or simple CT-based planning). • Tomotherapy is a special type of intensity-modulated radiotherapy, so it is recorded with its own separate code 8; do not use code 4 again for tomotherapy. • If the following codes are used in individual phases: 1 (2D or simple CT-based planning); 2 (three-dimensional conformal radiotherapy); 4 (intensity-modulated radiotherapy); 8 (tomotherapy), record only the highest code for each treatment, then add the highest codes of the phases to form the final summed code for the whole course; if the radiotherapy of different phases is duplicated, it can be used only once in the summation. • Image-guided radiotherapy (code 32) and respiratory monitoring technique (code 64) may be recorded only when specifically documented in the radiotherapy summary. Moreover, the two are unlikely to be used with 2D radiotherapy, so if the combined code is 33, 65 or 97, its correctness should be re-audited. • If the treatment machine is described as SBRT (Stereotatic Body Radiotherapy) or SABR (Stereotatic Ablative Body Radiotherapy), and the technique uses Novalis (Norvalis), intensity-modulated radiotherapy (IMRT), volumetric arc therapy (Rapid Arc® ) or particles (proton or carbon ion), radiosurgery and external beam radiotherapy are distinguished by number of fractions (Fraction /Session) and dose: number of fractions ≦6 and dose ≧800 cGy per fraction is regarded as radiosurgery; number of fractions >6 or dose <800 cGy per fraction is recorded as external beam radiotherapy. • If Novalis is used as an advanced external beam radiotherapy technique rather than for radiosurgery, it should be regarded as IMRT and recorded in this item. • If the radiotherapy summary records that several radiation techniques were used in the course but does not clearly show the sequence of the various techniques over time, the cancer registrar may simply sum the codes. • Proton therapy requires distinguishing the technique used; if the case received only proton therapy, code 1, 2 or 4 according to the technique used. • If the radiotherapy includes three treatment modalities: (1) photon therapy, (2) proton or carbon ion therapy, and (3) radiosurgery or brachytherapy, the information on radiosurgery or brachytherapy should be abstracted in the relevant fields of 4.2.3 “Other radiotherapy”, while photon therapy and proton or carbon ion therapy should be abstracted in the relevant fields of 4.2.2.1 “External beam radiotherapy technique”. When photon and proton or carbon ion are abstracted in “External beam radiotherapy technique”, abstract only the photon irradiation technique, sum the codes 1, 2, 4, 8, 32, 64, and then add code 16. • If multiple radiotherapy machines were used in the first course of treatment, refer to the clinical scenario combination table of 4.2.1.2 “Radiotherapy machine” and abstract the relevant radiotherapy data into the appropriate fields. Example: Code: Case and reason
1: A breast cancer patient used simple CT-based planning; the breast and ipsilateral supraclavicular fossa received 6MV x-rays radiotherapy.
0: A thyroid cancer patient received iodine-131 radioisotope therapy.
1: A patient with non-small cell lung cancer complicated by superior vena cava syndrome and a single brain metastasis received palliative 2D external beam radiotherapy to the primary tumor, mediastinum and whole brain, with an additional radiosurgery boost to the brain metastasis.
0: A patient with T1N0M0 prostate cancer received only low-dose-rate brachytherapy of the prostate.
35: A breast cancer patient used 3D-CRT + IGRT 5000cGy, followed by 2D electron beam appositional boost to tumor bed (surgical scar) to 6200 cGy. Code: Case and reason
36: A patient with prostate cancer, Gleason’s score 5+5, stage T2N0M0, received intensity-modulated radiotherapy (IMRT) at a total dose of 81 Gy in 45 fractions. To locate the target accurately, image-guided radiotherapy (IGRT) was used together with this radiotherapy every day.
6: A patient with T2N2M0 nasopharyngeal cancer first received 20 fractions of three-dimensional conformal radiotherapy to a total dose of 40 Gy, followed by 35 fractions of intensity-modulated radiotherapy (IMRT) boosting to a total dose of 70 Gy.
4: In a patient with T2N2M0 nasopharyngeal cancer, the gross tumor volume (GTV) received intensity-modulated radiotherapy (IMRT) at a total dose of 70 Gy in 35 fractions, and, using the simultaneous in-field boost technique, the adjacent clinical target volume received an additional 63 Gy in 35 fractions.
1: A patient with stage IIB cervical cancer received whole-pelvis 2D box radiotherapy, followed by a high-dose-rate intracavitary boost to the primary tumor.
66: A patient with inoperable cT1N0M0 non-small cell lung cancer received respiratory-gated three-dimensional conformal radiotherapy to the gross tumor volume at a total dose of 70 Gy in 35 fractions.
4: A nasopharyngeal cancer patient initially received intensity-modulated radiotherapy (IMRT) to the primary tumor and upper neck region and a 3D anterior field to the lower neck region, for 20 fractions to a total dose of 50 Gy; then the gross tumor volume received intensity-modulated radiotherapy at 20 Gy in 10 fractions. In the mixed technique of the first phase above, the codes for intensity-modulated radiotherapy and 3D are 4 and 2 respectively, and the highest code, 4, is the code for that phase; the code for intensity-modulated radiotherapy in the second phase is 4. Because the same code in different phases can be counted only once, the combined code for the whole course is 4.
42: A lung cancer patient received photon radiotherapy from 2015/10/27 to 2015/12/24: 3D Conformal RT to the primary site and regional lymph nodes at 2000cGy/10 fractions, with a RapidArc with IG boost to the primary tumor at 1000cGy/5 fractions; in addition, from 2015/11/19 to 2015/12/17 the patient also received proton therapy to the primary site and regional lymph nodes using 2-Ports Ridge Filter at 4000 cGy/20 fractions.
1: A lung cancer patient received proton radiotherapy (Proton radiotherapy) from 2016/4/8 to 2016/4/22, to the primary site and regional lymph nodes using the Wobbling uniform scanning technique at 5500 cGy/10 fractions.
56: Endometrioid carcinoma, pT1bN0(i+), postoperative radiotherapy: EBRT totally 5040 cGy/28 fx. Proton beam: T+N (whole pelvis and para-aortic lymphatic regions), 45 CGE/25 fx by particle passive scattering. Photon beam: T+N (boost the lower pelvis), 540 cGy/ 3 fx by rapid arc + IG. Brachytherapy: Intra-vagina, HDR, 200cGy x 3fx. The external beam radiotherapy technique is coded 56 (8 Rapid Arc +16 Mixed photon and proton + 32 IGRT).

fields.name_zh: 最高放射劑量臨床標靶體積
fields.name_zh_en: maximum radiation dose clinical target volume
fields.description_zh:
記錄在申報醫院的首次療程中，利用放射線涵蓋之局部原發腫瘤(T)，區域淋巴結(N)或遠端轉移(M)來區分並記錄體外射治療中接受最高劑量的目標區域之範圍。一般而言，此最高劑量區域也就是腫瘤負荷最重的區域。
欄位位置：231–232
fields.description_en:
Record, by whether the radiation covers the local primary tumor (T), regional lymph nodes (N) or distant metastasis (M), the extent of the target region receiving the highest dose in external beam radiation therapy in the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital. In general, this highest-dose region is the region with the greatest tumor burden.
Field position: 231–232
fields.purpose_zh:
在作治療效果分析時，放射腫瘤醫師會將局部治療失敗的因素分為下列四類：
1. 治療部位：是在原發部位失敗，還是淋巴引流區域失敗。
2. 腫瘤負荷的輕重：是在臨床可辨識的顯著腫瘤體積(GTV)內失敗，還是在可能有顯微性侵犯的臨床標靶體積內(CTV)內失敗。
3. 治療是否涵蓋足夠的範圍：是在放射治療範圍內失敗，是在放射治療邊緣失敗，還是在放射治療範圍外失敗。
4. 腫瘤的放射線敏感度(Radiosensitivity)：失敗是否和腫瘤病理及其分化程度相關。
5. 本項目CTV_H合併前兩點的資訊以供未來分析之用。
fields.guide_zh:
 申報醫院若有委託他院執行部分放射治療，應視為申報醫院首次療程的一部份，須整併他院放射治療資料完整申報。 臨床標靶體積的範圍通常是記錄在放射治療摘要。為達到摘錄編碼的一致性，可能需要與放射腫瘤醫師討論以決定確切的治療範圍。 手術中放射治療的標靶體積的範圍也可能記錄在腫瘤醫師所撰寫外科手術摘要中。 沒有一定或絕對的數值來定義放射劑量的高低。CTV_H的最高放射線劑量及CTV_L的較低劑量，只代表該放射療程中，個案接受到最高和次高放射劑量的臨床標靶體積相對的高低劑量關係，並不是用一定或絕對的數值來定義放射劑量的高低。 一般而言，CTV_H通常顯著腫瘤體積(GTV)或者是手術切除腫瘤後臨床上無法偵測但相對的高腫瘤負荷(Tumor Burden)及高復發機率的開刀範圍。而CTV_L代表相對低腫瘤負荷的臨床標靶體積。但是也有一些例外：例如子宮頸癌的放射治療，首先是全骨盆體外放射治療，接著追加體外放射治療至子宮頸旁組織(parametrium，T+N)，最後再加上空腔內近距放射治療。在這樣的個案中，只接受全骨盆體外放射治療的CTV_L卻是有較高腫瘤負荷的原發部位，而額外接受追加體外放射治療的CTV_H為腫瘤負荷較低的子宮頸旁組織。但加上空腔內近距放射治療，CTV_L原發部位所接受到的總劑量還是高於子宮頸旁組織的總劑量。 CTV_L可能是鄰近於CTV_H的另一個範圍，也可以是圍繞在CTV_H外的區域。 有些放射腫瘤醫師會以「區域劑量」(Regional Dose)及「追加劑量」(Boost Dose)的方式來記錄放射治療範圍及劑量。這種報告方式隱喻有一個較大的腫瘤標靶範圍接受了「區域劑量」，而在此大範圍中有一個較小的腫瘤標靶範圍接受了額外的「追加劑量」。一般而言，是在大範圍接受到「區域劑量」後才給予「追加劑量」至小範圍，但有時「追加劑量」會在放射治療的第一階段中先行給與，也可能和「區域劑量」同時給與。 如果「放射治療臨床標靶體積摘要」只有記載一個治療範圍及劑量，此治療範圍應登錄於本項目CTV_H。 如果「放射治療臨床標靶體積摘要」記載數個治療範圍但接受到相同照射次數及相同劑量，應先合併這些範圍成同一臨床體積後，再判斷是否應登錄至本項目CTV_H(只有單一劑量，或是還有其他臨床標靶體積接受到較低的劑量)，還是應登錄至項目CTV_L(還有其他臨床標靶體積接受到更高的劑量)。 如果「放射治療臨床標靶體積摘要」中有三個(含)以上的放射劑量，只需記錄最高的兩個劑量之相關資料。 CTV_H可以同時涵蓋原發腫瘤、區域淋巴結甚至遠端轉移，其先決條件是這些區域接受到相同次數及相同劑量的放射照射。 在臨床實務中，放射腫瘤醫師可能不完全遵循ICRU的建議方式來撰寫放射治療摘要，而直接以詳細的解剖結構名稱來敘述治療的部位。癌症登記人員必須從這些解剖結構名稱直接或間接地判斷治療部位是原發腫瘤、區域淋巴結或是遠端轉移。 請依循TNM分期的準則來定義個別癌症的放射治療範圍是否涵蓋(T)局部原發腫瘤及其侵犯程度、(N)區域淋巴結的範圍，和(M)遠端轉移。 涵蓋局部原發腫瘤之放射治療標靶體積，不需考慮T的分期，其編碼為1；涵蓋區域淋巴結之放射治療標靶體積，不需考慮N的分期，其編碼為2；涵蓋遠端轉移之放射治療標靶體積，不需考慮實際上轉移部位，其編碼為4。 放射治療標靶體積可同時包含局部原發腫瘤、區域淋巴結或遠端轉移等三種範圍之不同組合，請加總上述與T、N、M相關之編碼而得到最後的組合碼記錄之。例如：若局部原發腫瘤和區域淋巴結均包含在放射範圍內，則編碼應為3(=1+2)，因為照射目標為T(1)及N(2)。 其他三個可合併相加之編碼：8代表廣泛淋巴照射(包含mini-Mantle / Mantle / inverted Y / total lymphoid irradiation)，16代表全身照射，32代表全身皮膚電子射線放射治療。 代碼8只適用於何杰金氏症(Hodgkin’s disease，以下簡稱HD)及非何杰金氏淋巴癌(non-Hodgkin lymphoma，以下簡稱NHL)的廣泛淋巴照射。若單用局部淋巴結放射治療於HD及NHL，仍應編碼為2。若廣泛淋巴照射後又追加局部淋巴結放射治療，其編碼為10。 如果放射治療是單純的內分泌處置，例如乳癌個案接受卵巢放射治療，其編碼為-1。如果放射治療不僅是傳統直接地破壞腫瘤，也藉由破壞內分泌來間接地抑制腫瘤，這時只需摘錄傳統的腫瘤標靶體積的範圍，而不需考慮加總內分泌處置的-1編碼。範例：編碼：案例及原因
3：cT3N2M0 非角質化鼻咽癌個案，於 2006/04/01 至 2006/05/18 接受完全性 9 個照野(definitive 9-field)的強度調控放射療法(IMRT)和同步照野內加強法(simultaneous in-field boost)，使用 6MV x-rays 對原發腫瘤和右側 level 2 淋巴結病變的顯著腫瘤體積給予35次總劑量 70Gy(即最高放射劑量臨床標靶體積)，對於位於鼻咽和口咽的原發腫瘤的臨床標靶體積和位於雙側 level 2 和雙側level 3 淋巴結的臨床標靶體積給予35次總劑量 59.5Gy(即較低放射劑量臨床標靶體積)，對雙側level 4 和鎖骨上窩的淋巴結臨床標靶體積給予 25 次總劑量 50Gy。另外，並同步給予 2 個療程的Cisplatin 100mg/m2。
3：左側乳房管道侵襲癌個案，經左側改良式根除乳房切除術後病理發現為pT3N1M0G2、ER+、PR+、Her2-，於完成 6 個 FAC 輔助化療後，再進行 28 次總劑量 50.4Gy 的術後三維順形放射治療(3D-CRT)，其中胸壁使用 6MV 對側切割照野(opposing tangential field)，鎖骨上窩使用單一前側照野(single anterior field)。編碼：案例及原因
3：bulky stage IIB 的子宮頸鱗狀細胞癌個案，於 2006/04/01 至 2006/05/11 接受 28 次總劑量50.4Gy 的全骨盆2D Box 放射治療，並於總劑量達到 39.6Gy時停止中央區照射(with central block after 39.6Gy)。接著再給予 Point A 6 次各500cGy的腔內高劑量率銥-192 近距放射治療(2006/06/01 及 2006/06/02 給予 500cGy x3，再於2006/06/15 及2006/06/16 給予500cGy x3)。同時於體外放射治療期間給予兩個療程的Cisplatin 100mg/m2。
1：Gleason score 5+5,PSA 20 的 T2N0M0 攝護腺癌個案，於 2006/04/01 至 2006/06/03接受7-field 強度調控放射療法(IMRT)，使用 10MV x-rays 對攝護腺給予 45 次總劑量81Gy，對攝護腺和儲精囊給予 40次總劑量72Gy，以及對全骨盆給予 25 次總劑量45Gy。
3：左下肺葉cT3N2M1G3 鱗狀細胞癌個案合併腦轉移個案及左下肺葉阻塞性肺炎，於2006/04/01 到2006/04/24 接受放射治療，其中全腦經由 2D兩邊對側照野給予 14次總劑量35Gy，縱隔膜和原發腫瘤接受 16次總劑量40Gy 的三維順形放射療法。腦轉移病灶再於 2006/05/01 至2006/05/04 接受4次5Gy 電腦刀放射手術。
0：T1N0M0 攝護腺癌個案只接受攝護腺低劑量率碘-125 空腔內近距放射治療 140Gy。
fields.purpose_en:
When analyzing treatment effect, radiation oncologists classify the factors of local treatment failure into the following four categories:
1. Treatment site: whether failure is at the primary site or in the lymph drainage region.
2. Tumor burden: whether failure is within the clinically identifiable gross tumor volume (GTV) or within the clinical target volume (CTV) where microscopic invasion is possible.
3. Whether treatment covered an adequate extent: whether failure is within the radiation field, at the radiation field margin, or outside the radiation field.
4. Tumor radiosensitivity (Radiosensitivity): whether failure is related to tumor pathology and degree of differentiation.
5. This item, CTV_H, combines the information of the first two points for future analysis.
fields.guide_en:
• If the reporting hospital has commissioned another facility to deliver part of the radiotherapy, it should be regarded as part of the reporting hospital's first course of treatment, and the radiotherapy data from the other facility must be consolidated and reported in full. • The extent of the clinical target volume is usually recorded in the radiotherapy summary. To ensure consistency of abstracting and coding, it may be necessary to discuss with the radiation oncologist to determine the exact extent of treatment. • The extent of the target volume for intraoperative radiotherapy may also be recorded in the surgical summary written by the oncologist. • There is no fixed or absolute value that defines a high or low radiation dose. The highest radiation dose of CTV_H and the lower dose of CTV_L merely represent the relative high/low dose relationship between the clinical target volumes that received the highest and second-highest radiation doses in that course of radiotherapy; they are not defined by fixed or absolute values. • In general, CTV_H is usually the gross tumor volume (GTV) or the surgical field that is clinically undetectable after tumor resection but has a relatively high tumor burden (Tumor Burden) and a high probability of recurrence. CTV_L represents the clinical target volume with a relatively low tumor burden. There are some exceptions, however: for example, in radiotherapy for cervical cancer, whole-pelvis external beam radiotherapy is given first, followed by an external beam boost to the parametrium (parametrium, T+N), and finally intracavitary brachytherapy is added. In such a case, the CTV_L that received only whole-pelvis external beam radiotherapy is the primary site with the higher tumor burden, whereas the CTV_H that received the additional external beam boost is the parametrium with the lower tumor burden. With intracavitary brachytherapy added, however, the total dose received by the primary site in CTV_L is still higher than the total dose to the parametrium. • CTV_L may be another region adjacent to CTV_H, or a region surrounding CTV_H. • Some radiation oncologists record the radiotherapy volume and dose as "regional dose" (Regional Dose) and "boost dose" (Boost Dose). This way of reporting implies that a larger tumor target volume received the "regional dose", and within this larger volume a smaller tumor target volume received an additional "boost dose". In general, the "boost dose" is given to the smaller volume after the larger volume has received the "regional dose", but sometimes the "boost dose" is given first in the first phase of radiotherapy, or may be given simultaneously with the "regional dose". • If the "radiotherapy clinical target volume summary" records only one treatment volume and dose, this treatment volume should be recorded in this item, CTV_H. • If the "radiotherapy clinical target volume summary" records several treatment volumes that received the same number of fractions and the same dose, first merge these volumes into one clinical volume, then decide whether it should be recorded in this item, CTV_H (only a single dose, or other clinical target volumes received a lower dose), or in the item CTV_L (other clinical target volumes received a higher dose). • If the "radiotherapy clinical target volume summary" contains three or more radiation doses, record only the data for the two highest doses. • CTV_H may simultaneously cover the primary tumor, regional lymph nodes and even distant metastases, on the condition that these regions received the same number of fractions and the same dose of radiation. • In clinical practice, radiation oncologists may not fully follow the ICRU-recommended format when writing the radiotherapy summary, and instead describe the treated sites directly by detailed anatomical structure names. Cancer registrars must determine, directly or indirectly, from these anatomical names whether the treated site is the primary tumor, regional lymph nodes or distant metastasis. • Follow the TNM staging criteria to define, for each cancer, whether the radiotherapy volume covers (T) the local primary tumor and its extent of invasion, (N) the regional lymph nodes, and (M) distant metastasis. • A radiotherapy target volume covering the local primary tumor, regardless of the T stage, is coded 1; a target volume covering regional lymph nodes, regardless of the N stage, is coded 2; a target volume covering distant metastasis, regardless of the actual metastatic site, is coded 4. • A radiotherapy target volume may include any combination of the three areas (local primary tumor, regional lymph nodes, distant metastasis); add up the codes related to T, N and M above to obtain the final combined code to record. For example: if both the local primary tumor and regional lymph nodes are included in the radiation field, the code should be 3 (=1+2), because the irradiation targets are T (1) and N (2). • Three other codes can be added into the combination: 8 represents extensive lymphatic irradiation (including mini-Mantle / Mantle / inverted Y / total lymphoid irradiation), 16 represents total body irradiation, and 32 represents total skin electron beam therapy. • Code 8 applies only to extensive lymphatic irradiation for Hodgkin's disease (hereinafter HD) and non-Hodgkin lymphoma (hereinafter NHL). If only regional lymph node radiotherapy is used for HD and NHL, code 2 still applies. If regional lymph node radiotherapy is added after extensive lymphatic irradiation, the code is 10. • If the radiotherapy is purely an endocrine intervention, for example ovarian irradiation for a breast cancer patient, the code is -1. If the radiotherapy not only destroys the tumor directly in the conventional way but also suppresses the tumor indirectly by destroying endocrine function, record only the conventional extent of the tumor target volume, and do not add the -1 code for the endocrine intervention. Examples: Code: Case and reason
3: A patient with cT3N2M0 non-keratinizing nasopharyngeal carcinoma received, from 2006/04/01 to 2006/05/18, definitive 9-field intensity-modulated radiotherapy (IMRT) with simultaneous in-field boost, using 6MV x-rays: 35 fractions to a total dose of 70Gy to the gross tumor volume of the primary tumor and right level 2 lymph node disease (i.e. the highest-dose clinical target volume); 35 fractions to a total dose of 59.5Gy to the clinical target volume of the primary tumor in the nasopharynx and oropharynx and to the clinical target volumes of the bilateral level 2 and bilateral level 3 lymph nodes (i.e. the lower-dose clinical target volume); and 25 fractions to a total dose of 50Gy to the clinical target volumes of the bilateral level 4 and supraclavicular fossa lymph nodes. In addition, 2 courses of Cisplatin 100mg/m2 were given concurrently.
3: A patient with invasive ductal carcinoma of the left breast; after left modified radical mastectomy, pathology showed pT3N1M0G2, ER+, PR+, Her2-; after completing 6 cycles of adjuvant FAC chemotherapy, the patient received postoperative three-dimensional conformal radiotherapy (3D-CRT), 28 fractions to a total dose of 50.4Gy, with 6MV opposing tangential fields to the chest wall and a single anterior field to the supraclavicular fossa. Code: Case and reason
3: A patient with bulky stage IIB squamous cell carcinoma of the cervix received, from 2006/04/01 to 2006/05/11, whole-pelvis 2D Box radiotherapy, 28 fractions to a total dose of 50.4Gy, with central block after 39.6Gy. This was followed by intracavitary high-dose-rate iridium-192 brachytherapy to Point A, 6 fractions of 500cGy each (500cGy x3 on 2006/06/01 and 2006/06/02, and 500cGy x3 on 2006/06/15 and 2006/06/16). Two courses of Cisplatin 100mg/m2 were given during the external beam radiotherapy.
1: A patient with T2N0M0 prostate cancer, Gleason score 5+5, PSA 20, received 7-field intensity-modulated radiotherapy (IMRT) from 2006/04/01 to 2006/06/03, using 10MV x-rays: 45 fractions to a total dose of 81Gy to the prostate, 40 fractions to a total dose of 72Gy to the prostate and seminal vesicles, and 25 fractions to a total dose of 45Gy to the whole pelvis.
3: A patient with cT3N2M1G3 squamous cell carcinoma of the left lower lobe with brain metastasis and obstructive pneumonia of the left lower lobe received radiotherapy from 2006/04/01 to 2006/04/24: the whole brain received 14 fractions to a total dose of 35Gy via 2D opposed lateral fields, and the mediastinum and primary tumor received 16 fractions to a total dose of 40Gy by three-dimensional conformal radiotherapy. The brain metastasis then received CyberKnife radiosurgery, 4 fractions of 5Gy, from 2006/05/01 to 2006/05/04.
0: A patient with T1N0M0 prostate cancer received only low-dose-rate iodine-125 intracavitary brachytherapy to the prostate, 140Gy.

Record the radiation dose to CTV_H in the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital. The unit of this field is centiGray (abbreviated cGy), the same size as the old unit “rads”.

fields.purpose_zh: 可分析放射治療範圍內失敗的原因是放射劑量不足，或是受限於周邊正常組織的放射線耐受度。
fields.guide_zh:
 申報醫院若有委託他院執行部分放射治療，應視為申報醫院首次療程的一部份，須整併他院放射治療資料完整申報。 為達到資料的一致性，應採用國際放射線單位和測量協會(The International Commission of Radiation Units and Measurement)發布之50和62號報告中所建議的方式登錄放射劑量。如果無法確知是否是軸心劑量，則登錄放射治療摘要中記載的放射劑量。有時放射劑量是非常主觀的，必須與放射腫瘤醫師討論以達到摘錄編碼的一致性。 放射治療劑量通常是記錄在放射治療摘要。如果局部放射治療劑量及追加放射治療劑量是分別記載，CTV_H的放射治療劑量是這些劑量的總和。為達到摘錄編碼的一致性，可能需要與放射腫瘤醫師討論以決定正確的放射治療劑量。 CTV_H的放射劑量必須是最高或是加總後最高的體外放射治療劑量。 如果放射治療計畫是二維點計算的方式，則登錄在軸心上有代表性深度的點劑量。 如果放射治療計畫是三維體積計算的方式，CTV_H的放射劑量通常是整個CTV_H所接受到的最低劑量，或者是95% CTV_H體積所接受到的劑量。本項目CTV_H的放射劑量不是整個CTV_H所接受到最高劑量，也不是其平均劑量。 本項目CTV_H的放射劑量不含利用其他特殊放射線技術，如近距放射治療或放射手術，所給與的追加劑量；特殊放射線技術的追加劑量應登錄於「其他放射治療臨床標靶體積劑量」次分節中。 單一療程的放射劑量很少超過100,000cGy，如果單一療程的放射劑量是99997cGy(含)以上，皆編碼為99997。範例：編碼：案例及原因

05040：左側乳房管道侵襲癌個案，經左側改良式根除乳房切除術後病理發現為pT3N1M0G2、ER+、PR+、Her2-，於完成 6個FAC 輔助化療後，再進行 28 次總劑量 50.4Gy 的術後三維順形放射治療(3D-CRT)，其中胸壁使用 6MV 對側切割照野(opposing tangential field)，鎖骨上窩使用單一前側照野(single anterior field)。
05040：bulky stage IIB 的子宮頸鱗狀細胞癌個案，於 2006/04/01 至2006/05/11 接受 28次總劑量 50.4Gy 的全骨盆 2D Box 放射治療，並於總劑量達到 39.6Gy 時停止中央區照射(with central block after 39.6Gy)。接著再給予 Point A 6 次各500cGy的腔內高劑量率銥-192近距放射治療(2006/06/01 及2006/06/02 給予 500cGy x3，再於 2006/06/15及2006/06/16 給予500cGy x3)。同時於體外放射治療期間給予兩個療程的 Cisplatin 100mg/m2。
08100：Gleason score 5+5，PSA 20 的T2N0M0 攝護腺癌個案，於 2006/04/01 至2006/06/03接受7-field 強度調控放射療法(IMRT)，使用10MV x-rays 對攝護腺給予 45 次總劑量81Gy，對攝護腺和儲精囊給予 40次總劑量72Gy，以及對全骨盆給予 25 次總劑量45Gy。
04000：左下肺葉cT3N2M1G3 鱗狀細胞癌個案合併腦轉移個案及左下肺葉阻塞性肺炎，於2006/04/01 到2006/04/24 接受放射治療，其中全腦經由 2D兩邊對側照野給予 14次總劑量 35Gy，縱隔膜和原發腫瘤接受 16 次總劑量 40Gy 的三維順形放射療法。腦轉移病灶再於 2006/05/01 至2006/05/04 接受4次5Gy 電腦刀放射手術。
00000：T1N0M0 攝護腺癌個案只接受攝護腺低劑量率碘-125空腔內近距放射治療 140Gy。
fields.purpose_en: Can be used to analyze whether failure within the radiation field is due to insufficient radiation dose or limited by radiation tolerance of surrounding normal tissue.
fields.guide_en:
If the reporting hospital commissioned another hospital to perform part of the radiation therapy, this should be regarded as part of the reporting hospital's first course of treatment, and the radiation therapy data of the other hospital must be consolidated and reported completely. For data consistency, the radiation dose should be recorded in the manner recommended in Reports 50 and 62 of the International Commission of Radiation Units and Measurement. If it is not possible to determine whether the dose is the axial (central axis) dose, record the radiation dose stated in the radiation therapy summary. Sometimes the radiation dose is very subjective, and it must be discussed with the radiation oncologist to achieve consistency in abstracting and coding. The radiation therapy dose is usually recorded in the radiation therapy summary. If the local radiation therapy dose and the boost radiation therapy dose are recorded separately, the radiation therapy dose of CTV_H is the sum of these doses. To achieve consistency in abstracting and coding, it may be necessary to discuss with the radiation oncologist to determine the correct radiation therapy dose. The radiation dose of CTV_H must be the highest, or the highest summed, external beam radiation therapy dose. If the radiation therapy plan is calculated as a two-dimensional point dose, record the point dose at a representative depth on the central axis. If the radiation therapy plan is calculated as a three-dimensional volume, the radiation dose of CTV_H is usually the lowest dose received by the whole CTV_H, or the dose received by 95% of the CTV_H volume. The CTV_H radiation dose in this item is neither the highest dose received by the whole CTV_H nor its mean dose. The CTV_H radiation dose in this item does not include boost doses given with other special radiation techniques such as brachytherapy or radiosurgery; boost doses of special radiation techniques should be recorded in the subsection "Radiation dose of other radiation therapy clinical target volume". The radiation dose of a single course of treatment rarely exceeds 100,000cGy; if the radiation dose of a single course is 99997cGy or more, code 99997. Examples: Code: Cases and reasons
07000: A case of cT3N2M0 non-keratinizing nasopharyngeal cancer received definitive 9-field intensity-modulated radiation therapy (IMRT) with simultaneous in-field boost from 2006/04/01 to 2006/05/18, using 6MV x-rays: a total dose of 70Gy in 35 fractions to the gross tumor volume of the primary tumor and the right level 2 nodal disease (the highest-dose clinical target volume); a total dose of 59.5Gy in 35 fractions to the clinical target volume of the primary tumor in the nasopharynx and oropharynx and the clinical target volume of the bilateral level 2 and bilateral level 3 lymph nodes (the lower-dose clinical target volume); and a total dose of 50Gy in 25 fractions to the clinical target volume of the bilateral level 4 and supraclavicular fossa lymph nodes. In addition, 2 courses of Cisplatin 100mg/m2 were given concurrently.
05040: A case of invasive ductal carcinoma of the left breast; after left modified radical mastectomy, pathology showed pT3N1M0G2, ER+, PR+, Her2-. After completing 6 cycles of adjuvant FAC chemotherapy, post-operative three-dimensional conformal radiation therapy (3D-CRT) with a total dose of 50.4Gy in 28 fractions was given, using 6MV opposing tangential fields for the chest wall and a single anterior field for the supraclavicular fossa.
05040: A case of bulky stage IIB cervical squamous cell carcinoma received whole-pelvis 2D Box radiation therapy with a total dose of 50.4Gy in 28 fractions from 2006/04/01 to 2006/05/11, with the central region shielded when the total dose reached 39.6Gy (with central block after 39.6Gy). This was followed by high-dose-rate intracavitary iridium-192 brachytherapy to Point A, 6 fractions of 500cGy each (500cGy x3 on 2006/06/01 and 2006/06/02, and again 500cGy x3 on 2006/06/15 and 2006/06/16). Two courses of Cisplatin 100mg/m2 were given concurrently during the external beam radiation therapy.
08100: A case of T2N0M0 prostate cancer with Gleason score 5+5 and PSA 20 received 7-field intensity-modulated radiation therapy (IMRT) from 2006/04/01 to 2006/06/03, using 10MV x-rays: a total dose of 81Gy in 45 fractions to the prostate, a total dose of 72Gy in 40 fractions to the prostate and seminal vesicles, and a total dose of 45Gy in 25 fractions to the whole pelvis.
04000: A case of left lower lobe cT3N2M1G3 squamous cell carcinoma with brain metastasis and left lower lobe obstructive pneumonia received radiation therapy from 2006/04/01 to 2006/04/24: the whole brain received a total dose of 35Gy in 14 fractions via 2D opposing lateral fields, and the mediastinum and primary tumor received three-dimensional conformal radiation therapy with a total dose of 40Gy in 16 fractions. The brain metastasis was further treated with CyberKnife radiosurgery, 4 fractions of 5Gy, from 2006/05/01 to 2006/05/04.
00000: A case of T1N0M0 prostate cancer received only low-dose-rate iodine-125 intracavitary brachytherapy of the prostate, 140Gy.

fields.name_zh: 最高放射劑量臨床標靶體積治療次數
fields.name_zh_en: Maximum radiation dose clinical target volume treatment frequency.
fields.description_zh:
記錄在申報醫院的首次療程中，CTV_H 的放射治療次數(fractions or sessions)。
欄位位置：238–239
fields.description_en:
Record the number of radiation therapy treatments (fractions or sessions) for CTV_H in the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital.
Field position: 238–239
fields.purpose_zh: 放射治療控制腫瘤效果的好壞與破壞正常組織毒性的高低，和標靶體積的大小，總劑量的高低，分次劑量(dose per fraction)的大小，及整個射線療程的長短相關。一般而言，分次劑量愈大，腫瘤控制效果愈好，但同時正常組織毒性愈高。如要計算CTV_H的平均放射分次劑量，只要將「最高放射劑量臨床標靶體積劑量」除以「最高放射劑量臨床標靶體積治療次數」即可得知。

fields.purpose_en: The effectiveness of radiation therapy in controlling the tumor and the degree of toxicity from damage to normal tissue are related to the size of the target volume, the total dose, the dose per fraction, and the length of the entire radiation course. In general, the larger the dose per fraction, the better the tumor control, but the higher the normal tissue toxicity. To calculate the average dose per fraction for CTV_H, divide the "dose to the highest-dose clinical target volume" by the "number of treatments to the highest-dose clinical target volume".
fields.guide_en:
• If the reporting hospital commissions another facility to perform part of the radiotherapy, it should be regarded as part of the reporting hospital's first course of treatment, and the radiotherapy data of the other facility must be integrated and reported completely. • The number of radiotherapy fractions is usually recorded in the radiotherapy summary. To achieve consistency in abstraction and coding, it may be necessary to discuss with the radiation oncologist to determine the exact number of fractions. • Although radiotherapy may have several radiotherapy fields or ports (fields or ports) irradiating the treatment site in sequence, most are completed within 30 minutes, so they can only be counted as one fraction. • The number of radiotherapy fractions for CTV_H is the sum of the number of irradiations in each radiotherapy phase within a course that contribute to the total dose of CTV_H. • The number of radiotherapy fractions for CTV_H does not include the number of irradiations of other special radiation techniques. In addition, 2 courses of cisplatin 100mg/m2 were given concurrently.

This was followed by intracavitary high-dose-rate iridium-192 brachytherapy to Point A, 6 fractions of 500cGy each (500cGy x3 on 2006/06/01 and 2006/06/02, and 500cGy x3 again on 2006/06/15 and 2006/06/16). Two courses of cisplatin 100mg/m2 were given during the external beam radiotherapy.

fields.name_zh: 較低放射劑量臨床標靶體積
fields.description_zh:
記錄在申報醫院的首次療程中，利用放射線涵蓋之局部原發腫瘤(T)，區域淋巴結(N)或遠端轉移(M)來區分並記錄體外射線治療中接受次高劑量的目標區域之範圍。
欄位位置：240–241
fields.description_en:
Record, by whether the radiation covers the local primary tumor (T), regional lymph nodes (N) or distant metastasis (M), the extent of the target region receiving the second-highest dose in external beam radiation therapy in the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital.
Field position: 240–241
fields.purpose_zh: 評估放射治療效果及檢討失敗原因。
fields.guide_zh:
 申報醫院若有委託他院執行部分放射治療，應視為申報醫院首次療程的一部份，須整併他院放射治療資料完整申報。 臨床標靶體積的範圍通常是記錄在放射治療摘要。為達到摘錄編碼的一致性，可能需要與放射腫瘤醫師討論以決定確切的治療範圍。 手術中放射治療的標靶體積的範圍也可能記錄在腫瘤醫師所撰寫外科手術摘要中。 沒有一定或絕對的數值來定義放射劑量的高低。CTV_H的最高放射劑量及CTV_L的較低劑量，只代表該放射療程中，相對的高低劑量關係。 一般而言，CTV_H通常是也就是顯著腫瘤體積(GTV)或者是手術切除腫瘤後臨床上無法偵測但相對的高腫瘤負荷(Tumor Burden)及高復發機率的開刀範圍。而CTV_L代表相對低腫瘤負荷的臨床標靶體積。但是也有一些例外：例如子宮頸癌的放射治療，首先是全骨盆體外放射治療，接著追加體外放射治療至子宮頸旁組織(parametrium，T+N)，最後再加上空腔內近距放射治療。在這樣的病例中，只接受全骨盆體外放射治療的CTV_L卻是有較高腫瘤負荷的原發部位，而額外接受追加體外放射治療的CTV_H為腫瘤負荷較低的子宮頸旁組織。但加上空腔內近距放射治療，CTV_L原發部位所接受到的總劑量還是高於子宮頸旁組織的總劑量。 CTV_L可能是鄰近於CTV_H的另一個範圍，也可以是圍繞在CTV_H外的區域。 有些放射腫瘤醫師會以「區域劑量」(Regional Dose)及「追加劑量」(Boost Dose)的方式來記錄放射治療範圍及劑量。這種報告方式隱喻有一個較大的腫瘤標靶範圍接受了「區域劑量」，而在此大範圍中有一個較小的腫瘤標靶範圍接受了額外的「追加劑量」。一般而言，是在大範圍接受到「區域劑量」後才給予「追加劑量」至小範圍，但有時「追加劑量」會在放射治療的第一階段中先行給與，也可能和「區域劑量」同時給與。 如果放射治療摘要記載數個治療範圍但接受到相同照射次數及相同劑量，應先合併這些範圍成同一臨床體積後，在判斷是否應登錄至項目CTV_H(只有單一劑量，或是還有其他臨床標靶體積接受到較低的劑量)，還是應登錄至本項目CTV_L(還有其他臨床標靶體積接受到更高的劑量)。 如果放射治療摘要只有記載一個治療範圍及劑量，或是有數個治療範圍但因為接受到相同照射次數及相同劑量而合併成單一標靶體積，Target of CTV_L編碼為0。 如果放射治療摘要中有三個(含)以上的放射劑量，且標靶類別TNM皆同時包含時，需記錄最高和最廣的兩個體積之相關資料。此時最廣的體積應摘錄標靶類別M。 CTV_L可以同時涵蓋原發腫瘤、區域淋巴結甚至遠端轉移，其先決條件是這些區域接受到相同次數及相同劑量的放射照射。 在臨床實務中，放射腫瘤醫師可能不完全遵循ICRU的建議方式來撰寫放射摘要，而直接以詳細的解剖結構名稱來敘述治療的部位。癌症登記人員必須從這些解剖結構名稱直接或間接地判斷治療部位是原發腫瘤、是區域淋巴結、還是遠端轉移。 其他相關編碼指引，請參照「最高放射劑量之臨床標靶體積」。 如果放射治療是單純的內分泌處置，例如乳癌個案接受卵巢放射治療，其編碼為-1。如果放射治療不僅是傳統直接地破壞腫瘤，也藉由破壞內分泌來間接地抑制腫瘤，這時只需摘錄傳統的腫瘤標靶體積的範圍，而不需考慮加總內分泌處置的-1編碼。範例：編碼：案例及原因
3：cT3N2M0 鼻咽非角質化細胞癌個案，於 2006/04/01 至 2006/05/18 接受完全性 9 個照野(definitive 9-field)的強度調控放射療法(IMRT)和同步照野內加強法(simultaneous in-field boost)，使用 6MV x-rays 對原發腫瘤和右側 level 2淋巴結病變的顯著腫瘤體積給予 35 次總劑量 70Gy(即最高放射劑量臨床標靶體積)，對於位於鼻咽和口咽的原發腫瘤的臨床標靶體積和位於雙側 level 2 和雙側 level 3 淋巴結的臨床標靶體積給予35次總劑量59.5Gy(即較低放射劑量臨床標靶體積)，對雙側level 4 和鎖骨上窩的淋巴結臨床標靶體積給予 25 次總劑量 50Gy。另外，並同步給予 2個療程的Cisplatin 100mg/m2。
0：左側乳房管道侵襲癌個案，經左側改良式根除乳房切除術後病理發現為pT3N1M0G2、ER+、PR+、Her2-，於完成 6個FAC 輔助化療後，再進行 28 次總劑量 50.4Gy 的術後三維順形放射治療(3D-CRT)，其中胸壁使用 6MV 對側切割照野(opposing tangential field)，鎖骨上窩使用單一前側照野(single anterior field)。
1：bulky stage IIB 的子宮頸鱗狀細胞癌個案，於 2006/04/01 至2006/05/11 接受 28次總劑量 50.4Gy 的全骨盆 2D Box 放射治療，並於總劑量達到 39.6Gy 時停止中央區照射(with central block after 39.6Gy)。接著再給予 Point A 6 次各500cGy的腔內高劑量率銥-192近距放射治療(2006/06/01 及2006/06/02 給予 500cGy x3，再於 2006/06/15及2006/06/16 給予500cGy x3)。同時於體外放射治療期間給予兩個療程的 Cisplatin 100mg/m2。
3：Gleason score 5+5，PSA 20 的T2N0M0 攝護腺癌個案，於 2006/04/01 至2006/06/03接受7-field 強度調控放射療法(IMRT)，使用10MV x-rays 對攝護腺給予 45 次總劑量81Gy，對攝護腺和儲精囊給予 40次總劑量72Gy，以及對全骨盆給予 25 次總劑量45Gy。
4：左下肺葉cT3N2M1G3 鱗狀細胞癌個案合併腦轉移個案及左下肺葉阻塞性肺炎，於2006/04/01 到2006/04/24 接受放射治療，其中全腦經由 2D兩邊對側照野給予 14次總劑量 35Gy，縱隔膜和原發腫瘤接受 16 次總劑量 40Gy 的三維順形放射療法。腦轉移病灶再於 2006/05/01至2006/05/04 接受4次5Gy 電腦刀放射手術。
0：T1N0M0 攝護腺癌個案只接受攝護腺低劑量率碘-125空腔內近距放射治療 140Gy。
fields.purpose_en: Evaluates the effect of radiation therapy and reviews causes of failure.
fields.guide_en:
If the reporting hospital commissioned another facility to perform part of the radiotherapy, it should be regarded as part of the reporting hospital's first course of treatment, and the other facility's radiotherapy data must be merged and reported completely. The extent of the clinical target volume is usually recorded in the radiotherapy summary. To achieve consistency in abstracting and coding, it may be necessary to discuss with the radiation oncologist to determine the exact treatment extent. The extent of the target volume of intraoperative radiotherapy may also be recorded in the surgical summary written by the oncologist. There is no fixed or absolute value defining a high or low radiation dose. The highest radiation dose of CTV_H and the lower dose of CTV_L only represent the relative high-low dose relationship within that radiotherapy course. In general, CTV_H is the gross tumor volume (GTV), or the surgical field after tumor resection that is clinically undetectable but has a relatively high tumor burden and high probability of recurrence. CTV_L represents the clinical target volume with a relatively low tumor burden. There are some exceptions: for example, in radiotherapy for cervical cancer, whole-pelvis external beam radiotherapy is given first, followed by an external beam boost to the parametrium (T+N), and finally intracavitary brachytherapy is added. In such a case, the CTV_L that received only whole-pelvis external beam radiotherapy is the primary site with the higher tumor burden, while the CTV_H that received the additional external beam boost is the parametrium with the lower tumor burden. But with intracavitary brachytherapy added, the total dose received by the primary site in CTV_L is still higher than the total dose to the parametrium. CTV_L may be another area adjacent to CTV_H, or an area surrounding CTV_H. Some radiation oncologists record the radiotherapy extent and dose as "Regional Dose" and "Boost Dose". This way of reporting implies that a larger tumor target area received the "Regional Dose" and a smaller tumor target area within it received an additional "Boost Dose". In general, the "Boost Dose" is given to the small area after the large area has received the "Regional Dose", but sometimes the "Boost Dose" is given first in the first phase of radiotherapy, or may be given at the same time as the "Regional Dose". If the radiotherapy summary lists several treatment areas that received the same number of fractions and the same dose, first merge these areas into one clinical volume, and then decide whether it should be recorded in the item CTV_H (there is only a single dose, or other clinical target volumes received a lower dose) or in this item CTV_L (other clinical target volumes received a higher dose). If the radiotherapy summary records only one treatment area and dose, or several treatment areas that were merged into a single target volume because they received the same number of fractions and the same dose, code Target of CTV_L as 0. If the radiotherapy summary has three or more radiation doses and the target categories T, N and M are all included, record the data of the two volumes with the highest dose and the widest extent. In this case the widest volume should be abstracted with target category M. CTV_L may cover the primary tumor, regional lymph nodes and even distant metastases at the same time, provided that these areas received the same number of fractions and the same dose. In clinical practice, radiation oncologists may not fully follow the ICRU-recommended way of writing the radiotherapy summary, and may directly describe the treated sites by detailed anatomic structure names. The cancer registrar must determine, directly or indirectly, from these anatomic structure names whether the treated site is the primary tumor, regional lymph nodes or distant metastasis. For other related coding guidelines, see "Clinical target volume of highest radiation dose". If radiotherapy is purely an endocrine procedure, for example ovarian irradiation in a breast cancer case, code -1. If radiotherapy not only destroys the tumor directly in the traditional way but also suppresses the tumor indirectly by destroying endocrine function, abstract only the extent of the traditional tumor target volume, and do not add the -1 code for the endocrine procedure. Examples: Code: Case and reason
3: A cT3N2M0 nasopharyngeal non-keratinizing carcinoma case received, from 2006/04/01 to 2006/05/18, definitive 9-field intensity-modulated radiotherapy (IMRT) with simultaneous in-field boost, using 6MV x-rays, giving 35 fractions to a total dose of 70Gy to the gross tumor volume of the primary tumor and right level 2 lymph node disease (i.e. the clinical target volume of highest radiation dose), 35 fractions to a total dose of 59.5Gy to the clinical target volume of the primary tumor in the nasopharynx and oropharynx and to the clinical target volume of bilateral level 2 and bilateral level 3 lymph nodes (i.e. the clinical target volume of lower radiation dose), and 25 fractions to a total dose of 50Gy to the clinical target volume of bilateral level 4 and supraclavicular fossa lymph nodes. In addition, 2 courses of cisplatin 100mg/m2 were given concurrently.
0: A case of left breast invasive ductal carcinoma, with pathology after left modified radical mastectomy of pT3N1M0G2, ER+, PR+, Her2-, completed 6 cycles of adjuvant FAC chemotherapy and then underwent postoperative three-dimensional conformal radiotherapy (3D-CRT), 28 fractions to a total dose of 50.4Gy, using 6MV opposing tangential fields for the chest wall and a single anterior field for the supraclavicular fossa.
1: A case of bulky stage IIB squamous cell carcinoma of the cervix received, from 2006/04/01 to 2006/05/11, 28 fractions of whole-pelvis 2D box radiotherapy to a total dose of 50.4Gy, with a central block after 39.6Gy. This was followed by intracavitary high-dose-rate iridium-192 brachytherapy to Point A, 6 fractions of 500cGy each (500cGy x3 on 2006/06/01 and 2006/06/02, then 500cGy x3 on 2006/06/15 and 2006/06/16). Two courses of cisplatin 100mg/m2 were given during external beam radiotherapy.
3: A T2N0M0 prostate cancer case with Gleason score 5+5 and PSA 20 received, from 2006/04/01 to 2006/06/03, 7-field intensity-modulated radiotherapy (IMRT), using 10MV x-rays, giving 45 fractions to a total dose of 81Gy to the prostate, 40 fractions to a total dose of 72Gy to the prostate and seminal vesicles, and 25 fractions to a total dose of 45Gy to the whole pelvis.
4: A case of left lower lobe cT3N2M1G3 squamous cell carcinoma with brain metastases and left lower lobe obstructive pneumonia received radiotherapy from 2006/04/01 to 2006/04/24: the whole brain received 14 fractions to a total dose of 35Gy through 2D opposing lateral fields, and the mediastinum and primary tumor received three-dimensional conformal radiotherapy, 16 fractions to a total dose of 40Gy. The brain metastases then received CyberKnife radiosurgery, 4 fractions of 5Gy, from 2006/05/01 to 2006/05/04.
0: A T1N0M0 prostate cancer case received only low-dose-rate iodine-125 intracavitary brachytherapy to the prostate, 140Gy.

fields.description_zh:
記錄在申報醫院的首次療程中，CTV_L 的放射劑量。本欄位的單位是 centiGray (縮寫cGy)，與舊單位“rads”相同大小。

fields.description_en:
Record the radiation dose to CTV_L in the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital. The unit of this field is centiGray (abbreviated cGy), the same size as the old unit “rads”.
Field position: 242–246
fields.purpose_zh: 評估放射治療效果及檢討失敗原因(放射治療範圍內失敗的原因是放射劑量不足，或是受限於周邊正常組織的放射線耐受度)。
fields.guide_zh:
 申報醫院若有委託他院執行部分放射治療，應視為申報醫院首次療程的一部份，須整併他院放射治療資料完整申報。 放射治療劑量通常是記錄在放射治療摘要。如果局部放射治療劑量及追加放射治療劑量是分別記載，CTV_L的放射治療劑量通常就是局部放射治療劑量。為達到摘錄編碼的一致性，可能需要與放射腫瘤醫師討論以決定正確的放射治療劑量。 如果放射治療摘要只有記載一個治療範圍及劑量，此治療範圍應登錄於本項目CTV_H；而CTV_L應記錄00000。 如果放射治療摘要中有三個或三個以上的放射劑量，只需記錄最高的兩個劑量之相關資料。若標靶類別TNM皆同時包含時，需記錄最高和最廣的兩個劑量之相關資料。此時最廣的劑量應摘錄標靶類別M。 如果放射治療計畫是二維點計算的方式，則登錄在軸心上有代表性深度的點劑量。 如果放射治療計畫是三維體積計算的方式，CTV_L的放射劑量通常是整個CTV_L所接受到的最低劑量，或者是95%CTV_L體積所接受到的劑量。本項目CTV_L的放射劑量不是整個CTV_L所接受到最高劑量，也不是其平均劑量。 其他相關之編碼指引，請參照「最高放射劑量之臨床標靶體積的放射線劑量」。範例：編碼：案例及原因

fields.purpose_en: Evaluates the effect of radiation therapy and reviews causes of failure (whether failure within the radiation field is due to insufficient radiation dose or limited by radiation tolerance of surrounding normal tissue).
fields.guide_en:
If the reporting hospital commissioned another hospital to perform part of the radiation therapy, this should be regarded as part of the reporting hospital's first course of treatment, and the radiation therapy data of the other hospital must be consolidated and reported completely. The radiation therapy dose is usually recorded in the radiation therapy summary. If the local radiation therapy dose and the boost radiation therapy dose are recorded separately, the radiation therapy dose of CTV_L is usually the local radiation therapy dose. To achieve consistency in abstracting and coding, it may be necessary to discuss with the radiation oncologist to determine the correct radiation therapy dose. If the radiation therapy summary records only one treatment volume and dose, that treatment volume should be recorded in CTV_H of this item, and CTV_L should be recorded as 00000. If the radiation therapy summary has three or more radiation doses, only the data of the two highest doses need be recorded. If the target categories T, N and M are all included, record the data of the highest dose and the widest-volume dose; in that case the target category for the widest dose should be abstracted as M. If the radiation therapy plan is calculated as a two-dimensional point dose, record the point dose at a representative depth on the central axis. If the radiation therapy plan is calculated as a three-dimensional volume, the radiation dose of CTV_L is usually the lowest dose received by the whole CTV_L, or the dose received by 95% of the CTV_L volume. The CTV_L radiation dose in this item is neither the highest dose received by the whole CTV_L nor its mean dose. For other related coding guidelines, refer to "Radiation dose of the clinical target volume with the highest radiation dose". Examples: Code: Cases and reasons
05950: A case of cT3N2M0 nasopharyngeal non-keratinizing carcinoma received definitive 9-field intensity-modulated radiation therapy (IMRT) with simultaneous in-field boost from 2006/04/01 to 2006/05/18, using 6MV x-rays: a total dose of 70Gy in 35 fractions to the gross tumor volume of the primary tumor and the right level 2 nodal disease (the highest-dose clinical target volume); a total dose of 59.5Gy in 35 fractions to the clinical target volume of the primary tumor in the nasopharynx and oropharynx and the clinical target volume of the bilateral level 2 and bilateral level 3 lymph nodes (the lower-dose clinical target volume); and a total dose of 50Gy in 25 fractions to the clinical target volume of the bilateral level 4 and supraclavicular fossa lymph nodes. In addition, 2 courses of Cisplatin 100mg/m2 were given concurrently.
00000: A case of invasive ductal carcinoma of the left breast; after left modified radical mastectomy, pathology showed pT3N1M0G2, ER+, PR+, Her2-. After completing 6 cycles of adjuvant FAC chemotherapy, post-operative three-dimensional conformal radiation therapy (3D-CRT) with a total dose of 50.4Gy in 28 fractions was given, using 6MV opposing tangential fields for the chest wall and a single anterior field for the supraclavicular fossa.
03960: A case of bulky stage IIB cervical squamous cell carcinoma received whole-pelvis 2D Box radiation therapy with a total dose of 50.4Gy in 28 fractions from 2006/04/01 to 2006/05/11, with the central region shielded after a total dose of 39.6Gy (with central block after 39.6Gy). This was followed by high-dose-rate intracavitary iridium-192 brachytherapy to Point A, 6 fractions of 500cGy each (500cGy x3 on 2006/06/01 and 2006/06/02, and again 500cGy x3 on 2006/06/15 and 2006/06/16). Two courses of Cisplatin 100mg/m2 were given concurrently during the external beam radiation therapy.
04500: A case of T2N0M0 prostate cancer with Gleason score 5+5, PSA 20 received 7-field intensity-modulated radiation therapy (IMRT) from 2006/04/01 to 2006/06/03, using 10MV x-rays: a total dose of 81Gy in 45 fractions to the prostate, a total dose of 72Gy in 40 fractions to the prostate and seminal vesicles, and a total dose of 45Gy in 25 fractions to the whole pelvis.
03500: A case of left lower lobe cT3N2M1G3 squamous cell carcinoma with brain metastasis and left lower lobe obstructive pneumonia received radiation therapy from 2006/04/01 to 2006/04/24: the whole brain received a total dose of 35Gy in 14 fractions via 2D opposing lateral fields, and the mediastinum and primary tumor received three-dimensional conformal radiation therapy with a total dose of 40Gy in 16 fractions. The brain metastasis was further treated with CyberKnife radiosurgery, 4 fractions of 5Gy, from 2006/05/01 to 2006/05/04.

fields.name_zh: 較低放射劑量臨床標靶體積治療次數
fields.name_zh_en: Lower radiation dose clinical target volume treatment frequency.
fields.description_zh:
記錄在申報醫院的首次療程中，CTV_L 的放射治療次數(fractions or sessions)。
欄位位置：247–248
fields.description_en:
Record the number of radiation therapy treatments (fractions or sessions) for CTV_L in the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital.
Field position: 247–248
fields.purpose_zh: 評估放射治療效果，也可用來計算 CTV_L 的平均放射分次劑量，只要將「較低放射劑量之臨床標靶體積的放射線劑量」除以「較低放射劑量之臨床標靶體積的放射治療次數」即可得知。
fields.guide_zh:
 申報醫院若有委託他院執行部分放射治療，應視為申報醫院首次療程的一部份，須整併他院放射治療資料完整申報。 放射治療次數通常是記錄在放射治療摘要。為達到摘錄編碼的一致性，可能需要與放射腫瘤醫師討論以決定確切的放射治療次數。 雖然放射治療可能有數個放射治療照野(fields or ports)，並分別依序照射到治療部位；但大多在三十分鐘內完成，因此只能合算成一個分次。 CTV_L的放射治療次數是一個療程內各個放射治療階段對CTV_L總劑量有貢獻的照射次數之總和。 CTV_L的放射治療次數不含其他特殊放射線技術的照射次數。範例：編碼：案例及原因
35：cT3N2M0 鼻咽非角質化細胞癌個案，於 2006/04/01 至 2006/05/18 接受完全性 9 個照野(definitive 9-field)的強度調控放射療法(IMRT)和同步照野內加強法(simutaneous in-field boost)，使用 6MV x-rays 對原發腫瘤和右側 level 2淋巴結病變的顯著腫瘤體積給予 35 次總劑量 70Gy(即最高放射劑量臨床標靶體積)，對於位於鼻咽和口咽的原發腫瘤的臨床標靶體積和位於雙側 level 2 和雙側 level 3 淋巴結的臨床標靶體積給予35次總劑量59.5Gy(即較低放射劑量臨床標靶體積)，對雙側level 4 和鎖骨上窩的淋巴結臨床標靶體積給予 25 次總劑量 50Gy。另外，並同步給予 2個療程的Cisplatin 100mg/m2。
00：左側乳房管道侵襲癌個案，經左側改良式根除乳房切除術後病理發現為pT3N1M0G2、ER+、PR+、Her2-，於完成 6個FAC 輔助化療後，再進行 28 次總劑量 50.4Gy 的術後三維順形放射治療(3D-CRT)，其中胸壁使用 6MV 對側切割照野(opposing tangential field)，鎖骨上窩使用單一前側照野(single anterior field)。
22：bulky stage IIB 的子宮頸鱗狀細胞癌個案，於 2006/04/01 至2006/05/11 接受 28次總劑量 50.4Gy 的全骨盆 2D Box 放射治療，並於總劑量達到 39.6Gy 時停止中央區照射(with central block after 39.6Gy)。接著再給予 Point A 6 次各500cGy的腔內高劑量率銥-192近距放射治療(2006/06/01 及2006/06/02 給予 500cGy x3，再於 2006/06/15及2006/06/16 給予500cGy x3)。同時於體外放射治療期間給予兩個療程的 Cisplatin 100mg/m2。
25：Gleason score 5+5,PSA 20 的 T2N0M0 攝護腺癌個案，於 2006/04/01 至 2006/06/03接受7-field 強度調控放射療法(IMRT)，使用10MV x-rays 對攝護腺給予 45 次總劑量81Gy，對攝護腺和儲精囊給予 40次總劑量72Gy，以及對全骨盆給予 25 次總劑量45Gy。
14：左下肺葉cT3N2M1G3 鱗狀細胞癌個案合併腦轉移個案及左下肺葉阻塞性肺炎，於2006/04/01 到2006/04/24 接受放射治療，其中全腦經由 2D兩邊對側照野給予 14次總劑量 35Gy，縱隔膜和原發腫瘤接受 16 次總劑量 40Gy 的三維順形放射療法。腦轉移病灶再於 2006/05/01 至2006/05/04 接受4次5Gy 電腦刀放射手術。
00：T1N0M0 攝護腺癌個案只接受攝護腺低劑量率碘-125空腔內近距放射治療 140Gy。
fields.purpose_en: Used to evaluate the effect of radiation therapy; can also be used to calculate the average dose per fraction for CTV_L, by dividing the "radiation dose to the lower-dose clinical target volume" by the "number of radiation therapy fractions to the lower-dose clinical target volume".
fields.guide_en:
• If the reporting hospital has commissioned another facility to deliver part of the radiotherapy, it should be regarded as part of the reporting hospital's first course of treatment, and the radiotherapy data from the other facility must be consolidated and reported in full. • The number of radiotherapy treatments is usually recorded in the radiotherapy summary. To ensure consistency of abstracting and coding, it may be necessary to discuss with the radiation oncologist to determine the exact number of radiotherapy treatments. • Although radiotherapy may involve several radiation fields (fields or ports), irradiating the treatment site in sequence, most are completed within thirty minutes, so they can only be counted together as one fraction. • The number of radiotherapy treatments for CTV_L is the sum of the fractions, across all phases of radiotherapy within one course, that contributed to the total dose of CTV_L. • The number of radiotherapy treatments for CTV_L does not include fractions delivered by other special radiation techniques. Examples: Code: Case and reason
35: A patient with cT3N2M0 non-keratinizing carcinoma of the nasopharynx received, from 2006/04/01 to 2006/05/18, definitive 9-field intensity-modulated radiotherapy (IMRT) with simultaneous in-field boost (simutaneous in-field boost), using 6MV x-rays: 35 fractions to a total dose of 70Gy to the gross tumor volume of the primary tumor and right level 2 lymph node disease (i.e. the highest-dose clinical target volume); 35 fractions to a total dose of 59.5Gy to the clinical target volume of the primary tumor in the nasopharynx and oropharynx and to the clinical target volumes of the bilateral level 2 and bilateral level 3 lymph nodes (i.e. the lower-dose clinical target volume); and 25 fractions to a total dose of 50Gy to the clinical target volumes of the bilateral level 4 and supraclavicular fossa lymph nodes. In addition, 2 courses of Cisplatin 100mg/m2 were given concurrently.
00: A patient with invasive ductal carcinoma of the left breast; after left modified radical mastectomy, pathology showed pT3N1M0G2, ER+, PR+, Her2-; after completing 6 cycles of adjuvant FAC chemotherapy, the patient received postoperative three-dimensional conformal radiotherapy (3D-CRT), 28 fractions to a total dose of 50.4Gy, with 6MV opposing tangential fields to the chest wall and a single anterior field to the supraclavicular fossa.
22: A patient with bulky stage IIB squamous cell carcinoma of the cervix received, from 2006/04/01 to 2006/05/11, whole-pelvis 2D Box radiotherapy, 28 fractions to a total dose of 50.4Gy, with central block after 39.6Gy. This was followed by intracavitary high-dose-rate iridium-192 brachytherapy to Point A, 6 fractions of 500cGy each (500cGy x3 on 2006/06/01 and 2006/06/02, and 500cGy x3 on 2006/06/15 and 2006/06/16). Two courses of Cisplatin 100mg/m2 were given during the external beam radiotherapy.
25: A patient with T2N0M0 prostate cancer, Gleason score 5+5, PSA 20, received 7-field intensity-modulated radiotherapy (IMRT) from 2006/04/01 to 2006/06/03, using 10MV x-rays: 45 fractions to a total dose of 81Gy to the prostate, 40 fractions to a total dose of 72Gy to the prostate and seminal vesicles, and 25 fractions to a total dose of 45Gy to the whole pelvis.
14: A patient with cT3N2M1G3 squamous cell carcinoma of the left lower lobe with brain metastasis and obstructive pneumonia of the left lower lobe received radiotherapy from 2006/04/01 to 2006/04/24: the whole brain received 14 fractions to a total dose of 35Gy via 2D opposed lateral fields, and the mediastinum and primary tumor received 16 fractions to a total dose of 40Gy by three-dimensional conformal radiotherapy. The brain metastasis then received CyberKnife radiosurgery, 4 fractions of 5Gy, from 2006/05/01 to 2006/05/04.
00: A patient with T1N0M0 prostate cancer received only low-dose-rate iodine-125 intracavitary brachytherapy to the prostate, 140Gy.

fields.description_zh:
記錄在申報醫院的首次療程中，進行放射治療所使用的特殊放射治療儀器或治療方式。
欄位位置：249–250
fields.description_en:
Record the special radiation therapy equipment or modality used for radiation therapy in the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital.
Field position: 249–250
fields.purpose_zh: 可作為治療結果分析之依據。
fields.guide_zh:
 申報醫院若有委託他院執行部分放射治療，應視為申報醫院首次療程的一部份，須整併他院放射治療資料完整申報。 放射治療儀器通常是記錄在放射治療摘要。而放射手術儀器及技術也可能記錄在神經外科醫師的手術摘要。 記錄於申報醫院進行之放射治療所使用的特殊放射治療儀器或治療方式，包括近距放射治療(Brachytherapy)、放射線同位素治療(Radioisotopes)、放射手術(Radiosurgery)、中子治療機(Neutron Therapy)、其他帶電荷粒子治療機(Charged Particle Therapy)，甚至硼捉中子治療(Boron neutron capture therapy，縮寫BNCT)等。 若治療儀器描述為SBRT(Stereotactic Body Radiotherapy)或SABR(Stereotactic Ablative Body Radiotherapy)，且治療技術使用諾力刀(Norvalis)、強度調控放射治療(IMRT)、體積弧形放射治療(Rapid Arc® )或粒子(質子或碳離子)時，依據治療次數(Fraction /Session)及劑量區分放射手術或體外放射治療：治療次數≦6且劑量≧800 cGy/次視為放射手術；治療次數>6次或劑量＜800 cGy/次，則登錄為體外放射線治療。 傳統體外放射治療、斷層放射療法，及電子射線(Novac7®, Mobetron®)手術中放射治療(Intra-operative radiotherapy，縮寫IORT)的相關資料應登錄在「體外放射治療」的次分節中。 IORT也可以是以Brachytherapy的形式進行，例如INTRABEAM® 或Xoft® 用於乳癌IORT(Intraoperative radiotherapy)。 這些特殊放射療法通常是互相排斥的，也就是在同一個療程中個案很少會接受到兩種或兩種以上的特殊放射療法。因此本項目是單一不可相加合併編碼。但為了方便運算及記憶，本項目的編碼與「放射治療技術」所使用的編碼相同。 但在一個非常罕見極端的病例，是可能接受到兩種特殊放射療法的。例如一位子宮頸癌的個案在發病時就有單一腦轉移，接受了全骨盆體外放射治療和空腔內近距放射治療來治療原發部位，並且接受加馬刀放射手術來治療單一腦轉移。 在這種接受了接受到兩種或兩種以上特殊放射療法的罕見病例時，癌症登記人員應將所有的放射治療模式都登錄在「放射治療技術」中。在編碼本項目「其他放射治療技術」時，癌症登記人員使用下列原則登錄一種特殊放射療法： 如果某一特殊放射療法是該癌症的必要療法，例如放射線同位素碘131是甲狀腺癌最重要的治療，則優先登錄該特殊放射療法。 如果某一個案接受體外放射治療及兩種特殊放射療法，癌症登記人員應選擇登錄有涵蓋不同於體外放射治療部位類別的特殊放射療法。 如果某一個案接受兩種特殊放射療法但未接受體外放射治療，癌症登記人員應選擇登錄代碼高的特殊放射療法。 若首次療程中同時有一般傳統放射治療(光子或電子)，與粒子(質子或碳離子)治療時，一般傳統光子或電子放射治療需摘錄於「放射治療儀器」及「體外放射治療技術」等相關欄位；粒子(質子或碳離子)治療則需摘錄於「其他放射治療儀器」及「其他放射治療技術」等相關欄位。 若首次療程僅接受粒子治療且同時有質子與碳離子，但無一般傳統光子或電子放射治療時，質子治療需摘錄於「放射治療儀器」及「體外放射治療技術」等相關欄位；而碳離子治療登錄需摘錄於「其他放射治療儀器」及「其他放射治療技術」等相關欄位。 若首次治療為單一種粒子治療(質子或碳離子)，但無一般傳統光子或電子放射治療時，此粒子治療需摘錄於「放射治療儀器」及「體外放射治療技術」等相關欄位。 首次療程若有使用到多重放射治療儀器，請參考 4.2.1.2「放射治療儀器」的臨床情境組合表格，摘錄相關放射治療數據至適當欄位。範例：編碼：案例及原因
