fields.purpose_en: Can serve as a basis for analyzing treatment outcomes.
fields.guide_en:
If the reporting hospital commissioned another hospital to perform part of the radiation therapy, this should be regarded as part of the reporting hospital's first course of treatment, and the radiation therapy data of the other hospital must be consolidated and reported completely. The radiation therapy equipment is usually recorded in the radiation therapy summary. Radiosurgery equipment and techniques may also be recorded in the neurosurgeon's operative summary. Record the special radiation therapy equipment or treatment modality used in radiation therapy performed at the reporting hospital, including brachytherapy, radioisotopes, radiosurgery, neutron therapy, other charged particle therapy, and even boron neutron capture therapy (abbreviated BNCT). If the treatment equipment is described as SBRT (Stereotactic Body Radiotherapy) or SABR (Stereotactic Ablative Body Radiotherapy), and the treatment technique uses Novalis, intensity-modulated radiation therapy (IMRT), volumetric arc therapy (RapidArc®) or particles (protons or carbon ions), distinguish radiosurgery from external beam radiation therapy by the number of fractions (Fraction/Session) and the dose: a number of fractions ≦6 with a dose ≧800 cGy per fraction is regarded as radiosurgery; a number of fractions >6 or a dose <800 cGy per fraction is recorded as external beam radiation therapy. Data on conventional external beam radiation therapy, tomotherapy, and intra-operative radiotherapy (abbreviated IORT) with electron beams (Novac7®, Mobetron®) should be recorded in the subsection "External beam radiation therapy". IORT may also be given in the form of brachytherapy, for example INTRABEAM® or Xoft® used for breast cancer IORT (Intraoperative radiotherapy). These special radiation therapies are usually mutually exclusive; that is, a case rarely receives two or more special radiation therapies during the same course of treatment. Therefore this item is a single code that cannot be summed. However, for ease of calculation and memorization, the codes of this item are the same as those used in "Radiation therapy technique". In a very rare, extreme case, two special radiation therapies are possible. For example, a cervical cancer case with a single brain metastasis at onset received whole pelvic external beam radiation therapy and intracavitary brachytherapy for the primary site, and Gamma Knife radiosurgery for the single brain metastasis. In such rare cases in which two or more special radiation therapies were received, the cancer registrar should record all radiation therapy modalities in "Radiation therapy technique". When coding this item, "Other radiation therapy technique", the cancer registrar records one special radiation therapy using the following principles: If a particular special radiation therapy is essential for that cancer, for example radioisotope iodine-131, the most important treatment for thyroid cancer, record that special radiation therapy first. If a case received external beam radiation therapy and two special radiation therapies, the cancer registrar should choose to record the special radiation therapy that covers a site category different from that of the external beam radiation therapy. If a case received two special radiation therapies but no external beam radiation therapy, the cancer registrar should choose to record the special radiation therapy with the higher code. If the first course of treatment includes both conventional radiation therapy (photons or electrons) and particle (proton or carbon ion) therapy, the conventional photon or electron radiation therapy should be abstracted in the related fields such as "Radiation therapy equipment" and "External beam radiation therapy technique"; particle (proton or carbon ion) therapy should be abstracted in the related fields such as "Other radiation therapy equipment" and "Other radiation therapy technique". If the first course of treatment includes only particle therapy, with both protons and carbon ions but no conventional photon or electron radiation therapy, proton therapy should be abstracted in the related fields such as "Radiation therapy equipment" and "External beam radiation therapy technique", and carbon ion therapy should be abstracted in the related fields such as "Other radiation therapy equipment" and "Other radiation therapy technique". If the first treatment is a single type of particle therapy (protons or carbon ions) with no conventional photon or electron radiation therapy, that particle therapy should be abstracted in the related fields such as "Radiation therapy equipment" and "External beam radiation therapy technique". If multiple radiation therapy devices were used in the first course of treatment, refer to the clinical scenario combination table in 4.2.1.2 "Radiation therapy equipment" and abstract the relevant radiation therapy data into the appropriate fields. fields.description_zh:
記錄在申報醫院的首次療程中，進行特殊放射治療所使用的技術。
欄位位置：251–252
fields.description_en:
Record the technique used for special radiation therapy in the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital.
Field position: 251–252
fields.purpose_zh: 有助於分析治療技術與治療效果的關係。
fields.guide_zh:
 申報醫院若有委託他院執行部分放射治療，應視為申報醫院首次療程的一部份，須整併他院放射治療資料完整申報。 若治療儀器描述為SBRT(Stereotactic Body Radiotherapy)或SABR(Stereotactic Ablative Body Radiotherapy)，且治療技術使用諾力刀(Norvalis)、強度調控放射治療(IMRT)、體積弧形放射治療(Rapid Arc® )或粒子(質子或碳離子)時，依據治療次數(Fraction /Session)及劑量區分放射手術或體外放射治療：治療次數≦6且劑量≧800 cGy/次視為放射手術；治療次數>6次或劑量＜800 cGy/次，則登錄為體外放射線治療。 若首次療程中同時有一般傳統放射治療(光子或電子)，與粒子(質子或碳離子)治療時，一般傳統光子或電子放射治療需摘錄於「放射治療儀器」及「體外放射治療技術」等相關欄位；粒子(質子或碳離子)治療則需摘錄於「其他放射治療儀器」及「其他放射治療技術」等相關欄位。 若首次療程僅接受粒子治療且同時有質子與碳離子，但無一般傳統光子或電子放射治療時，質子治療需摘錄於「放射治療儀器」及「體外放射治療技術」等相關欄位；而碳離子治療登錄需摘錄於「其他放射治療儀器」及「其他放射治療技術」等相關欄位，此時碳離子治療之「其他放射治療技術」應編碼為2 (Active scanning)或4 (IMPT)，再加總8 (Carbon)，應編碼為10或12。 若首次治療為單一種粒子治療(質子或碳離子)，但無一般傳統光子或電子放射治療時，此粒子治療需摘錄於「放射治療儀器」及「體外放射治療技術」等相關欄位。 手術中放射治療(IORT)請登錄在「手術與放射治療順序」項目中。 空腔內近接放射治療包含「自然解剖空腔(lumen) 」與 「人造空腔」，其放射源不直接接觸組織，放射劑量的分布主要在空腔壁內面及其下5mm的組織。「自然的解剖空腔」，例如：子宮頸、陰道內、鼻咽、食道、氣管、直腸等。「人造空腔」則是由外科產生的手術空腔，例如：乳癌IORT，大部分是由外科產生手術空腔後，才執行低能量淺層x-rays (Xoft®或 Intrabeam ® 機器)照射。 乳癌的手術後快速短療程部分乳房放射治療 (accerlarated partial breast irradiation, APBI)，除了可以使用體外放射治療外，也可以使用Ir-192的高劑量率組織插種，此時植入的放射線同位素是直接接觸到組織，緊鄰放射線同位素的組織劑量非常的高。 各種特殊放射線療法有其特異專用的編碼，分別敘述如下：通用編碼放射手術專用編碼近距放射治療專用編碼放射線同位素治療專用編碼質子或其他帶電荷粒子治療專用編碼硼捉中子治療專用編碼範例：編碼：案例及原因
0：cT3N2M0 鼻咽非角質化細胞癌個案，於 2006/04/01 至 2006/05/18 接受完全性 9 個照野(definitive 9-field)的強度調控放射療法(IMRT)和同步照野內加強法(simultaneous in-field boost)，使用 6MV x-rays 對原發腫瘤和右側 level 2 淋巴結病變的顯著腫瘤體積給予35次總劑量 70Gy(即最高放射劑量臨床標靶體積)，對於位於鼻咽和口咽的原發腫瘤的臨床標靶體積和位於雙側 level 2 和雙側 level 3淋巴結的臨床標靶體積給予 35次總劑量 59.5Gy(即較低放射劑量臨床標靶體積)，對雙側 level 4 和鎖骨上窩的淋巴結臨床標靶體積給予 25 次總劑量 50Gy。另外，並同步給予 2 個療程的 Cisplatin 100mg/m2。

2：bulky stage IIB 的子宮頸鱗狀細胞癌個案，於 2006/04/01 至 2006/05/11 接受 28 次總劑量50.4Gy的全骨盆 2D Box 放射治療，並於總劑量達到 39.6Gy時停止中央區照射(with central block after 39.6Gy)。接著再給予 Point A 6 次各 500cGy 的腔內高劑量率銥-192 近距放射治療(2006/06/01 及 2006/06/02 給予 500cGy x3，再於 2006/06/15 及2006/06/16 給予 500cGy x3)。同時於體外放射治療期間給予兩個療程的 Cisplatin 100mg/m2。
0：Gleason score 5+5，PSA 20 的T2N0M0 攝護腺癌個案，於 2006/04/01至2006/06/03 接受 7-field 強度調控放射療法(IMRT)，使用 10MV x-rays 對攝護腺給予 45 次總劑量81Gy，對攝護腺和儲精囊給予 40 次總劑量 72Gy，以及對全骨盆給予 25 次總劑量45Gy。
3：左下肺葉 cT3N2M1G3 鱗狀細胞癌個案合併腦轉移個案及左下肺葉阻塞性肺炎，於2006/04/01 到 2006/04/24 接受放射治療，其中全腦經由 2D 兩邊對側照野給予 14 次總劑量35Gy，縱隔膜和原發腫瘤接受 16次總劑量40Gy 的三維順形放射療法。腦轉移病灶再於2006/05/01 至2006/05/04 接受4次5Gy電腦刀放射手術。
3：T1N0M0 攝護腺癌個案只接受攝護腺低劑量率碘-125組織插種近距放射治療 140Gy。
1：甲狀腺濾泡癌已發生肺轉移個案，接受 3 期(sessions)碘-131 放射同位素治療，每期100 mCi。
1：肺癌個案於 2015/10/27 至 2015/12/24 執行光子放射治療；於原發部位及區域淋巴結使用 3D Conformal RT 治療 2000cGy/10 次，並以 RapidArc with IG 追加治療原發腫瘤1000cGy/5 次；另於2015/11/19 至2015/12/17 再接受質子治療，於原發部位及區域淋巴結使用2-Ports Ridge Filter治療 4000 cGy/20 次。
fields.purpose_en: Helps analyze the relationship between treatment technique and treatment effect.
fields.guide_en:
• If the reporting hospital commissions another facility to perform part of the radiotherapy, it should be regarded as part of the reporting hospital's first course of treatment, and the radiotherapy data of the other facility must be integrated and reported completely. • If the treatment machine is described as SBRT (Stereotactic Body Radiotherapy) or SABR (Stereotactic Ablative Body Radiotherapy), and the technique uses Novalis (Norvalis), intensity-modulated radiotherapy (IMRT), volumetric arc therapy (Rapid Arc® ) or particles (proton or carbon ion), radiosurgery and external beam radiotherapy are distinguished by number of fractions (Fraction /Session) and dose: number of fractions ≦6 and dose ≧800 cGy per fraction is regarded as radiosurgery; number of fractions >6 or dose <800 cGy per fraction is recorded as external beam radiotherapy. • If the first course of treatment includes both conventional radiotherapy (photon or electron) and particle (proton or carbon ion) therapy, the conventional photon or electron radiotherapy should be abstracted in the relevant fields such as “Radiotherapy machine” and “External beam radiotherapy technique”; the particle (proton or carbon ion) therapy should be abstracted in the relevant fields such as “Other radiotherapy machine” and “Other radiotherapy technique”. • If the first course of treatment includes only particle therapy, with both proton and carbon ion but no conventional photon or electron radiotherapy, proton therapy should be abstracted in the relevant fields such as “Radiotherapy machine” and “External beam radiotherapy technique”; carbon ion therapy should be abstracted in the relevant fields such as “Other radiotherapy machine” and “Other radiotherapy technique”; in this case the “Other radiotherapy technique” of carbon ion therapy should be coded 2 (Active scanning) or 4 (IMPT), plus 8 (Carbon), i.e. coded 10 or 12. • If the first course of treatment is a single type of particle therapy (proton or carbon ion) with no conventional photon or electron radiotherapy, this particle therapy should be abstracted in the relevant fields such as “Radiotherapy machine” and “External beam radiotherapy technique”. • Intraoperative radiotherapy (IORT) should be recorded in the “Sequence of surgery and radiotherapy” item. • Intracavitary brachytherapy includes “natural anatomical cavities (lumen)” and “artificial cavities”; the radiation source does not directly touch the tissue, and the radiation dose is distributed mainly on the inner surface of the cavity wall and tissue to a depth of 5 mm below it. “Natural anatomical cavities” are, for example, the cervix, vagina, nasopharynx, esophagus, trachea and rectum. “Artificial cavities” are surgically created operative cavities, for example breast cancer IORT, in most cases irradiation with low-energy superficial x-rays (Xoft® or Intrabeam ® machines) given after the surgeon creates the operative cavity. • Accelerated partial breast irradiation (APBI) after breast cancer surgery can use not only external beam radiotherapy but also Ir-192 high-dose-rate interstitial implants; in this case the implanted radioisotope directly touches the tissue, and the tissue immediately adjacent to the radioisotope receives a very high dose. • Each special radiotherapy modality has its own specific codes, described as follows: General codes, Radiosurgery-specific codes, Brachytherapy-specific codes, Radioisotope therapy-specific codes, Proton or other charged particle therapy-specific codes, Boron neutron capture therapy-specific codes. fields.name_zh: 其他放射治療臨床標靶體積
fields.name_zh_en: other clinical target volume for radiotherapy
fields.description_zh:
記錄在申報醫院的首次療程中，利用放射線涵蓋局部原發腫瘤(T)，區域淋巴結(N)或遠端轉移(M)來區分並記錄特殊放射治療的目標區域之範圍。
欄位位置：253–254
fields.description_en:
Record, by whether the radiation covers the local primary tumor (T), regional lymph nodes (N) or distant metastasis (M), the extent of the target region of special radiation therapy in the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital.
Field position: 253–254
fields.purpose_zh: 評估放射治療效果及檢討失敗原因。
fields.guide_zh:
 申報醫院若有委託他院執行部分放射治療，應視為申報醫院首次療程的一部份，須整併他院放射治療資料完整申報。 近距放射治療、放射手術、中子治療機、其他帶電荷粒子治療機及硼捉中子治療之標靶體積範圍通常是記錄在放射腫瘤醫師所撰寫的放射治療摘要。放射手術及硼捉中子治療之標靶體積範圍也可能記錄在神經外科醫師的手術摘要中。為達到摘錄編碼的一致性，可能需要與放射腫瘤醫師討論以決定確切的治療範圍。 放射性同位素治療(例如：甲狀腺癌的碘131放射性同位素治療或神經母細胞瘤的MIBG含碘131放射性同位素治療)通常是編碼為7，因為其原發腫瘤部位、區域淋巴結及遠端轉移部位全部都有接受到放射劑量。雖然放射性同位素治療會影響到全身各處，但仍不能編碼為16；這是因為16是保留給應用於血液幹細胞移植的前置全身體外放射治療，或應用於抑制免疫排斥、慢性淋巴性血癌或慢性淋巴癌等較罕見之全身體外放射治療。 鍶-89放射性同位素治療骨轉移，編碼為4。 請依循TNM分期的準則來定義個別癌症的放射治療範圍是否涵蓋(T)局部原發腫瘤及其侵犯程度、(N)區域淋巴結的範圍，和(M)遠端轉移。 放射治療臨床標靶體積可同時包含局部原發腫瘤、區域淋巴結或遠端轉移等三種範圍之不同組合，請加總上述與T、N、M相關之編碼而得到最後的組合碼記錄之。例如：若局部原發腫瘤和區域淋巴結均包含在放射範圍內，則編碼應為3(=1+2)，因為照射目標為T(1)及N(2)。 另外，還有三個額外可合併相加之編碼：8代表廣泛淋巴照射(包含mini-Mantle / Mantle / inverted Y / total lymphoid irradiation)，16代表全身照射，32代表全身皮膚電子射線放射治療。範例：編碼：案例及原因
0：cT3N2M0 鼻咽非角質化細胞癌個案，於 2006/04/01 至 2006/05/18 接受完全性 9 個照野(definitive 9-field)的強度調控放射療法(IMRT)和同步照野內加強法(simultaneous in-field boost)，使用 6MV x-rays 對原發腫瘤和右側 level 2淋巴結病變的顯著腫瘤體積給予 35 次總劑量 70Gy(即最高放射劑量臨床標靶體積)，對於位於鼻咽和口咽的原發腫瘤的臨床標靶體積和位於雙側 level 2 和雙側 level 3 淋巴結的臨床標靶體積給予35次總劑量59.5Gy(即較低放射劑量臨床標靶體積)，對雙側level 4 和鎖骨上窩的淋巴結臨床標靶體積給予 25 次總劑量 50Gy。另外，並同步給予 2個療程的 Cisplatin 100mg/m2。
0：左側乳房管道侵襲癌個案，經左側改良式根除乳房切除術後病理發現為pT3N1M0G2、ER+、PR+、Her2-，於完成 6 個FAC 輔助化療後，再進行 28 次總劑量 50.4Gy 的術後三維順形放射治療(3D-CRT)，其中胸壁使用 6MV 對側切割照野(opposing tangential field)，鎖骨上窩使用單一前側照野(single anterior field)。
1：bulky stage IIB 的子宮頸鱗狀細胞癌個案，於 2006/04/01 至2006/05/11 接受 28次總劑量 50.4Gy 的全骨盆 2D Box 放射治療，並於總劑量達到 39.6Gy 時停止中央區照射(with central block after 39.6Gy)。接著再給予 Point A 6 次各500cGy的腔內高劑量率銥-192近距放射治療(2006/06/01 及2006/06/02 給予 500cGy x3，再於2006/06/15及2006/06/16 給予500cGy x3)。同時於體外放射治療期間給予兩個療程的 Cisplatin 100mg/m2。

4：左下肺葉 cT3N2M1G3 鱗狀細胞癌個案合併腦轉移個案及左下肺葉阻塞性肺炎，於2006/04/01 到2006/04/24 接受放射治療，其中全腦經由 2D兩邊對側照野給予 14次總劑量 35Gy，縱隔膜和原發腫瘤接受 16 次總劑量 40Gy 的三維順形放射療法。腦轉移病灶再於 2006/05/01 至2006/05/04 接受4次5Gy 電腦刀放射手術。

fields.guide_en:
If the reporting hospital commissioned another facility to perform part of the radiotherapy, it should be regarded as part of the reporting hospital's first course of treatment, and the other facility's radiotherapy data must be merged and reported completely. The target volume extent of brachytherapy, radiosurgery, neutron therapy machines, other charged-particle therapy machines and boron neutron capture therapy is usually recorded in the radiotherapy summary written by the radiation oncologist. The target volume extent of radiosurgery and boron neutron capture therapy may also be recorded in the surgical summary of the neurosurgeon. To achieve consistency in abstracting and coding, it may be necessary to discuss with the radiation oncologist to determine the exact treatment extent. Radioisotope therapy (for example, iodine-131 radioisotope therapy for thyroid cancer or MIBG iodine-131 radioisotope therapy for neuroblastoma) is usually coded 7, because the primary tumor site, regional lymph nodes and distant metastatic sites all receive radiation dose. Although radioisotope therapy affects the whole body, it still must not be coded 16; this is because 16 is reserved for total body external beam irradiation used as conditioning before hematopoietic stem cell transplantation, or for rarer uses such as suppressing immune rejection, chronic lymphocytic leukemia or chronic lymphoma. Strontium-89 radioisotope therapy for bone metastases is coded 4. Follow the TNM staging criteria to define whether the radiotherapy extent for an individual cancer covers (T) the local primary tumor and its extent of invasion, (N) the regional lymph node extent, and (M) distant metastasis. The clinical target volume of radiotherapy may include different combinations of the three extents: local primary tumor, regional lymph nodes or distant metastasis; add the codes related to T, N and M above to obtain the final combined code to record. For example, if both the local primary tumor and regional lymph nodes are included in the radiation field, the code should be 3 (=1+2), because the irradiation targets are T (1) and N (2). In addition, there are three extra codes that can be added in combination: 8 represents extensive lymphatic irradiation (including mini-Mantle / Mantle / inverted Y / total lymphoid irradiation), 16 represents total body irradiation, and 32 represents total skin electron beam radiotherapy. Examples: Code: Case and reason
0: A cT3N2M0 nasopharyngeal non-keratinizing carcinoma case received, from 2006/04/01 to 2006/05/18, definitive 9-field intensity-modulated radiotherapy (IMRT) with simultaneous in-field boost, using 6MV x-rays, giving 35 fractions to a total dose of 70Gy to the gross tumor volume of the primary tumor and right level 2 lymph node disease (i.e. the clinical target volume of highest radiation dose), 35 fractions to a total dose of 59.5Gy to the clinical target volume of the primary tumor in the nasopharynx and oropharynx and to the clinical target volume of bilateral level 2 and bilateral level 3 lymph nodes (i.e. the clinical target volume of lower radiation dose), and 25 fractions to a total dose of 50Gy to the clinical target volume of bilateral level 4 and supraclavicular fossa lymph nodes. In addition, 2 courses of cisplatin 100mg/m2 were given concurrently.
0: A case of left breast invasive ductal carcinoma, with pathology after left modified radical mastectomy of pT3N1M0G2, ER+, PR+, Her2-, completed 6 cycles of adjuvant FAC chemotherapy and then underwent postoperative three-dimensional conformal radiotherapy (3D-CRT), 28 fractions to a total dose of 50.4Gy, using 6MV opposing tangential fields for the chest wall and a single anterior field for the supraclavicular fossa.
1: A case of bulky stage IIB squamous cell carcinoma of the cervix received, from 2006/04/01 to 2006/05/11, 28 fractions of whole-pelvis 2D box radiotherapy to a total dose of 50.4Gy, with a central block after 39.6Gy. This was followed by intracavitary high-dose-rate iridium-192 brachytherapy to Point A, 6 fractions of 500cGy each (500cGy x3 on 2006/06/01 and 2006/06/02, then 500cGy x3 on 2006/06/15 and 2006/06/16). Two courses of cisplatin 100mg/m2 were given during external beam radiotherapy.
0: A T2N0M0 prostate cancer case with Gleason score 5+5, PSA 20 received, from 2006/04/01 to 2006/06/03, 7-field intensity-modulated radiotherapy (IMRT), using 10MV x-rays, giving 45 fractions to a total dose of 81Gy to the prostate, 40 fractions to a total dose of 72Gy to the prostate and seminal vesicles, and 25 fractions to a total dose of 45Gy to the whole pelvis.
4: A case of left lower lobe cT3N2M1G3 squamous cell carcinoma with brain metastases and left lower lobe obstructive pneumonia received radiotherapy from 2006/04/01 to 2006/04/24: the whole brain received 14 fractions to a total dose of 35Gy through 2D opposing lateral fields, and the mediastinum and primary tumor received three-dimensional conformal radiotherapy, 16 fractions to a total dose of 40Gy. The brain metastases then received CyberKnife radiosurgery, 4 fractions of 5Gy, from 2006/05/01 to 2006/05/04.
1: A T1N0M0 prostate cancer case received only low-dose-rate iodine-125 intracavitary brachytherapy to the prostate, 140Gy.
7: A follicular thyroid cancer case with lung metastases received 3 sessions of iodine-131 radioisotope therapy, 100 mCi each.

fields.purpose_en: Evaluates the effect of radiation therapy and reviews causes of failure.
fields.guide_en:
If the reporting hospital commissioned another hospital to perform part of the radiation therapy, this should be regarded as part of the reporting hospital's first course of treatment, and the radiation therapy data of the other hospital must be consolidated and reported completely. The radiation therapy doses of brachytherapy, radiosurgery, neutron therapy, other charged particle therapy and boron neutron capture therapy are usually recorded in the radiation therapy summary written by the radiation oncologist. The radiation therapy doses of radiosurgery and boron neutron capture therapy may also be recorded in the neurosurgeon's operative summary. The dose of radioisotope therapy is recorded in the nuclear medicine report. To achieve consistency in abstracting and coding, it may be necessary to discuss with the radiation oncologist to determine the exact radiation therapy dose. If the special radiation therapy is brachytherapy, radiosurgery, neutron therapy, other charged particle therapy, or boron neutron capture therapy, the unit of this item is centiGray (abbreviated cGy), which is the same size as the old unit "rads". The reference point for the intracavitary brachytherapy dose in cervical cancer is point A, defined as 2 cm above the external cervical os and 2 cm lateral to it. If other radiation therapy has two or more doses, abstract the highest dose. Examples: Code: Cases and reasons
00000: A case of cT3N2M0 nasopharyngeal non-keratinizing carcinoma received definitive 9-field intensity-modulated radiation therapy (IMRT) with simultaneous in-field boost from 2006/04/01 to 2006/05/18, using 6MV x-rays: a total dose of 70Gy in 35 fractions to the gross tumor volume of the primary tumor and the right level 2 nodal disease (the highest-dose clinical target volume); a total dose of 59.5Gy in 35 fractions to the clinical target volume of the primary tumor in the nasopharynx and oropharynx and the clinical target volume of the bilateral level 2 and bilateral level 3 lymph nodes (the lower-dose clinical target volume); and a total dose of 50Gy in 25 fractions to the clinical target volume of the bilateral level 4 and supraclavicular fossa lymph nodes. In addition, 2 courses of Cisplatin 100mg/m2 were given concurrently.
00000: A case of invasive ductal carcinoma of the left breast; after left modified radical mastectomy, pathology showed pT3N1M0G2, ER+, PR+, Her2-. After completing 6 cycles of adjuvant FAC chemotherapy, post-operative three-dimensional conformal radiation therapy (3D-CRT) with a total dose of 50.4Gy in 28 fractions was given, using 6MV opposing tangential fields for the chest wall and a single anterior field for the supraclavicular fossa.
03000: A case of bulky stage IIB cervical squamous cell carcinoma received whole-pelvis 2D Box radiation therapy with a total dose of 50.4Gy in 28 fractions from 2006/04/01 to 2006/05/11, with the central region shielded when the total dose reached 39.6Gy (with central block after 39.6Gy). This was followed by high-dose-rate intracavitary iridium-192 brachytherapy to Point A, 6 fractions of 500cGy each (500cGy x3 on 2006/06/01 and 2006/06/02, and again 500cGy x3 on 2006/06/15 and 2006/06/16). Two courses of Cisplatin 100mg/m2 were given concurrently during the external beam radiation therapy.
00000: A case of T2N0M0 prostate cancer with Gleason score 5+5, PSA 20 received 7-field intensity-modulated radiation therapy (IMRT) from 2006/04/01 to 2006/06/03, using 10MV x-rays: a total dose of 81Gy in 45 fractions to the prostate, a total dose of 72Gy in 40 fractions to the prostate and seminal vesicles, and a total dose of 45Gy in 25 fractions to the whole pelvis.
02000: A case of left lower lobe cT3N2M1G3 squamous cell carcinoma with brain metastasis and left lower lobe obstructive pneumonia received radiation therapy from 2006/04/01 to 2006/04/24: the whole brain received a total dose of 35Gy in 14 fractions via 2D opposing lateral fields, and the mediastinum and primary tumor received three-dimensional conformal radiation therapy with a total dose of 40Gy in 16 fractions. The brain metastasis was further treated with CyberKnife radiosurgery, 4 fractions of 5Gy, from 2006/05/01 to 2006/05/04.
14000: A case of T1N0M0 prostate cancer received only low-dose-rate iodine-125 interstitial seed brachytherapy of the prostate, 140Gy.

fields.guide_zh:
 申報醫院若有委託他院執行部分放射治療，應視為申報醫院首次療程的一部份，須整併他院放射治療資料完整申報。 近距放射治療、放射手術、中子治療機、其他帶電荷粒子治療機及硼捉中子治療的治療次數通常是記錄在放射治療摘要。放射手術及硼捉中子治療的治療次數也可能記錄在神經外科醫師的手術摘要中。為達到摘錄編碼的一致性，可能需要與放射腫瘤醫師討論以決定確切的放射治療次數。 雖然特殊放射治療可能有數個放射治療照野(fields or ports)或數個中興點，並分別依序照射到治療部位；但大多在三小時內完成，因此只能合算成一個分次。範例：編碼：案例及原因
00：cT3N2M0 鼻咽非角質化細胞癌個案，於 2006/04/01 至 2006/05/18 接受完全性 9 個照野(definitive 9-field)的強度調控放射療法(IMRT)和同步照野內加強法(simultaneous in-field boost)，使用 6MV x-rays 對原發腫瘤和右側 level 2淋巴結病變的顯著腫瘤體積給予 35 次總劑量 70Gy(即最高放射劑量臨床標靶體積)，對於位於鼻咽和口咽的原發腫瘤的臨床標靶體積和位於雙側 level 2 和雙側 level 3 淋巴結的臨床標靶體積給予35次總劑量59.5Gy(即較低放射劑量臨床標靶體積)，對雙側level編碼：案例及原因4 和鎖骨上窩的淋巴結臨床標靶體積給予 25 次總劑量 50Gy。另外，並同步給予 2個療程的Cisplatin 100mg/m2。
00：左側乳房管道侵襲癌個案，經左側改良式根除乳房切除術後病理發現為pT3N1M0G2、ER+、PR+、Her2-，於完成 6個FAC 輔助化療後，再進行 28 次總劑量 50.4Gy 的術後三維順形放射治療(3D-CRT)，其中胸壁使用 6MV 對側切割照野(opposing tangential field)，鎖骨上窩使用單一前側照野(single anterior field)。
06：bulky stage IIB 的子宮頸鱗狀細胞癌個案，於 2006/04/01 至2006/05/11 接受 28次總劑量 50.4Gy 的全骨盆 2D Box 放射治療，並於總劑量達到 39.6Gy 時停止中央區照射(with central block after 39.6Gy)。接著再給予 Point A 6 次各500cGy的腔內高劑量率銥-192近距放射治療(2006/06/01 及2006/06/02 給予 500cGy x3，再於 2006/06/15及2006/06/16 給予500cGy x3)。同時於體外放射治療期間給予兩個療程的Cisplatin 100mg/m2。
00：Gleason score 5+5,PSA 20 的 T2N0M0 攝護腺癌個案，於 2006/04/01 至 2006/06/03接受7-field 強度調控放射療法(IMRT)，使用10MV x-rays 對攝護腺給予 45 次總劑量81Gy，對攝護腺和儲精囊給予 40次總劑量72Gy，以及對全骨盆給予 25 次總劑量45Gy。
04：左下肺葉cT3N2M1G3 鱗狀細胞癌個案合併腦轉移個案及左下肺葉阻塞性肺炎，於2006/04/01 到2006/04/24 接受放射治療，其中全腦經由 2D兩邊對側照野給予 14次總劑量 35Gy，縱隔膜和原發腫瘤接受 16 次總劑量 40Gy 的三維順形放射療法。腦轉移病灶再於 2006/05/01 至2006/05/04 接受4次5Gy 電腦刀放射手術。
01：T1N0M0 攝護腺癌個案只接受攝護腺低劑量率碘-125 組織插種近距放射治療140Gy。
03：甲狀腺濾泡癌已發生肺轉移個案，接受 3期(sessions)碘-131放射同位素治療，每期100 mCi。
fields.purpose_en: Used to evaluate the effect of radiation therapy; can also be used to calculate the average dose per fraction of other special radiation therapy, by dividing the "radiation dose of other radiation therapy" by the "number of radiation therapy fractions of other radiation therapy".
fields.guide_en:
• If the reporting hospital has commissioned another facility to deliver part of the radiotherapy, it should be regarded as part of the reporting hospital's first course of treatment, and the radiotherapy data from the other facility must be consolidated and reported in full. • The number of treatments for brachytherapy, radiosurgery, neutron therapy machines, other charged-particle therapy machines and boron neutron capture therapy is usually recorded in the radiotherapy summary. The number of treatments for radiosurgery and boron neutron capture therapy may also be recorded in the neurosurgeon's operative summary. To ensure consistency of abstracting and coding, it may be necessary to discuss with the radiation oncologist to determine the exact number of radiotherapy treatments. • Although special radiotherapy may involve several radiation fields (fields or ports) or several isocenters, irradiating the treatment site in sequence, most are completed within three hours, so they can only be counted together as one fraction. Examples: Code: Case and reason
00: A patient with cT3N2M0 non-keratinizing carcinoma of the nasopharynx received, from 2006/04/01 to 2006/05/18, definitive 9-field intensity-modulated radiotherapy (IMRT) with simultaneous in-field boost, using 6MV x-rays: 35 fractions to a total dose of 70Gy to the gross tumor volume of the primary tumor and right level 2 lymph node disease (i.e. the highest-dose clinical target volume); 35 fractions to a total dose of 59.5Gy to the clinical target volume of the primary tumor in the nasopharynx and oropharynx and to the clinical target volumes of the bilateral level 2 and bilateral level 3 lymph nodes (i.e. the lower-dose clinical target volume); and 25 fractions to a total dose of 50Gy to the clinical target volumes of the bilateral level Code: Case and reason4 and supraclavicular fossa lymph nodes. In addition, 2 courses of Cisplatin 100mg/m2 were given concurrently.
00: A patient with invasive ductal carcinoma of the left breast; after left modified radical mastectomy, pathology showed pT3N1M0G2, ER+, PR+, Her2-; after completing 6 cycles of adjuvant FAC chemotherapy, the patient received postoperative three-dimensional conformal radiotherapy (3D-CRT), 28 fractions to a total dose of 50.4Gy, with 6MV opposing tangential fields to the chest wall and a single anterior field to the supraclavicular fossa.
06: A patient with bulky stage IIB squamous cell carcinoma of the cervix received, from 2006/04/01 to 2006/05/11, whole-pelvis 2D Box radiotherapy, 28 fractions to a total dose of 50.4Gy, with central block after 39.6Gy. This was followed by intracavitary high-dose-rate iridium-192 brachytherapy to Point A, 6 fractions of 500cGy each (500cGy x3 on 2006/06/01 and 2006/06/02, and 500cGy x3 on 2006/06/15 and 2006/06/16). Two courses of Cisplatin 100mg/m2 were given during the external beam radiotherapy.
00: A patient with T2N0M0 prostate cancer, Gleason score 5+5, PSA 20, received 7-field intensity-modulated radiotherapy (IMRT) from 2006/04/01 to 2006/06/03, using 10MV x-rays: 45 fractions to a total dose of 81Gy to the prostate, 40 fractions to a total dose of 72Gy to the prostate and seminal vesicles, and 25 fractions to a total dose of 45Gy to the whole pelvis.
04: A patient with cT3N2M1G3 squamous cell carcinoma of the left lower lobe with brain metastasis and obstructive pneumonia of the left lower lobe received radiotherapy from 2006/04/01 to 2006/04/24: the whole brain received 14 fractions to a total dose of 35Gy via 2D opposed lateral fields, and the mediastinum and primary tumor received 16 fractions to a total dose of 40Gy by three-dimensional conformal radiotherapy. The brain metastasis then received CyberKnife radiosurgery, 4 fractions of 5Gy, from 2006/05/01 to 2006/05/04.
01: A patient with T1N0M0 prostate cancer received only low-dose-rate iodine-125 interstitial brachytherapy to the prostate, 140Gy.
03: A patient with follicular thyroid cancer with lung metastasis received 3 sessions (sessions) of iodine-131 radioisotope therapy, 100 mCi per session.

fields.description_zh:
記錄在任何醫療機構的首次療程中，全身性治療開始日期(包含外院資料)。全身性治療包括化學治療、荷爾蒙/類固醇治療、免疫治療、骨髓/幹細胞移植或內分泌處置、標靶治療。
欄位位置：262–269
fields.description_en:
Record the start date of systemic therapy in the first course of treatment at any healthcare institution (including data from other hospitals). Systemic therapy includes chemotherapy, hormone/steroid therapy, immunotherapy, bone marrow/stem cell transplant or endocrine procedure, and targeted therapy.
Field position: 262–269
fields.purpose_zh: 可以歸納各種治療方法的順序，評估診斷至治療及治療後至復發的時間間隔。
fields.guide_zh:
 記錄全身性治療最早的開始日期。全身性治療包括「化學治療」、「荷爾蒙/類固醇治療」、「免疫治療」、「骨髓/幹細胞移植或內分泌處置」、「標靶治療」。 局部治療包含腰椎管注射(intrathecal)、肋膜腔/心包膜腔注射、腹腔內注射、膀胱灌注、局部免疫治療及TACE，全身性治療不包括前述局部療法，局部藥物治療開始執行的日期不應編碼在「全身性治療開始日期」欄位中。 若臨床試驗為最早執行的全身性治療，則臨床試驗開始日期應編碼於「全身性治療開始日期」。 假如治療計畫含全身性治療，但在最近一次的追蹤還尚未進行，則編碼為88888888。若此個案後續接受全身性治療，本欄位項目須加以更新。範例：編碼：案例
20031215：乳癌個案在民國 92年12月 15日開始接受化學治療，並於民國 93年 1月20日開始接受 Tamoxifen 治療。
20030602：攝護腺癌第四期的個案在民國 92 年 6 月 2 日接受睪丸切除術，並於民國 92年6月 9日開始接受荷爾蒙治療。
00000000：肝癌個案僅於民國 97年1 月5日接受局部肝動脈栓塞化學治療(TACE)。
20080105：肝癌個案僅於民國 97年1 月5日接受全身性化學治療。
20080120：肝癌個案在民國 97 年 1 月 5 日接受局部肝動脈栓塞化學治療(TACE)，並於民國 97年1月20日開始接受全身性化學治療。
20080105：肝癌個案在民國 97 年 1 月 5 日接受開始接受全身性化學治療，並於民國 97年1月 20日開始接受局部肝動脈栓塞化學治療(TACE)。
20080120：肝癌個案在民國 97 年 1 月 5 日接受局部肝動脈栓塞化學治療(TACE)，並於民國 97年1月20日開始接受 Thalidomide治療。
fields.purpose_en: Can summarize the sequence of various treatment methods and evaluate the time intervals from diagnosis to treatment and from treatment to recurrence.
fields.guide_en:
• Record the earliest start date of systemic therapy. Systemic therapy includes "chemotherapy", "hormone/steroid therapy", "immunotherapy", "bone marrow/stem cell transplant or endocrine procedure", and "targeted therapy".• Local therapy includes intrathecal injection, pleural cavity/pericardial cavity injection, intraperitoneal injection, intravesical instillation, local immunotherapy and TACE; systemic therapy does not include these local therapies, and the start date of local drug therapy must not be coded in the "Date of systemic therapy start" field.• If a clinical trial is the earliest systemic therapy performed, the start date of the clinical trial should be coded in "Date of systemic therapy start".• If the treatment plan includes systemic therapy but it had not yet been given at the most recent follow-up, code 88888888. If the patient subsequently receives systemic therapy, this field must be updated. Examples: Code: Case
20031215: A patient with breast cancer started chemotherapy on 15 December ROC year 92 (2003) and started Tamoxifen on 20 January ROC year 93 (2004).
20030602: A patient with stage IV prostate cancer underwent orchiectomy on 2 June ROC year 92 (2003) and started hormone therapy on 9 June ROC year 92 (2003).
00000000: A patient with liver cancer received only transarterial chemoembolization (TACE) on 5 January ROC year 97 (2008).
20080105: A patient with liver cancer received only systemic chemotherapy on 5 January ROC year 97 (2008).
20080120: A patient with liver cancer received transarterial chemoembolization (TACE) on 5 January ROC year 97 (2008) and started systemic chemotherapy on 20 January ROC year 97 (2008).
20080105: A patient with liver cancer started systemic chemotherapy on 5 January ROC year 97 (2008) and started transarterial chemoembolization (TACE) on 20 January ROC year 97 (2008).
20080120: A patient with liver cancer received transarterial chemoembolization (TACE) on 5 January ROC year 97 (2008) and started Thalidomide on 20 January ROC year 97 (2008).

fields.description_zh:
記錄個案在外院首次療程中，所給予化學治療相關情形。化學治療包括多種抗癌藥物，可干擾癌細胞中DNA 的合成和分裂。
欄位位置：270–271
fields.description_en:
Record the chemotherapy given to the case in the first course of treatment at another hospital. Chemotherapy includes many anticancer drugs that can interfere with DNA synthesis and division in cancer cells.
Field position: 270–271
fields.purpose_zh: 全身性治療可為單一藥物或複合處方能包括給予個案一種或是多種的治療物質。本欄位可評估外院首次療程的化學治療。
fields.guide_zh:  個案未接受化學治療，化學治療非首次療程的一部份，則編碼為00。 記錄首次療程中，所給予化學治療之相關情形，包括：全身性化學治療、局部動脈栓塞化學治療(Transarterial Chemoembolization, TACE)、其他局部性化學治療及臨床化學治療試驗。 針對轉移部位所給予之化學治療或接受臨床化學治療試驗，若屬於首次療程，也應記錄於本欄位。 編碼00-09、20-21、30-31適用於任何原發部位。 醫師提供多種的治療計畫選擇，而個案選擇不含化學治療的計畫，應編碼為00。 肝轉移個案若有接受局部動脈栓塞化學治療(TACE)，應視其治療情況編碼10-13。例如： 結腸癌個案(C18.9)在診斷時發現肝轉移，但因個案年邁不適合開刀，個案因轉移性肝癌接受局部動脈栓塞化學治療(TACE)，且針對大腸癌接受 5-FU，則此欄位應編碼 11。 編碼02-03僅適用於2017(含)診斷年之前的個案；2018診斷年起之個案，請一律編碼01。 個案若有接受臨床試驗化學治療，則視治療情況編碼20、21、30、31。注意：若個案於病歷上有描述參與臨床試驗，請確認個案是否進入試驗組；若有則視為有接受臨床試驗化學治療；若僅為對照組則不視為有接受臨床試驗化學治療。若無法得知為試驗組或對照組，則編碼30或31。 個案若接受雙盲試驗，但不清楚使用何種藥物，應編碼於其他治療欄位。 不知道化學治療是否通常使用於個案所罹患癌症的種類和期別，同時病歷也沒有記載化學治療是否有被建議或是已經執行，則編碼為99。 在治療週期所給予之化學治療，可能是單一或多種化學藥物合併處方。於治療過程中因藥物毒性、不良反應或副作用而修改處方，在未惡化的前提下，主治醫師可能會更換藥物，則此新的處方仍視為首次療程。 抗腫瘤藥物的分類可下載SEER網站上之藥物查詢工具：http://seer.cancer.gov/tools/seerrx作為編碼依據(通常分類為alkylating agents、antimetabolites、natural products or other miscellaneous)。
fields.purpose_en: Systemic therapy may be a single drug or a combination regimen and may include one or more therapeutic substances given to the case. This field can be used to evaluate chemotherapy in the first course of treatment at another hospital.
fields.guide_en: If the case did not receive chemotherapy and chemotherapy is not part of the first course of treatment, code 00. Record the chemotherapy given in the first course of treatment, including systemic chemotherapy, transarterial chemoembolization (TACE), other local chemotherapy and clinical chemotherapy trials. Chemotherapy given for metastatic sites or participation in a clinical chemotherapy trial should also be recorded in this field if it is part of the first course of treatment. Codes 00-09, 20-21 and 30-31 apply to any primary site. If the physician offered several treatment plans and the case chose a plan without chemotherapy, code 00. If a case with liver metastases received transarterial chemoembolization (TACE), code 10-13 according to the treatment. For example: a colon cancer case (C18.9) was found at diagnosis to have liver metastases, but because of advanced age was unsuitable for surgery; the case received transarterial chemoembolization (TACE) for the metastatic liver cancer and received 5-FU for the colorectal cancer, so this field should be coded 11. Codes 02-03 apply only to cases diagnosed in 2017 or earlier; for cases diagnosed from 2018, always code 01. If the case received clinical trial chemotherapy, code 20, 21, 30 or 31 according to the treatment. Note: if the medical record describes participation in a clinical trial, confirm whether the case entered the study arm; if so, it is regarded as having received clinical trial chemotherapy; if the case was only in the control arm, it is not regarded as having received clinical trial chemotherapy. If it cannot be known whether the case was in the study arm or the control arm, code 30 or 31. If the case participated in a double-blind trial but it is unclear which drug was used, code it in the other therapy field. If it is not known whether chemotherapy is usually used for the cancer type and stage of the case, and the medical record also does not state whether chemotherapy was recommended or has been performed, code 99. Chemotherapy given in a treatment cycle may be a single drug or a combination of several drugs. If the regimen is modified during treatment because of drug toxicity, adverse reactions or side effects, and the attending physician changes drugs without disease progression, the new regimen is still regarded as the first course of treatment. For the classification of antineoplastic drugs, download the drug lookup tool on the SEER website: http://seer.cancer.gov/tools/seerrx as the basis for coding (usually classified as alkylating agents, antimetabolites, natural products or other miscellaneous).

fields.description_zh:
記錄個案於申報醫院首次療程中，所給予化學治療相關情形。若個案未接受化學治療，則記錄未進行化學治療的原因。化學治療包括多種抗癌藥物，可干擾癌細胞中 DNA的合成和分裂。
欄位位置：272–273
fields.description_en:
Record the chemotherapy given to the case in the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital. If the case did not receive chemotherapy, record the reason chemotherapy was not given. Chemotherapy includes many anticancer drugs that can interfere with DNA synthesis and division in cancer cells.
Field position: 272–273
fields.purpose_zh: 全身性治療可能包括單一或複合藥物處方。本欄位可評估首次療程的化學治療，及了解個案未接受化學治療的原因。
fields.guide_zh:
 僅記載申報醫院在首次療程中所給予個案化學治療的相關情形。不包括外院在首次療程中所給予個案的化學治療。 記錄首次療程中，所給予化學治療之相關情形，包括：全身性化學治療、局部動脈栓塞化學治療(TACE)、其他局部性化學治療及臨床化學治療試驗。 針對轉移部位所給予之化學治療或接受臨床化學治療試驗，若屬於首次療程，也應記錄於本欄位。 編碼00-09、20-21、30-31、81-83、85-88適用於任何原發部位。 個案未接受化學治療，因個案所罹患的癌症種類及分期通常不需接受化學治療，則編碼為00。 醫師提供多種的治療計畫選擇，而個案選擇不含化學治療的計畫，應編碼為00。 編碼02-03僅適用於2017(含)診斷年之前的個案；2018診斷年起之個案，請一律編碼01。 肝轉移個案若有接受局部動脈栓塞化學治療(TACE)，應視其治療情況編碼10-13。例如：結腸癌個案(C18.9)在診斷時發現肝轉移，但因個案年邁不適合開刀，個案因肝轉移接受局部動脈栓塞化學治療(TACE)，且針對大腸癌接受 5-FU，則此欄位應編碼 11。 個案若有接受臨床試驗化學治療，則視治療情況編碼20、21、30、31。注意：若個案於病歷上有描述參與臨床試驗，請確認個案是否進入試驗組；若有則視為有接受臨床試驗化學治療；若僅為對照組則不視為有接受臨床試驗化學治療。若無法得知為試驗組或對照組，則編碼30或31。 個案若接受雙盲試驗，但不清楚使用何種藥物，則應編碼於其他治療欄位。 若個案所罹患的癌症與期別通常需要接受化學治療，但未接受化學治療，則編碼為81、82、83、85、86或87，以記錄未治療原因。 個案若因基因檢測結果而未執行既定的化學治療，則編碼81。 個案拒絕醫師建議的化學治療、拒絕已建議的所有治療或在醫師提治療建議前即拒絕所有治療，則編碼為87。 若化學治療為個案既定之治療計畫，但是於摘錄時或作最近一次的追蹤時個案尚未開始接受此項治療，則編碼為88，其治療日期應於下一次追蹤時予以更新。 不知道化學治療是否通常使用於個案所罹患癌症的種類和期別，同時病歷也沒有記載化學治療是否有被建議或是已經執行，則編碼為99。 在治療週期所給予之化學治療，可能是單一或多種化學藥物合併處方。於治療過程中因藥物毒性、不良反應或副作用而修改處方，在未惡化的前提下，主治醫師可能會更換藥物，則此新的處方仍視為首次療程。 抗腫瘤藥物的分類可下載SEER網站上之藥物查詢工具：http://seer.cancer.gov/tools/seerrx作為編碼依據(通常分類為alkylating agents、antimetabolites、natural products or other miscellaneous)。 若執行之化學治療是為控制症狀來延長生命、減輕疼痛或使個案感到較舒適，則同時也要記錄在「申報醫院緩和照護」欄位中。範例：編碼：案例及原因
02：個案於2017 年診斷為第三期大腸癌，接受fluorouracil 和 levamisole 的合併治療，由於fluorouracil 屬於化學治療，而 levamisole 屬於免疫治療，所以在化學治療中，僅記錄接受一種化學藥物。
01：個案於2018 年診斷為Non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma，接受fludarabine 治療。
01：個案於2018 年診斷為口腔癌第三期，後續接受Cisplatin 合併免疫治療雙盲臨床試驗Nimotuzumab or Placebo。
02：個案於2017 年診斷為腿部惡性肉瘤，接受IAIC (Intra-arterial injection chemotherapy) adriamycin治療。
01：2018年診斷之乳癌個案接受CEF治療。
04：肝癌個案接受 TACE治療。編碼：案例及原因
05：肝癌個案接受 TACE及口服或注射 Fluorouracil 治療。
05：肝癌個案接受IAIC (Intra-arterial injection chemotherapy)或HAIC合併TACE治療。
08：Glioblastoma 個案於手術中接受Gliadel(BCNU wafer)植入。
04：肝內膽管癌個案(C221，cholangiocarcinoma)接受TACE 治療。
09：急性淋巴性血癌個案接受全身性化學治療合併脊髓腔內化學治療。
11：大腸癌合併肝轉移個案接受全身性化學治療及肝臟TACE治療。
21：肺癌末期個案接受臨床化學治療試驗及治療指引中規範的化學治療。
86：卵巢癌個案術後醫師建議化學治療，但是個案沒有接受化學治療，且病歷未記載沒有接受化學治療的原因。
fields.purpose_en: Systemic therapy may include single-agent or combination drug regimens. This field can be used to evaluate chemotherapy in the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital and to understand why the case did not receive chemotherapy.
fields.guide_en:
Record only the chemotherapy given to the case by the reporting hospital during the first course of treatment. Chemotherapy given to the case by another facility during the first course of treatment is not included. Record the chemotherapy given in the first course of treatment, including: systemic chemotherapy, transarterial chemoembolization (TACE), other local chemotherapy and clinical chemotherapy trials. Chemotherapy given for metastatic sites or enrollment in a clinical chemotherapy trial should also be recorded in this field if it belongs to the first course of treatment. Codes 00-09, 20-21, 30-31, 81-83 and 85-88 apply to any primary site. If the case did not receive chemotherapy because the type and stage of the case's cancer ordinarily do not require chemotherapy, code 00. If the physician offered several treatment plans and the case chose a plan that did not include chemotherapy, code 00. Codes 02-03 apply only to cases diagnosed in 2017 or earlier; for cases diagnosed from 2018, always code 01. If a case with liver metastasis received transarterial chemoembolization (TACE), code 10-13 according to the treatment. For example: a colon cancer case (C18.9) was found to have liver metastasis at diagnosis but was not suitable for surgery because of advanced age; the case received TACE for the liver metastasis and received 5-FU for the colorectal cancer; this field should be coded 11. If the case received clinical trial chemotherapy, code 20, 21, 30 or 31 according to the treatment. Note: if the medical record describes the case's participation in a clinical trial, confirm whether the case entered the experimental arm; if so, it is regarded as receiving clinical trial chemotherapy; if the case was only in the control arm, it is not regarded as receiving clinical trial chemotherapy. If it cannot be determined whether the case was in the experimental or control arm, code 30 or 31. If the case received a double-blind trial but it is unclear which drug was used, code it in the other treatment field. If the case's cancer type and stage ordinarily require chemotherapy but chemotherapy was not given, code 81, 82, 83, 85, 86 or 87 to record the reason for no treatment. If the case did not receive the planned chemotherapy because of the result of genetic testing, code 81. If the case refused the chemotherapy recommended by the physician, refused all recommended treatment, or refused all treatment before the physician made any treatment recommendation, code 87. If chemotherapy is part of the case's planned treatment but the case had not yet started it at the time of abstracting or the latest follow-up, code 88, and update the treatment date at the next follow-up. If it is not known whether chemotherapy is ordinarily used for the case's cancer type and stage, and the medical record does not state whether chemotherapy was recommended or has been given, code 99. The chemotherapy given in a treatment cycle may be a single agent or a combination of several chemotherapy drugs. If the regimen is modified during treatment because of drug toxicity, adverse reactions or side effects, and the attending physician changes the drugs without disease progression, the new regimen is still regarded as the first course of treatment. For the classification of antineoplastic drugs, the drug lookup tool on the SEER website can be downloaded as the basis for coding: http://seer.cancer.gov/tools/seerrx (usually classified as alkylating agents, antimetabolites, natural products or other miscellaneous). If the chemotherapy given was to control symptoms, prolong life, relieve pain or make the case more comfortable, it should also be recorded in the "Palliative care at the reporting hospital" field. Examples: Code: Case and reason
02: A case diagnosed in 2017 with stage III colorectal cancer received combined fluorouracil and levamisole; because fluorouracil is chemotherapy and levamisole is immunotherapy, only one chemotherapy agent is recorded under chemotherapy.
01: A case diagnosed in 2018 with Non-Hodgkin's lymphoma received fludarabine.
01: A case diagnosed in 2018 with stage III oral cancer subsequently received Cisplatin combined with a double-blind immunotherapy clinical trial of Nimotuzumab or Placebo.
02: A case diagnosed in 2017 with malignant sarcoma of the leg received IAIC (Intra-arterial injection chemotherapy) adriamycin.
01: A breast cancer case diagnosed in 2018 received CEF.
04: A liver cancer case received TACE. Code: Case and reason
05: A liver cancer case received TACE and oral or injected Fluorouracil.
05: A liver cancer case received IAIC (Intra-arterial injection chemotherapy) or HAIC combined with TACE.
08: A glioblastoma case received Gliadel (BCNU wafer) implantation during surgery.
04: An intrahepatic bile duct cancer case (C221, cholangiocarcinoma) received TACE.
09: An acute lymphoblastic leukemia case received systemic chemotherapy combined with intrathecal chemotherapy.
11: A colorectal cancer case with liver metastasis received systemic chemotherapy and liver TACE.
21: A terminal-stage lung cancer case received a clinical chemotherapy trial and the chemotherapy specified in the treatment guideline.
86: After surgery for an ovarian cancer case, the physician recommended chemotherapy, but the case did not receive chemotherapy, and the medical record does not state the reason for not receiving chemotherapy.

fields.name_zh: 申報醫院化學治療開始日期
fields.name_en: Date of Chemotherapy Started at This Facility
fields.description_zh:
記錄個案在申報醫院化學治療開始的日期。
欄位位置：274–281
fields.description_en:
Record the start date of chemotherapy for the case at the reporting hospital.
Field position: 274–281
fields.purpose_zh: 可進行多種治療模式的排序或是評估多種治療的時間間隔。
fields.guide_zh:
 記錄個案在申報醫院化學治療開始執行的日期。 為確知申報醫院對局部化學治療的開始治療日期，不論局部化學治療是否合併全身性化學治療，申報醫院化學治療開始日期優先填寫局部化學治療開始治療的日期。例如:肝癌個案接受TACE治療，則申報醫院化學治療開始日期以TACE治療日期為優先登錄。局部治療包含脊髓腔內注射(intrathecal)、肋膜腔/心包膜腔注射、腹腔內注射、膀胱灌注及TACE，全身性治療不包括前述局部化學療法。範例：編碼：案例
20080105：肝癌個案僅於民國 97年1 月5日接受局部肝動脈栓塞化學治療(TACE)。
20080105：肝癌個案僅於民國 97年1 月5日接受全身性化學治療。
20080105：肝癌個案在民國 97 年 1 月 5 日接受局部肝動脈栓塞化學治療(TACE)，並於民國 97年1月20日開始接受全身性化學治療。編碼：案例
20080120：肝癌個案在民國 97 年 1 月 5 日接受開始接受全身性化學治療，並於民國 97年1月 20日開始接受局部肝動脈栓塞化學治療(TACE)。
20080105：肝癌個案在民國 97 年 1 月 5 日接受局部肝動脈栓塞化學治療(TACE)，並於民國 97年1月20日開始接受 Thalidomide治療。
fields.purpose_en: Allows ordering of multiple treatment modalities and evaluation of the time intervals between treatments.
fields.guide_en:
• Record the date on which chemotherapy was started for the case at the reporting hospital. • To know definitely the start date of local chemotherapy at the reporting hospital, regardless of whether local chemotherapy is combined with systemic chemotherapy, the reporting hospital's chemotherapy start date should give priority to the start date of local chemotherapy. For example: if a liver cancer patient receives TACE, the reporting hospital's chemotherapy start date is recorded with the TACE date as the priority. • Local therapy includes intrathecal (intrathecal) injection, intrapleural/intrapericardial injection, intraperitoneal injection, intravesical instillation and TACE; systemic therapy does not include the aforementioned local chemotherapy. Example: Code: Case
20080105: A liver cancer patient received only local transarterial chemoembolization (TACE) on January 5, ROC year 97 (2008).
20080105: A liver cancer patient received only systemic chemotherapy on January 5, ROC year 97 (2008).
20080105: A liver cancer patient received local transarterial chemoembolization (TACE) on January 5, ROC year 97 (2008), and began systemic chemotherapy on January 20, ROC year 97 (2008). Code: Case
20080120: A liver cancer patient began systemic chemotherapy on January 5, ROC year 97 (2008), and began local transarterial chemoembolization (TACE) on January 20, ROC year 97 (2008).
20080105: A liver cancer patient received local transarterial chemoembolization (TACE) on January 5, ROC year 97 (2008), and began thalidomide therapy on January 20, ROC year 97 (2008).

fields.name_zh: 外院荷爾蒙/類固醇治療
fields.description_zh:
記載個案在外院首次療程中，所給予荷爾蒙/類固醇治療的相關情形。荷爾蒙/類固醇治療包括了很多種藥物，其作用為控制影響癌症的生長。
欄位位置：282–283
fields.description_en:
Record the hormone/steroid therapy given to the case in the first course of treatment at another hospital. Hormone/steroid therapy includes many drugs whose action is to control factors affecting cancer growth.
Field position: 282–283
fields.purpose_zh: 全身性治療可能包括單一或複合藥物處方。本欄位可評估外院首次療程的荷爾蒙/類固醇治療。
fields.guide_zh:  若 prednisone 與 化 學 藥 物 ， 例 如 MOPP(mechlorethamine, vincristine, procarbazine, prednisone)或CHOP (cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, vincristin, prednisone)合併給予時，prednisone為類固醇治療，勿認為是化學治療。 血液惡性腫瘤(Myeloid leukemia除外)自確定診斷日起接受類固醇治療，不論是否併用化學藥物皆編碼為01。 若荷爾蒙/類固醇藥物不是用來直接抑制或毒殺腫瘤，而是為了其他療效，例如：降水腫、止吐或促進食慾時，不可以視為荷爾蒙/類固醇治療。 因腫瘤侵犯或是治療腫瘤時破壞身體製造荷爾蒙的組織器官，為了維持正常新陳代謝及身體功能，會給予荷爾蒙補充治療(Hormone replacement therapy)，此時的荷爾蒙補充治療不可以視為荷爾蒙治療。 個案未接受荷爾蒙/類固醇治療，因個案所罹患的癌症種類及分期通常不需接受荷爾蒙/類固醇治療，則編碼為00。 醫師提供多種的治療計畫選擇，而個案選擇不含荷爾蒙/類固醇治療的計畫，則編碼為00。 個案接受甲狀腺補充治療，目的在於抑制TSH (thyroid-stimulating hormone是腦垂腺所產生的，可以刺激促進腫瘤的生長)，則編碼為01。 個案若有接受臨床試驗荷爾蒙/類固醇治療，則視治療情況編碼20、21、30、31。注意：若個案於病歷上有描述參與臨床試驗，請確認個案是否進入試驗組；若有則視為有接受臨床試驗荷爾蒙/類固醇治療；若僅為對照組則不視為有接受臨床試驗荷爾蒙/類固醇治療。若無法得知為試驗組或對照組，則編碼30或31。 個案若接受雙盲試驗，但不清楚使用何種藥物，則應編碼於其他治療欄位。 不知道荷爾蒙/類固醇治療是否通常使用於個案所罹患癌症的種類和期別，同時病歷也沒有記載荷爾蒙/類固醇治療是否有被建議或是已經執行，則編碼為99。 抗腫瘤藥物的分類可下載SEER網站上之藥物查詢工具：http://seer.cancer.gov/tools/seerrx作為編碼依據。
fields.purpose_en: Systemic therapy may include single-agent or combination drug regimens. This field can be used to evaluate hormone/steroid therapy in the first course of treatment at another hospital.
fields.guide_en: When prednisone is given together with chemotherapy drugs, for example MOPP (mechlorethamine, vincristine, procarbazine, prednisone) or CHOP (cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, vincristin, prednisone), prednisone is steroid therapy; do not regard it as chemotherapy. For hematologic malignancies (except Myeloid leukemia), steroid therapy received from the date of confirmed diagnosis is coded 01, whether or not chemotherapy drugs are used together. If hormone/steroid drugs are not used to directly inhibit or kill the tumor but for other effects, for example reducing edema, preventing vomiting or promoting appetite, they must not be regarded as hormone/steroid therapy. If hormone replacement therapy is given to maintain normal metabolism and body function because the tumor invaded, or treatment of the tumor destroyed, the tissues or organs that produce hormones, that hormone replacement therapy must not be regarded as hormone therapy. If the case did not receive hormone/steroid therapy because hormone/steroid therapy is not usually needed for the type and stage of cancer the case has, code 00. If the physician offered several treatment plan options and the case chose a plan that does not include hormone/steroid therapy, code 00. If the case received thyroid replacement therapy with the purpose of suppressing TSH (thyroid-stimulating hormone, produced by the pituitary gland, which can stimulate tumor growth), code 01. If the case received clinical trial hormone/steroid therapy, code 20, 21, 30 or 31 according to the treatment situation. Note: if the medical record describes the case as participating in a clinical trial, confirm whether the case entered the experimental arm; if so, it is regarded as having received clinical trial hormone/steroid therapy; if only in the control arm, it is not regarded as having received clinical trial hormone/steroid therapy. If it cannot be determined whether the case was in the experimental or control arm, code 30 or 31. If the case received a double-blind trial but it is unclear which drug was used, it should be coded in the other treatment field. If it is not known whether hormone/steroid therapy is usually used for the type and stage of cancer the case has, and the medical record does not document whether hormone/steroid therapy was recommended or has been performed, code 99. For the classification of antineoplastic drugs, the drug lookup tool on the SEER website may be downloaded as the basis for coding: http://seer.cancer.gov/tools/seerrx.

fields.name_zh: 申報醫院荷爾蒙/類固醇治療
fields.description_zh:
記載個案在申報醫院首次療程中，所給予荷爾蒙/類固醇治療的相關情形。假如個案沒有接受荷爾蒙/類固醇治療，則將沒有接受荷爾蒙/類固醇治療的原因加以編碼。荷爾蒙/類固醇治療包括了很多種藥物，其作用為控制影響癌症的生長。
欄位位置：284–285
fields.description_en:
Record the hormone/steroid therapy given to the case in the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital. If the case did not receive hormone/steroid therapy, code the reason hormone/steroid therapy was not given. Hormone/steroid therapy includes many drugs whose action is to control factors affecting cancer growth.
Field position: 284–285
fields.purpose_zh: 全身性治療可能包括單一或複合藥物處方。本欄位可評估申報醫院首次療程的荷爾蒙治療/類固醇，及了解個案未接受荷爾蒙/類固醇治療的原因。
fields.guide_zh:
 記載申報醫院在首次療程中所給予個案荷爾蒙/類固醇治療的相關情形。不包括外院在首次療程中所給予個案的荷爾蒙/類固醇治療。 血液惡性腫瘤(Myeloid leukemia除外)自確定診斷日起接受類固醇治療，不論是否併用化學藥物皆編碼為01 若荷爾蒙/類固醇藥物不是用來直接抑制或毒殺腫瘤，而是為了其他療效，例如：降水腫、止吐或促進食慾時，不可登錄此欄位。 若 prednisone 與 化 學 藥 物 ， 例 如 MOPP(mechlorethamine, vincristine, procarbazine, prednisone)或CHOP (cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, vincristin, prednisone)合併給予時，prednisone為類固醇治療，勿認為是化學治療。 因腫瘤侵犯或是治療腫瘤時破壞身體製造荷爾蒙的組織器官，為了維持正常新陳代謝及身體功能，會給予荷爾蒙補充治療(Hormone replacement therapy)，此時的荷爾蒙補充治療不可以視為荷爾蒙治療。 個案未接受荷爾蒙/類固醇治療，因個案所罹患的癌症種類及分期通常不需接受荷爾蒙/類固醇治療，則編碼為00。 醫師提供多種的治療計畫選擇，而個案選擇不含荷爾蒙/類固醇治療的計畫，則編碼為00。 個案接受甲狀腺補充治療，目的在於抑制TSH (thyroid-stimulating hormone是腦垂腺所產生的，可以刺激促進腫瘤的生長)，則編碼為01。 個案若有接受臨床試驗荷爾蒙/類固醇治療，則視治療情況編碼20、21、30、31。注意：若個案於病歷上有描述參與臨床試驗，請確認個案是否進入試驗組；若有則視為有接受臨床試驗荷爾蒙/類固醇治療；若僅為對照組則不視為有接受臨床試驗荷爾蒙/類固醇治療。若無法得知為試驗組或對照組，則編碼30或31。。 個案若接受雙盲試驗，但不清楚使用何種藥物，則應編碼於其他治療欄位。 若個案所罹患的癌症與期別通常需要接受荷爾蒙/類固醇治療，但未接受荷爾蒙治療/類固醇則編碼為82、83、85、86或87，以記錄未治療原因。 個案拒絕醫師建議的荷爾蒙/類固醇治療、拒絕己建議的所有治療或在醫師提治療建議前即拒絕所有治療，則編碼為87。 若荷爾蒙/類固醇治療為個案既定之治療計畫，但是於摘錄時或作最近一次的追蹤時個案尚未開始接受此項治療，則編碼為88，其治療日期應於下一次追蹤時予以更新。 不知道荷爾蒙/類固醇治療是否通常使用於個案所罹患癌症的種類和期別，同時病歷也沒有記載荷爾蒙/類固醇治療是否有被建議或是已經執行，則編碼為99。 抗腫瘤藥物的分類可下載SEER網站上之藥物查詢工具：http://seer.cancer.gov/tools/seerrx作為編碼依據。 若執行之荷爾蒙/類固醇治療是為控制症狀來延長生命、減輕疼痛或使個案感到較舒適，則同時也要記錄在「申報醫院緩和照護」欄位中。範例：編碼：理由
00：肺癌併腦轉移個案，醫師開立 Decadron以減少腦部水腫及神經症狀。Decadron並未與化學治療合併給予。
00：乳癌個案因 aminoglutethimide (Cytadren, Elipten)治療，而抑制 glucocorticoids 和mineralocorticoids 的製造，因此給 glucocorticoid (hydrocortisone)或 mineralocorticoid (Florinef)等荷爾蒙補充治療。
00：癌症末期個案給予 prednisone來促進食慾和改善營養狀況。
01：攝護腺癌個案，醫師給予 flutamide (一種antiandrogenic)的荷爾蒙治療。
87：攝護腺癌個案，在病歷記載個案拒絕接受 Megace (a progestational agent)治療。
03：個案診斷為 Diffuse large B cell lymphoma with multiple lymph nodes and CNS involved。採用口服 prednisone 治療，同時接受 intrathecal dexamethasone injection.
fields.purpose_en: Systemic therapy may include single-agent or combination drug regimens. This field can be used to evaluate hormone therapy/steroids in the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital and to understand why the case did not receive hormone/steroid therapy.
fields.guide_en:
Record the hormone/steroid therapy given to the case by the reporting hospital in the first course of treatment. Hormone/steroid therapy given to the case by another facility in the first course of treatment is not included. For hematologic malignancies (except myeloid leukemia), steroid therapy received from the date of confirmed diagnosis is coded 01, whether or not combined with chemotherapy drugs. If a hormone/steroid drug is not used to directly suppress or kill the tumor but for another effect, for example reducing edema, preventing vomiting or stimulating appetite, it must not be recorded in this field. If prednisone is given together with chemotherapy drugs, such as MOPP (mechlorethamine, vincristine, procarbazine, prednisone) or CHOP (cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, vincristine, prednisone), prednisone is steroid therapy and should not be regarded as chemotherapy. When tumor invasion, or treatment of the tumor, destroys the tissues or organs that produce hormones in the body, hormone replacement therapy is given to maintain normal metabolism and body function; such hormone replacement therapy must not be regarded as hormone therapy. If the case did not receive hormone/steroid therapy because the cancer type and stage of the case usually do not require hormone/steroid therapy, code 00. If the physician offered several treatment plans and the case chose a plan without hormone/steroid therapy, code 00. If the case received thyroid replacement therapy for the purpose of suppressing TSH (thyroid-stimulating hormone, produced by the pituitary gland, which can stimulate tumor growth), code 01. If the case received clinical trial hormone/steroid therapy, code 20, 21, 30 or 31 according to the treatment. Note: if the medical record describes participation in a clinical trial, confirm whether the case entered the study arm; if so, it is regarded as having received clinical trial hormone/steroid therapy; if the case was only in the control arm, it is not regarded as having received clinical trial hormone/steroid therapy. If it cannot be known whether the case was in the study arm or the control arm, code 30 or 31. If the case participated in a double-blind trial but it is unclear which drug was used, code it in the other therapy field. If the cancer type and stage of the case usually require hormone/steroid therapy but the case did not receive it, code 82, 83, 85, 86 or 87 to record the reason for no treatment. If the case refused the hormone/steroid therapy recommended by the physician, refused all recommended treatment, or refused all treatment before the physician made a treatment recommendation, code 87. If hormone/steroid therapy is part of the case's established treatment plan but the case had not yet started it at the time of abstracting or at the latest follow-up, code 88, and its treatment date should be updated at the next follow-up. If it is not known whether hormone/steroid therapy is usually used for the cancer type and stage of the case, and the medical record also does not state whether hormone/steroid therapy was recommended or has been performed, code 99. For the classification of antineoplastic drugs, download the drug lookup tool on the SEER website: http://seer.cancer.gov/tools/seerrx as the basis for coding. If the hormone/steroid therapy given was to control symptoms, prolong life, relieve pain or make the case more comfortable, it must also be recorded in the "Reporting hospital palliative care" field. Examples: Code: Reason
00: A lung cancer case with brain metastases; the physician prescribed Decadron to reduce brain edema and neurologic symptoms. Decadron was not given together with chemotherapy.
00: A breast cancer case was treated with aminoglutethimide (Cytadren, Elipten), which suppresses the production of glucocorticoids and mineralocorticoids, so hormone replacement therapy such as a glucocorticoid (hydrocortisone) or mineralocorticoid (Florinef) was given.
00: A terminal cancer case was given prednisone to stimulate appetite and improve nutritional status.
01: A prostate cancer case; the physician gave hormone therapy with flutamide (an antiandrogen).
87: A prostate cancer case; the medical record states that the case refused Megace (a progestational agent) treatment.
03: The case was diagnosed with diffuse large B cell lymphoma with multiple lymph nodes and CNS involved. Treated with oral prednisone, and also received intrathecal dexamethasone injection.

fields.purpose_zh: 全身性治療可能包括單一或複合藥物處方。這項資料乃評估外院首次治療中給予個案的免疫治療，以及照護的品質。
fields.guide_zh:  個案未接受免疫治療，因個案所罹患的癌症種類及分期通常不需接受免疫治療，則編碼為00。 免疫治療為透過刺激或抑制免疫系統，來達到治療癌症的效果。可區分為： 細胞介素與免疫調節劑，例如干擾素(interferon)、介白素(interleukin)、Thalidomide、Lenalidomide。 免疫檢查點抑制劑 (Immune checkpoint inhibitor)，例如CTLA-4抑制劑、PD-1抑制劑、PD-L1抑制劑。 免疫細胞治療，例如CAR-T細胞療法、NK細胞治療、Sipuleucel T細胞治療。 醫師提供多種的治療計畫選擇，而個案選擇不含免疫治療的計畫，則編碼為00。 個案有接受免疫細胞治療，則視治療情況編碼04-07。 個案若有接受臨床試驗免疫治療，則視治療情況編碼20-23、30-33。注意：若個案於病歷上有描述參與臨床試驗，請確認個案是否進入試驗組；若有則視為有接受臨床試驗免疫治療；若僅為對照組則不視為有接受臨床試驗免疫治療。若無法得知為試驗組或對照組，則編碼30-33。 個案若接受雙盲試驗，但不清楚使用何種藥物，則應編碼於其他治療欄位。 不知道免疫治療治療是否通常使用於個案所罹患癌症的種類和期別，同時病歷也沒有記載免疫治療是否有被建議或是已經執行，則編碼為99。 抗腫瘤藥物的分類可下載SEER網站上之藥物查詢工具：http://seer.cancer.gov/tools/seerrx作為編碼依據。
fields.purpose_en: Systemic therapy may include single-agent or combination drug regimens. These data are used to evaluate immunotherapy given in the first treatment at another hospital, and quality of care.
fields.guide_en: If the case did not receive immunotherapy because immunotherapy is not usually needed for the type and stage of cancer the case has, code 00. Immunotherapy achieves its therapeutic effect against cancer by stimulating or suppressing the immune system. It can be divided into: Cytokines and immunomodulators, for example interferon, interleukin, Thalidomide, Lenalidomide. Immune checkpoint inhibitors, for example CTLA-4 inhibitors, PD-1 inhibitors, PD-L1 inhibitors. Immune cell therapy, for example CAR-T cell therapy, NK cell therapy, Sipuleucel T cell therapy. If the physician offered several treatment plan options and the case chose a plan that does not include immunotherapy, code 00. If the case received immune cell therapy, code 04-07 according to the treatment situation. If the case received clinical trial immunotherapy, code 20-23 or 30-33 according to the treatment situation. Note: if the medical record describes the case as participating in a clinical trial, confirm whether the case entered the experimental arm; if so, it is regarded as having received clinical trial immunotherapy; if only in the control arm, it is not regarded as having received clinical trial immunotherapy. If it cannot be determined whether the case was in the experimental or control arm, code 30-33. If the case received a double-blind trial but it is unclear which drug was used, it should be coded in the other treatment field. If it is not known whether immunotherapy is usually used for the type and stage of cancer the case has, and the medical record does not document whether immunotherapy was recommended or has been performed, code 99. For the classification of antineoplastic drugs, the drug lookup tool on the SEER website may be downloaded as the basis for coding: http://seer.cancer.gov/tools/seerrx.

01：罹患惡性黑色素瘤的個案，接受 interferon的免疫治療。
20：個案於 2018 年診斷為肺癌，接受 Carboplatin+Alimta 合併使用免疫治療臨床試驗藥物MEDI4736(Durvalumab)。
21：Renal Medullary Carcinoma 的個案接受免疫藥物 Nivolumab 的治療及臨床試驗免疫藥物 Ipilimumab。
30：個案於 2018 年診斷為口腔癌第三期，接受Cisplatin 合併免疫治療雙盲臨床試驗Nimotuzumab (TheraCIM®/ h-R3) or Placebo。

fields.purpose_en: Systemic therapy may include single-agent or combination drug regimens. This field can be used to evaluate immunotherapy in the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital and to understand why the case did not receive immunotherapy.
fields.guide_en:
Record only the immunotherapy given to the case by the reporting hospital in the first course of treatment. Immunotherapy given to the case by another facility in the first course of treatment is not included. Immunotherapy treats cancer by stimulating or suppressing the immune system. It can be divided into: cytokines and immunomodulators, e.g. interferon, interleukin, thalidomide, lenalidomide. Immune checkpoint inhibitors, e.g. CTLA-4 inhibitors, PD-1 inhibitors, PD-L1 inhibitors. Immune cell therapy, e.g. CAR-T cell therapy, NK cell therapy, Sipuleucel-T cell therapy. If the case did not receive immunotherapy because the cancer type and stage of the case usually do not require immunotherapy, code 00. If the case received immune cell therapy, code 04-07 according to the treatment. If the physician offered several treatment plans and the case chose a plan without immunotherapy, code 00. If the case received clinical trial immunotherapy, code 20-23 or 30-33 according to the treatment. Note: if the medical record describes participation in a clinical trial, confirm whether the case entered the study arm; if so, it is regarded as having received clinical trial immunotherapy; if the case was only in the control arm, it is not regarded as having received clinical trial immunotherapy. If it cannot be known whether the case was in the study arm or the control arm, code 30-33. If the case participated in a double-blind trial but it is unclear which drug was used, code it in the other therapy field. If the cancer type and stage of the case usually require immunotherapy but the case did not receive it, code 82, 83, 85, 86 or 87 to record the reason for no treatment. If the case refused the immunotherapy recommended by the physician, refused all recommended treatment, or refused all treatment before the physician made a treatment recommendation, code 87. If immunotherapy is part of the case's established treatment plan but the case had not yet started it at the time of abstracting or at the latest follow-up, code 88, and its treatment date should be updated at the next follow-up. If it is not known whether immunotherapy is usually used for the cancer type and stage of the case, and the medical record also does not state whether immunotherapy was recommended or has been performed, code 99. If the immunotherapy given was to control symptoms, prolong life, relieve pain or make the case more comfortable, it must also be recorded in the "Reporting hospital palliative care" field. For the classification of antineoplastic drugs, download the drug lookup tool on the SEER website: http://seer.cancer.gov/tools/seerrx as the basis for coding. Examples: Code: Case
01: A case with malignant melanoma received interferon immunotherapy.
20: A case diagnosed with lung cancer in 2018 received carboplatin + Alimta combined with the clinical trial immunotherapy drug MEDI4736 (durvalumab).
21: A case of renal medullary carcinoma received the immunotherapy drug nivolumab and the clinical trial immunotherapy drug ipilimumab.
30: A case diagnosed with stage III oral cancer in 2018 received cisplatin combined with a double-blind clinical trial of immunotherapy, nimotuzumab (TheraCIM®/ h-R3) or placebo.
85: The physician recommended immunotherapy, but the case died before immunotherapy.

fields.name_zh: 骨髓/幹細胞移植或內分泌處置
fields.name_zh_en: bone marrow/stem cell transplantation or endocrine management
fields.description_zh:
記錄個案在任何醫療機構首次治療時，給予骨髓/幹細胞移植或內分泌處置情形。若個案未接受此等治療，則依據其原因加以編碼。此等治療包括骨髓移植、幹細胞移植、或以放射線照射或手術切除之內分泌處置。
欄位位置：306–307
fields.description_en:
Record the bone marrow/stem cell transplant or endocrine procedure given to the case at first treatment at any healthcare institution. If the case did not receive such treatment, code according to the reason. These treatments include bone marrow transplant, stem cell transplant, or endocrine procedures by irradiation or surgical resection.
Field position: 306–307
fields.purpose_zh: 瞭解與骨髓/幹細胞移植或內分泌處置有關的治療型式及照護品質，及個案未接受骨髓/幹細胞移植或內分泌處置的原因。
fields.guide_zh:  骨髓移植包括： 自體的(autologous)：骨髓來自個案本身。 異體的(allogeneic)：骨髓由他人所捐贈。若骨髓移植是同卵雙胞胎的(syngeneic)：骨髓來自同卵雙胞胎中的另一個體，亦視為異體骨髓移植。 幹細胞移植是收集個案體內未成熟的血液細胞，於體外處理，並於個案接受化學治療或放射治療後，此時其造血機能正處於恢復的時候，將這些培養過之細胞再輸入個案體內，使得個案得以獲得足夠恢復整個造血機能的血液幹細胞。 手術/放射線之內分泌處置，乃藉由抑制個案體內荷爾蒙活性，進而改變或影響以達到長期控制癌細胞的生長的一種治療方式。這些處置必須雙側腺體同時治療才符合手術/放射線之內分泌處置之定義，如果剛開始治療時，僅存單側腺體，則對此一僅存的腺體作手術或放射治療，亦符合本欄位定義。 個案未接受骨髓/幹細胞移植或內分泌處置，因個案所罹患的癌症種類及分期通常不需接受骨髓/幹細胞移植或內分泌處置，則編碼為00。 若有多種的治療計畫選擇，而個案選擇的治療計畫不含骨髓/幹細胞移植或內分泌處置，則編碼為00。 若個案所罹患的癌症與期別通常需要接受骨髓/幹細胞移植或內分泌處置，但未接受前述治療，則需以編碼82、83、85、86或87以記錄個案未治療原因。 個案拒絕醫師建議的骨髓/幹細胞移植或內分泌處置、拒絕已建議的所有治療或在醫師提治療建議前即拒絕所有治療，則編碼為87。 若骨髓/幹細胞移植或內分泌處置為個案既定之治療計畫，但是於摘錄時或作最近一次的追蹤時個案尚未開始接受此項治療，則編碼為88，其治療日期應於下一次追蹤時予以更新。 不知道骨髓/幹細胞移植或內分泌處置是否通常使用於個案所罹患癌症的種類和期別，同時病歷也沒有記載前述治療是否有被建議或是已經執行，就編碼為99。 若執行之骨髓/幹細胞移植或內分泌處置是為控制症狀來延長生命、減輕疼痛或使個案感到較舒適，則同時也要記錄在「申報醫院緩和照護」欄位中。 編碼10-40為記錄個案在申報醫院所接受的骨髓/幹細胞移植或內分泌處置。
fields.purpose_en: Understand the treatment types and quality of care related to bone marrow/stem cell transplant or endocrine procedure, and the reasons the case did not receive bone marrow/stem cell transplant or endocrine procedure.
fields.guide_en: • Bone marrow transplantation includes: • Autologous (autologous): the bone marrow comes from the patient. • Allogeneic (allogeneic): the bone marrow is donated by another person. If the bone marrow transplant is syngeneic (syngeneic), with the bone marrow coming from the other identical twin, it is also regarded as allogeneic bone marrow transplantation. • Stem cell transplantation collects immature blood cells from the patient's body, processes them outside the body, and, after the patient has received chemotherapy or radiotherapy, when hematopoietic function is in the process of recovering, infuses these cultured cells back into the patient so that the patient obtains enough blood stem cells to recover the entire hematopoietic function. • Surgical/radiation endocrine procedures are a treatment method that suppresses hormone activity in the patient's body, thereby altering or influencing it to achieve long-term control of cancer cell growth. These procedures must treat the glands on both sides at the same time to meet the definition of a surgical/radiation endocrine procedure; if only one gland remains at the start of treatment, surgery or radiotherapy of that remaining gland also meets the definition of this field. • If the patient did not receive bone marrow/stem cell transplantation or endocrine procedures because the type and stage of the patient's cancer usually do not require them, code 00. • If there were multiple treatment plan options and the patient chose a plan that does not include bone marrow/stem cell transplantation or endocrine procedures, code 00. • If the patient's cancer and stage usually require bone marrow/stem cell transplantation or endocrine procedures but the patient did not receive them, code 82, 83, 85, 86 or 87 to record the reason for no treatment. • If the patient refuses the bone marrow/stem cell transplantation or endocrine procedure recommended by the physician, refuses all recommended treatment, or refuses all treatment before the physician makes a treatment recommendation, code 87. • If bone marrow/stem cell transplantation or an endocrine procedure is part of the patient's planned treatment but the patient has not yet started it at the time of abstracting or at the latest follow-up, code 88, and its treatment date should be updated at the next follow-up. • If it is not known whether bone marrow/stem cell transplantation or endocrine procedures are usually used for the patient's cancer type and stage, and the medical record also does not state whether they were recommended or have been performed, code 99. • If the bone marrow/stem cell transplantation or endocrine procedure performed was to control symptoms, prolong life, relieve pain or make the patient more comfortable, it must also be recorded in the "Palliative care at the reporting hospital" field. • Codes 10-40 record the bone marrow/stem cell transplantation or endocrine procedures that the patient received at the reporting hospital.

fields.description_zh:
記錄個案在外院首次療程中，所給予標靶治療相關情形。標靶治療包括多種抗癌藥物，可能與細胞癌化過程有關的分子或是酵素，為一種新的標的性治療藥物直接作用於癌細胞中的異常蛋白，是與癌細胞異常增生或是抗藥性增加有關的細胞訊息傳導路徑、或是促進腫瘤異常的血管增生及癌細胞轉移的調控機轉等。以透過對這些異常機轉的抑制以達到抗癌的治療效果，故此類標靶藥物具有癌細胞專一性。
欄位位置：316–317
fields.description_en:
Record the targeted therapy given to the case in the first course of treatment at another hospital. Targeted therapy includes many anticancer drugs; it is a new class of targeted drugs that act directly on abnormal proteins in cancer cells, namely molecules or enzymes possibly involved in the process of malignant transformation, cell signaling pathways related to abnormal cancer cell proliferation or increased drug resistance, or regulatory mechanisms that promote abnormal tumor angiogenesis and cancer cell metastasis. Anticancer effects are achieved by inhibiting these abnormal mechanisms, so such targeted drugs are specific to cancer cells.
Field position: 316–317
fields.purpose_zh: 本欄位可評估外院首次療程的標靶治療。
fields.guide_zh:
 個案未接受標靶治療，標靶治療非首次療程的一部份，則編碼為00。 醫師提供多種的治療計畫選擇，而個案選擇不含標靶治療的計畫，編碼也是00。 個案若有接受臨床試驗標靶治療，則視治療情況編碼20、21、30、31。注意：若個案於病歷上有描述參與臨床試驗，請確認個案是否進入試驗組；若有則視為有接受臨床試驗標靶治療；若僅為對照組則不視為有接受臨床試驗標靶治療。若無法得知為試驗組或對照組，則編碼30或31。 個案若接受雙盲試驗，但不清楚使用何種藥物，則應編碼於其他治療欄位。 不知道標靶治療治療是否通常使用於個案所罹患癌症的種類和期別，同時病歷也沒有記載標靶治療是否有被建議或是已經執行，則編碼為99。 標靶治療藥物請參考SEER網站上之藥物查詢工具：
http://seer.cancer.gov/tools/seerrx中。注意1：以subcategory欄位描述為targeted therapy、 ＿＿＿＿kinase inhibitor、epidermal growth factor (EGF) receptor、cytostatic agent、antiangiogenesis agent、mTOR(mammalian target of rapamycin)、monoclonal antibody均登錄為標靶治療；不論category欄位為Chemotherapy或Biologic therapy (BRM, Immunotherapy)。例外1：Thalidomide或Lenalidomide視為Biologic therapy (BRM, Immunotherapy)登錄，不可以subcategory中的antiangiogenesis agent登錄為標靶治療。例外2：若subcategory欄位描述為monoclonal antibody的藥物，請優先參考附錄
C：常見標靶及免疫藥物清單，依清單內容登錄於標靶或免疫治療欄位中。注意2：除上述標靶治療外，不論subcategory欄位描述為何，皆以category欄位為編碼依據，例如: Ibritumomab，應以Radiation登錄，不可以subcategory中的Radiolabled monoclonal antibody作為編碼依據。
fields.purpose_en: This field can be used to evaluate targeted therapy in the first course of treatment at another hospital.
fields.guide_en:
• If the patient did not receive targeted therapy and targeted therapy is not part of the first course of treatment, code 00.• If the physician offered several treatment plans and the patient chose a plan that does not include targeted therapy, also code 00.• If the patient received clinical-trial targeted therapy, code 20, 21, 30 or 31 according to the treatment situation. Note: if the medical record describes the patient as participating in a clinical trial, confirm whether the patient entered the experimental arm; if so, it is regarded as receiving clinical-trial targeted therapy; if the patient was only in the control arm, it is not regarded as receiving clinical-trial targeted therapy. If it cannot be determined whether the patient was in the experimental or control arm, code 30 or 31.• If a patient takes part in a double-blind trial and it is unclear which drug is used, code it in the other treatment field.• If it is not known whether targeted therapy is usually used for the patient's cancer type and stage, and the medical record does not document whether targeted therapy was recommended or has been performed, code 99.• For targeted therapy drugs, refer to the drug lookup tool on the SEER website:
http://seer.cancer.gov/tools/seerrx. Note 1: Drugs whose subcategory field is described as targeted therapy, ____ kinase inhibitor, epidermal growth factor (EGF) receptor, cytostatic agent, antiangiogenesis agent, mTOR (mammalian target of rapamycin), or monoclonal antibody are all registered as targeted therapy, regardless of whether the category field is Chemotherapy or Biologic therapy (BRM, Immunotherapy). Exception 1: Thalidomide or Lenalidomide are registered as Biologic therapy (BRM, Immunotherapy); do not register them as targeted therapy on the basis of the antiangiogenesis agent subcategory. Exception 2: For drugs whose subcategory field is described as monoclonal antibody, refer first to Appendix
C: List of common targeted and immunotherapy drugs, and register in the targeted therapy or immunotherapy field according to the list. Note 2: Apart from the targeted therapies above, coding is based on the category field regardless of the subcategory description; for example, Ibritumomab should be registered as Radiation, and the subcategory Radiolabeled monoclonal antibody must not be used as the basis for coding.

http://seer.cancer.gov/tools/seerrx中。注意1：以subcategory欄位描述為targeted therapy、 ＿＿＿＿kinase inhibitor、epidermal growth factor (EGF) receptor、cytostatic agent、antiangiogenesis agent、mTOR(mammalian target of rapamycin)、monoclonal antibody均登錄為標靶治療；不論category欄位為Chemotherapy或Biologic therapy (BRM, Immunotherapy)。例外1：Thalidomide 或Lenalidomide視為Biologic therapy (BRM, Immunotherapy)登錄，不可以 subcategory 中的antiangiogenesis agent 登錄為標靶治療。例外2：若subcategory欄位描述為monoclonal antibody的藥物，請優先參考附錄C：常見標靶及免疫藥物清單，依清單內容登錄於標靶或免疫治療欄位中。注意2：除上述標靶治療外，不論subcategory欄位描述為何，皆以category欄位為編碼依據，例如: Ibritumomab，應以Radiation登錄，不可以subcategory中的Radiolabled monoclonal antibody作為編碼依據。範例：編碼：案例
21：第二期乳癌個案接受下列臨床試驗 A Dose-Finding Study of Pertuzumab (Perjeta) in Combination With Trastuzumab (Herceptin)。
30：第四期直腸癌併有肝臟轉移個案接受 Adjuvant Regorafenib Versus Placebo After Curative Treatment of Liver Metastases in a Randomized，Placebo Controlled 的臨床試驗。
fields.purpose_en: This field can be used to evaluate targeted therapy in the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital.
fields.guide_en:
If the case did not receive targeted therapy and targeted therapy is not part of the first course of treatment, code 00. If the physician offered several treatment plans and the case chose a plan without targeted therapy, the code is also 00. If the case received clinical trial targeted therapy, code 20, 21, 30 or 31 according to the treatment. Note: if the medical record describes participation in a clinical trial, confirm whether the case entered the study arm; if so, it is regarded as having received clinical trial targeted therapy; if the case was only in the control arm, it is not regarded as having received clinical trial targeted therapy. If it cannot be known whether the case was in the study arm or the control arm, code 30 or 31. If the case participated in a double-blind trial but it is unclear which drug was used, code it in the other therapy field. If the cancer type and stage of the case usually require targeted therapy but the case did not receive it, code 82, 83, 85, 86 or 87 to record the reason for no treatment. If the case refused the targeted therapy recommended by the physician, refused all recommended treatment, or refused all treatment before the physician made a treatment recommendation, code 87. If targeted therapy is part of the case's established treatment plan but the case had not yet started it at the time of abstracting or at the latest follow-up, code 88, and its treatment date should be updated at the next follow-up. If it is not known whether targeted therapy is usually used for the cancer type and stage of the case, and the medical record also does not state whether targeted therapy was recommended or has been performed, code 99. If the targeted therapy given was to control symptoms, prolong life, relieve pain or make the case more comfortable, it must also be recorded in the "Reporting hospital palliative care" field. For targeted therapy drugs, refer to the drug lookup tool on the SEER website:
http://seer.cancer.gov/tools/seerrx. Note 1: record as targeted therapy those whose subcategory field is described as targeted therapy, ____ kinase inhibitor, epidermal growth factor (EGF) receptor, cytostatic agent, antiangiogenesis agent, mTOR (mammalian target of rapamycin) or monoclonal antibody, whether the category field is Chemotherapy or Biologic therapy (BRM, Immunotherapy). Exception 1: Thalidomide or Lenalidomide are recorded as Biologic therapy (BRM, Immunotherapy), and must not be recorded as targeted therapy under the antiangiogenesis agent subcategory. Exception 2: for drugs whose subcategory field is described as monoclonal antibody, refer first to Appendix C: List of common targeted and immunotherapy drugs, and record in the targeted or immunotherapy field according to the list. Note 2: apart from the targeted therapies above, regardless of what the subcategory field says, code according to the category field; for example, Ibritumomab should be recorded as Radiation, and must not be coded by the subcategory Radiolabeled monoclonal antibody. Examples: Code: Case
21: A stage II breast cancer case received the following clinical trial: A Dose-Finding Study of Pertuzumab (Perjeta) in Combination With Trastuzumab (Herceptin).
30: A stage IV rectal cancer case with liver metastases received the clinical trial Adjuvant Regorafenib Versus Placebo After Curative Treatment of Liver Metastases in a Randomized, Placebo Controlled trial.
