fields.purpose_zh: 申報醫院可藉本欄位探知其照護為緩和性而非診斷或治癒性目的。
fields.guide_zh:
 記錄個案在申報醫院首次療程所接受之緩和照護的型態。 緩和照護不是作為診斷原發腫瘤或判斷期別之用。 經由手術、放射線或局部/全身性藥物治療或其他治療，以控制症狀來延長生命、減輕疼痛或使個案感到較舒適，皆應記錄為緩和照護。若這些治療將原發或轉移組織移除或改變時，也應填入首次療程的項目中。 各種治療引發之疼痛或副作用所執行的相關處理，不可在此欄位逕行編碼。 個案經醫師診斷為癌症末期，並評估其首次療程不適合根治性手術、放射治療或全身性治療，如有接受住院安寧或居家安寧照護，應依實際處置編碼1至7。 根據SEER的Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasm Coding Manual：輸血(全血或血小板等)為治療貧血症狀，可視為症狀緩解，而非癌症治療；故若個案僅接受輸血治療，請登錄為緩和治療。範例：編碼：理由
0：沒有給予個案緩和照護。
1：個案接受以緩和性手術移除腦部的轉移腫瘤，手術也要另外記錄在「其他部位手術方式」相關欄位項目上。
1：胰臟癌個案，但是已經無法根除，所以沒有切除原發腫瘤，但是為了減輕黃膽症狀和疼痛，個案接受了繞道手術。
7：因原發部位腫瘤造成的胸水引起症狀，而以胸水抽取術來減輕症狀。
2：攝護腺癌第四期的個案，其唯一的症狀是因為右側 hip 和 lower spine 的癌細胞轉移而引起的骨頭疼痛，因此個案接受了體外放射治療(XRT)。此體外放射治療和其劑量也要記錄在放射治療相關欄位中。
2：肺癌侵犯到脊柱骨骼，接受 XRT 來縮小脊柱和神經之外的腫瘤體積以減輕疼痛。XRT 和其劑量也要記錄在放射治療欄位中。
3：肺癌第三 B 期，接受緩和性化學治療。化學治療也要記錄在「申報醫院之化學治療」相關欄位中
4：一位 93歲的個案，診斷為多發性骨髓瘤，他於疼痛科門診就診以減輕疼痛。但是個案因為其他醫療的問題，並沒有接受任何其他的療法。
5：廣泛瀰漫性肺小細胞癌個案。接受以緩和性外科手術把轉移到腦的腫瘤切除，之後再接受 XRT 以減輕因為癌細胞轉移至 lower spine 所引起的骨頭疼痛。並未接受或是轉診至疼痛科門診。個案所接受的手術治療要記錄在「其他部位手術方式」相關欄位。個案所接受的 XRT和其劑量也要記錄在放射治療相關欄位中。
6：大腸癌個案，因為無法根除，所以接受繞道手術來減緩症狀，並且接受 XRT 來處理肝臟轉移的問題。之後個案到疼痛處理門診來治療持續的腹痛。個案所接受的 XRT和其劑量也要記錄在放射治療欄位中。
7：臨床上懷疑有腎臟癌轉移的個案至申報醫院就診，以非侵入性方式來進行緩和照護。
7：肺癌個案首次療程僅接受居家安寧照護。
9：剛被診斷為乳癌廣泛瀰漫性第四期的個案至申報醫院就診，但醫療記錄中，並未說明個案是否有接受緩和照護。
3：大腸癌第四期個案，因肝轉移接受緩和性 TACE治療。編碼：理由
0：食道癌個案接受同步化學、放射治療，治療期間因化學治療造成血色素過低而輸血。
0：個案於申報醫院診斷為大腸癌執行左側半結腸切除手術，術後予止痛劑減緩傷口疼痛。
7：個案接受肋膜沾黏術(pleurodesis)，且使用非抗癌性藥物。
fields.purpose_en: The reporting hospital can use this field to learn that its care was palliative rather than for diagnostic or curative purposes.
fields.guide_en:
Record the type of palliative care the case received in the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital. Palliative care is not used to diagnose the primary tumor or determine stage. Surgery, radiation, local/systemic drug therapy or other therapy given to control symptoms, prolong life, relieve pain or make the case more comfortable should all be recorded as palliative care. If these treatments remove or alter primary or metastatic tissue, they should also be entered in the first course of treatment items. Management of pain or side effects caused by various treatments must not be coded directly in this field. If the case is diagnosed by the physician as terminal cancer and the first course of treatment is assessed as unsuitable for curative surgery, radiotherapy or systemic therapy, and the case receives inpatient hospice or home hospice care, code 1 to 7 according to the actual management. According to SEER's Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasm Coding Manual: transfusion (whole blood or platelets etc.) treats symptoms of anemia and may be regarded as symptom relief rather than cancer treatment; therefore, if the case receives only transfusion, record it as palliative treatment. Examples: Code: Reason
0: No palliative care was given to the case.
1: The case underwent palliative surgery to remove a metastatic brain tumor; the surgery must also be recorded separately in the relevant items of "Surgical procedure of other sites".
1: A pancreatic cancer case that could no longer be cured, so the primary tumor was not resected, but the case underwent a bypass operation to relieve jaundice symptoms and pain.
7: Symptoms caused by pleural effusion due to the primary tumor were relieved by thoracentesis.
2: A stage IV prostate cancer case whose only symptom was bone pain caused by cancer cell metastases to the right hip and lower spine, so the case received external beam radiotherapy (XRT). This XRT and its dose must also be recorded in the radiotherapy fields.
2: Lung cancer invading the spinal bone; XRT was given to reduce the tumor volume outside the spine and nerves to relieve pain. The XRT and its dose must also be recorded in the radiotherapy fields.
3: Stage IIIB lung cancer; palliative chemotherapy was given. The chemotherapy must also be recorded in the relevant items of "Chemotherapy at the reporting hospital".
4: A 93-year-old case diagnosed with multiple myeloma attended the pain clinic to relieve pain. But because of other medical problems, the case did not receive any other therapy.
5: A case of extensive-stage small cell lung cancer. Palliative surgery was performed to remove a brain metastasis, followed by XRT to relieve bone pain caused by cancer cell metastasis to the lower spine. The case was not treated at or referred to the pain clinic. The surgery the case received must be recorded in the relevant fields of "Surgical procedure of other sites". The XRT the case received and its dose must also be recorded in the radiotherapy fields.
6: A colorectal cancer case that could not be cured underwent a bypass operation to relieve symptoms and received XRT for liver metastases. The case then attended the pain management clinic for persistent abdominal pain. The XRT the case received and its dose must also be recorded in the radiotherapy fields.
7: A case with clinically suspected metastatic kidney cancer came to the reporting hospital for non-invasive palliative care.
7: A lung cancer case received only home hospice care as the first course of treatment.
9: A case newly diagnosed with extensive stage IV breast cancer came to the reporting hospital, but the medical record does not state whether the case received palliative care.
3: A stage IV colorectal cancer case received palliative TACE for liver metastases. Code: Reason
0: An esophageal cancer case received concurrent chemoradiotherapy, and received a blood transfusion for low hemoglobin caused by chemotherapy during treatment.
0: A case diagnosed with colorectal cancer at the reporting hospital underwent left hemicolectomy, and was given analgesics after surgery to relieve wound pain.
7: The case underwent pleurodesis using a non-anticancer drug.

fields.description_zh:
記錄個案在任何醫療機構的首次療程中，所給予其他治療相關情形。其他治療的定義為未能歸類於手術、放射治療、全身性藥物治療或輔助性治療(ancillary treatment)。
欄位位置：329–330
fields.description_en:
Record the other treatment given to the case in the first course of treatment at any healthcare institution. Other treatment is defined as treatment that cannot be classified as surgery, radiation therapy, systemic drug therapy or ancillary treatment.
Field position: 329–330
fields.purpose_zh: 其他治療的資訊用來敘述及評估照護品質和治療成效。
fields.guide_zh:
 下列處置視為其他治療： UV therapy (ultraviolet) for skin cancer or cutaneous lymphoma. Trichloroacetic acid for anal intraepithelial neoplasia, grade III (AIN III) ONLY. Antibiotics/anti-microbials/anti-viral agents, such as anti-helicobacter pylori for gastric MALT lymphoma ONLY. Retinoid acid (ATRA) for acute promyelocytic leukemia (APL) ONLY. Anagrelide HCl for Essential thrombocythemia ONLY. Phlebotomy for polycythemia vera ONLY Blood-thinners and/or anti-clotting agents for essential thrombocythemia (9962/3) ONLY. 非肝癌個案執行TAE治療。 目前血液惡性腫瘤在支持照護的治療原則上並非一般治療所定義的「改變、控制、移除或破壞」增長的癌症組織；為了解血液惡性腫瘤病人是否有接受支持照護，故若接受放血治療和抗凝血劑，如阿斯匹靈等，則於其他治療(編碼01)內收錄。 根據SEER Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasm Coding Manual:輸血(全血或血小板等)為治療貧血症狀，可視為症狀緩解，而非癌症治療；故若個案僅接受輸血治療，請登錄於「緩和治療」欄位中。 個案若使用PUVA (psoralen and long wave ultraviolet，長波紫外線光化治療)等治療時，應編碼為01。 個案若接受臨床試驗藥物治療，依據藥物種類編碼於化學/荷爾蒙/類固醇/免疫/標靶欄位中，此欄位應編碼為00。 個案若接受雙盲試驗，但不清楚使用何種藥物，則應編碼於其他治療欄位。 不知道其他治療是否通常使用於個案所罹患癌症的種類和期別，病歷沒有記載其他治療是否有被建議或是已經執行，應編碼為99。 另類治療為本手冊未規範定義之各種療法，且個案自行認定該療法對癌症有療效的治療。這些另類療法可包括中草藥、針灸、氣功、生機療法、按摩療法、磁療法、精神療法和冥想，亦包括在未參與癌症診療認證合格的診所或醫療機構所接受被宣稱具有療效的免疫療法等。若個案僅接受另類治療，其不可視為其他治療的一種，應編碼於「治療狀態分類」欄位為5。 若執行之其他治療是為控制症狀來延長生命、減輕疼痛或使個案感到較舒適，則同時也應記錄在「申報醫院緩和照護」欄位中。 實質腫瘤所接受的其他治療，若僅為支持照護，輔助治療或症狀減緩(non-cancer direct treatment)，而並非直接針對癌症組織給予"改變、控制、移除或破壞"的處置，則不可視為其他治療。範例：編碼：定義
00：個案於2018 年診斷為口腔癌第三期，後續接受 Cisplatin 合併免疫治療雙盲臨床試驗 Nimotuzumab or Placebo。
01：新診斷第四期轉移個案至申報醫院，醫師經評估無法以現行的任何治療為個案治療，建議個案接受某雙盲試驗，但無法知道該實驗用藥為何種藥物。
01：ABT-414合併同步化學放射治療以及輔助性 Temozolomide用於新診斷之多型性神經膠母細胞瘤(GBM)並有表皮生長因子受體(EGFR)增殖之受試者的一項隨機分配、安慰劑對照、第 3期試驗 (Intellance1)。
fields.purpose_en: Information on other treatment is used to describe and evaluate quality of care and treatment effectiveness.
fields.guide_en:
The following procedures are regarded as other treatment: UV therapy (ultraviolet) for skin cancer or cutaneous lymphoma. Trichloroacetic acid for anal intraepithelial neoplasia, grade III (AIN III) ONLY. Antibiotics/anti-microbials/anti-viral agents, such as anti-helicobacter pylori for gastric MALT lymphoma ONLY. Retinoid acid (ATRA) for acute promyelocytic leukemia (APL) ONLY. Anagrelide HCl for Essential thrombocythemia ONLY. Phlebotomy for polycythemia vera ONLY Blood-thinners and/or anti-clotting agents for essential thrombocythemia (9962/3) ONLY. TAE performed in a non-liver cancer case. At present, the treatment principle of supportive care for hematologic malignancies is not "altering, controlling, removing or destroying" growing cancer tissue as defined for ordinary treatment; in order to know whether hematologic malignancy patients received supportive care, phlebotomy and anticoagulants such as aspirin are recorded under other treatment (code 01). According to the SEER Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Neoplasm Coding Manual: transfusion (whole blood or platelets, etc.) treats the symptoms of anemia and can be regarded as symptom relief rather than cancer treatment; therefore if the case received only transfusion, register it in the "Palliative treatment" field. If the case receives treatment such as PUVA (psoralen and long wave ultraviolet, long-wave ultraviolet photochemotherapy), code 01. If the case receives clinical trial drug therapy, code it in the chemotherapy/hormone/steroid/immunotherapy/targeted therapy field according to the type of drug, and this field should be coded 00. If the case receives a double-blind trial but it is unclear which drug was used, code it in the other treatment field. If it is not known whether other treatment is ordinarily used for the case's cancer type and stage, and the medical record does not state whether other treatment was recommended or has been given, code 99. Alternative therapy refers to various therapies not defined in this manual that the case personally considers effective against cancer. These alternative therapies may include Chinese herbal medicine, acupuncture, qigong, biological (organic) therapy, massage therapy, magnetic therapy, psychotherapy and meditation, and also include immunotherapy claimed to be effective that is received at clinics or medical institutions not accredited for cancer care. If the case received only alternative therapy, it must not be regarded as a kind of other treatment, and should be coded 5 in the "Treatment status classification" field. If the other treatment given was to control symptoms, prolong life, relieve pain or make the case more comfortable, it should also be recorded in the "Palliative care at the reporting hospital" field. For other treatment received by solid tumors, if it is only supportive care, adjuvant treatment or symptom relief (non-cancer direct treatment) and is not a procedure that directly "alters, controls, removes or destroys" cancer tissue, it must not be regarded as other treatment. Examples: Code: Definition
00: A case diagnosed in 2018 with stage III oral cancer subsequently received Cisplatin combined with a double-blind immunotherapy clinical trial of Nimotuzumab or Placebo.
01: A newly diagnosed stage IV metastatic case came to the reporting hospital; the physician assessed that no current treatment could be used and recommended that the case join a double-blind trial, but it is not known which drug the trial drug is.
01: ABT-414 combined with concurrent chemoradiotherapy and adjuvant Temozolomide in subjects with newly diagnosed glioblastoma multiforme (GBM) with epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) amplification, a randomized, placebo-controlled, phase 3 trial (Intellance1).

fields.description_zh:
收錄其他治療在任何醫療機構開始的日期。
欄位位置：331–338
fields.description_en:
Record the start date of other treatment at any healthcare institution.
Field position: 331–338
fields.purpose_zh: 可進行多種治療模式的排序或是評估多種治療的時間間隔。
fields.guide_zh:
 記錄在申報醫院或外院首次進行其他治療最早的開始日期。 若個案僅接受其他治療，則其他治療必然是首次且唯一的治療。因此，本欄位資料與「首次療程開始日期」欄位資料是一致的。範例：編碼：案例
20180316：轉移之病人於 2018年3月16 日參與臨床試驗。
20180917：真性紅血球增多症(polycythemia vera)的病人於 2018 年 9 月 17 日接受數次放血治療。結果
fields.purpose_en: Allows ordering of multiple treatment modalities and evaluation of the time intervals between treatments.
fields.guide_en:
Record the earliest start date of the first other treatment performed at the reporting hospital or another facility. If the case received only other treatment, that other treatment is necessarily the first and only treatment; therefore, the data of this field are consistent with the data of the "Date of first course of treatment start" field. Examples: Code: Case
20180316: A patient with metastasis participated in a clinical trial on March 16, 2018.
20180917: A patient with polycythemia vera received several phlebotomy treatments on September 17, 2018. Outcome

fields.name_zh: 首次復發或癌症狀態追蹤日期
fields.name_en: Date of First Recurrence or Cancer Status Follow-Up
fields.name_zh_en: first recurrence or cancer status follow-up date
fields.description_zh:
記錄此癌症首次復發或癌症狀態追蹤的日期。
欄位位置：339–346
fields.description_en:
Record the date of first recurrence of this cancer or of cancer status follow-up.
Field position: 339–346
fields.purpose_zh: 評估首次治療的效果。
fields.guide_zh:
 登錄經過一段「無癌病期間(disease-free period)」之後，其主責醫師首次診斷該癌病惡化(progression)、轉移、復發之日期。 個案一旦有復發，則優先摘錄首次復發日期。 若個案經首次療程後已disease-free且無復發、個案未接受治療或治療後從未disease-free，均應追蹤到最後能確認該狀態之日期；該狀態最後追蹤日期可採用個案至醫院就診日期，此就診日期不限於癌症門診。 本欄位應配合「首次復發型式」欄位一起收集資料，不可採用電話或信件訪問的日期。 此欄位以申報醫院的資料為主。若無申報醫院資料，可參考外院資料。 若個案曾在外院診斷為復發但日期不詳者，盡可能推算至年度、月份。範例：編碼：理由
20180102：乳癌個案於 20180102發現 chest wall recurrence，即20180113開立醫囑安排abdominal CT 及 bone scan，並於 20180115 開始接受化學治療，個案在20180227 才執行 abdominal CT 及 bone scan 檢查，檢查結果發現有肝臟轉移，bone scan 正常無骨轉移。編碼：理由
20160428：食道癌個案於 20150331 確診後接受治療，但首次申報日前尚未 disease free。後於病歷上查詢到個案最後於 20160428 至醫院就診，且癌症狀態仍未 disease free。
20190123：卵巢癌個案於 20150308 確診後進行治療。於 20200330進行滿五年追蹤電訪，個案已死亡。經回溯至 20161001於病歷上記載 disease free且持續回診至 20190123，且未曾復發，但 20190123之後個案就未再回診。
20150610：子宮體癌第二期個案於 20150409確診，經本院手術治療後，病理報告描述margin free。術後接受 adjuvant chemotherapy，後續轉回離家較近的醫院就近治療，故自 20150610 後未再回診。
20151224：子宮體癌第二期個案於 20150409確診，經手術治療後，病理報告描述margin not free。後續醫師評估需做化療，但化療未完成，個案自 20151224 就未再回診治療。因進行滿五年追蹤，電訪個案僅能從家屬口中得知病人之前已於外院治療，且已痊癒。
20200608：乳癌於 20150316確診，經本院手術後之病理報告描述 margin not free。個案接受化學治療未完成，即於 20150601轉至南部分院繼續治療，且未再回本院檢查。後續進行滿五年追蹤，因本院可查閱分院病歷，此個案後續於20160331 經各項檢查已痊癒，至 20200608未復發。
20221207：乳癌第三期個案於 20220403 經本院手術後之病理報告描述 margin not free。個案接受化學治療但尚未完成，就因個人因素轉至其他醫院就醫，且未再回本院檢查。後續個案於 20221207於本院看眼科，但無相關癌症檢查與資訊。
fields.purpose_en: Assesses the effect of first treatment.
fields.guide_en:
Record the date on which the attending physician first diagnosed progression, metastasis or recurrence of the cancer after a "disease-free period". Once a case has a recurrence, abstract the date of the first recurrence first. If, after the first course of treatment, the case is disease-free with no recurrence, or the case received no treatment, or the case was never disease-free after treatment, follow up to the last date on which that status can be confirmed; the last follow-up date for that status may be the date of the case's visit to the hospital, and this visit date is not limited to the cancer clinic. This field must be collected together with the "Type of first recurrence" field; the date of a telephone or mail interview may not be used. This field is based mainly on reporting hospital data. If there are no reporting hospital data, data from another facility may be consulted. If the case was diagnosed with recurrence at another facility but the date is unknown, estimate it down to the year and month as far as possible. Examples: Code: Reason
20180102: A breast cancer case was found to have chest wall recurrence on 20180102; abdominal CT and bone scan were ordered on 20180113, and chemotherapy was started on 20180115; the case did not have the abdominal CT and bone scan until 20180227, and the results showed liver metastasis, with a normal bone scan and no bone metastasis. Code: Reason
20160428: An esophageal cancer case received treatment after confirmed diagnosis on 20150331 but was not yet disease free before the first reporting date. The medical record shows that the last visit of the case to the hospital was on 20160428, and the cancer status was still not disease free.
20190123: An ovarian cancer case was treated after confirmed diagnosis on 20150308. On 20200330, the five-year follow-up telephone interview found that the case had died. Tracing back, the medical record documents disease free from 20161001 with continued return visits until 20190123, and no recurrence, but the case did not return after 20190123.
20150610: A stage II endometrial cancer case was diagnosed on 20150409 and treated surgically at this hospital; the pathology report described margin free. After surgery the case received adjuvant chemotherapy, and then transferred to a hospital closer to home for treatment, so the case has not returned since 20150610.
20151224: A stage II endometrial cancer case was diagnosed on 20150409 and, after surgical treatment, the pathology report described margin not free. The physician then assessed that chemotherapy was needed, but chemotherapy was not completed, and the case has not returned for treatment since 20151224. At the five-year follow-up, the telephone interview could only learn from family members that the patient had been treated at another facility and had recovered.
20200608: A breast cancer case was diagnosed on 20150316, and the pathology report after surgery at this hospital described margin not free. The case received chemotherapy but did not complete it, and on 20150601 transferred to a southern branch hospital to continue treatment and did not return to this hospital for examination. At the five-year follow-up, since this hospital can access the branch hospital's medical records, the case was found to have recovered on various examinations on 20160331 and had no recurrence as of 20200608.
20221207: A stage III breast cancer case; the pathology report after surgery at this hospital on 20220403 described margin not free. The case received chemotherapy but had not completed it when, for personal reasons, the case transferred to another hospital and did not return to this hospital for examination. The case later visited the ophthalmology clinic at this hospital on 20221207, but there were no related cancer examinations or information.

fields.description_zh:
個案經病歷記載經過一段無病 (disease-free intermission)或緩解(remission) 期間，首次出現復發的型式。
欄位位置：347–348
fields.description_en:
Pattern of first recurrence of the case, as documented in the medical record, after a disease-free intermission or remission period.
Field position: 347–348
fields.purpose_zh: 評估治療的成效及預後因子。
fields.guide_zh:
 依據首次復發的型式予以登錄。首次復發有可能發生在個案剛完成首次治療時(well after)。 若個案從未disease-free(編碼70)，仍須持續追蹤以了解是否達到disease-free狀態。因為disease-free可能在完成首次治療或後續治療後才出現。 若個案是disease-free(編碼00)，則持續追蹤到復發發生為止。首次復發有可能發生在個案首次治療剛完成的時候。 首次復發時，主責醫師會針對個案執行全身性檢查，以確認所有復發型態，此時應將所有發現之復發型態合併摘錄。 一旦登錄首次復發(編碼04-62或88)後，即使此復發經治療後已disease-free且後續仍出現其他部位的復發或轉移，皆不須再登錄。 編碼00-70是有層級順序(hierarchical)，應以數字最大的情況編碼。例外:若局部或區域復發(編碼10-15、20-25或30)且合併多處遠端部位復發，應編碼為60。 若個案首次療程後疾病持續存在(編碼70)，但五年追蹤申報已disease-free (編碼00)，此時首次復發型式應更新為00。 若個案首次療程後已disease-free (編碼00)，後續於五年追蹤申報前發現有復發，應更新編碼為適當的復發型式。 若腫瘤最初診斷是原位癌，其復發的型式只能選擇06、16、17、26、27、36或46編碼。上述的編碼不適用於其他的腫瘤。 編碼00、88或99則可適用於任何腫瘤。 癌症有復發，但復發型式不詳應編碼為88。 例如：攝護腺癌的個案檢測PSA值後，若醫師於病歷上描述biochemical failure或是PSA failure，醫師視為復發，則復發型式應編碼為88。 雖然首次復發可能出現多處遠端部位轉移或播種(seeding)，但編碼51-59(遠端器官或系統的復發)僅適用於單一部位或系統復發。 若白血病在緩解期(remission)，則編碼為00；若為復發(relapse)，則編碼為59。 此欄位以申報醫院的資料為主。若無申報醫院資料，可參考外院資料。 若個案有超過一種原發腫瘤且主責醫師無法確定首次復發是那一腫瘤引起，則每種原發腫瘤都記錄為復發。若之後可確定發生復發之原發腫瘤，則須更新資料至合適之編碼。 於五年追蹤申報時，個案若已失去追蹤或一直未回診，且不確定五年後癌症是否disease-free或復發，則依據病歷上最後記載該癌症的狀態，應編碼為00或70。此時，個案該狀態之最後追蹤日期應編碼於「首次復發或癌症狀態追蹤日期」。範例：編碼：理由
52：乳癌治療後 disease free，一年後發現肺轉移。
62：大腸癌治療後 disease free，其後發現肝臟和肺臟轉移。
60：乳癌個案於20180102發現chest wall recurrence，即20180113開立醫囑安排abdominal CT 及 bone scan，並於 20180115 開始接受化學治療，個案在 20180227 才執行abdominal CT 及bone scan 檢查，檢查結果發現有肝臟轉移，bone scan 正常無骨轉移。編碼：理由
70：食道癌個案於 20150331確診後接受治療，但首次申報日前尚未 disease free。
00：卵巢癌個案於 20150308 確診後進行治療。於 20200330 進行滿五年追蹤電訪，個案已死亡。經回溯至 20161001 於病歷上記載 disease free 且持續回診至 20190123，且未曾復發，但 20190123之後個案就未再回診。
00：子宮體癌第二期個案於 20150409 確診，經本院手術治療後，病理報告描述 margin free。術後接受 adjuvant chemotherapy，後續轉回離家較近的醫院就近治療，故自20150610 後未再回診。
00：乳癌於20150316 確診，經本院手術後之病理報告描述 margin not free。個案接受化學治療未完成，即於 20150601 轉至南部分院繼續治療，且未再回本院檢查。後續進行滿五年追蹤，因本院可查閱分院病歷，此個案後續於 20160331 經各項檢查已痊癒，至20200608 未復發。
70：子宮體癌第二期個案於 20150406 確診，經手術治療後，病理報告描述 margin not free。後續醫師評估需做化療，但化療未完成，個案自 20151224 就未再回診治療。因進行滿五年追蹤，電訪個案僅能從家屬口中得知病人之前已於外院治療，且已痊癒。
70：20221207 乳癌第三期個案於 20220403 經本院手術後之病理報告描述 margin not free。個案接受化學治療但尚未完成，就因個人因素轉至其他醫院就醫，且未再回本院檢查。後續個案於 20221207 於本院看眼科，但無相關癌症檢查與資訊。
fields.purpose_en: Assesses treatment effectiveness and prognostic factors.
fields.guide_en:
• Record according to the type of first recurrence. The first recurrence may occur just after the patient completes the first course of treatment (well after). • If the patient has never been disease-free (code 70), continue follow-up to find out whether a disease-free state is reached, because disease-free status may appear only after the first or subsequent treatment is completed. • If the patient is disease-free (code 00), follow up until a recurrence occurs. The first recurrence may occur just when the patient's first treatment has been completed. • At the first recurrence, the attending physician will perform systemic examinations to confirm all recurrence types; all recurrence types found should then be abstracted together. • Once the first recurrence has been registered (code 04-62 or 88), no further registration is needed even if, after treatment, the patient becomes disease-free and recurrence or metastasis at other sites subsequently occurs. • Codes 00-70 are hierarchical (hierarchical); code the situation with the largest number. Exception: if there is local or regional recurrence (codes 10-15, 20-25 or 30) combined with recurrence at multiple distant sites, code 60. • If the disease persisted after the first course of treatment (code 70) but the patient is disease-free (code 00) at the five-year follow-up report, the type of first recurrence should be updated to 00. • If the patient was disease-free (code 00) after the first course of treatment and a recurrence is found before the five-year follow-up report, update the code to the appropriate recurrence type. • If the tumor was initially diagnosed as carcinoma in situ, its recurrence type may only be coded 06, 16, 17, 26, 27, 36 or 46. The above codes do not apply to other tumors. • Codes 00, 88 or 99 may apply to any tumor. • If the cancer has recurred but the recurrence type is unknown, code 88. • For example: for a prostate cancer patient whose PSA is tested, if the physician describes biochemical failure or PSA failure in the medical record and regards it as recurrence, the recurrence type should be coded 88. • Although the first recurrence may involve metastasis or seeding (seeding) at multiple distant sites, codes 51-59 (recurrence in a distant organ or system) apply only to recurrence at a single site or system. • If leukemia is in remission (remission), code 00; if it is a relapse (relapse), code 59. • This field is based mainly on data from the reporting hospital. If there are no reporting hospital data, data from another facility may be consulted. • If the patient has more than one primary tumor and the attending physician cannot determine which tumor caused the first recurrence, record recurrence for every primary tumor. If the primary tumor that recurred can later be determined, the data must be updated to the appropriate code. • At the five-year follow-up report, if the patient is lost to follow-up or has never returned, and it is uncertain whether the cancer is disease-free or recurrent after five years, code 00 or 70 according to the last status of that cancer recorded in the medical record. In this case, the last follow-up date of that status should be coded in the "Date of first recurrence or cancer status follow-up". Examples: Code: Reason
52: Disease free after breast cancer treatment; lung metastasis found one year later.
62: Disease free after colorectal cancer treatment; liver and lung metastases found subsequently.
60: A breast cancer patient had chest wall recurrence found on 20180102; an abdominal CT and bone scan were ordered on 20180113, and chemotherapy began on 20180115; the patient did not have the abdominal CT and bone scan until 20180227, which found liver metastasis, and the bone scan was normal with no bone metastasis. Code: Reason
70: An esophageal cancer patient was treated after diagnosis on 20150331 but was not yet disease free before the first report date.
00: An ovarian cancer patient was treated after diagnosis on 20150308. At the five-year follow-up telephone interview on 20200330, the patient had died. Reviewing back, the medical record on 20161001 documented disease free, and the patient continued to return until 20190123 with no recurrence, but did not return after 20190123.
00: A stage II corpus uteri cancer patient was diagnosed on 20150409 and treated surgically at this hospital, and the pathology report described margin free. After surgery the patient received adjuvant chemotherapy, then transferred to a hospital closer to home for treatment and did not return after 20150610.
00: Breast cancer was diagnosed on 20150316; the pathology report after surgery at this hospital described margin not free. The patient did not complete chemotherapy and transferred to a branch hospital in southern Taiwan on 20150601 to continue treatment, and did not return to this hospital for examination. At the subsequent five-year follow-up, because this hospital can access the branch hospital's medical records, the patient was found to have been cured on 20160331 by various examinations, with no recurrence up to 20200608.
70: A stage II corpus uteri cancer patient was diagnosed on 20150406 and treated surgically, and the pathology report described margin not free. The physician subsequently assessed that chemotherapy was needed, but chemotherapy was not completed, and the patient did not return for treatment after 20151224. At the five-year follow-up, the telephone interview with the patient could only learn from the family that the patient had been treated at another facility and was cured.
70: 20221207 A stage III breast cancer patient's pathology report after surgery at this hospital on 20220403 described margin not free. The patient received chemotherapy but did not complete it, transferred to another hospital for personal reasons, and did not return to this hospital for examination. The patient later visited ophthalmology at this hospital on 20221207, but there were no cancer-related examinations or information.

fields.name_en: Date of Last Contact or Death
fields.name_zh_en: Last Contact or Date of Death
fields.description_zh:
記錄個案的最後聯絡日期或是死亡日期。
欄位位置：349–356
fields.description_en:
Record the date of last contact or the date of death of the case.
Field position: 349–356
fields.purpose_zh: 作為個案追蹤和治療結果研究之用。
fields.guide_zh:
 記錄個案存活時的最後聯絡日期或是個案死亡的日期。 如個案患有多發癌症，則其每一癌症的「最後聯絡或死亡日期」都應一致。範例：編碼：案例
20040630：個案在民國 93年6月30日死亡。
20039999：個案的相關醫療記錄只記載於民國 92年死亡。
20050114：個案回覆追蹤信函中並無確切的日期資訊，但其信件上之郵戳日期為民國 94年1 月14日。
fields.purpose_en: Used for case follow-up and research on treatment outcomes.
fields.guide_en:
Record the date of last contact while the case was alive, or the date of death. If the case has multiple cancers, the "Date of last contact or death" should be the same for each cancer. Examples: Code: Case
20040630: The case died on June 30, ROC year 93 (2004).
20039999: The case's medical records document only that the case died in ROC year 92 (2003).
20050114: The case's reply to the follow-up letter contains no exact date, but the postmark date on the letter is January 14, ROC year 94 (2005).

fields.description_zh:
記錄個案「最後聯絡或死亡日期」的存活狀態。
欄位位置：357–357
fields.description_en:
Record the vital status of the case as of the “date of last contact or death”.
Field position: 357–357
fields.purpose_zh: 作為個案追蹤和治療結果研究之用。
fields.guide_zh:
 本欄位應配合「最後聯絡或死亡日期」一起收集資料。 如個案有多發癌症，則每一個癌症的存活狀態應一致。範例：編碼：案例及理由
0：由衛生署癌症登記中心之申報資料回饋機制中，確定個案已於去年死亡。
1：負責追蹤個案的醫師得到回信，回信中提到個案還存活。個案行政
fields.purpose_en: Used for case follow-up and research on treatment outcomes.
fields.guide_en:
Data for this field should be collected together with the "Date of last contact or death". If the case has multiple cancers, the survival status should be the same for each cancer. Examples: Code: Case and reason
0: Through the feedback mechanism of reports to the Cancer Registry of the Department of Health, it was determined that the case died last year.
1: The physician responsible for following the case received a reply letter stating that the case was still alive. Case administration

fields.description_zh:
記錄摘錄此癌症登記個案人員之癌症登記證照編號或姓名。
欄位位置：358–367
fields.description_en:
Record the cancer registrar license number or name of the person who abstracted this cancer registry case.
Field position: 358–367
fields.purpose_zh: 作為申報醫院內部於數名工作人員在資料庫之品質管控與管理。
fields.guide_zh:
 優先摘錄癌症登記技術人員進階級認證字號；若無進階認證字號，則摘錄癌症登記技術人員基礎級認證字號；若兩者認證皆無，則摘錄姓名。 編碼癌症登記技術人員進階級與基礎級認證字號共八碼：前三碼為民國年；第四碼為A(進階級)或B(基礎級)；後四碼為認證字號。例如1：林員通過癌症登記技術人員進階級認證，應記錄(105)癌登進證字第0001。例如2：林員僅通過癌症登記技術人員基礎級認證，應記錄(098)癌登基證字第0001號。例如3：林員未通過癌症登記技術人員基礎級及進階級認證，應記錄其姓名林OO。範例：編碼：案例
105B0001：林員通過癌症登記技術人員基礎級認證，摘錄者依據基礎認證字號為(105)癌登基證字第 0001號來編碼。
099A0108：陳員通過癌症登記記術人員進階級認證，摘錄者依據進階認證字號為(099)癌登進證字第 0108號來編碼。其他因子
fields.purpose_en: Used for quality control and management of the database by several staff members within the reporting hospital.
fields.guide_en:
Abstract the cancer registrar's advanced-level certification number first; if there is no advanced certification number, abstract the cancer registrar's basic-level certification number; if neither certification exists, abstract the name. The cancer registrar's advanced-level and basic-level certification numbers have eight digits: the first three are the ROC year; the fourth is A (advanced level) or B (basic level); the last four are the certification number. Example 1: Registrar Lin passed the cancer registrar advanced-level certification; record "(105) Cancer Registry Advanced Certificate No. 0001" (ROC year 105, advanced level). Example 2: Registrar Lin passed only the cancer registrar basic-level certification; record "(098) Cancer Registry Basic Certificate No. 0001" (ROC year 98, basic level). Example 3: Registrar Lin has not passed the cancer registrar basic-level or advanced-level certification; record the name, Lin OO. Examples: Code: Case
105B0001: Registrar Lin passed the cancer registrar basic-level certification, and the abstractor codes according to the basic certification number "(105) Cancer Registry Basic Certificate No. 0001" (ROC year 105 (2016)).
099A0108: Registrar Chen passed the cancer registrar advanced-level certification, and the abstractor codes according to the advanced certification number "(099) Cancer Registry Advanced Certificate No. 0108" (ROC year 99 (2010)). Other factors

fields.description_zh:
記錄個案於首次治療前的身高。
欄位位置：368–370
fields.description_en:
Record the height of the case before first treatment.
Field position: 368–370
fields.purpose_zh: 肥胖是致癌的危險因子，為瞭解個案肥胖狀態，需得知個案身體質量指數(BMI)，而身高是計算BMI所需數值。
fields.guide_zh:  記錄個案於癌症首次療程前一年內，最近一次病歷所記載身高的資料。 請直接摘錄個案的身高數值並四捨五入至個位數。 身高小於100cm：四捨五入後不足三碼者請補 0；例如身高75.3cm，編碼075。 身高大於100cm：四捨五入後滿三碼者請直接摘錄；例如身高102.5cm，編碼103。
fields.purpose_en: Obesity is a carcinogenic risk factor. To understand the case's obesity status, the body mass index (BMI) is needed, and height is a value required to calculate BMI.
fields.guide_en: • Record the height from the most recent medical record within one year before the first course of cancer treatment. • Abstract the case's height value directly and round it to the integer. • Height less than 100 cm: if the rounded value has fewer than three digits, pad with 0; for example, height 75.3 cm is coded 075. • Height greater than 100 cm: if the rounded value has three digits, abstract it directly; for example, height 102.5 cm is coded 103.

fields.description_zh:
記錄個案於首次治療前的體重。
欄位位置：371–373
fields.description_en:
Record the body weight of the case before first treatment.
Field position: 371–373
fields.purpose_zh: 肥胖是致癌的危險因子，為瞭解個案肥胖狀態，需得知個案身體質量指數(BMI)，而體重是計算BMI所需數值。
fields.guide_zh:  記錄個案於癌症首次療程前一年內，最近一次病歷所記載體重的資料。 請直接摘錄個案的體重數值並四捨五入至個位數。 體重小於100kg：四捨五入後不足三碼者請補 0；例如體重75.3kg，編碼075。 體重大於100kg：四捨五入後滿三碼者請直接摘錄；例如體重102.5kg，編碼103。
fields.purpose_en: Obesity is a carcinogenic risk factor. To understand the case's obesity status, the body mass index (BMI) is needed, and weight is a value required to calculate BMI.
fields.guide_en: • Record the patient's body weight as documented in the most recent medical record within one year before the first course of treatment of the cancer.• Abstract the patient's weight value directly, rounded to a whole number.• Weight less than 100 kg: if the rounded value has fewer than three digits, pad with 0; for example, a weight of 75.3 kg is coded 075.• Weight of 100 kg or more: if the rounded value has three digits, abstract it directly; for example, a weight of 102.5 kg is coded 103.

fields.description_zh:
記錄個案於最初診斷日前的吸菸行為。
欄位位置：374–379
fields.description_en:
Record the smoking behavior of the case before the date of initial diagnosis.
Field position: 374–379
fields.purpose_zh: 吸菸是致癌的危險因子。
fields.guide_zh:  記錄個案於最初診斷日前一年內，最近一次病歷所記載吸菸行為的資料。 若病歷無記載個案於最初診斷日前吸菸資訊，則摘錄癌症首次療程前最近一次病歷所記載之吸菸資訊。 此欄位共6碼，說明如下： 1-2碼為每日吸菸量(以支為單位)；每日吸菸量≧90支，編碼90。 3-4碼為吸菸年。 5-6碼為戒菸年；但戒菸時間如未達1個月(30天)者，則視為未戒菸。 若吸菸量、吸菸年、戒菸年等資訊有小數點者，皆採無條件進位。例如：吸菸1.3 年，吸菸年編碼為 02。 若吸菸量、吸菸年、戒菸年等資訊僅有粗略值，應摘錄最大值。例如1：每日吸菸量 5-6支、吸菸 3-5年、戒菸1-2年，則編碼 060502。例如2：每日吸菸量＞6支、吸菸＞5年、戒菸＞2年，則編碼 060502。 若病歷僅記載吸菸(+)但未有數值者，編碼989800；從未吸菸者，編碼000088(不適用)。 病歷未記載或吸菸狀態完全不詳者，應編碼999999。此欄位共6碼，說明如下：舉例：
fields.purpose_en: Smoking is a carcinogenic risk factor.
fields.guide_en: Record the smoking behavior recorded in the most recent medical record within one year before the date of initial diagnosis. If the medical record has no smoking information before the date of initial diagnosis, abstract the smoking information recorded in the most recent medical record before the first course of treatment of the cancer. This field has 6 digits, as follows: digits 1-2 are the daily amount smoked (in cigarettes); if the daily amount is ≧90 cigarettes, code 90. Digits 3-4 are the years of smoking. Digits 5-6 are the years since quitting; if the time since quitting is less than 1 month (30 days), the case is regarded as not having quit. If information such as amount smoked, years of smoking or years since quitting has a decimal point, always round up. For example: smoking for 1.3 years is coded 02 for years of smoking. If information such as amount smoked, years of smoking or years since quitting is only a rough range, abstract the maximum value. Example 1: daily amount 5-6 cigarettes, smoked 3-5 years, quit 1-2 years: code 060502. Example 2: daily amount >6 cigarettes, smoked >5 years, quit >2 years: code 060502. If the medical record states only smoking (+) without values, code 989800; for never smokers, code 000088 (not applicable). If the medical record does not document it or the smoking status is completely unknown, code 999999. This field has 6 digits, as follows: Example:

fields.purpose_zh: 嚼檳榔是致癌的危險因子。
fields.guide_zh:  記錄個案於最初診斷日前一年內，最近一次病歷所記載嚼檳榔行為的資料。 若病歷無記載個案於最初診斷日前嚼檳榔資訊，則摘錄癌症首次療程前最近一次病歷所記載之嚼檳榔資訊。 此欄位共6碼，說明如下： 1-2碼為每日嚼檳榔量(以顆為單位)；每日嚼檳榔量≧90顆，編碼90。 3-4碼為嚼檳榔年。 5-6碼為戒檳榔年；但戒嚼檳榔時間如未達1個月(30天)者，則視為未戒嚼檳榔。 若嚼檳榔量、嚼檳榔年、戒嚼檳榔年等資訊有小數點者，皆採無條件進位。例如：嚼檳榔 1.3年，嚼檳榔年編碼為 02。 若嚼檳榔量、嚼檳榔年、戒嚼檳榔年等資訊僅有粗略值，應摘錄最大值。例如1：每日嚼檳榔 5-6顆、嚼檳榔 3-5年、戒嚼檳榔1-2年，則編碼060502。例如2：每日嚼檳榔＞6顆、嚼檳榔＞5年、戒嚼檳榔＞2年，則編碼060502。 若病歷僅記載嚼檳榔(+)但未有數值者，編碼989800；從未嚼檳榔者，編碼000088(不適用)。 病歷未記載或嚼檳榔狀態完全不詳者，應編碼999999。此欄位共6碼，說明如下：舉例：
fields.purpose_en: Betel quid chewing is a carcinogenic risk factor.
fields.guide_en: Record the case's betel nut chewing data as documented in the most recent medical record within one year before the date of initial diagnosis. If the medical record has no betel nut chewing information before the date of initial diagnosis, abstract the betel nut chewing information documented in the most recent medical record before the first course of cancer treatment. This field has 6 digits, explained as follows: Digits 1-2: daily betel nut quantity (in units of pieces); if the daily quantity is ≧90 pieces, code 90. Digits 3-4: years of betel nut chewing. Digits 5-6: years since quitting betel nut; if the time since quitting is less than 1 month (30 days), the case is regarded as not having quit. If the betel nut quantity, years of chewing, years since quitting, etc. contain decimals, always round up. For example: chewing betel nut for 1.3 years, code the years of chewing as 02. If the betel nut quantity, years of chewing, years since quitting, etc. are only rough values, abstract the maximum value. Example 1: daily betel nut 5-6 pieces, chewing for 3-5 years, quit for 1-2 years: code 060502. Example 2: daily betel nut >6 pieces, chewing >5 years, quit >2 years: code 060502. If the medical record only records betel nut chewing (+) without values, code 989800; for a case who never chewed betel nut, code 000088 (not applicable). If the medical record has no record or the betel nut chewing status is completely unknown, code 999999. This field has 6 digits, explained as follows: Examples:

fields.name_zh: 首次治療前生活功能狀態評估
fields.name_en: Assessment of Performance Status before Treatment
fields.description_zh:
記錄醫師於首次治療前最近一次評估個案的生活功能狀態。
欄位位置：389–391
fields.description_en:
Record the functional (performance) status of the case as most recently assessed by the physician before first treatment.
Field position: 389–391
fields.purpose_zh: 本項目的資料可作為訂定個案治療計畫參考之用。
fields.guide_zh:
 自2018年起之新診斷個案需申報此欄位。 記錄醫師於首次治療前最近一次評估個案的生活功能狀態。 首次治療前生活功能狀態的評估以臨床主責醫師為主，其次為其他科別的醫師。 未治療個案，持續於院內追蹤時，可能進行多次生活功能狀態評估，登錄時請以判定臨床期別時的評估值為主。 生活功能狀態評估採三碼登記，各依實際狀況進行組合編碼：第一、二碼表示使用KPS (Karnofsky Scale)評估值、第三碼表示使用ECOG (Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group) Performance Status評估值；詳細編碼規則請參考下列對應表。 若病歷僅記載KPS評估值，且ECOG PS未評估(第三碼應編碼為9)，則KPS定義與對應編碼如下所示。注意：KPS=100且ECOG PS=0或ECOG未評估，應編碼為100；KPS=0等同ECOG PS =5，應編碼為005。 若病歷僅記載ECOG PS評估值，且KPS未評估(第一、二碼應編碼為0)，則ECOG PS定義與對應編碼如下所示： 若病歷同時記載KPS與ECOG PS評估值，請依對應位置(第1、2碼KPS，第3碼ECOG PS)與下表定義進行組合編碼： 若病歷記載生活功能狀態評估為一範圍值，而非單一數值，請以嚴重度高的數值編碼。例如1：若病歷上記載KPS為70-80，ECOG PS未評估，請依KPS=70編碼為709。例如2：若病歷上記載ECOG PS為1-2，KPS未評估，請依ECOG PS=2編碼為002。 KPS和ECOG PS評估結果若有不一致，請以生活功能狀態評估嚴重度高的數值編碼。例如：KPS為60，ECOG PS為1，則編碼為609。KPS為70，ECOG PS為3，則編碼為003。範例：編碼：案例
702：病歷中記載KPS評估值為70，ECOG PS評估值為2。
005：病歷中記載KPS評估值為0，ECOG PS評估值為5。
988：乳癌個案於外院進行改良式根除乳房切除術後，僅攜帶病理報告到本院，病歷中未呈現外院生活功能狀態評估值。癌症部位特定因子
fields.purpose_en: The data in this item can be used as a reference for formulating the case's treatment plan.
fields.guide_en:
• Cases newly diagnosed from 2018 onward must report this field.• Record the patient's performance status as most recently assessed by a physician before the first treatment.• The assessment of performance status before the first treatment is based on the attending clinical physician first, then physicians of other specialties.• For untreated patients who continue to be followed in the hospital, performance status may be assessed several times; when registering, use mainly the assessment made at the time the clinical stage was determined.• Performance status is registered with three digits, each combined according to the actual situation: the first and second digits represent the KPS (Karnofsky Scale) value, and the third digit represents the ECOG (Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group) Performance Status value; for detailed coding rules, see the corresponding tables below.• If the medical record documents only the KPS value and ECOG PS was not assessed (the third digit should be coded 9), the KPS definitions and corresponding codes are as shown below. Note: KPS=100 with ECOG PS=0 or ECOG not assessed should be coded 100; KPS=0 is equivalent to ECOG PS=5 and should be coded 005.• If the medical record documents only the ECOG PS value and KPS was not assessed (the first and second digits should be coded 0), the ECOG PS definitions and corresponding codes are as shown below:• If the medical record documents both KPS and ECOG PS values, combine the codes by position (digits 1-2 KPS, digit 3 ECOG PS) according to the definitions in the table below:• If the medical record documents the performance status as a range rather than a single value, code the value with the greater severity. Example 1: If the medical record states KPS 70-80 and ECOG PS was not assessed, code according to KPS=70 as 709. Example 2: If the medical record states ECOG PS 1-2 and KPS was not assessed, code according to ECOG PS=2 as 002.• If the KPS and ECOG PS results are inconsistent, code the value with the greater severity of performance status. For example: KPS 60 and ECOG PS 1 is coded 609. KPS 70 and ECOG PS 3 is coded 003. Examples: Code: Case
702: The medical record documents a KPS value of 70 and an ECOG PS value of 2.
005: The medical record documents a KPS value of 0 and an ECOG PS value of 5.
988: A patient with breast cancer underwent modified radical mastectomy at another facility and brought only the pathology report to this hospital; the medical record does not show the performance status assessment from the other facility.Site-specific factors

entries.label_zh: 未於申報醫院接受任何治療即死亡： 申報醫院診斷後死亡或病危出院。 他院診斷，轉診至申報醫院後死亡。
entries.label_en: Died without receiving any treatment at the reporting hospital: died or discharged in critical condition after diagnosis at the reporting hospital. Diagnosed at another hospital and died after referral to the reporting hospital.

entries.label_zh:  僅於申報醫院接受首次療程(首次療程定義詳見總論及指引)，未於他院接受任何首次療程。 首次療程接受其他治療(other treatment)。
entries.label_en: Received the first course of treatment only at the reporting hospital (see the general introduction and guidelines for the definition of first course of treatment), and did not receive any first course of treatment at another hospital. Received other treatment (other treatment) as the first course of treatment.

entries.label_zh: 未於申報醫院接受任何首次療程： 僅於他院接受首次療程。 於申報醫院診斷，但至他院接受後續診療，其首次療程內容不詳。 於他院診斷未治療，至申報醫院諮詢第二意見。主要癌症治療計畫由他院規劃： 接受首次療程後維持輔助性荷爾蒙治療(maintenance adjuvant hormonal therapy)或維持性口服性化療。 因為原轉介醫院放射治療設備不足，接受委託局部追加放射治療，且放射治療模式為其他放射療法 (Other RT)，如brachytherapy, radiosurgery, proton...等。 因為原轉介醫院放射治療設備在療程中途故障，為避免延誤療程，接受委託執行部分放射治療。 維持性口服性化療。
entries.label_en: Did not receive any first course of treatment at the reporting hospital: received the first course of treatment only at another hospital. Diagnosed at the reporting hospital but went to another hospital for subsequent care, with the content of the first course of treatment unknown. Diagnosed at another hospital without treatment and came to the reporting hospital for a second opinion. The main cancer treatment plan is made by another hospital: maintenance adjuvant hormonal therapy or maintenance oral chemotherapy after the first course of treatment. Because the originally referring hospital had insufficient radiation therapy equipment, entrusted local boost radiation therapy was received, with the radiation therapy mode being other radiation therapy (Other RT), such as brachytherapy, radiosurgery, proton...etc. Because the originally referring hospital's radiation therapy equipment broke down mid-course, entrusted partial radiation therapy was performed to avoid delaying the course. Maintenance oral chemotherapy.

entries.label_zh:  於申報醫院接受部分首次療程，也於他院接受部分首次療程。 申報醫院委託他院執行部分放射治療。
entries.label_en: Received part of the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital and part at another hospital. The reporting hospital entrusted another hospital to perform part of the radiation therapy.

entries.label_zh:  首次療程為不予治療或是再密切觀察(Watchful observation)。 首次療程僅給予非腫瘤切除之緩和性手術、疼痛控制、支持療法、轉介安寧照護。
entries.label_en: First course of treatment was no treatment or close observation (Watchful observation). First course of treatment was only palliative surgery without tumor resection, pain control, supportive care, or referral to hospice care.

entries.label_zh: 首次療程僅有另類治療。
entries.label_en: First course of treatment was alternative treatment only.

entries.label_zh: 首次療程為個案拒絕治療。
entries.label_en: First course of treatment was refused by the case.

entries.label_zh: 他院診斷及治療，因癌症或其治療的『併發症』至申報醫院求診(In-transit services for care、such as chemotherapy induced leukopenic fever、tumor bleeding and etc.)。
entries.label_en: Diagnosed and treated at another hospital; visited the reporting hospital because of 'complications' of the cancer or its treatment (In-transit services for care, such as chemotherapy induced leukopenic fever, tumor bleeding and etc.).

entries.label_zh: 他院診斷個案，為了其他疾病至申報醫院求診。(不需申報)
entries.label_en: Case diagnosed at another hospital, visiting the reporting hospital for another disease. (No report required)

entries.label_zh: 首次療程不詳，也無法確認個案拒絕治療： 於申報醫院初診斷後個案失聯 他院診斷及治療
entries.label_en: First course of treatment unknown, and refusal of treatment by the case cannot be confirmed: lost to contact after initial diagnosis at the reporting hospital; diagnosed and treated at another hospital

entries.label_zh: 個案因此癌症至申報醫院門診或住院之最早日期。前4碼是西元年，第5、6碼是月，而最後 2碼是日。
entries.label_en: Earliest date the case visited the outpatient clinic or was hospitalized at the reporting hospital for this cancer. The first 4 digits are the AD year, digits 5-6 the month, and the last 2 digits the day.

entries.label_zh: 最初診斷日期是指此癌症最早被醫師診斷的日期。前 4碼是西元年，第5、6碼是月，而最後 2碼是日。
entries.label_en: The initial diagnosis date is the date this cancer was first diagnosed by a physician. The first 4 digits are the AD year, digits 5-6 the month, and the last 2 digits the day.
Not a paired organ.
Primary originates on the right side.
Primary originates on the left side.

entries.label_zh: 成對器官，只有單側侵犯，但起源於左側或右側則不清楚。
entries.label_en: Paired organ with unilateral involvement only, but whether it originated on the left or right is unclear.

entries.label_zh: 成對器官，雙側侵犯但起源之側位不清楚，且病歷描述是單一原發。較少見，如下： 雙側卵巢同時有單一組織類型或不同epithelial組織型態(8000-8799)之腫瘤侵犯。 雙側乳房同時有發炎性乳癌(inflammatory breast cancer)。 雙側同時有視網膜芽細胞瘤(retinoblastomas)。 雙側同時有Wilm腫瘤(Wilm tumors)。 雙側瀰漫性肺部結節。
entries.label_en: Paired organs, with bilateral involvement but the side of origin unclear, and the medical record describes a single primary. Less common, as follows: bilateral ovaries simultaneously involved by tumors of a single histologic type or of different epithelial histologic types (8000-8799). Bilateral breasts simultaneously with inflammatory breast cancer. Bilateral retinoblastomas simultaneously. Bilateral Wilm tumors simultaneously. Bilateral diffuse lung nodules.

entries.label_zh:  原發部位為以下部位且為身體中線的腫瘤。 C700,C710-C714,C722-C725,C443,C444,C445
entries.label_en: Primary site is one of the following and the tumor is on the body midline. C700,C710-C714,C722-C725,C443,C444,C445

entries.label_zh:  成對器官，但其側位不清楚。
entries.label_en: Paired organ, but the side is unclear.

entries.label_en: Differentiation/grade unknown, not recorded in the medical record. No grade/differentiation before first treatment. Cancer diagnosed only after surgery

High grade dysplasia (severe dysplasia) For Ovary borderline tumor

entries.label_en: Not applicable: For Use in All Histologies

entries.label_zh:  分化/分級不明、病歷未記載。 原發部位未接受手術。 術前已經接受前導性治療(Neoadjuvant therapy)，後續再接受手術，術後病理報告描述為無殘餘腫瘤(no residual tumor)。
entries.label_en: Differentiation/grade unknown, not documented in the medical record. No surgery to the primary site. Neoadjuvant therapy was given before surgery, and the postoperative pathology report describes no residual tumor.

entries.label_zh: 組織病理學確診(Positive histology) 經顯微鏡檢證實，檢查方式為組織病理。
entries.label_en: Positive histology: confirmed by microscopic examination, with histopathology as the method of examination.

entries.label_zh: 細胞學確診(Positive cytology) 經顯微鏡檢證實，檢查方式為細胞學診斷。
entries.label_en: Positive cytology: confirmed by microscopic examination, with cytology as the method of examination.

entries.label_zh: 經顯微鏡檢證實，但未描述其確診方式 經顯微鏡檢證實，但不知為組織病理或是細胞學診斷。
entries.label_en: Confirmed by microscopic examination, but the method of confirmation is not described. Confirmed by microscopic examination, but unknown whether histopathology or cytology.

entries.label_zh: 實驗室檢驗/腫瘤標記檢查為陽性，但未經 顯 微 鏡 檢 證 實 (Positive laboratory test/marker study) 診斷依據為某些特定癌症臨床診斷用之實驗室檢驗/腫瘤標記的臨床確診方式。
entries.label_en: Positive laboratory test/tumor marker study but not confirmed by microscopic examination (Positive laboratory test/marker study). The basis of diagnosis is the clinical confirmation method using laboratory tests/tumor markers for the clinical diagnosis of certain specific cancers.

entries.label_zh: 直接察看診斷為癌症，但未經顯微鏡檢證實 僅由手術或內視鏡方式察看腫瘤，但並未切除腫瘤組織以供顯微鏡檢查。
entries.label_en: Direct visualization diagnosed cancer but not confirmed by microscopic examination. The tumor was viewed only by surgery or endoscopy, without resecting tumor tissue for microscopic examination.

entries.label_zh: 放射線或其他影像學檢查診斷為癌症，但未經顯微鏡檢證實 診斷依據為醫師僅由影像學檢查報告而判斷個案患有癌症。
entries.label_en: Radiologic or other imaging diagnosis of cancer, not confirmed by microscopic examination. The basis of diagnosis is the physician's judgment, from imaging reports alone, that the case has cancer.

entries.label_zh: 僅臨床診斷(不包含 5、6、7) 診斷依據為醫師於病歷上記載個案罹患癌症請參考第一部份「含糊不清字彙」之說明。
entries.label_en: Clinical diagnosis only (excluding 5, 6, 7). The basis of diagnosis is the physician's record in the medical record that the case has cancer; refer to the explanation of "ambiguous terms" in Part 1.

entries.label_zh: 不清楚是否經顯微鏡檢證實 病歷記載個案患有癌症，但未記錄其癌症確診方式(通常為個案分類 3者)。
entries.label_en: Unclear whether confirmed by microscopic examination. The medical record states the case has cancer but does not record the method of cancer confirmation (usually case category 3).

entries.label_zh: 組織病理學確診(Positive histology) 組織病理確診(組織標本經顯微鏡檢查)。
entries.label_en: Positive histology: histopathologic confirmation (tissue specimen examined under the microscope).

entries.label_zh: 細胞學確診(Positive cytology) 細胞學確診(液體細胞經顯微鏡檢查，並沒有組織標本經顯微鏡檢查)。
entries.label_en: Positive cytology: cytologic confirmation (fluid cells examined under the microscope, with no tissue specimen examined under the microscope).

entries.label_zh: 組織病理學確診加上免疫表現分型(immunophenotyping) 陽性同時/或基因(genetic)檢測為陽性 組織學確定為惡性，且免疫表現分型(immunophenotyping)同時/或基因(genetic)檢測結果為陽性。例如：Acute myeloid leukemia經bone marrow檢查為 Acute myeloid leukemia，編碼9861/3；加上基因(genetic)檢測 AML with inv(16)(p13;1q22)，編碼9871/3。
entries.label_en: Histopathologic confirmation plus positive immunophenotyping and/or positive genetic testing. Malignancy is confirmed histologically, and immunophenotyping and/or genetic testing results are positive. For example: Acute myeloid leukemia confirmed as Acute myeloid leukemia on bone marrow examination, code 9861/3; plus genetic testing AML with inv(16)(p13;1q22), code 9871/3.

entries.label_zh: 經顯微鏡檢證實，但未描述其確診方式 經顯微鏡檢證實，但不知為組織病理或是細胞學診斷。
entries.label_en: Confirmed by microscopic examination, but the method of confirmation is not described. Confirmed by microscopic examination, but unknown whether histopathology or cytology.

entries.label_zh: 實驗室檢驗/腫瘤標記檢查為陽性(Positive laboratory test/marker study)或免疫表現分型(immunophenotyping) 陽性同時/或基因(genetic)檢測為陽性 診斷依據為某些特定癌症臨床診斷用之實驗室檢驗/腫瘤標記的臨床確診方式。
entries.label_en: Positive laboratory test/tumor marker study (Positive laboratory test/marker study) or positive immunophenotyping, and/or positive genetic testing. The basis of diagnosis is the clinical confirmation method using laboratory tests/tumor markers for the clinical diagnosis of certain specific cancers.

entries.label_zh: 直接察看診斷為癌症，但未經顯微鏡檢證實 僅由手術或內視鏡方式察看腫瘤，但並未切除腫瘤組織以供顯微鏡檢查。
entries.label_en: Direct visualization diagnosed cancer but not confirmed by microscopic examination. The tumor was viewed only by surgery or endoscopy, without resecting tumor tissue for microscopic examination.

entries.label_zh: 放射線或其他影像學檢查診斷為癌症，但未經顯微鏡檢證實 診斷依據為醫師僅由影像學檢查報告而判斷個案患有癌症。
entries.label_en: Radiologic or other imaging diagnosis of cancer, not confirmed by microscopic examination. The basis of diagnosis is the physician's judgment, from imaging reports alone, that the case has cancer.

entries.label_zh: 僅臨床診斷(不包含5、6、7) 診斷依據為醫師於病歷上記載個案罹患癌症。
entries.label_en: Clinical diagnosis only (excluding 5, 6, 7). The basis of diagnosis is the physician's record in the medical record that the case has cancer.

entries.label_zh: 不清楚是否經顯微鏡檢證實 病歷記載個案患有癌症，但未記錄其癌症確診方式(通常為不可分析的個案)。
entries.label_en: Unclear whether confirmed by microscopic examination. The medical record states the case has cancer but does not record the method of cancer confirmation (usually non-analytic cases).

entries.label_en: No tumor found, for example: no tumor found at the primary site, but metastatic cancer is already present.

Extensive stage disease: Any extent of disease beyond limited stage (including lymph nodes, brain, liver, bone marrow, and intra-abdominal and soft tissue metastasis).

Stage I with All of the following: Hb > 10 g/dL Serum calcium normal < 12 mg/dL Bone x-ray: normal bone structure or solitary bone plasmacytoma only Low M-component production rate IgG value < 5g/dL IgA value < 3 g/dL Bence Jones protein < 4 g/24 h

entries.label_zh:  記錄個案在任何醫療機構內開始首次治療療程(包括手術、放射治療、全身性治療、局部藥物治療、其他治療的日期)。 記錄積極監測或予以密切觀察(Active surveillance or watchful waiting)，則記錄決定予以密切觀察之日期為首次療程開始日期。 記錄經討論後決定不治療的日期。 若個案在治療計畫擬定前即死亡或病危出院，則此欄位記錄其死亡日期或病危出院日期。
entries.label_en: Records the date the first course of treatment began at any healthcare facility (including the dates of surgery, radiation therapy, systemic therapy, local drug therapy, and other treatment). For active surveillance or watchful waiting, records the date the decision for close observation was made as the start date of the first course of treatment. Records the date it was decided after discussion not to treat. If the case died or was discharged in critical condition before a treatment plan was made, this field records the date of death or the date of critical discharge.
