entries.label_en: A site other than the primary tumor was resected. A site other than the primary tumor was resected, but it is unknown whether this site is regional or distant.

entries.label_zh: 有切除原發腫瘤外的部位，且此部位是屬於區域性的。 切除區域性部位組織或器官。
entries.label_en: A site other than the primary tumor was resected, and this site is regional. Regional site tissue or organ resected.

entries.label_zh: 有切除原發腫瘤外的部位，且此部位是屬於遠端淋巴結。 切除遠端淋巴結。
entries.label_en: A site other than the primary tumor was resected, and this site is a distant lymph node. Distant lymph node resected.

entries.label_zh: 有切除原發腫瘤外的部位，且此部位是屬於遠端部位。 切除遠端部位。
entries.label_en: A site other than the primary tumor was resected, and this site is a distant site. Distant site resected.

entries.label_zh: 上列手術術式編碼2或3或4的任一組合。 上列手術術式編碼 2或3或4的任一組合。
entries.label_en: Any combination of surgical procedure codes 2, 3 or 4 listed above. Any combination of surgical procedure codes 2, 3 or 4 listed above.

entries.label_zh: 不詳。  不清楚是否有執行非原發腫瘤部位切除手術。 僅由死亡證明書得知個案有癌症。
entries.label_en: Unknown.  Unclear whether resection of a site other than the primary tumor was performed. Cancer known only from the death certificate.

entries.label_zh: 右側大腸癌個案，接受手術切除，在手術過程中，順便(incidental)把盲腸也切除。
entries.label_en: A right-sided colon cancer case underwent surgical resection, and the cecum was also resected incidentally during the operation.

entries.label_zh: 原發部位不詳，手術移除肝轉移病灶。
entries.label_en: Unknown primary site; liver metastasis removed surgically.

entries.label_zh: 大腸癌個案，原發部位直接侵犯至肝臟，外科切除手術時一併切除肝臟轉移的癌症。
entries.label_en: Colorectal cancer case, with the primary site directly invading the liver; at surgical resection, the cancer metastatic to the liver was resected together.

entries.label_zh: 切除肺臟轉移到腦部的單顆轉移癌。
entries.label_en: Resection of a single lung metastasis to the brain.

entries.label_zh: 切除肛門癌轉移到肝臟的轉移癌和一顆大的肝門淋巴結轉移癌。
entries.label_en: Resection of liver metastases from anal cancer and a large hilar lymph node metastasis.

entries.label_zh: 個案因下背疼痛，接受 laminectomy，病理組織證實為轉移性癌症。
entries.label_en: The case underwent laminectomy for lower back pain, and the pathological tissue confirmed metastatic cancer.

entries.label_zh: 個案因下背疼痛，接受腰椎骨切片及 vertebroplasty，病理組織證實為轉移性癌症。
entries.label_en: The case underwent lumbar vertebra biopsy and vertebroplasty for lower back pain, and the pathological tissue confirmed metastatic cancer.

entries.label_zh: 肝癌個案(C22.0)，且直接侵犯(direct invasion)橫膈膜(diaphragm)，接受肝腫瘤切除手術時一併切除橫膈膜腫瘤。
entries.label_en: A liver cancer case (C22.0) with direct invasion of the diaphragm; the diaphragmatic tumor was resected together at liver tumor resection.

Surgical Procedure/Other Site at this Fa.field_zh: 申報醫院其他部位手術方式
Surgical Procedure/Other Site at this Fa.field_en: Surgical Procedure/Other Site at this Facility

entries.label_zh: 未切除原發腫瘤外的部位。  未切除原發腫瘤外的部位。 個案由屍體解剖時才診斷為癌症。
entries.label_en: No resection of sites other than the primary tumor.  No resection of sites other than the primary tumor. Cancer diagnosed only at autopsy.

entries.label_zh: 有切除原發腫瘤外的部位。 切除原發腫瘤外的部位，但不知道此部位是屬於區域性或是遠端。
entries.label_en: A site other than the primary tumor was resected. A site other than the primary tumor was resected, but it is unknown whether this site is regional or distant.

entries.label_zh: 有切除原發腫瘤外的部位，且此部位是屬於區域性的。 切除區域性部位組織或器官。
entries.label_en: A site other than the primary tumor was resected, and this site is regional. Regional site tissue or organ resected.

entries.label_zh: 有切除原發腫瘤外的部位，且此部位是屬於遠端淋巴結。 切除遠端淋巴結。
entries.label_en: A site other than the primary tumor was resected, and this site is a distant lymph node. Distant lymph node resected.

entries.label_zh: 有切除原發腫瘤外的部位，且此部位是屬於遠端部位。 切除遠端部位。
entries.label_en: A site other than the primary tumor was resected, and this site is a distant site. Distant site resected.

entries.label_zh: 上列手術術式編碼2或3或4的任一組合。 上列手術術式編碼 2或3或4的任一組合。
entries.label_en: Any combination of surgical procedure codes 2, 3 or 4 listed above. Any combination of surgical procedure codes 2, 3 or 4 listed above.

entries.label_zh: 不詳。  不清楚是否有執行非原發腫瘤部位切除手術。 僅由死亡證明書得知個案有癌症。
entries.label_en: Unknown.  Unclear whether resection of a site other than the primary tumor was performed. Cancer known only from the death certificate.

Reason for No Surgery of Primary Site.field_en: Reason for No Surgery of Primary Site

entries.label_zh: 個案在首次療程中接受手術治療。
entries.label_en: The case received surgical treatment in the first course of treatment.

entries.label_zh: 手術治療非既定之首次療程計畫中的一部分。
entries.label_en: Surgical treatment was not part of the planned first course of treatment.

entries.label_zh: 手術治療因禁忌症或個案其他危險因素(併發症、年邁)而未建議或給予。
entries.label_en: Surgical treatment was not recommended or given because of contraindications or other risk factors of the case (complications, advanced age).

entries.label_zh: 手術治療因疾病進展而未建議或給予。
entries.label_en: Surgery was not recommended or given because of disease progression.

entries.label_zh: 手術治療是既定之首次療程計畫中的一部分，但因個案未接受前即死亡或病危出院。
entries.label_en: Surgical treatment was part of the planned first course of treatment, but the case died or was discharged in critical condition before receiving it.

entries.label_zh: 手術治療雖然是既定之首次療程計畫中的一部分，未執行且病歷也未記載未執行的原因。
entries.label_en: Surgical treatment was part of the planned first course of treatment, but was not performed and the medical record does not state the reason.

entries.label_zh: 手術治療雖然是既定之首次療程計畫中的一部分，但病歷記載個案或其家屬拒絕。
entries.label_en: Surgical treatment was part of the planned first course of treatment, but the medical record states that the case or family refused it.

entries.label_zh: 手術治療雖然是既定之首次療程計畫中的一部分，但摘錄時尚未執行。
entries.label_en: Surgical treatment was part of the planned first course of treatment, but had not yet been performed at the time of abstraction.

entries.label_zh:  由於病歷未記載，所以不知道原發腫瘤手術是否有被建議或是已經執行。 個案由屍體解剖而診斷為癌症。 僅由死亡證明書得知個案有癌症。
entries.label_en: The medical record does not document whether primary tumor surgery was recommended or performed, so it is unknown. Cancer diagnosed by autopsy. Cancer known only from the death certificate.

entries.label_zh: 肝癌個案，因為有嚴重的肝硬化，所以不建議手術治療。
entries.label_en: Hepatocellular carcinoma case; surgical treatment was not recommended because of severe cirrhosis.

entries.label_zh: 胃癌個案，建議轉至他院做胃切除手術，此個案到他院的後續情況及相關資訊並不清楚。
entries.label_en: A gastric cancer case was advised to transfer to another hospital for gastrectomy; the subsequent course and related information at the other hospital are unclear.

RT Target Summary.field_zh: 放射治療臨床標靶體積摘要

entries.label_zh: Unknown/Missing Data不知道/無資料 不知道個案是否有接受放射治療。
entries.label_en: Unknown/Missing Data: unknown/no data. Unknown whether the case received radiation therapy.

entries.label_zh: RT, NOS；RT as endocrine procedure放射治療，未明示範圍；放射線內分泌處置  個案有接受放射治療，但放射範圍未明示。 放射治療是單純內分泌處置，藉由破壞內分泌來間接地抑制腫瘤。
entries.label_en: RT, NOS; RT as endocrine procedure: radiation therapy, extent not specified; radiation as endocrine procedure  The case received radiation therapy, but the radiation field is not specified. Radiation therapy is purely an endocrine procedure, indirectly suppressing the tumor by destroying endocrine function.

entries.label_zh: No radiation therapy無放射治療 個案未接受放射治療。
entries.label_en: No radiation therapy: no radiation therapy. The case did not receive radiation therapy.

entries.label_zh: T原發腫瘤 放射範圍侷限於局部原發腫瘤。
entries.label_en: T primary tumor: radiation field limited to the local primary tumor.

entries.label_zh: N區域淋巴結 放射範圍侷限於區域淋巴結。
entries.label_en: N regional lymph nodes: radiation field limited to regional lymph nodes.

entries.label_zh: M 遠端轉移 放射範圍侷限於遠端轉移部位。
entries.label_en: M distant metastasis: radiation field limited to distant metastatic sites.

entries.label_zh: Extended lymphoid region廣泛淋巴區域 放射範圍為位於 mini-mantle、mantle、inverted Y 之淋巴組織或全身淋巴照射。本編碼只適用於何杰金氏症及非何杰金氏症個案。
entries.label_en: Extended lymphoid region: extensive lymphoid region. The radiation field is lymphoid tissue in a mini-mantle, mantle, or inverted Y field, or total lymphoid irradiation. This code applies only to Hodgkin and non-Hodgkin lymphoma cases.

entries.label_zh: Total body/Bone Marrow全身/全骨髓 全部身體或全骨髓均涵蓋於一次放射範圍內。
entries.label_en: Total body/Bone Marrow: total body/total bone marrow. The entire body or total bone marrow is covered in one radiation field.

entries.label_zh: Total skin全身皮膚 本編碼只適用於卡波西氏肉瘤、原發表皮淋巴癌或其他疾病需要做全身皮膚電子射線放射治療者。
entries.label_en: Total skin: total skin. This code applies only to Kaposi sarcoma, primary cutaneous lymphoma or other diseases requiring total skin electron beam radiation therapy.

entries.label_zh: 眼窩淋巴結外淋巴癌用 4cm x 4cm 照野(portals)放射治療。
entries.label_en: Extranodal orbital lymphoma treated with radiation therapy using 4cm x 4cm portals.

entries.label_zh: 為轉移性疾病給予全腦放射治療。
entries.label_en: Whole-brain radiation therapy given for metastatic disease.

entries.label_zh: 寡樹突間質瘤(oligodendroglioma)或神經膠母細胞瘤(glioblastoma)個案進行局部(limited)放射治療。
entries.label_en: Limited radiation therapy for an oligodendroglioma or glioblastoma case.

entries.label_zh: 左側扁桃腺癌個案，其口咽、上頸部及前鎖骨上區域接受外側對照(opposed lateral)照野放射治療。
entries.label_en: A left tonsil cancer case; the oropharynx, upper neck and anterior supraclavicular region received opposed lateral field radiation therapy.

entries.label_zh: 小型舌側癌個案接受組織插種(interstitial implant)放射治療。
entries.label_en: A small tongue-side cancer case received interstitial implant radiation therapy.

entries.label_zh: 於T1或T2 聲門腫瘤進行小外側照野(Small lateral fields)放射治療。
entries.label_en: Small lateral fields radiation therapy for a T1 or T2 glottic tumor.

entries.label_zh: 為終止肺癌個案之咳血症狀，於右側支氣管/肺門區域進行小照野(small portal)放射治療。
entries.label_en: Small portal radiation therapy to the right bronchial/hilar region to stop hemoptysis in a lung cancer case.

entries.label_zh: 因第 4 期淋巴癌或慢性骨髓性白血病(CML)所引起的脾臟功能亢進症而給予放射治療。
entries.label_en: Radiation therapy given for hypersplenism caused by stage 4 lymphoma or chronic myeloid leukemia (CML).

entries.label_zh: 乳癌腫瘤位於內側(medial)者，其切線照野(tangential fields)必須涵蓋內乳淋巴結區域；如果有 5 個淋巴結被侵犯之個案，應接受乳房切線照野加鎖骨上或腋窩照野之放射治療。
entries.label_en: For a breast cancer tumor located medially, the tangential fields must cover the internal mammary lymph node region; a case with 5 involved lymph nodes should receive radiation therapy with tangential breast fields plus supraclavicular or axillary fields.

entries.label_zh: 為防止局部復發，於乳房切除術後胸壁處給予預防性放射治療；另外，由於已知腫瘤污染，胸廓切開疤痕處也給予放射治療。
entries.label_en: To prevent local recurrence, prophylactic radiation therapy was given to the chest wall after mastectomy; in addition, because tumor contamination was known, radiation therapy was also given to the thoracotomy scar.

entries.label_zh: 以反轉(inverted) “T”或“Y”照野來治療個案因攝護腺癌轉移到腰椎及薦椎所引起的疼痛。
entries.label_en: Inverted "T" or "Y" fields used to treat pain caused by metastasis of prostate cancer to the lumbar spine and sacrum.

entries.label_zh: 為減輕骨髓瘤個案因許多「洞孔式(punched out)」病灶造成的不舒服而給予全頭骨(total skull)放射治療。
entries.label_en: Total skull radiation therapy given to relieve discomfort caused by many "punched out" lesions in a myeloma case.

entries.label_zh: 為減少腺病變(adenopathy)或淋巴球數目，慢性淋巴細胞白血病(CLL)個案接受每次10cGy共5次的全身放射治療。
entries.label_en: To reduce adenopathy or lymphocyte count, a chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) case received total body irradiation of 10 cGy per fraction for 5 fractions.

entries.label_zh: 高度分化第 1A期子宮內膜癌個案只接受空腔內治療(intracavitary therapy)。
entries.label_en: A well-differentiated stage 1A endometrial cancer case received intracavitary therapy only.

entries.label_zh: 因為轉移病灶侵犯到橈骨而接受前臂遠端之放射治療。
entries.label_en: Radiation therapy to the distal forearm because a metastatic lesion invaded the radius.

entries.label_zh: 個案鼠蹊淋巴結罹患 1A 期何杰金氏症，接受過全身性化學治療及鼠蹊淋巴節之局部放射治療。
entries.label_en: A case with stage 1A Hodgkin lymphoma of the inguinal lymph nodes received systemic chemotherapy and local radiation therapy to the inguinal lymph nodes.

entries.label_zh: 個案脊椎(spine)出現室管膜瘤(ependymoma)，於部分脊髓處接受放射治療。
entries.label_en: The case had an ependymoma of the spine and received radiation therapy to part of the spinal cord.

entries.label_zh: 卵巢癌個案出現左鎖骨上淋巴結轉移，於鎖骨上區域接受放射治療以預防神經性併發症。
entries.label_en: An ovarian cancer case with left supraclavicular lymph node metastasis received radiation therapy to the supraclavicular region to prevent neurological complications.

entries.label_zh: 原發為甲狀腺之淋巴癌個案接受甲狀線及甲狀腺之區域淋巴結放射治療。
entries.label_en: A lymphoma case with a thyroid primary received radiation therapy to the thyroid and thyroid regional lymph nodes.

entries.label_zh: 第4期後腹腔淋巴癌合併雙側眼球轉移之個案，眼球接受 4cm 4cm 照野治療。
entries.label_en: A stage 4 retroperitoneal lymphoma case with bilateral eyeball metastases; the eyeballs were treated with 4cm 4cm portals.

entries.label_zh: 為終止因原發食道癌直接侵犯所引發的咳血，對右側支氣管/肺門區域進行小照野放射治療。
entries.label_en: Small-field radiation therapy to the right bronchial/hilar region to stop hemoptysis caused by direct invasion of primary esophageal cancer.

entries.label_zh: 為終止因腎細胞癌轉移至支氣管內所引發的咳血，對右側支氣管/肺門區域進行小照野放射治療。
entries.label_en: Small-field radiation therapy to the right bronchial/hilar region to stop hemoptysis caused by metastasis of renal cell carcinoma into the bronchus.

entries.label_zh: 原發為脾臟之淋巴結外淋巴癌所引起的脾臟功能亢進症所進行之放射治療。
entries.label_en: Radiation therapy for hypersplenism caused by a primary extranodal lymphoma of the spleen.

entries.label_zh: 對胸壁或全乳房有侵犯、但未侵犯至區域淋巴結者所給予之放射治療。
entries.label_en: Radiation therapy given for invasion of the chest wall or the whole breast without involvement of regional lymph nodes.

entries.label_zh: 第1期睪丸精母細胞瘤(seminoma)個案，其周邊大動脈淋巴結(peri-aortic LN)和右總腸骨淋巴結(common iliac LN)進行之選擇性(elective)放射治療。
entries.label_en: For a stage 1 testicular seminoma case, elective radiation therapy to the peri-aortic lymph nodes (peri-aortic LN) and right common iliac lymph nodes (common iliac LN).

entries.label_zh: 高度分化第 4期子宮內膜癌個案術後給予陰道壁或內陰道空腔內近距放射治療。
entries.label_en: A well-differentiated stage 4 endometrial cancer case received postoperative vaginal wall or intravaginal intracavitary brachytherapy.

entries.label_zh: 第1A期何杰金淋巴癌個案接受外套式(mantle)放射治療。
entries.label_en: A stage 1A Hodgkin lymphoma case received mantle radiation therapy.

entries.label_zh: 胸腺第 IE 期瀰漫性大 B 細胞淋巴癌個案，接受 4 個療程的全身性化學治療及胸腺病灶放射治療。
entries.label_en: A stage IE diffuse large B-cell lymphoma case of the thymus received 4 courses of systemic chemotherapy and radiation therapy to the thymic lesion.

entries.label_zh: 罹患神經管母細胞瘤(medulloblastoma)之兒童接受腦脊髓放射治療 (或全神經軸放射治療)。
entries.label_en: A child with medulloblastoma received craniospinal radiation therapy (or whole neuraxis radiation therapy).

entries.label_zh: 甲狀腺癌個案接受碘-131同位素治療。
entries.label_en: Thyroid cancer case received iodine-131 radioisotope therapy.

entries.label_zh: 攝護腺癌合併全身成骨性(osteoblastic)骨轉移個案接受鍶-89放射同位素治療。
entries.label_en: A prostate cancer case with generalized osteoblastic bone metastases received strontium-89 radioisotope therapy.

entries.label_zh: 全身性皮膚 T細胞淋巴癌個案接受全身皮膚電子放射治療。
entries.label_en: A systemic cutaneous T-cell lymphoma case received total skin electron beam radiation therapy.

entries.label_zh: 鼻部皮膚基底細胞癌個案皮膚病灶接受放射治療。
entries.label_en: Basal cell carcinoma of the nasal skin; the skin lesion received radiation therapy.

entries.label_zh: 非小細胞肺癌併上腔靜脈症候群及單一腦轉移個案，進行原發腫瘤、縱隔腔和全腦之體外放射治療，並對腦轉移處進行追加放射手術治療。
entries.label_en: A non-small cell lung cancer case with superior vena cava syndrome and a single brain metastasis received external beam radiation therapy to the primary tumor, mediastinum and whole brain, with an additional radiosurgery boost to the brain metastasis.

entries.label_zh: T1N0M0 攝護腺癌個案只接受攝護腺低劑量率(low-dose-rate, LDR)近距放射治療。
entries.label_en: A T1N0M0 prostate cancer case received only low-dose-rate (LDR) brachytherapy of the prostate.

entries.label_zh: 第 2B 期子宮頸癌個案接受全骨盆體外放射治療及高劑量率(high-dose-rate, HDR)空腔內近距放射治療。
entries.label_en: A stage 2B cervical cancer case received whole pelvic external beam radiation therapy and high-dose-rate (HDR) intracavitary brachytherapy.

entries.label_zh: 原發不明個案其上後頸部淋巴結病變發現有轉移性鱗狀細胞癌，其鼻咽、口咽、下咽和及全頸部接受體外放射治療。
entries.label_en: A case with unknown primary and metastatic squamous cell carcinoma found in the upper posterior cervical lymph nodes; the nasopharynx, oropharynx, hypopharynx and whole neck received external beam radiation therapy.

entries.label_zh: 原發為多重淋巴結侵犯淋巴癌(C778)，CT報告描述huge neck lymph nodules level I directed invasion to tonsil，neck lymph nodules 及 tonsil 同時接受放射治療。
entries.label_en: Primary is lymphoma with multiple lymph node involvement (C778); CT report describes huge neck lymph nodules level I directed invasion to tonsil; the neck lymph nodules and tonsil received radiation therapy at the same time.

entries.label_zh: 醫師診斷 Hodgkin lymphoma，原發部位為 neck lymph node (C770) with tonsil involvement，針對 neck 及tonsil 接受放射線治療。
entries.label_en: Physician diagnosis of Hodgkin lymphoma, primary site neck lymph node (C770) with tonsil involvement; received radiation therapy to the neck and tonsil.

entries.label_zh: 原發為Mediastinum(C77.1)的Non-Hodgkin lymphoma，chest CT報告描述Mediastinum masses and bilateral lung nodules，針對 mediastum and lung 接受放射治療。
entries.label_en: Non-Hodgkin lymphoma with primary site Mediastinum (C77.1); chest CT report describes Mediastinum masses and bilateral lung nodules; received radiation therapy to the mediastum and lung.

entries.label_zh: Unknown/Missing Data不知道/無資料 不知道個案是否有接受放射治療。
entries.label_en: Unknown/Missing Data: unknown/no data. Unknown whether the case received radiation therapy.

entries.label_zh: RT modality, NOS有放射治療，詳情不明 個案有接受放射治療，但未明示使用的治療儀器或方法。
entries.label_en: RT modality, NOS: radiation therapy given, details unknown. The case received radiation therapy, but the equipment or method used is not specified.

entries.label_zh: No radiation therapy無放射治療 個案未接受放射治療。
entries.label_en: No radiation therapy: no radiation therapy. The case did not receive radiation therapy.

entries.label_zh: External Beam Radiation Therapy一般體外放射治療 • 包括鈷六十機(cobalt unit)、光子射線或電子射線之直線加速器(photon beam or electron beam from linear accelerator)及螺旋式斷層治療機(tomotherapy)。• 治療儀器描述為SBRT或SABR，且治療技術使用諾力刀(Norvalis)、IMRT、體積弧形放射治療(Rapid Arc® )或粒子(質子/碳離子)時，治療次數>6次或劑量＜800 cGy/次。
entries.label_en: External Beam Radiation Therapy: conventional external beam radiation therapy • Includes cobalt unit, photon beam or electron beam from linear accelerator, and tomotherapy. • When the treatment equipment is described as SBRT or SABR, and the treatment technique uses Novalis (Norvalis), IMRT, volumetric arc therapy (Rapid Arc® ) or particles (proton/carbon ion), the number of fractions is >6 or the dose is <800 cGy/fraction.

entries.label_zh: Radiosurgery放射手術 • 使用加馬刀(Gamma Knife)、Linac-based放射手術、電腦刀(Cyberknife)、Zap-X放射手術。• 立體定位放射手術(Stereotactic radiosurgery)：治療儀器描述為SBRT或SABR，且治療技術使用諾力刀(Norvalis)、IMRT、體積弧形放射治療(Rapid Arc® )或粒子(質子/碳離子)時，治療次數≦6且劑量≧800 cGy/次。
entries.label_en: Radiosurgery: radiosurgery • Uses Gamma Knife, Linac-based radiosurgery, CyberKnife, Zap-X radiosurgery. • Stereotactic radiosurgery: when the treatment equipment is described as SBRT or SABR, and the treatment technique uses Novalis (Norvalis), IMRT, volumetric arc therapy (Rapid Arc® ) or particles (proton/carbon ion), the number of fractions is ≤6 and the dose is ≥800 cGy/fraction.

entries.label_zh: Brachytherapy近距放射治療 近距放射治療、組織插種(interstitial implants)、molds、seeds、needles 或 intracavitary applicators of radioactive materials。
entries.label_en: Brachytherapy: brachytherapy. Brachytherapy, interstitial implants, molds, seeds, needles, or intracavitary applicators of radioactive materials.

entries.label_zh: Radioisotopes放射線同位素治療 注射放射性同位素，如：碘-131(I-131)、鍶-89(Sr-89)等物質進入體內。
entries.label_en: Radioisotopes: radioisotope therapy. Injection of radioactive isotopes into the body, such as iodine-131 (I-131), strontium-89 (Sr-89).

entries.label_zh: Protons therapy質子治療機 利用質子射線進行體外放射治療。
entries.label_en: Protons therapy: proton therapy machine. External beam radiation therapy using proton beams.

entries.label_zh: Other Charged Particles or Neutron Therapy其他帶電荷粒子或中子治療機 利用帶電荷粒子射線或中子射線進行體外放射治療。
entries.label_en: Other Charged Particles or Neutron Therapy: other charged particle or neutron therapy machines. External beam radiation therapy using charged particle beams or neutron beams.

entries.label_zh: 硼捉中子治療(BNCT) 硼捉中子治療(Boron Neutron Capture Therapy)。
entries.label_en: Boron neutron capture therapy (BNCT): Boron Neutron Capture Therapy.

entries.label_zh: 放射手術 近距放射治療 同位素放射治療 質子治療 碳離子治療 BNCT 放射治療儀器 體外放射治療技術編碼組合範圍 其他放射治療儀器
entries.label_en: Radiosurgery Brachytherapy Radioisotope therapy Proton therapy Carbon ion therapy BNCT Radiation therapy equipment Range of external beam radiation technique code combinations Other radiation therapy equipment

entries.label_zh: 記錄個案於申報醫院所接受放射治療的開始日期。前 4碼是西元年，第 5、6碼是月，而最後 2碼是日。
entries.label_en: Records the start date of radiation therapy the case received at the reporting hospital. The first 4 digits are the AD year, digits 5-6 the month, and the last 2 digits the day.

entries.label_zh:  沒有進行任何的放射治療。 由屍體解剖而診斷為癌症。
entries.label_en: No radiation therapy performed. Cancer diagnosed by autopsy.

entries.label_zh: 治療計畫中已經擬定準備要放射治療，但是在最近一次的追蹤，還尚未給予放射治療，這時候要編碼為 88888888。應於下一次追蹤時，更新其治療日期。
entries.label_en: If radiation therapy was planned in the treatment plan but had not yet been given at the most recent follow-up, code 88888888. The treatment date should be updated at the next follow-up.

entries.label_zh:  不知道個案是否有接受放射治療。 個案有接受放射治療，但是接受放射治療的日期不清楚。 僅由死亡證明書得知個案有癌症。
entries.label_en: Unknown whether the case received radiation therapy. The case received radiation therapy, but the date of radiation therapy is unclear. Cancer known only from the death certificate.

entries.label_zh: 記錄個案於申報醫院裡所接受放射治療的結束日期。前 4碼是西元年，第5、6碼是月，而最後 2 碼是日。
entries.label_en: Records the end date of radiation therapy the case received at the reporting hospital. The first 4 digits are the AD year, digits 5-6 the month, and the last 2 digits the day.

entries.label_zh:  沒有進行任何的放射治療。 由屍體解剖而診斷為癌症。
entries.label_en: No radiation therapy performed. Cancer diagnosed by autopsy.

entries.label_zh:  個案正接受首次療程中的放射治療，療程仍未結束。應於下一次追蹤時，更新其治療日期。 首次治療計畫中已經擬定準備要放射治療，但是在最近一次的追蹤，尚未給予放射治療。應於下一次追蹤時，更新其治療日期。
entries.label_en: The case is receiving radiation therapy as part of the first course of treatment and the course has not yet ended. The treatment date should be updated at the next follow-up. Radiation therapy was planned in the first treatment plan but had not yet been given at the most recent follow-up. The treatment date should be updated at the next follow-up.

entries.label_zh:  不知道個案是否有接受放射治療。 個案有接受放射治療，但是放射治療結束日期不清楚。 僅由死亡證明書得知個案有癌症。
entries.label_en: Unknown whether the case received radiation therapy. The case received radiation therapy, but the end date of radiation therapy is unclear. Cancer known only from the death certificate.

entries.label_zh: Unknown/Missing Data資料缺漏 不清楚是否有手術或放射治療
entries.label_en: Unknown/Missing Data: data missing. Unclear whether surgery or radiation therapy was performed

entries.label_zh: No surgery未手術  首次療程中個案有原發部位及區域淋巴結放射治療，但未接受原發部位及區域淋巴結手術 無原發部位或區域淋巴結手術，接受遠端部位預防性放射治療
entries.label_en: No surgery  In the first course of treatment the case received radiation therapy to the primary site and regional lymph nodes but no surgery to the primary site and regional lymph nodes. No surgery to the primary site or regional lymph nodes, with prophylactic radiation therapy to a distant site

entries.label_zh: No need to compare不需比較順序  結內淋巴癌、血液腫瘤疾病或遠端轉移個案 首次療程包含手術及放射治療，但治療範圍不同。
entries.label_en: No need to compare: no need to compare sequence. Intranodal lymphoma, hematologic malignancy or distant metastasis cases. The first course of treatment included surgery and radiation therapy, but the treated areas differ.

entries.label_zh: More than two locoregionl surgeries, and have locoregionl radiation therapy有兩次以上原發部位或區域淋巴結手術，無法決定順序 有兩次或兩次以上手術，而且兩次手術期間有進行原發部位或區域淋巴結放射治療
entries.label_en: More than two locoregionl surgeries, and have locoregionl radiation therapy: two or more primary site or regional lymph node surgeries, sequence cannot be determined  Two or more surgeries, with radiation therapy to the primary site or regional lymph nodes given between the two surgeries

entries.label_zh: Sequence unknown順序未明 首次癌症療程中有手術也有放射治療，但順序未明
entries.label_en: Sequence unknown: sequence unknown. The first course of cancer treatment included both surgery and radiation therapy, but the sequence is unknown

entries.label_zh: No radiation therapy無放射治療  首次癌症療程中個案未接受放射治療 首次療程不含放射治療亦不含手術
entries.label_en: No radiation therapy: no radiation therapy  The case did not receive radiation therapy in the first course of cancer treatment. The first course of treatment included neither radiation therapy nor surgery

entries.label_zh: Pre-operative radiation therapy手術前放射治療 手術前接受放射治療以縮小腫瘤
entries.label_en: Pre-operative radiation therapy: preoperative radiation therapy. Radiation therapy given before surgery to shrink the tumor

entries.label_zh: IORT手術中放射治療 手術中接受放射治療殘存或可能殘存的腫瘤
entries.label_en: IORT: intraoperative radiation therapy. Radiation therapy given intraoperatively to residual or possibly residual tumor

entries.label_zh: Post-operative radiation therapy手術後放射治療 手術後放射治療以降低局部復發率
entries.label_en: Post-operative radiation therapy: postoperative radiation therapy. Radiation therapy after surgery to reduce the local recurrence rate

Sequence of Locoregional Therapy and Sys.field_zh: 區域治療與全身性治療順序
Sequence of Locoregional Therapy and Sys.field_en: Sequence of Locoregional Therapy and Systemic Therapy

entries.label_zh: Unknown/Missing Data資料缺漏 不清楚是否有區域療法與全身性治療
entries.label_en: Unknown/Missing Data: data missing. Unclear whether regional therapy and systemic therapy were given

entries.label_zh: No regional therapy無區域治療  首次療程有全身性藥物治療而無區域治療 (不論是否有局部性藥物治療)
entries.label_en: No regional therapy: no regional therapy  The first course of treatment included systemic drug therapy without regional therapy (with or without local drug therapy)

entries.label_zh: Locoregional medical therapy局部性藥物治療  首次療程僅有局部性藥物治療而未使用全身性藥物治療 (不論是否有區域治療)
entries.label_en: Locoregional medical therapy: local drug therapy  The first course of treatment included only local drug therapy without systemic drug therapy (with or without regional therapy)

entries.label_zh: Sequence unknown；Systemic therapy as the major treatment modality順序未明；全身性治療為最主要的療法  首次療程中有區域治療與全身性治療，但順序未明 結內淋巴癌、血液腫瘤疾病或遠端轉移個案
entries.label_en: Sequence unknown; Systemic therapy as the major treatment modality: sequence unknown; systemic therapy is the main treatment modality  The first course of treatment included both regional treatment and systemic therapy, but the sequence is unknown. Intranodal lymphoma, hematologic malignancy, or distant metastasis cases

entries.label_zh: No medical therapy無藥物治療 首次療程中不含化學藥物、荷爾蒙、免疫及標靶治療，不論是否有接受區域治療
entries.label_en: No medical therapy: no drug therapy. The first course of treatment did not include chemotherapy drugs, hormone, immune or targeted therapy, with or without regional therapy

entries.label_zh: Induction/Neoadjuvant導引/前導性輔助療法  手術前進行全身性治療 當放射治療是主要的局部治療方式時，全身性治療在放射治療前進行 先給予全身性治療再進行術前放射治療
entries.label_en: Induction/Neoadjuvant: induction/neoadjuvant therapy  Systemic therapy before surgery. When radiation therapy is the main local treatment, systemic therapy given before radiation therapy. Systemic therapy first, then preoperative radiation therapy

entries.label_zh: Concurrent/Concomitant同步療法  全身性藥物治療與區域治療同步進行 全身性化學治療同步放射治療(CCRT) 手 術 旁 全 身 性 藥 物 治 療 (perioperative chemotherapy)
entries.label_en: Concurrent/Concomitant: concurrent therapy  Systemic drug therapy given at the same time as regional treatment. Concurrent systemic chemotherapy and radiation therapy (CCRT). Perioperative systemic drug therapy (perioperative chemotherapy)

entries.label_zh: Adjuvant輔助療法  手術後進行全身性治療 當放射治療是主要的局部治療方式(definitive RT)時，全身性治療在放射治療後進行
entries.label_en: Adjuvant: adjuvant therapy  Systemic therapy after surgery. When radiation therapy is the main local treatment (definitive RT), systemic therapy given after radiation therapy

entries.label_zh: 個案僅於申報醫院接受首次療程的放射治療。
entries.label_en: The case received radiation therapy as part of the first course of treatment only at the reporting hospital.

entries.label_zh: 放射治療非既定之首次療程計畫中的一部分。
entries.label_en: Radiation therapy was not part of the planned first course of treatment.

entries.label_zh: 放射治療因禁忌症或個案其他危險因素(併發症、年邁)而未建議或給予。
entries.label_en: Radiation therapy was not recommended or given because of contraindications or other risk factors of the case (complications, advanced age).

entries.label_zh: 放射治療因疾病進展而未建議或給予。
entries.label_en: Radiation therapy was not recommended or given because of disease progression.

entries.label_zh: 個案於申報醫院接受首次療程的放射治療，但病人因個人因素(例如：併發症、體力不佳、副作用、死亡等)未完成既定放射治療之療程。
entries.label_en: The case received radiation therapy in the first course of treatment at the reporting hospital, but did not complete the planned radiation therapy course because of personal factors of the patient (for example: complications, poor physical condition, side effects, death).

entries.label_zh: 放射治療是既定之首次療程計畫中的一部分，但因個案未接受前即死亡或病危出院。
entries.label_en: Radiation therapy was part of the planned first course of treatment, but the case died or was discharged in critical condition before receiving it.

entries.label_zh: 放射治療是既定之首次療程計畫中的一部分，未執行且病歷也未記載未執行的原因。
entries.label_en: Radiation therapy was part of the planned first course of treatment, but was not performed and the medical record does not state the reason.

entries.label_zh: 放射治療是既定之首次療程計畫中的一部分，但病歷記載個案或其家屬拒絕放射治療。
entries.label_en: Radiation therapy was part of the planned first course of treatment, but the medical record states that the case or family refused radiation therapy.

entries.label_zh: 放射治療雖是既定之首次療程計畫中的一部分，但摘錄時尚未執行。
entries.label_en: Radiation therapy was part of the planned first course of treatment, but had not yet been performed at the time of abstraction.

entries.label_zh: 個案僅於外院接受首次療程的放射治療。
entries.label_en: The case received radiation therapy as part of the first course of treatment only at another hospital.

entries.label_zh: 個案於外院及申報醫院皆接受首次療程的放射治療。
entries.label_en: The case received radiation therapy as part of the first course of treatment at both another hospital and the reporting hospital.

entries.label_zh:  由於病歷未記載，所以不知道放射治療是否有被建議或是已經執行。 個案是在死後解剖後才診斷癌症、或僅由死亡證明書得知個案有癌症。
entries.label_en: The medical record does not document whether radiation therapy was recommended or performed, so it is unknown. The case's cancer was diagnosed only after autopsy, or known only from the death certificate.

entries.label_zh: Unknown/Missing Data資料缺漏 不清楚是否有體外放射治療
entries.label_en: Unknown/Missing Data: data missing. Unclear whether external beam radiation therapy was given

entries.label_zh: EBRT, NOS體外放射治療儀器不明 有體外放射治療但其詳細儀器不明
entries.label_en: EBRT, NOS: external beam radiation therapy equipment unknown. External beam radiation therapy given but the specific equipment is unknown

entries.label_zh: No EBRT無體外放射治療 無體外放射治療
entries.label_en: No EBRT: no external beam radiation therapy. No external beam radiation therapy

entries.label_zh:  2D/Simple CT Simulation二維或簡單電腦斷層定位 Particle Passive Scattering被動散射粒子治療  二維或簡單電腦斷層定位 粒子治療採用被動散射 (Passive scattering)技術達成 SOBP(Spread Out Bregg Peak)
entries.label_en: 2D/Simple CT Simulation: two-dimensional or simple CT simulation. Particle Passive Scattering: passive scattering particle therapy  Two-dimensional or simple CT simulation. Particle therapy using the passive scattering technique to achieve SOBP (Spread Out Bregg Peak)

entries.label_zh:  3D Conformal RT三維順形放射治療 Active Scanning with Single Field Uniform Dose (SFUD)主動掃描均勻照野粒子治療  三維順形放射治療 粒子治療採用主動掃描(Active scanning)技術達成SOBP (Spread Out Bregg Peak)，但個別照野採用均勻劑量(Single Field Uniform Dose，SFUD)
entries.label_en: 3D Conformal RT: three-dimensional conformal radiation therapy Active Scanning with Single Field Uniform Dose (SFUD): active scanning uniform-field particle therapy  Three-dimensional conformal radiation therapy. Particle therapy using the active scanning technique to achieve SOBP (Spread Out Bregg Peak), with each individual field using a uniform dose (Single Field Uniform Dose, SFUD)

entries.label_zh:  IMRT強度調控放射治療 IMPT強度調控粒子治療  固定角度強度調控放射治療(Intensity Modulated Radiation Therapy) 包括：滑動窗口動態多葉式準直儀(Sliding window, dynamic multi-leaf collimator, dMLC)，或一停頓一照射的靜態準直儀(step-and-shoot or stop-and-shoot)，或諾力刀(Norvalis)
entries.label_en: IMRT: intensity-modulated radiation therapy IMPT: intensity-modulated particle therapy  Fixed-angle intensity-modulated radiation therapy (Intensity Modulated Radiation Therapy), including: sliding window dynamic multi-leaf collimator (Sliding window, dynamic multi-leaf collimator, dMLC), or stop-and-irradiate static collimator (step-and-shoot or stop-and-shoot), or Novalis (Norvalis)

entries.label_zh: 旋轉式強度調控放射治療 旋轉式強度調控放射治療包括： 扇形放射線束強度調控放射治療：螺旋式(helical，Tomotherapy®斷層放射治療)、步進式(axial，Peacock®)。 體積弧形放射治療(Rapid Arc®)或全體積強度調控弧形放射治療(VMAT®)。
entries.label_en: Rotational intensity-modulated radiation therapy. Rotational intensity-modulated radiation therapy includes: fan-beam intensity-modulated radiation therapy: helical (helical, Tomotherapy®), step-and-shoot (axial, Peacock®). Volumetric arc therapy (Rapid Arc®) or volumetric modulated arc therapy (VMAT®).

entries.label_zh: Mixed Photon and Charged Particle Therapy, or Mixed Charged Particle Therapy (mixed proton and carbon ion therapy)合併光子和帶電粒子治療或合併質子和碳離子治療  此編碼僅適用於放射治療包含三種治療：光子治療、質子或碳離子治療，與放射手術或近接放射治療。 此編碼不可單獨摘錄，必須加總體外放射技術編碼1、2、4、8、32、64。
entries.label_en: Mixed Photon and Charged Particle Therapy, or Mixed Charged Particle Therapy (mixed proton and carbon ion therapy): combined photon and charged particle therapy, or combined proton and carbon ion therapy  This code applies only when radiation therapy includes three types of treatment: photon therapy, proton or carbon ion therapy, and radiosurgery or brachytherapy. This code cannot be abstracted alone; it must be the sum of external beam radiation technique codes 1, 2, 4, 8, 32, 64.

entries.label_zh: IGRT影像導引放射治療 影像導引放射治療(Image-guided radiation therapy)使用內建或外加式影像擷取器材以改善體外放射治療執行時的精確性。
entries.label_en: IGRT: image-guided radiation therapy. Image-guided radiation therapy uses built-in or add-on imaging equipment to improve the accuracy of external beam radiation therapy delivery.

entries.label_zh: Respiratory Control Radiotherary呼吸監控技術 透過電腦呼吸監控技術可以改善胸腹部癌症執行時的精確性包括：Respiratory Gaiting、Respiratory Tracking、Active Breath Control(ABC)。不包括：Abdominal Compression、Breath Hold。
entries.label_en: Respiratory Control Radiotherary: respiratory monitoring technology. Computerized respiratory monitoring technology can improve accuracy when treating thoracic and abdominal cancers, including: Respiratory Gaiting, Respiratory Tracking, Active Breath Control (ABC). Excludes: Abdominal Compression, Breath Hold.

Target of CTV_H.field_zh: 最高放射劑量臨床標靶體積

entries.label_zh: Unknown/Missing Data不知道/無資料 不知道個案是否有接受體外放射治療。
entries.label_en: Unknown/Missing Data: unknown/no data. Unknown whether the case received external beam radiation therapy.

entries.label_zh: EBRT, NOS；EBRT as endocrine procedure體外放射治療，未明示範圍；放射線內分泌處置  個案有接受體外放射治療，但放射範圍未明示。 放射治療是單純內分泌處置，藉由破壞內分泌功能來間接地抑制腫瘤，且未針對腫瘤範圍做直接照射。
entries.label_en: EBRT, NOS; EBRT as endocrine procedure: external beam radiation therapy, extent not specified; radiation as endocrine procedure  The case received external beam radiation therapy, but the radiation field is not specified. Radiation therapy is purely an endocrine procedure, indirectly suppressing the tumor by destroying endocrine function, with no direct irradiation of the tumor area.

entries.label_zh: 假如治療計畫含其他治療，但在最近一次的追蹤還尚未進行，則編碼為88888888。若此個案後續接受其他治療，本欄位項目須加以更新。
entries.label_en: If the treatment plan includes other treatment but it had not yet been given at the most recent follow-up, code 88888888. If the case later receives other treatment, this field must be updated.

entries.label_zh:  不知道個案是否有接受其他治療。 個案有接受其他治療，但是日期不清楚。 僅由死亡證明書得知個案有癌症。
entries.label_en: Unknown whether the case received other treatment. The case received other treatment, but the date is unclear. Cancer known only from the death certificate.

Date of First Recurrence or Cancer Statu.field_zh: 首次復發或癌症狀態追蹤日期
Date of First Recurrence or Cancer Statu.field_en: Date of First Recurrence or Cancer Status Follow-Up

entries.label_zh:  記錄個案被首次診斷為復發的日期。 若個案首療後為disease-free且無復發，則記錄該狀態最後追蹤日期。 若個案從未disease-free，則記錄該狀態最後追蹤日期。
entries.label_en: Records the date the case was first diagnosed with recurrence. If the case was disease-free after the first course of treatment with no recurrence, records the date of last follow-up for this status. If the case was never disease-free, records the date of last follow-up for this status.

entries.label_zh: 由屍體解剖而診斷為癌症。
entries.label_en: Cancer diagnosed by autopsy.

entries.label_zh:  不確定癌症是否曾復發或曾disease-free過 (通常為個案分類3者)。 有復發，但復發日期不詳。
entries.label_en: Uncertain whether the cancer has ever recurred or ever been disease-free (usually case category 3). Recurred, but the recurrence date is unknown.

entries.label_zh: 個案治療後 disease-free且沒有復發。
entries.label_en: The case was disease-free after treatment with no recurrence.

entries.label_zh: 侵襲癌以原位癌的形式復發。
entries.label_en: Invasive cancer recurring as carcinoma in situ.

entries.label_zh: 原位癌以原位癌的形式復發。
entries.label_en: Carcinoma in situ recurring as carcinoma in situ.

entries.label_zh: 局部復發，且無足夠的資訊可供編碼為 13-17。局部復發是指復發在原發器官的殘存組織、在原發器官、在吻合處、或之前器官所在處的疤痕組織。
entries.label_en: Local recurrence, with insufficient information to code as 13-17. Local recurrence means recurrence in residual tissue of the primary organ, in the primary organ, at the anastomosis, or in scar tissue where the organ previously was.
Invasive cancer with local recurrence.

entries.label_zh: 侵襲癌於套管處(trocar)復發。包括在套管的路徑上或之前手術切開處(entrance site)上復發。
entries.label_en: Invasive cancer recurring at the trocar site. Includes recurrence along the trocar path or at the entrance site of the previous surgical incision.

entries.label_zh: 侵襲癌同時於局部(編碼13)及套管處(編碼14)復發。
entries.label_en: Invasive cancer with simultaneous recurrence locally (code 13) and at the port site (code 14).

entries.label_zh: 原位癌於局部復發，其他未詳細描述。
entries.label_en: Carcinoma in situ with local recurrence, not otherwise described in detail.

entries.label_zh: 原位癌同時於局部及套管處復發。
entries.label_en: Carcinoma in situ with simultaneous local and port-site recurrence.

entries.label_zh: 區域性復發，且無足夠資訊可供編碼為 21-27。
entries.label_en: Regional recurrence, with insufficient information to code as 21-27.

entries.label_zh: 侵襲癌僅於鄰近組織或器官復發。
entries.label_en: Invasive cancer with recurrence only in adjacent tissue or organs.

entries.label_zh: 侵襲癌僅於區域淋巴結復發。
entries.label_en: Invasive cancer with recurrence only in regional lymph nodes.

entries.label_zh: 侵襲癌同時於鄰近組織或器官(編碼21)及區域淋巴結復發(編碼22)。
entries.label_en: Invasive cancer with simultaneous recurrence in adjacent tissue or organs (code 21) and regional lymph nodes (code 22).

entries.label_zh: 原位癌於區域性復發，其他未詳細描述。
entries.label_en: Carcinoma in situ with regional recurrence, not otherwise described in detail.

entries.label_zh: 原位癌同時於鄰近組織或器官以及區域淋巴結復發。
entries.label_en: Carcinoma in situ with simultaneous recurrence in adjacent tissue or organs and regional lymph nodes.

entries.label_zh: 侵襲癌之復發以下二組編碼中各一種復發型式之組合： 鄰近組織/器官或區域淋巴結復發(編碼20-25) 局部、先前手術套管處或是手術切開處復發(編碼10, 13-15)
entries.label_en: Recurrence of invasive cancer: a combination of one recurrence type from each of the following two groups of codes: recurrence in adjacent tissue/organ or regional lymph nodes (codes 20-25); recurrence locally, at a previous surgical port site, or at the surgical incision (codes 10, 13-15)

entries.label_zh: 原位癌之復發以下二組編碼中各一種復發型式之組合： 鄰近組織/器官或區域淋巴結復發(編碼26-27) 局部、先前手術套管處或是手術切開處復發(編碼16-17)
entries.label_en: Recurrence of carcinoma in situ: a combination of one recurrence type from each of the following two groups of codes: recurrence in adjacent tissue/organ or regional lymph nodes (codes 26-27); recurrence locally, at a previous surgical port site, or at the surgical incision (codes 16-17)

entries.label_zh: 遠端復發，且無足夠資訊可供編碼為 46-62。
entries.label_en: Distant recurrence, with insufficient information to code as 46-62.
Carcinoma in situ with distant recurrence.

entries.label_zh: 侵襲癌僅於腹膜 (peritoneum) 發生遠端復發，或腹水呈現惡性細胞。
entries.label_en: Invasive cancer with distant recurrence only in the peritoneum, or ascites showing malignant cells.

entries.label_zh: 侵襲癌僅於肺臟(包括visceral pleura)發生遠端復發。
entries.label_en: Invasive cancer with distant recurrence only in the lung (including visceral pleura).

entries.label_zh: 侵襲癌僅於 pleura發生遠端復發，或肋膜滲液呈現惡性細胞。
entries.label_en: Invasive cancer with distant recurrence only in the pleura, or pleural effusion showing malignant cells.

entries.label_zh: 侵襲癌僅於肝發生遠端復發。
entries.label_en: Invasive cancer with distant recurrence only in the liver.

entries.label_zh: 侵襲癌僅於骨骼發生遠端復發，但原發部位的骨骼除外。
entries.label_en: Invasive cancer with distant recurrence only in bone, excluding the bone of the primary site.

entries.label_zh: 侵襲癌僅於 CNS(包括brain 和 spinal cord，但 external eye除外)發生遠端復發。
entries.label_en: Invasive cancer with distant recurrence only in the CNS (including brain and spinal cord, but excluding external eye).

entries.label_zh: 侵襲癌僅於皮膚發生遠端復發，但原發部位的皮膚除外。
entries.label_en: Invasive cancer with distant recurrence only in skin, excluding the skin of the primary site.

entries.label_zh: 侵襲癌僅於遠端淋巴結復發，請參考各癌症別遠端淋巴結的定義。
entries.label_en: Invasive cancer with distant recurrence only in distant lymph nodes; refer to the definition of distant lymph nodes for each cancer site.

entries.label_zh: 侵襲癌僅發生全身性(systemic)遠端復發，包括 lymphoma、leukemia、bone marrow metastasis、carcinomatosis 或generalized disease 等。
entries.label_en: Invasive cancer with only systemic distant recurrence, including lymphoma, leukemia, bone marrow metastasis, carcinomatosis or generalized disease.

entries.label_zh: 侵襲癌之復發為以下二組編碼中各一種復發型式之組合： 單一或多處遠端部位復發合併 局部或區域復發(編碼10-15、20-25或30)
entries.label_en: Recurrence of invasive cancer is a combination of one recurrence type from each of the following two groups of codes: single or multiple distant site recurrence combined with local or regional recurrence (codes 10-15, 20-25 or 30)

entries.label_zh: 侵襲癌於多處遠端部位復發
entries.label_en: Invasive cancer with recurrence at multiple distant sites

entries.label_zh: 個案癌症確診後從未 disease-free過。包括： 診斷為癌症時即已有遠端轉移。 全身性癌症。 原發部位不清楚。 癌症情況不嚴重尚未加以治療。
entries.label_en: Never disease-free after the cancer was confirmed. Includes: distant metastasis already present at diagnosis. Systemic cancer. Unknown primary site. Cancer not severe and not yet treated.

entries.label_zh: 癌症有復發，但復發型式不詳。
entries.label_en: Cancer recurred, but the recurrence type is unknown.

entries.label_zh: 不確定癌症是否曾復發或曾 disease-free 過 (通常為個案分類 3者)。
entries.label_en: Uncertain whether the cancer has ever recurred or ever been disease-free (usually case category 3).

Date of Last Contact or Death.field_en: Date of Last Contact or Death

entries.label_zh: 記錄個案的最後聯絡日期或是死亡日期。
entries.label_en: Records the case's date of last contact or date of death.
Dead.
Alive.

entries.label_zh: < 100 cm 之身高數值(採四捨五入)。
entries.label_en: Height value <100 cm (rounded).

entries.label_zh: ≧100 cm 之身高數值(採四捨五入)。
entries.label_en: Height value ≥100 cm (rounded).
Not recorded in medical record or unknown.

entries.label_zh: < 100kg 之體重數值(採四捨五入)。
entries.label_en: Body weight value <100kg (rounded).

entries.label_zh: ≧100kg 之體重數值(採四捨五入)。
entries.label_en: Body weight value ≥100kg (rounded).
Not recorded in medical record or unknown.

entries.label_zh: 個案診斷前最近一次病歷記載，個案目前有抽菸，每日抽 1包菸(20 支)，抽菸時間長達 5年。
entries.label_en: The most recent medical record before diagnosis states the case currently smokes, 1 pack (20 cigarettes) per day, and has smoked for 5 years.

entries.label_zh: 個案診斷前最近一次病歷記載，個案已戒菸 10 年，以前有抽菸，每日抽半包菸(10支)，抽菸年度不詳。
entries.label_en: The most recent medical record before diagnosis states the case quit smoking 10 years ago, previously smoked half a pack (10 cigarettes) per day, and the year of smoking is unknown.

entries.label_zh: 個案診斷前最近一次病歷記載，個案已戒菸 10 年，以前有抽菸，每日抽 5包菸(100支)，抽菸年度不詳。
entries.label_en: The most recent medical record before diagnosis states the case quit smoking 10 years ago, previously smoked 5 packs (100 cigarettes) per day, and the year of smoking is unknown.

entries.label_zh: 個案診斷前最近一次病歷記載，個案偶爾抽菸，目前還有抽，抽菸時間長達 5年。
entries.label_en: The most recent medical record before diagnosis states the case smokes occasionally, still smokes currently, and has smoked for 5 years.

entries.label_zh: 個案診斷前最近一次病歷記載，個案抽菸每日抽 1-1.5包菸(20-30支)，目前還有抽，抽了 14.3年。
entries.label_en: The most recent medical record before diagnosis states the case smokes 1-1.5 packs (20-30 cigarettes) per day, still smokes currently, and has smoked for 14.3 years.

entries.label_zh: 個案診斷前最近一次病歷記載，個案以前每日抽＞1包菸(＞20支)，抽菸時間＜10年，已戒菸＞20年。
entries.label_en: The most recent medical record before diagnosis states the case previously smoked >1 pack (>20 cigarettes) per day for <10 years, and has quit smoking for >20 years.

entries.label_zh: 個案診斷前最近一次病歷記載，個案目前有嚼檳榔，每日嚼20顆，嚼檳榔時間長達 5年。
entries.label_en: The most recent medical record before diagnosis states the case currently chews betel quid, 20 quids per day, and has chewed for 5 years.

entries.label_zh: 個案診斷前最近一次病歷記載，個案已戒檳榔 10 年，以前有嚼檳榔，每日嚼10顆，嚼檳榔年度不詳。
entries.label_en: The most recent medical record before diagnosis states the case quit betel quid 10 years ago, previously chewed 10 quids per day, and the year of chewing is unknown.

entries.label_zh: 個案診斷前最近一次病歷記載，個案已戒檳榔 10 年，以前有嚼檳榔，每日嚼90顆，嚼檳榔年度不詳。
entries.label_en: The most recent medical record before diagnosis states the case quit betel quid 10 years ago, previously chewed 90 quids per day, and the year of chewing is unknown.

entries.label_zh: 個案診斷前最近一次病歷記載，個案偶爾嚼檳榔，目前還有嚼，嚼檳榔時間長達 5年。
entries.label_en: The most recent medical record before diagnosis states the case chews betel quid occasionally, still chews currently, and has chewed for 5 years.

entries.label_zh: 個案診斷前最近一次病歷記載，個案每日嚼檳榔 20-30顆，目前還有嚼，嚼了 14.3年。
entries.label_en: The most recent medical record before diagnosis states the case chews 20-30 betel quids per day, still chews currently, and has chewed for 14.3 years.

entries.label_zh: 個案診斷前最近一次病歷記載，個案以前每日嚼檳榔＞20顆，嚼檳榔時間＜10 年，已戒嚼＞20年。
entries.label_en: The most recent medical record before diagnosis states the case previously chewed >20 betel quids per day for <10 years, and has quit chewing for >20 years.
Never drank alcohol.
Quit.
Drinks occasionally (regardless of years).
Habitual drinking <10 years.
Habitual drinking ≥10 years.

entries.label_zh: 習慣性喝酒，但年數不詳。
entries.label_en: Habitual drinking, but years unknown.
Not recorded in medical record or unknown.

Assessment of Performance Status before.field_zh: 首次治療前生活功能狀態評估
Assessment of Performance Status before.field_en: Assessment of Performance Status before Treatment

entries.label_zh: 100 正常，沒有任何抱怨，確定沒有疾病
entries.label_en: 100 Normal, no complaints, no evidence of disease

entries.label_zh: 90 可以正常活動，有一些疾病症狀
entries.label_en: 90 Able to carry on normal activity, with some symptoms of disease

entries.label_zh: 80 可以稍微正常活動，已經有一些疾病的症狀
entries.label_en: 80 Normal activity with effort, some symptoms of disease

entries.label_zh: 70 可以自我照顧，但無法從事正常活動
entries.label_en: 70 Cares for self, but unable to carry on normal activity

entries.label_zh: 60 有時需要別人幫助，但能照顧自己大部分需要
entries.label_en: 60 Requires occasional assistance, but is able to care for most of own needs

entries.label_zh: 50 需要考慮別人幫助，經常給予醫療照顧
entries.label_en: 50 Requires considerable assistance, frequent medical care

entries.label_zh: 40 傷殘，需要特別照顧及幫助
entries.label_en: 40 Disabled, requires special care and assistance

entries.label_zh: 30 嚴重傷殘，尚未有死亡的危險
entries.label_en: 30 Severely disabled, not yet at risk of death

entries.label_zh: 20 病情嚴重，尚未有死亡的危險
entries.label_en: 20 Very sick, not yet at risk of death

entries.label_zh: 10 病況緊急，很快有死亡的危險
entries.label_en: 10 Moribund, at imminent risk of death
0 Died without treatment

entries.label_zh: 0 活動性與生病之前無異，不受疾病影響
entries.label_en: 0 Activity unchanged from before illness, not affected by disease

entries.label_zh: 1 無法做劇烈活動，但可以走動與從事輕鬆或坐著的工作，例如：家事、辦公室內的工作
entries.label_en: 1 Unable to carry out strenuous activity, but ambulatory and able to do light or sedentary work, for example: housework, office work

entries.label_zh: 2 可以走動，可以完全自我照顧，但無法工作，一半以上的清醒時刻是可以下床的
entries.label_en: 2 Ambulatory, capable of all self-care but unable to work; up and about more than half of waking hours

entries.label_zh: 3 自我照顧能力有限，一半以上的清醒時刻需臥床或坐輪椅
entries.label_en: 3 Limited self-care; confined to bed or wheelchair more than half of waking hours

entries.label_zh: 4 處於完全失能狀態，生活完全無法自理，整天臥床或坐輪椅
entries.label_en: 4 Completely disabled; totally unable to care for self; confined to bed or wheelchair all day
5 Died without treatment
KPS=0 and/or ECOG PS=5.

entries.label_zh: 不適用。 首次療程已在他院執行，無法取得治療前之生活功能狀態評估值。
entries.label_en: Not applicable. The first course of treatment was already performed at another hospital, and the pre-treatment functional status assessment cannot be obtained.
Not recorded in medical record or unknown.
